-- Shared rig topology: legacy joints and attachment-based avatar constraints.
local Rig = {}
function Rig.links(model)
    local links={}
    local function add(object,a,b,c0,c1,transform)
        if a and b and a:IsA("BasePart") and b:IsA("BasePart") and a:IsDescendantOf(model) and b:IsDescendantOf(model) then
            table.insert(links,{Object=object,A=a,B=b,C0=c0,C1=c1,Transform=transform or CFrame.new()})
        end
    end
    for _,item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("JointInstance") then
            add(item,item.Part0,item.Part1,item.C0,item.C1,item:IsA("Motor6D") and item.Transform or nil)
        elseif item:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
            local a,b=item.Part0,item.Part1
            if a and b then add(item,a,b,a.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(b.CFrame),CFrame.new()) end
        elseif item:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or item:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
            local a,b=item.Attachment0,item.Attachment1
            if a and b then add(item,a.Parent,b.Parent,a.CFrame,b.CFrame,item:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and item.Transform or nil) end
        end
    end
    return links
end
function Rig.reachable(model,pose)
    local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    assert(root and root:IsA("BasePart"),"Model has no HumanoidRootPart.")
    local known={[root]=true}; local links=Rig.links(model)
    for _=1,#links+1 do
        local changed=false
        for _,link in ipairs(links) do
            local a,b=link.A,link.B
-- cache YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
            if known[a] and not known[b] then
                if pose then b.CFrame=a.CFrame*link.C0*link.Transform*link.C1:Inverse() end
                known[b]=true; changed=true
            elseif known[b] and not known[a] then
                if pose then a.CFrame=b.CFrame*link.C1*link.Transform:Inverse()*link.C0:Inverse() end
                known[a]=true; changed=true
            end
        end
        if not changed then break end
    end
    return known
end
function Rig.repair(model)
    local known=Rig.reachable(model,false)
    local groups={}
    for _,part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _,attachment in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                if attachment:IsA("Attachment") and attachment.Name:match("RigAttachment$") then
                    groups[attachment.Name]=groups[attachment.Name] or {}
                    table.insert(groups[attachment.Name],attachment)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Connect only across the reached/unreached boundary: no duplicate motor or cycles.
    for _=1,20 do
        local changed=false
        for name,attachments in pairs(groups) do
            for _,a in ipairs(attachments) do
                if known[a.Parent] then
                    for _,b in ipairs(attachments) do
                        if a.Parent~=b.Parent and not known[b.Parent] then
                            local joint=Instance.new("Motor6D"); joint.Name=name:gsub("RigAttachment$","")
                            joint.C0=a.CFrame; joint.C1=b.CFrame; joint.Part0=a.Parent; joint.Part1=b.Parent; joint.Parent=b.Parent
                            known=Rig.reachable(model,false); changed=true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not changed then break end
    end
    return known
end

local API = {}
function API.description(id)
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(id) end)
    if not ok then ok, result = pcall(function() return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(id) end) end
    if not ok or not result then error("Avatar unavailable: " .. tostring(result), 0) end
    return result
end
function API.model(desc, rig)
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(desc, rig) end)
    if not ok then ok, result = pcall(function() return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, rig) end) end
    if not ok or not result then error("The avatar model could not be created: " .. tostring(result), 0) end
    -- Makeup is drawn as one decal composed from the description's MakeupDescriptions. It is tagged so a saved
    -- snapshot neither stores it nor removes it: the description rebuilds it.
    pcall(function()
        local hum = result:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local applied = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("HumanoidDescription")
        for _, item in ipairs(applied and applied:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if item.ClassName == "MakeupDescription" then
                local decal = item:GetAppliedInstance()
                if typeof(decal) == "Instance" then decal:SetAttribute("Lyra_Makeup", true) end
            elseif item.ClassName == "AccessoryDescription" then
                -- Each accessory knows its catalog id, so removing one in the shop needs no rebuild (see Catalog.edit).
                pcall(function()
                    local accessory = item:GetAppliedInstance()
                    if typeof(accessory) == "Instance" and accessory:IsA("Accessory") and tonumber(item.AssetId) then
                        accessory:SetAttribute("Lyra_AssetId", tonumber(item.AssetId))
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
    return result
end

local SafeToolWatchers = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
F.protectSafeTool = function(inst)
    if not inst then return end
    S_SafeTools[inst] = true
    for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do S_SafeTools[child] = true end
    if not SafeToolWatchers[inst] then
        SafeToolWatchers[inst] = RegisterConnection(inst.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if S_SafeTools[inst] then S_SafeTools[child] = true end
        end))
    end
end

-- Distinguishes game accessories (for example, MM2 waist weapons) from avatar items.
S.ownAccNames = nil
-- The description the game applied to your character (a Catalog Creator outfit, a morph). The copier replaces its
-- own copy on the Humanoid, so the game's one is remembered before that (see applySnapshot).
F.gameDescription = function()
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        for _, item in ipairs(hum:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("HumanoidDescription") and not item:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") then return item:Clone() end
        end
    end
    return S.gameDescription and S.gameDescription:Clone() or nil
end
F.descSignature = function(desc)
    local ids = {}
    pcall(function() for _, row in ipairs(desc:GetAccessories(true)) do table.insert(ids, tostring(row.AssetId)) end end)
    table.sort(ids)
    return table.concat(ids, ",")
end
-- Accessory names (and body effects) of your own avatar and of the look the game gave you. Accessories with these
-- names are avatar items, so a copied avatar replaces them instead of mixing with them; anything else on the
-- character belongs to the game and stays. The game's part is rebuilt only when its look changes.
F.getSafeAccessoryNames = function()
    local rt = (F.getTrueRigType(lp.Character)) or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
    local function collect(desc, names, effects)
        local model = API.model(desc, rt)
        for _, item in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Accessory") then names[item.Name] = true
            elseif item:IsA("BasePart") and S.BD[item.Name] then
                for _, effect in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                    if effect:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or effect:IsA("Fire") or effect:IsA("Smoke") or effect:IsA("Sparkles") or effect:IsA("Light") or effect:IsA("Trail") or effect:IsA("Beam") then
                        effects[item.Name .. "/" .. effect.Name .. "/" .. effect.ClassName] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
    end
    if not S.ownAvatarNames then
        local names, effects = {}, {}
        if pcall(function() collect(API.description(lp.UserId), names, effects) end) then S.ownAvatarNames = names; S.ownEffectNames = effects end
    end
    local gameDesc = F.gameDescription()
    local signature = gameDesc and F.descSignature(gameDesc) or ""
    if not S.gameAccNames or S.gameAccSignature ~= signature then
        -- A look that cannot be built here is not retried until it changes.
        local names = {}
        if gameDesc then pcall(function() collect(gameDesc, names, {}) end) end
        S.gameAccNames = names; S.gameAccSignature = signature
    end
    if gameDesc then gameDesc:Destroy() end
    local merged = {}
    for name in pairs(S.ownAvatarNames or {}) do merged[name] = true end
    for name in pairs(S.gameAccNames or {}) do merged[name] = true end
    if S.ownAvatarNames then S.ownAccNames = merged end
    return merged
end
F.getDummyAccessoryNames = function(dm) local names = {}; if dm then for _, ac in ipairs(dm:GetChildren()) do if ac:IsA("Accessory") then names[ac.Name] = true end end end; return names end

-- [v8] snapshot accessories actually equipped on our own character (fallback if description fetch fails)
F.snapshotOwnAccessories = function()
    local ch = lp.Character; if not ch then return end
    S.ownAccSnapshot = S.ownAccSnapshot or {}
    for _, ac in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
        if ac:IsA("Accessory") then S.ownAccSnapshot[ac.Name] = true end
    end
end
F.snapshotOwnAccessories()
RegisterConnection(lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(2); F.snapshotOwnAccessories() end))

F.isGameAccessory = function(ac, dm)
    if not ac or not ac:IsA("Accessory") then return false end
    if ac:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") then return false end
    if ac:FindFirstChildOfClass("Script") or ac:FindFirstChildOfClass("LocalScript") then return true end
    local ownNames = F.getSafeAccessoryNames()
    if ownNames and ownNames[ac.Name] then return false end
    if S.ownAccSnapshot and S.ownAccSnapshot[ac.Name] then return false end
    local targetNames = F.getDummyAccessoryNames(dm)
    if targetNames[ac.Name] then return false end
    return true
end

local HiddenGuis = {}
local HiddenCoreStates = {}
F.ToggleUI = function()
    _G.Copier_UIHidden = not _G.Copier_UIHidden
    if _G.Copier_UIHidden then
        local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if pg then
            for _, gui in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
                if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and gui.Name ~= "CopierHubGUI" and gui.Name ~= "TouchGui" then
                    HiddenGuis[gui] = gui.Enabled
                    gui.Enabled = false
                end
            end
        end
        for _, kind in ipairs(Enum.CoreGuiType:GetEnumItems()) do
            if kind ~= Enum.CoreGuiType.All then
                local ok, enabled = pcall(function() return SG:GetCoreGuiEnabled(kind) end)
                if ok then HiddenCoreStates[kind] = enabled; pcall(function() SG:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind, false) end) end
            end
        end
    else
        for gui, enabled in pairs(HiddenGuis) do pcall(function() gui.Enabled = enabled end) end
        for kind, enabled in pairs(HiddenCoreStates) do pcall(function() SG:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind, enabled) end) end
        table.clear(HiddenGuis); table.clear(HiddenCoreStates)
    end
end

    pcall(function()

        end 
    end)
    if dummy then dummy.Archivable = true end; return dummy
end

F.ResolvedTrackIds = {}
F.resolveAnimationTrackId = function(assetId)
    if not assetId or tonumber(assetId) == 0 then return nil end
    local idNum = tonumber(assetId)
    if F.ResolvedTrackIds[idNum] then return F.ResolvedTrackIds[idNum] end
    -- Tenta obter os objetos do asset diretamente para extrair a Animation interna
    local rawAnimId = nil
    pcall(function()
        local objs = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(idNum))
        if objs and #objs > 0 then
            for _, root in ipairs(objs) do
                if root:IsA("Animation") and root.AnimationId ~= "" then
                    rawAnimId = root.AnimationId
                    break
                else
                    for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                        if desc:IsA("Animation") and desc.AnimationId ~= "" then
                            rawAnimId = desc.AnimationId
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if rawAnimId then break end
            end
        end
    end)
    if rawAnimId then F.ResolvedTrackIds[idNum] = rawAnimId end
    return rawAnimId or ("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(idNum))
end

-- ANIMATION PACKS: an animation asset holds one set per state, each with its own animations and weights. An idle
-- has two (the main idle and a rarer look-around, weights 9 and 1 in Roblox's packs) and a swim asset holds "swim"
-- and "swimidle". The whole set is copied into Animate, names and weights included, so both idles play.
-- Returns {[set name] = {{Name, Id, Weight}, ...}} or nil when the asset has no sets (then only one id is known).
F.AnimationSetCache = {}
F.animationSets = function(assetId)
    local idNum = tonumber(assetId)
    if not idNum or idNum == 0 then return nil end
    local cached = F.AnimationSetCache[idNum]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached or nil end
    local sets
    pcall(function()
        for _, root in ipairs(game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(idNum)) or {}) do
            local holders = {root}
            for _, item in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do table.insert(holders, item) end
            for _, holder in ipairs(holders) do
                if holder:IsA("StringValue") then
                    local list = {}
                    for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Animation") and child.AnimationId ~= "" then
                            local weight = child:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                            table.insert(list, {Name = child.Name, Id = child.AnimationId, Weight = weight and weight:IsA("NumberValue") and weight.Value or nil})
                        end
                    end
                    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
                    if #list > 0 and #list <= 12 then sets = sets or {}; sets[holder.Name:lower()] = list end
                end
            end
            pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
        end
    end)
    F.AnimationSetCache[idNum] = sets or false
    return sets
end
-- The Animate folder (a StringValue such as "idle") for a set name, whatever its case.
F.animateFolder = function(animate, name)
    local exact = animate:FindFirstChild(name)
    if exact then return exact end
    for _, child in ipairs(animate:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name:lower() == name:lower() and (child:IsA("StringValue") or child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Configuration")) then return child end
    end
    return nil
end
-- Makes one Animate folder hold exactly the given animations: same names, ids and weights. Animations it has no
-- longer are removed, missing ones are added. Returns whether anything changed.
F.applyAnimationSet = function(folder, list)
    local changed, existing, used = false, {}, {}
    for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("Animation") then table.insert(existing, child) end end
    local function take(name)
        for _, node in ipairs(existing) do if not used[node] and node.Name == name then used[node] = true; return node end end
        return nil
    end
    local function weigh(node, weight)
        if type(weight) ~= "number" then return end
        local value = node:FindFirstChild("Weight")
        if not (value and value:IsA("NumberValue")) then value = Instance.new("NumberValue"); value.Name = "Weight"; value.Parent = node; changed = true end
        if value.Value ~= weight then value.Value = weight; changed = true end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do
        F.rememberAnimateId(row.Id)
        local node = take(row.Name)
        if node then
            local replaced, fresh = F.setAnimationId(node, row.Id)
            if replaced then changed = true end
            weigh(fresh or node, row.Weight)
        else
            -- The weight goes on before the animation enters Animate, so Animate reads the set complete.
            node = Instance.new("Animation"); node.Name = row.Name; node.AnimationId = F.normalizeAnimId(row.Id)
            weigh(node, row.Weight)
            node.Parent = folder; changed = true
        end
    end
    for _, node in ipairs(existing) do
        if not used[node] and node.Parent == folder then pcall(function() node:Destroy() end); changed = true end
    end
    return changed
end

F.applyAnimationIdsToAnimate = function(ch, desc)
    if not desc then return false end
    -- HumanoidDescription animation ids are R15 animations. On an R6 (or custom) rig they play nothing,
    -- which leaves the character stiff, so those rigs keep the game's own animations.
    if F.getTrueRigType(ch) ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return false end
    local animate = ch:FindFirstChild("Animate"); if not animate then return false end
    -- Names in Roblox's native Animate script are lowercase: idle, walk, run, jump, fall, climb, swim (+ swimidle).
    local map = {
        ClimbAnimation = {"climb"},
        FallAnimation = {"fall"},
        IdleAnimation = {"idle"},
        JumpAnimation = {"jump"},
        RunAnimation = {"run"},
        SwimAnimation = {"swim", "swimidle"},
        WalkAnimation = {"walk"},
        MoodAnimation = {"mood"},
    }
    local changed = false
    for field, names in pairs(map) do
        local ok, animAssetId = pcall(function() return desc[field] end)
        if ok and animAssetId and tonumber(animAssetId) ~= 0 then
            local sets = F.animationSets(animAssetId)
            local used = false
            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                local list = sets and sets[name]
                local folder = list and F.animateFolder(animate, name)
                if folder then
                    used = true
                    F.markWritten(list)
                    if F.applyAnimationSet(folder, list) then changed = true end
                end
            end
            -- An asset without sets only gives one id: every animation of the state plays it.
            if not used and not sets then
                local folder = F.animateFolder(animate, names[1])
                local realAnimId = folder and F.resolveAnimationTrackId(animAssetId)
                if realAnimId then
                    F.markWritten({{Id = realAnimId}})
                    for _, node in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
                        if node:IsA("Animation") then
                            pcall(function() if F.setAnimationId(node, realAnimId) then changed = true end end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return changed
end

-- Following the game hiding your character, its size changes, and covering your own avatar until the copy is on
-- (see GAME INVISIBILITY, GAME SIZE CHANGES and COVER); defined further down.
-- Mask: what the copier writes to hide a part itself instead of 1, so the game's own 1 still shows as a change. Roblox
-- keeps transparency as a 32-bit float, so the mark is a value it stores exactly (1 - 1/1024) and is always compared
-- with a tolerance: 0.999 came back as 0.99900001, was never recognised, and a covered character stayed invisible.
local Cloak, Scale, Cover = {Parts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), Mask = 0.9990234375}, {Factor = 1}, {}
local function isMask(value) return type(value) == "number" and math.abs(value - Cloak.Mask) < 1e-4 end
-- APPEARANCE / body changes keep the game's own objects, joints and links.
local Appearance = {}
function Appearance.isBody(part, character)
    return part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent == character and S.BD[part.Name] ~= nil
end
function Appearance.isAvatarAccessory(item)
    if item:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") then return true end
    if item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Script", true) or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("LocalScript", true) then return false end
    -- The v12 snapshot contained game accessories too, so it is deliberately not
    -- used as an ownership list. Unknown items belong to the game and survive.
    return S.ownAccNames and S.ownAccNames[item.Name] == true or false
end
-- STASH: the game's own clothing and avatar accessories are never destroyed while another avatar is worn. They are
-- taken off the character (kept, unparented) and put back when your own look returns, with whatever the server
-- changed on them meanwhile (a catalog game's try-on, a team uniform). A destroyed item could not come back: the
-- server only sends what it changes, so deleting it locally used to leave pieces missing or mixed after Restore.
-- Kept by character (weak): a character the game takes out of the world for a while (a size potion that swaps in a
-- bigger body, then puts yours back) keeps its items aside until it comes back; a character that is gone for good is
-- dropped with it.
Appearance.Stash = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function Appearance.stash(character, item)
    local list = Appearance.Stash[character]
    if not list then list = {}; Appearance.Stash[character] = list end
    if pcall(function() item.Parent = nil end) then table.insert(list, item) end
end
-- Puts the stashed items back. Returns how many came back and whether this character had a stash at all (items the
-- server removed meanwhile stay gone, as they are on the server).
function Appearance.unstash(character)
    local list = Appearance.Stash[character]
    if not list then return 0, false end
    Appearance.Stash[character] = nil
    local count = 0
    for _, item in ipairs(list) do
        if pcall(function() item.Parent = character end) and item.Parent == character then count = count + 1 end
    end
    return count, true
end
-- Body parts the copier reshaped. Your own look is only rebuilt on these: a part the game replaced meanwhile is new,
-- already the game's, and stays as it is.
Appearance.TouchedParts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
-- Roblox picks an assembly's root by face area (the HumanoidRootPart only gets a bonus). A bigger copied torso or head
-- could take the root over on your screen while the server keeps the HumanoidRootPart; the Humanoid then stops
-- balancing and the character tips over. So the copied body parts get a lower root priority than the
-- HumanoidRootPart. The HumanoidRootPart itself is never raised: in a vehicle seat the character joins the car's
-- assembly, and a raised HumanoidRootPart became the root of the whole car on your screen only, so the server lost
-- track of the car and put you back where you got in when you got out.
function Appearance.keepRoot(character)
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    -- Older versions raised the HumanoidRootPart itself.
    local raised = root:GetAttribute("Lyra_RootPriority")
    if type(raised) == "number" then pcall(function() root.RootPriority = raised; root:SetAttribute("Lyra_RootPriority", nil) end) end
    local below = math.clamp(root.RootPriority - 1, -127, 127)
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if part ~= root and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.RootPriority > below and Appearance.isBody(part, character) then
            if part:GetAttribute("Lyra_RootPriority") == nil then part:SetAttribute("Lyra_RootPriority", part.RootPriority) end
            part.RootPriority = below
        end
    end
end
function Appearance.releaseRoot(character)
    for _, part in ipairs(character and character:GetChildren() or {}) do
        local original = part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("Lyra_RootPriority")
        if type(original) == "number" then pcall(function() part.RootPriority = original; part:SetAttribute("Lyra_RootPriority", nil) end) end
    end
end
-- Body parts that no joint connects to the root (empty when the rig is whole).
function Appearance.rigMissing(character)
    local ok, known = pcall(Rig.reachable, character, false)
    local missing = {}
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if Appearance.isBody(part, character) and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and not (ok and known[part]) then table.insert(missing, part.Name) end
    end
    if not ok then table.insert(missing, "HumanoidRootPart") end
    return missing
end

function Appearance.attach(character, accessory)
    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not hum or not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then accessory:Destroy(); return nil, "accessory has no Handle" end
    for _, item in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then item.Anchored = false; item.CanCollide = false; item.Massless = true
        elseif item:IsA("JointInstance") or item:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
            if item.Name == "AccessoryWeld" or (item.Part0 and not item.Part0:IsDescendantOf(accessory)) or (item.Part1 and not item.Part1:IsDescendantOf(accessory)) then item:Destroy() end
        elseif item:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or item:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
            local a,b=item.Attachment0,item.Attachment1
            if (a and not a:IsDescendantOf(accessory)) or (b and not b:IsDescendantOf(accessory)) then item:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    -- AddAccessory warns "already being worn by another character" when the accessory is already
    -- parented to a model, so it is detached first; it is parented back below if AddAccessory fails.
    accessory.Parent = nil
    local ok = pcall(function() hum:AddAccessory(accessory) end)
    if accessory.Parent ~= character then accessory.Parent = character end
    local function connected()
        for _,link in ipairs(Rig.links(character)) do
            if (Appearance.isBody(link.A,character) and link.B:IsDescendantOf(accessory))
                or (Appearance.isBody(link.B,character) and link.A:IsDescendantOf(accessory)) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    if not connected() then
        -- Every attachment of the handle is tried: the first one can belong to an effect instead of the mount.
        local attachment, body, targetAttachment
        for _, candidate in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
            if candidate.ClassName == "Attachment" then
                attachment = attachment or candidate
                for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                    if Appearance.isBody(part, character) then
                        local match = part:FindFirstChild(candidate.Name)
                        if match and match:IsA("Attachment") then body = part; targetAttachment = match; attachment = candidate; break end
                    end
                end
                if body then break end
            end
        end
        -- Games weld their own items (CAC pets, weapons) without a matching attachment. A saved skin keeps the
        -- body part and offset the item really had, so it goes back exactly where it was.
        local mountName, mountOffset = accessory:GetAttribute("Lyra_MountBody"), accessory:GetAttribute("Lyra_MountOffset")
        local mount = type(mountName) == "string" and character:FindFirstChild(mountName)
        if mount and not Appearance.isBody(mount, character) then mount = nil end
        if body then
            local weld = Instance.new("Weld"); weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
            weld.C0 = targetAttachment.CFrame; weld.C1 = attachment.CFrame
            handle.CFrame = body.CFrame * weld.C0 * weld.C1:Inverse()
            weld.Part0 = body; weld.Part1 = handle; weld.Parent = handle
        elseif mount and typeof(mountOffset) == "CFrame" then
            local weld = Instance.new("Weld"); weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
            weld.C0 = mountOffset; weld.C1 = CFrame.new()
            handle.CFrame = mount.CFrame * mountOffset
            weld.Part0 = mount; weld.Part1 = handle; weld.Parent = handle
        elseif not attachment and character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            local head = character.Head; local weld = Instance.new("Weld"); weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
            weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, head.Size.Y * 0.5, 0); weld.C1 = accessory.AttachmentPoint
            handle.CFrame = head.CFrame * weld.C0 * weld.C1:Inverse(); weld.Part0 = head; weld.Part1 = handle; weld.Parent = handle
        end
    end
    if not connected() then accessory:Destroy(); return nil, ok and "incompatible attachment" or "accessory was rejected" end
    return accessory
end

function Appearance.item(source, character, key)
    local clone = source:Clone()
    clone:SetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem", true); clone:SetAttribute("Lyra_ItemKey", key)
    if clone:IsA("Accessory") then return Appearance.attach(character, clone) end
    clone.Parent = character; return clone
end
-- Live characters retain their original instances, joints and controller.
-- Surface copying and proportional fitting are separate steps; preview posing stays isolated.
function Appearance.copySurface(target, source)
    local physical={}
    for _,key in ipairs({"Size","CFrame","Anchored","CanCollide","CanTouch","CanQuery","Massless","RootPriority","CollisionGroup","CustomPhysicalProperties"}) do
        pcall(function() physical[key]=target[key] end)
    end
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        if target:IsA("MeshPart") and source:IsA("MeshPart") then
            target:ApplyMesh(source)
        elseif target:IsA("MeshPart") ~= source:IsA("MeshPart") then
            error("Incompatible body-part types for in-place application")
        end
        local function cosmetic(item)
            return item:IsA("DataModelMesh") or item:IsA("Decal") or item:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")
                or item:IsA("FaceControls") or item:IsA("Bone") or item:IsA("WrapTarget")
        end
        local prepared={}
        for _,child in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do if cosmetic(child) then table.insert(prepared,child:Clone()) end end
        for _,child in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do if cosmetic(child) then child:Destroy() end end
        -- The copies are the copier's (a face fades with the body when the game hides it, see GAME INVISIBILITY).
        for _,child in ipairs(prepared) do child:SetAttribute("Lyra_CopiedSurface",true); child.Parent=target end
        target.Color=source.Color; target.Transparency=source.Transparency
        pcall(function() target.Material=source.Material end)
    end)
    -- ApplyMesh can copy mesh data, but cannot be allowed to resize/reposition the controller rig.
    for key,value in pairs(physical) do pcall(function() target[key]=value end) end
    return ok,err
end
-- Some games expose replicated MeshParts that reject ApplyMesh. Keep the live
-- limb/joint as the controller and weld a local, non-colliding visual to it.
function Appearance.clearVisuals(character)
    for _,item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor") then item:Destroy()
        elseif Appearance.isBody(item,character) then
--[==[YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE]==]
            local transparency=item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BeforeOverlay")
            if transparency~=nil then item.Transparency=transparency; item:SetAttribute("Lyra_BeforeOverlay",nil) end
            for _,child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
                local old=child:GetAttribute("Lyra_BeforeOverlay")
                if old~=nil and child:IsA("Decal") then child.Transparency=old; child:SetAttribute("Lyra_BeforeOverlay",nil) end
            end
        end
    end
end
function Appearance.visualFallback(character,target,source)
    local display=source:Clone(); assert(display,"Could not prepare the visual part "..source.Name)
    display.Name="LyraVisual_"..target.Name; display:SetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor",target.Name)
    for _,child in ipairs(display:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("JointInstance") or child:IsA("WeldConstraint") or child:IsA("Constraint")
            or child:IsA("Script") or child:IsA("LocalScript") or child:IsA("ModuleScript")
            or child:IsA("Attachment") and not child:IsA("Bone") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    display.Anchored=false; display.CanCollide=false; display.CanTouch=false; display.CanQuery=false; display.Massless=true; display.RootPriority=-127
    display.CFrame=target.CFrame; display.Parent=character
    local weld=Instance.new("Weld"); weld.Name="LyraVisualWeld"; weld.Part0=target; weld.Part1=display; weld.Parent=display
    -- The mask, not 1: the game hiding the limb (setting 1) must still show as a change (see GAME INVISIBILITY).
    target:SetAttribute("Lyra_BeforeOverlay",target.Transparency); target.Transparency=Cloak.Mask
    for _,child in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Decal") then child:SetAttribute("Lyra_BeforeOverlay",child.Transparency); child.Transparency=1 end
    end
end
function Appearance.checkLiveRig(character)
    assert(#Appearance.rigMissing(character)==0,"Your character is not fully loaded (some body parts are not connected). Wait a moment, or respawn, and try again.")
end

-- Match target geometry while retaining the live controller and all joint instances.
function Appearance.beginGeometry(hum)
    local original=hum:GetAttribute("Lyra_OriginalAutomaticScaling")
    if original==nil then hum:SetAttribute("Lyra_OriginalAutomaticScaling",hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled) end
    -- The generated source is already scaled. Automatic scaling would scale it twice.
    hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled=false
end
function Appearance.releaseGeometry(hum)
    if not hum then return end
    local original=hum:GetAttribute("Lyra_OriginalAutomaticScaling")
    if original~=nil then hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled=original; hum:SetAttribute("Lyra_OriginalAutomaticScaling",nil) end
end
function Appearance.fitGeometry(character,sourceModel,copied,dryRun)
    local hum=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local sourceHum=sourceModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local sourceLinks=Rig.links(sourceModel)
    local liveLinks=Rig.links(character)
    local function targetOffsets(a,b)
        for _,link in ipairs(sourceLinks) do
            if link.A.Parent==sourceModel and link.B.Parent==sourceModel then
                if link.A.Name==a.Name and link.B.Name==b.Name then return link.C0,link.C1 end
                if link.B.Name==a.Name and link.A.Name==b.Name then return link.C1,link.C0 end
            end
        end
        -- Some generated models expose the rig sockets before their joints.
        local sa,sb=sourceModel:FindFirstChild(a.Name),sourceModel:FindFirstChild(b.Name)
        if sa and sb then
            for _,at in ipairs(sa:GetChildren()) do
                if at:IsA("Attachment") and at.Name:match("RigAttachment$") then
                    local bt=sb:FindFirstChild(at.Name)
                    if bt and bt:IsA("Attachment") then return at.CFrame,bt.CFrame end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local updates={}
    for _,link in ipairs(liveLinks) do
        if Appearance.isBody(link.A,character) and Appearance.isBody(link.B,character) then
            local a,b=targetOffsets(link.A,link.B)
            -- Unknown or fixed links keep the game's own offsets instead of aborting the whole application.
            if a and b and not link.Object:IsA("WeldConstraint") then table.insert(updates,{Link=link,C0=a,C1=b}) end
        end
    end
    if dryRun then return end
    for _,source in ipairs(sourceModel:GetChildren()) do
        local target=copied[source.Name] and character:FindFirstChild(source.Name)
        if target then
            target.Size=source.Size
            for _,name in ipairs({"OriginalSize","AvatarPartScaleType"}) do
                local value=source:FindFirstChild(name); local current=target:FindFirstChild(name)
                if value then
                    if current and current.ClassName==value.ClassName then current.Value=value.Value
                    elseif not current then value:Clone().Parent=target end
                end
            end
            -- Retain attachment identities, including references owned by game weapons.
            for _,at in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
                if at:IsA("Attachment") and not at:IsA("Bone") then
                    local current=target:FindFirstChild(at.Name)
                    if current and current:IsA("Attachment") then current.CFrame=at.CFrame
                    elseif not current then
                        -- Effects hanging from it are copied (and tagged) by Appearance.copyEffects.
                        local added=at:Clone(); added:ClearAllChildren(); added:SetAttribute("Lyra_AddedAttachment",true); added.Parent=target
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _,row in ipairs(updates) do
        local link=row.Link; local joint=link.Object
        if (copied[link.A.Name] or link.A.Name=="HumanoidRootPart") and (copied[link.B.Name] or link.B.Name=="HumanoidRootPart") then
            if joint:IsA("JointInstance") then joint.C0=row.C0; joint.C1=row.C1
            else joint.Attachment0.CFrame=row.C0; joint.Attachment1.CFrame=row.C1 end
            -- Endpoints, parent, animation Transform, and joint class remain untouched.
        end
    end
    -- A restore that rebuilt no part leaves the game's scale values alone.
    if sourceHum and next(copied) then
        for _,name in ipairs({"BodyDepthScale","BodyHeightScale","BodyWidthScale","HeadScale","BodyProportionScale","BodyTypeScale"}) do
            local source=sourceHum:FindFirstChild(name); local target=hum:FindFirstChild(name)
            if source and source:IsA("NumberValue") then
                if target and target:IsA("NumberValue") then target.Value=source.Value
                elseif not target then source:Clone().Parent=hum end
            end
        end
    end
    -- HipHeight follows the new legs only when every leg part really took the new size. In a game that keeps its
    -- own limbs, the game's HipHeight stays: a HipHeight taller than the real legs makes the character hover and
    -- lets it jump again in mid-air.
    local legsResized=false
    for _,name in ipairs({"LowerTorso","LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot","RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg","RightFoot","Left Leg","Right Leg"}) do
        if character:FindFirstChild(name) then
            if not copied[name] then legsResized=false; break end
            legsResized=true
        end
    end
    if legsResized and sourceHum and type(sourceHum.HipHeight)=="number" then
        local sourceRoot=sourceModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local delta=sourceRoot and root and (sourceRoot.Size.Y-root.Size.Y)*0.5 or 0
        hum.HipHeight=sourceHum.HipHeight+delta
    end
    -- No BuildRigFromAttachments, no body replacement, no live CFrame posing or polling.
end

-- CARRIED ITEMS ON A RESHAPED BODY: the game joins its items to your body parts (a held tool at the hand's grip, a
-- sword on the back or at the waist, a game accessory) with offsets made for the body it knows, your own. After a
-- copied avatar reshaped those parts, the items kept the old offsets: a sword sank into a bigger arm or floated off a
-- smaller hand. Now each item moves with the point of the body it sits at: the attachment it is fixed to (the grip,
-- an accessory's attachment), else the nearest attachment of that part. The game's own offsets and attachment places
-- are kept as attributes, so the next avatar starts from them and your own look puts them back. Items the game joins
-- later (a tool you equip, a weapon put away) follow the same way. Invisible parts (hitboxes) are left as they are.
local Fit = {Watched = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), Busy = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), Tracked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
function Fit.same(a, b)
    if typeof(a) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(b) ~= "CFrame" then return false end
    local ca, cb = {a:GetComponents()}, {b:GetComponents()}
    for i = 1, 12 do if math.abs(ca[i] - cb[i]) > 1e-3 then return false end end
    return true
end
-- How the game made a body part, kept the first time the copier reshapes it.
function Fit.remember(part)
    if part:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameSize") ~= nil then return end
    for _, attachment in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if attachment.ClassName == "Attachment" and not attachment:GetAttribute("Lyra_AddedAttachment") then
            attachment:SetAttribute("Lyra_GameCFrame", attachment.CFrame)
        end
    end
    part:SetAttribute("Lyra_GameSize", part.Size)
end
-- A part the game carries on the body: in the character, visible (itself, or the tool, accessory or model it belongs
-- to), and not one of the copier's own items.
function Fit.carried(item, character)
    if not item:IsDescendantOf(character) or item:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor") then return false end
    local accessory = item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory")
    if accessory and accessory:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") then return false end
    if item.Transparency < 1 then return true end
    local holder = item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") or accessory
    if not holder and item.Parent ~= character and item.Parent:IsA("Model") then holder = item.Parent end
    for _, part in ipairs(holder and holder:GetDescendants() or {}) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency < 1 then return true end
    end
    return false
end
-- The reshaped body part of a joint, the field holding its offset on that part, the other field and the item part.
function Fit.sides(joint, character)
    local a, b = joint.Part0, joint.Part1
    if not a or not b then return nil end
    local body, item, field, other
    if Appearance.isBody(a, character) and not Appearance.isBody(b, character) then body, item, field, other = a, b, "C0", "C1"
    elseif Appearance.isBody(b, character) and not Appearance.isBody(a, character) then body, item, field, other = b, a, "C1", "C0"
    else return nil end
    if body.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or typeof(body:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameSize")) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
    if not item:IsA("BasePart") or not Fit.carried(item, character) then return nil end
    if Fit.covers(body, item, joint[field], joint[other]) then return nil end
    return body, field, other
end
-- A game effect that covers a body part (a part at its centre, the same way round and about its size, like Blox
-- Fruits' Haki) is not an item carried at one point of it: it is left exactly as the game makes it.
function Fit.covers(body, item, bodySide, itemSide)
    local where = bodySide * itemSide:Inverse()
    if where.Position.Magnitude > 0.15 then return false end
    local _, angle = where:ToAxisAngle()
    if math.abs(angle) > math.rad(10) then return false end
    local known = body:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameSize")
    local ratio = item.Size / Vector3.new(math.max(known.X, 1e-3), math.max(known.Y, 1e-3), math.max(known.Z, 1e-3))
    local low, high = math.min(ratio.X, ratio.Y, ratio.Z), math.max(ratio.X, ratio.Y, ratio.Z)
    return low >= 0.85 and high <= 1.6 and high / low <= 1.35
end
-- The offset on the reshaped part for an offset the game made for its own body (itemSide is the joint's other
-- offset). Returns it and the game's offset (which differs only for a joint already made for the reshaped part).
function Fit.map(body, base, itemSide)
    local where = base * itemSide:Inverse()
    local exact, made, nearest, nearestDistance
    for _, attachment in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
        if attachment.ClassName == "Attachment" and not attachment:GetAttribute("Lyra_AddedAttachment") then
            local before = attachment:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameCFrame")
            if typeof(before) ~= "CFrame" then before = attachment.CFrame end
            local now = attachment.CFrame
            if not exact and (base.Position - before.Position).Magnitude < 0.02 then exact = {before, now}
            elseif not made and (base.Position - now.Position).Magnitude < 0.02 then made = {before, now} end
            local distance = (where.Position - before.Position).Magnitude
            if not nearest or distance < nearestDistance then nearest, nearestDistance = {before, now}, distance end
        end
    end
    -- Fixed to an attachment (a tool's grip, an accessory): it keeps its place on that attachment.
    if exact then return exact[2] * exact[1]:Inverse() * base, base end
    -- Already made for the reshaped part (a tool equipped on your screen takes the grip as it is now): it stays, and
    -- the game's offset is the same place on that attachment as the game had it.
    if made then return base, made[1] * made[2]:Inverse() * base end
    -- Anywhere else: it moves as much as the nearest point of the body moved.
    if nearest then return CFrame.new(nearest[2].Position - nearest[1].Position) * base, base end
    -- A part without attachments: the item keeps its place relative to the part's size.
    local size = body:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameSize")
    local ratio = body.Size / Vector3.new(math.max(size.X, 1e-3), math.max(size.Y, 1e-3), math.max(size.Z, 1e-3))
    return CFrame.new(where.Position * ratio) * (where - where.Position) * itemSide, base
end
-- ITEMS HELD AWAY FROM THE HAND: some tools are held by the hand but drawn somewhere else, through the tool's grip
-- (Steal a Brainrot's Invisibility Cloak: a cape held by the right hand, about 3 studs from it, so that it hangs on
-- the back while the arm holds the tool pose). On a copied avatar with a narrower torso, other arms or a shorter hand,
-- the same pose put the cape in the wrong place (lower, to one side, into the hair). Such an item (the hand's grip
-- point is outside the handle) is placed every frame where the game's own arm, in the same pose, would hold it,
-- relative to the torso. Items held in the hand (swords, guns) keep following the copied hand.
Fit.Far = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Fit.ArmJoints = {{"RightShoulder", "RightUpperArm", "RightShoulderRigAttachment"}, {"RightElbow", "RightLowerArm", "RightElbowRigAttachment"},
    {"RightWrist", "RightHand", "RightWristRigAttachment"}}
-- Where the hand is relative to the upper torso in the pose being played, with the game's own arm (game) or the arm
-- the character has now. nil when the arm is not a standard R15 arm.
function Fit.armPlace(character, side, game)
    local place = CFrame.new()
    for _, row in ipairs(Fit.ArmJoints) do
        local child = character:FindFirstChild((row[2]:gsub("^Right", side)))
        local motor = child and child:FindFirstChild((row[1]:gsub("^Right", side)))
        if not motor or not motor:IsA("Motor6D") or not motor.Part0 then return nil end
        local c0, c1 = motor.C0, motor.C1
        if game then
            local name = row[3]:gsub("^Right", side)
            local a, b = motor.Part0:FindFirstChild(name), child:FindFirstChild(name)
            local ga, gb = a and a:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameCFrame"), b and b:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameCFrame")
            if typeof(ga) == "CFrame" then c0 = ga end
            if typeof(gb) == "CFrame" then c1 = gb end
        end
        place = place * c0 * motor.Transform * c1:Inverse()
    end
    return place
end
-- Starts placing a tool held away from the hand (see ITEMS HELD AWAY FROM THE HAND). Returns whether it did.
function Fit.farGrip(joint, character, body, field, other)
    local side = body.Name == "RightHand" and "Right" or body.Name == "LeftHand" and "Left" or nil
    local item = field == "C0" and joint.Part1 or joint.Part0
    -- A tool's grip weld has the hand as Part0 (its offset is C0).
    if not side or field ~= "C0" or not joint:IsA("JointInstance") or not item or not item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then return false end
    -- The hand's grip point, in the handle's space, is outside the handle: the hand is not holding it where it is drawn.
    local grip, half = joint[other].Position, item.Size / 2
    if math.abs(grip.X) <= half.X + 0.5 and math.abs(grip.Y) <= half.Y + 0.5 and math.abs(grip.Z) <= half.Z + 0.5 then return false end
    if not Fit.armPlace(character, side, false) then return false end
    local _, base = Fit.map(body, joint[field], joint[other])
--[[YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE]]
    local stored = joint:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameC0")
    if typeof(stored) == "CFrame" then base = stored end
    local connection
    local function stop(back)
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
        Fit.Far[joint] = nil
        if back and joint.Parent then Fit.Busy[joint] = true; pcall(function() joint.C0 = base end); Fit.Busy[joint] = nil end
    end
    connection = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not IsAlive() or not joint.Parent or not character.Parent or (field == "C0" and joint.Part0 or joint.Part1) ~= body or body.Parent ~= character then stop(false); return end
        -- Your own look is back on the arm: the game's offset goes back.
        if not Appearance.TouchedParts[body] then stop(true); return end
        local game, now = Fit.armPlace(character, side, true), Fit.armPlace(character, side, false)
        if not game or not now then return end
        local wanted = now:Inverse() * game * base
        Fit.Busy[joint] = true
        pcall(function() joint.C0 = wanted end)
        Fit.Busy[joint] = nil
    end)
    Fit.Far[joint] = stop
    if Fit.Trace then Fit.Trace(joint, body, field, base, base, "held away from the hand: placed as the game's arm holds it") end
    return true
end
function Fit.joint(joint, character)
    if Fit.Busy[joint] or Fit.Far[joint] or not IsAlive() then return end
    local body, field, other = Fit.sides(joint, character)
    if not body then return end
    if Fit.farGrip(joint, character, body, field, other) then return end
    local current = joint[field]
    local base, placed = joint:GetAttribute("Lyra_Game" .. field), joint:GetAttribute("Lyra_Fit" .. field)
    local wanted
    if typeof(base) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(placed) ~= "CFrame" then
        base = current
    elseif not Fit.same(current, placed) then
        -- The game changed the offset since the last fit. A change worked out from the fitted offset (a script that
        -- turns it a little) keeps the fit; an offset of its own, nearer to its old one, is fitted again.
        if (current.Position - placed.Position).Magnitude < (current.Position - base.Position).Magnitude then
            base = base * placed:Inverse() * current; wanted = current
        else
            base = current
        end
    end
    if not wanted then wanted, base = Fit.map(body, base, joint[other]) end
    Fit.Busy[joint] = true
    pcall(function()
        joint:SetAttribute("Lyra_Game" .. field, base); joint:SetAttribute("Lyra_Fit" .. field, wanted)
        if not Fit.same(current, wanted) then
            joint[field] = wanted
            -- The character log (dev builds) shows every item the copier moved on the reshaped body.
            if Fit.Trace then Fit.Trace(joint, body, field, current, wanted) end
        end
    end)
    Fit.Busy[joint] = nil
    Fit.watch(joint, character)
end
-- A fitted joint the game changes again (or a new joint the game finishes setting up) is fitted again.
function Fit.watch(joint, character)
    if Fit.Watched[joint] then return end
    local list = {}
    local function changed()
        if Fit.Busy[joint] or not IsAlive() then return end
        task.defer(function() if joint.Parent and character.Parent then pcall(Fit.joint, joint, character) end end)
    end
    for _, name in ipairs({"C0", "C1", "Part0", "Part1"}) do table.insert(list, joint:GetPropertyChangedSignal(name):Connect(changed)) end
    table.insert(list, joint.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if joint:IsDescendantOf(character) then return end
        for _, connection in ipairs(list) do connection:Disconnect() end
        Fit.Watched[joint] = nil
    end))
    Fit.Watched[joint] = list
end
-- Fits every joint of a character the copier just reshaped, and the ones the game adds afterwards.
function Fit.refit(character)
    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("JointInstance") then pcall(Fit.joint, item, character) end
    end
    if Fit.Tracked[character] then return end
    Fit.Tracked[character] = RegisterConnection(character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
        if not item:IsA("JointInstance") or not IsAlive() then return end
        task.defer(function()
            if not item.Parent or not character.Parent then return end
            pcall(Fit.joint, item, character)
            -- Some games parent the joint before choosing its parts.
            if not item.Part0 or not item.Part1 then Fit.watch(item, character) end
        end)
    end))
end
-- Your own look is back on these parts: the game's offsets go back (unless the game changed them since).
function Fit.release(character, names)
    for _, joint in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("JointInstance") then
            for _, field in ipairs({"C0", "C1"}) do
                local base, placed = joint:GetAttribute("Lyra_Game" .. field), joint:GetAttribute("Lyra_Fit" .. field)
                local part = field == "C0" and joint.Part0 or joint.Part1
                if (base ~= nil or placed ~= nil) and part and part.Parent == character and names[part.Name] then
                    Fit.Busy[joint] = true
                    pcall(function()
                        if typeof(base) == "CFrame" and Fit.same(joint[field], placed) then joint[field] = base end
                        joint:SetAttribute("Lyra_Game" .. field, nil); joint:SetAttribute("Lyra_Fit" .. field, nil)
                    end)
                    Fit.Busy[joint] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for name in pairs(names) do
        local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and Appearance.isBody(part, character) then
            part:SetAttribute("Lyra_GameSize", nil)
            for _, attachment in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                if attachment:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameCFrame") ~= nil then attachment:SetAttribute("Lyra_GameCFrame", nil) end
            end
        end
    end
end
function Fit.stop()
    local far = {}
    for _, stop in pairs(Fit.Far) do table.insert(far, stop) end
    for _, stop in ipairs(far) do pcall(stop, true) end
    for _, list in pairs(Fit.Watched) do for _, connection in ipairs(list) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end end
    table.clear(Fit.Watched)
    for _, connection in pairs(Fit.Tracked) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(Fit.Tracked)
end

-- An accessory that looks like an avatar item: layered clothing, or worn on a standard avatar attachment, without scripts.
-- Game items (weapons, belts, pets) hang from their own attachments or welds.
Appearance.AvatarAttachments = {HatAttachment = true, HairAttachment = true, FaceFrontAttachment = true, FaceCenterAttachment = true,
    NeckAttachment = true, LeftShoulderAttachment = true, RightShoulderAttachment = true, LeftCollarAttachment = true, RightCollarAttachment = true,
    BodyFrontAttachment = true, BodyBackAttachment = true, WaistFrontAttachment = true, WaistBackAttachment = true, WaistCenterAttachment = true}
function Appearance.avatarItem(accessory)
    local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not handle or accessory:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Script", true) or accessory:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("LocalScript", true) then return false end
    if handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("WrapLayer") then return true end
    for _, child in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
        if child.ClassName == "Attachment" and Appearance.AvatarAttachments[child.Name] then return true end
    end
    return false
end
-- Characters whose body the copier has reshaped in this session (weak), so a restore knows its record is complete.
Appearance.TouchedFor = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
-- Whether the character still has body parts the copier reshaped for a copied avatar (your own look gives them back).
function Appearance.carries(char)
    if not char or not Appearance.TouchedFor[char] then return false end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if Appearance.TouchedParts[part] and Appearance.isBody(part, char) then return true end
    end
    return false
end
-- options.Original: your own look comes back (the undo base, or the game's new look). Only the copier's items come
--   off, the stashed game items go back on, and only the body parts the copier reshaped are rebuilt. The look's own
--   clothing and accessories are added only when there is no stash to bring back (a character from an older run).
-- options.KeepAccessories: no accessories are added (the game's look, whose accessories the game already put on).
-- options.Mirror: a stand-in (a copy of you the game built, see STAND-INS): every avatar item on it is set aside.
function Appearance.apply(character, sourceModel, options)
    options = options or {}
    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    assert(hum and sourceModel, "Character or model unavailable.")
    local report = {Items = {}, Skipped = {}, BodyErrors = {}, Unstashed = 0, HadStash = false}
    Appearance.checkLiveRig(character)
    -- A restore rebuilds only the parts the copier reshaped; without a record of them (an older run), every part.
    local only
    if options.Original and Appearance.TouchedFor[character] then
        only = {}
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if Appearance.TouchedParts[part] and Appearance.isBody(part, character) then only[part.Name] = true end
        end
    end
    -- Games often ship custom characters (missing Head, extra parts, hidden limbs). Apply to every part the live
    -- character really has, skip the rest, and only fail when nothing matches at all.
    local expected, missing = {}, {}
    for _,source in ipairs(sourceModel:GetChildren()) do
        if Appearance.isBody(source,sourceModel) and source.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" and (not only or only[source.Name]) then
            if Appearance.isBody(character:FindFirstChild(source.Name),character) then expected[source.Name]=true
            else table.insert(missing,source.Name) end
        end
    end
    assert(next(expected) or options.Original,"This game's character has none of the expected body parts ("..table.concat(missing,", ")..").")
    Appearance.fitGeometry(character,sourceModel,expected,true)
    -- Only your own character carries the game's items (the stand-ins of STAND-INS are left as they are).
    local fitItems=character==lp.Character and not options.Mirror
    local previousAutoScale=hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled
    local previousNeck=hum.RequiresNeck
    local ok, err = xpcall(function()
        Appearance.beginGeometry(hum)
        hum.RequiresNeck=false
        Appearance.clearVisuals(character)
        Appearance.clearEffects(character)
        local copied={}
        local visualSnapshot=sourceModel:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualSnapshot")
        for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            local clothing = item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or item:IsA("BodyColors") or item:IsA("CharacterMesh")
            local accessory = item:IsA("Accessory")
            if (clothing or accessory) and item:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") then item:Destroy()
            elseif not options.Original and (clothing or (accessory and not options.KeepAccessories
                and (Appearance.isAvatarAccessory(item) or ((visualSnapshot or options.Mirror) and Appearance.avatarItem(item))))) then
                -- The game's own piece is kept aside, never destroyed (see STASH).
                Appearance.stash(character, item)
            end
        end
        -- Preserve every body BasePart and every game-owned attachment/joint.
        -- Meshes first, then dimensions and offsets from the already-scaled source.
        for _,source in ipairs(sourceModel:GetChildren()) do
            if source:IsA("BasePart") and source.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" and S.BD[source.Name] and (not only or only[source.Name]) then
                local target=character:FindFirstChild(source.Name)
                if target and Appearance.isBody(target,character) then
                    if fitItems and not options.Original then Fit.remember(target) end
                    -- The game's own transparency of the part, the first time the copier changes it (see GAME INVISIBILITY).
                    if fitItems and not options.Original and target:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameTransparency")==nil then
                        local before=target:GetAttribute("Lyra_BeforeOverlay")
                        target:SetAttribute("Lyra_GameTransparency",type(before)=="number" and before or target.Transparency)
                    end
                    local success,reason=Appearance.copySurface(target,source)
                    if not success then
                        Appearance.visualFallback(character,target,source)
                        copied[source.Name]=true
                        report.LocalVisuals=(report.LocalVisuals or 0)+1
                        warn("[Lyra Appearance] "..source.Name..": usando visual local; "..tostring(reason))
                    else copied[source.Name]=true end
                else table.insert(report.BodyErrors,source.Name) end
            end
        end
        Appearance.fitGeometry(character,sourceModel,copied)
        -- The game's items on the body follow its new shape (see CARRIED ITEMS ON A RESHAPED BODY).
        if fitItems then
            if options.Original then Fit.release(character,copied) else Fit.refit(character) end
        end
        -- After fitGeometry, so the attachments the effects hang from exist.
        Appearance.copyEffects(character,sourceModel,copied)
        Appearance.pauseOwnEffects(character,sourceModel,copied)
        -- A restored part is the game's again; a reshaped one is remembered for the next restore.
        if not options.Original and next(copied) then Appearance.TouchedFor[character] = true end
        for name in pairs(copied) do
            local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
            if part then Appearance.TouchedParts[part] = (not options.Original) or nil end
        end
        local hadStash = false
        if options.Original then report.Unstashed, hadStash = Appearance.unstash(character); report.HadStash = hadStash end
        local index = 0
        for _, source in ipairs(sourceModel:GetChildren()) do
            local clothing = source:IsA("Shirt") or source:IsA("Pants") or source:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or source:IsA("BodyColors") or source:IsA("CharacterMesh")
            if not hadStash and ((source:IsA("Accessory") and not options.KeepAccessories) or clothing) then
                index = index + 1; local key = source.ClassName .. ":" .. tostring(index)
                local applied, item, reason = pcall(Appearance.item, source, character, key)
                if applied and item then
                    table.insert(report.Items, {Key = key, Instance = item, Template = source:Clone(), Attempts = 0, Suppressed = false})
                else table.insert(report.Skipped, source.Name .. (reason and (" (" .. reason .. ")") or "")) end
            end
        end
        -- BodyColors can overwrite per-limb tint when parented; the captured
        -- visible colors are authoritative for the final local result.
        for name in pairs(copied) do character:FindFirstChild(name).Color=sourceModel:FindFirstChild(name).Color end
        if options.Original then
            Appearance.releaseRoot(character)
            -- Attachments only a copied avatar had (their effects are already gone) come off again.
            for name in pairs(copied) do
                local part, source = character:FindFirstChild(name), sourceModel:FindFirstChild(name)
                if part then part:SetAttribute("Lyra_GameTransparency", nil); part:SetAttribute("Lyra_SetSize", nil) end
                for _, at in ipairs(part and part:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    if at:IsA("Attachment") and at:GetAttribute("Lyra_AddedAttachment") and #at:GetChildren() == 0 and not (source and source:FindFirstChild(at.Name)) then
                        pcall(function() at:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            Appearance.keepRoot(character)
        end
    end, function(message) return tostring(message) end)
    pcall(function() hum.RequiresNeck=previousNeck end)
    if not ok then
        pcall(function() hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled=previousAutoScale end)
        for _,item in ipairs(report.Items) do item.Template:Destroy() end
        error(err,0)
    end
    return report
end
F.aAc = function(character, accessory) return Appearance.attach(character, accessory) end
F.aAv = function(character, model, options) return Appearance.apply(character, model, options) end

F.rDsp = function(u, f) if u == "SAVED" then return "Custom Avatar" end; local ok, i = pcall(function() return US:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync({u}) end); if ok and i and i[1] then local d = i[1].DisplayName; return (d and d ~= "" and d ~= i[1].Username) and d or i[1].Username end; return f end
F.spoofGameEvents = function(ch) if not Config.SpoofGameEvents then return end; if not ch or not getconnections then return end; pcall(function() for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(lp.CharacterAdded)) do if type(conn.Function) == "function" then task.spawn(conn.Function, ch) end end end); pcall(function() for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(lp.CharacterAppearanceLoaded)) do if type(conn.Function) == "function" then task.spawn(conn.Function, ch) end end end) end
F.updateNameSpoofInRealTime = function() local ch = lp.Character; if not ch then return end; local hm = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hm and hm.DisplayName ~= lp.DisplayName then pcall(function() hm.DisplayName = lp.DisplayName end) end end

-- ANIMATION RELOAD
-- Other players only replicate what the local Animator actually plays. Three things used to go wrong:
--   1) Animation instances were edited in place, so tracks cached by the old instance kept the old data.
--   2) Animate was restarted before the new assets were loaded, so the first Play was sent too early.
--   3) Several restarts could overlap and leave orphan tracks behind.
-- Now: ids are normalized, changed Animation instances are replaced by fresh ones, assets are preloaded and
-- warmed on the Animator, restarts are serialized, and one optional resync re-sends the start of every state.
F.normalizeAnimId = function(id)
    local text = tostring(id or "")
    local number = text:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or text:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or text:match("^(%d+)$")
    return number and ("rbxassetid://" .. number) or text
end
-- Every animation id Animate has used. A restart stops only tracks with these ids (or Animate's own instances): the
-- game's tracks, such as a weapon hold that the game plays once, keep playing.
F.AnimateIds = {}
F.rememberAnimateId = function(id)
    local normalized = F.normalizeAnimId(id)
    if normalized ~= "" then F.AnimateIds[normalized] = true end
end
F.rememberAnimateIds = function(animate)
    if not animate then return end
    for _, item in ipairs(animate:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("Animation") then F.rememberAnimateId(item.AnimationId) end
    end
end
-- Roblox's own animations of the default R6 and R15 Animate scripts. A game that keeps them lets avatars bring their
-- own animations; a game with other ids in Animate made its own.
F.DefaultAnimIds = {}
for _, id in ipairs({180435571, 180435792, 180426354, 125750702, 180436148, 180436334, 178130996, 182393478, 129967390, 129967478,
    128777973, 128853357, 182435998, 182491037, 182491065, 182436842, 182491248, 182491277, 182436935, 182491368, 182491423,
    129423131, 129423030, 507766388, 507766666, 507766951, 507777826, 507767714, 507784897, 507785072, 507765000, 507767968,
    507765644, 2506281703, 507768375, 522635514, 522638767, 507770239, 507770453, 507771019, 507771955, 507772104, 507776043,
    507776720, 507776879, 507777268, 507777451, 507777623, 507770818, 507770677, 913402848, 913376220, 913384386, 913389285}) do
    F.DefaultAnimIds["rbxassetid://" .. id] = true
end
-- Ids the copier put into Animate from an avatar's animation pack.
F.WrittenIds = {}
F.markWritten = function(list)
    for _, row in ipairs(list or {}) do
        local id = F.normalizeAnimId(row.Id)
        if id ~= "" then F.WrittenIds[id] = true end
    end
end
-- Animate's tracks: its own Animation instances, ids it has used and Roblox's defaults it plays when a folder is
-- missing. The game's tracks keep playing, even unparented ones (a game's own animation system).
F.isAnimateTrack = function(track, animate)
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local animation = track.Animation
        if not animation then return track.Priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Core end
        if animate and animation:IsDescendantOf(animate) then return true end
        local id = F.normalizeAnimId(animation.AnimationId)
        return F.AnimateIds[id] == true or F.DefaultAnimIds[id] == true
    end)
    return ok and result == true
end
-- Returns whether the id changed, and the Animation that now holds it (a changed one is replaced by a fresh copy).
F.setAnimationId = function(animation, id)
    local wanted = F.normalizeAnimId(id)
    if wanted == "" or F.normalizeAnimId(animation.AnimationId) == wanted then return false, animation end
    F.rememberAnimateId(animation.AnimationId); F.rememberAnimateId(wanted)
    local replaced, fresh = false, nil
    local parent = animation.Parent
    if parent then
        pcall(function() fresh = animation:Clone() end)
        if fresh then
            fresh.AnimationId = wanted
            if pcall(function() fresh.Parent = parent end) then
                replaced = true
                pcall(function() animation:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
    if not replaced then animation.AnimationId = wanted; fresh = animation end
    return true, fresh
end
-- Yields (up to timeout). Gets animations ready to play the moment Animate starts them: downloaded and loaded on the
-- character's Animator. An animation that is still loading plays nothing, so the character used to move stiff until
-- it had loaded. Ids that were ready once are skipped.
F.ReadyAnims = {}
-- Ids that did not load in time once (an animation this game may not play): they are not waited for again, so every
-- later change does not stand still for seconds. Animate still plays them if they load later.
F.SlowAnims = {}
F.preloadAnimations = function(ch, ids, timeout)
    local list, seen = {}, {}
    for _, id in ipairs(ids or {}) do
        local norm = F.normalizeAnimId(id)
        if norm ~= "" and not seen[norm] and not F.ReadyAnims[norm] and not F.SlowAnims[norm] then
            seen[norm] = true
            local animation = Instance.new("Animation"); animation.AnimationId = norm; table.insert(list, animation)
        end
    end
    if #list == 0 then return end
    local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 3)
    local preloaded = false
    task.spawn(function() pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(list) end); preloaded = true end)
    while not preloaded and os.clock() < deadline and IsAlive() do task.wait(0.05) end
    local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    local tracks = {}
    if animator then
--- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
        for _, animation in ipairs(list) do
            local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
            if ok and track then table.insert(tracks, {track, animation.AnimationId}) end
        end
        while os.clock() < deadline and IsAlive() do
            local ready = true
            for _, row in ipairs(tracks) do if row[1].Length <= 0 then ready = false; break end end
            if ready then break end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    elseif preloaded then
        for _, animation in ipairs(list) do F.ReadyAnims[animation.AnimationId] = true end
    end
    -- Only once its download finished: an animation that downloaded and still has no length will not play here.
    local late = preloaded and os.clock() >= deadline
    for _, row in ipairs(tracks) do
        if row[1].Length > 0 then F.ReadyAnims[row[2]] = true elseif late then F.SlowAnims[row[2]] = true end
        pcall(function() row[1]:Destroy() end)
    end
    for _, animation in ipairs(list) do pcall(function() animation:Destroy() end) end
end
F.warmAnimations = function(ch, timeout)
    local animate = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Animate"); if not animate then return end
    local ids = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(animate:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("Animation") and item.AnimationId ~= "" then table.insert(ids, item.AnimationId) end
    end
    F.preloadAnimations(ch, ids, timeout)
end
-- Yields. The animation ids of avatar animation assets (packs or single animations), read side by side.
F.packAnimationIds = function(assets)
    local ids, pending = {}, #assets
    for _, assetId in ipairs(assets) do
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                local sets = F.animationSets(assetId)
                if sets then for _, list in pairs(sets) do for _, row in ipairs(list) do table.insert(ids, row.Id) end end
                else
                    local one = F.resolveAnimationTrackId(assetId)
                    if one then table.insert(ids, one) end
                end
            end)
            pending = pending - 1
        end)
    end
    local deadline = os.clock() + 6
    while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline and IsAlive() do task.wait(0.05) end
    return ids
end
F.AnimSerial = 0
-- Restarts Animate so new animation ids play. The swap is smooth: playing tracks fade out while Animate
-- restarts on the next frame, so the character never stands stiff. The animations are made ready first (usually
-- they already are, see App.prefetchAnimations). The optional resync repeats the same swap once, so other players
-- load the new animations completely.
F.restartAnimate = function(ch, resync)
    local animate = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if not animate then return end
    F.AnimSerial = F.AnimSerial + 1
    local serial = F.AnimSerial
    task.spawn(function()
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local function cycle()
            if not ch.Parent or not animate.Parent then return false end
            -- A game that switched Animate off plays its own animations: Animate stays off and nothing is stopped.
            if not animate.Enabled then return false end
            F.rememberAnimateIds(animate)
            local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            -- Some games' Animate does not start again once switched off and on (a game that runs its own
            -- character scripts): the character then stood stiff, and an avatar drawn over it with visual-only too.
            -- There Animate is left running; its folders already hold the new ids, which it plays from its next move.
            if F.AnimateStuck then return true end
            -- Only Animate's tracks stop (the restarted Animate plays them again); the game's own tracks keep going.
            local stopped = {}
            if animator then
                for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    if F.isAnimateTrack(tr, animate) then
                        local ok, weight, speed = pcall(function() return tr.WeightTarget, tr.Speed end)
                        stopped[tr] = ok and {weight, speed} or {1, 1}
                        pcall(function() tr:Stop(0.15) end)
                    end
                end
            end
            animate.Enabled = false
            RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if ch.Parent and animate.Parent then animate.Enabled = true end
            -- Animate plays its idle at once when it starts. When nothing of it plays a moment later, the tracks it
            -- had are played again and restarts are not tried again in this session.
            if animator and next(stopped) then
                local deadline = os.clock() + 0.75
                local started = false
                while os.clock() < deadline and ch.Parent and animate.Parent and IsAlive() do
                    RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        -- A stopped track fades to weight 0; one Animate plays again has a weight to reach.
                        local ok, again = pcall(function() return tr.IsPlaying and tr.WeightTarget > 0 end)
                        if F.isAnimateTrack(tr, animate) and (not stopped[tr] or (ok and again)) then started = true; break end
                    end
                    if started then break end
                end
                if not started and ch.Parent and animate.Parent then
                    F.AnimateStuck = true
                    for tr, row in pairs(stopped) do pcall(function() tr:Play(0.15, row[1], row[2]) end) end
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        -- Animate restarted while the character walks stays in its standing animation until the speed changes, so
        -- the character slid along stiff. It restarts once the character stands still; meanwhile Animate already
        -- plays the new animations from its next move on. False when a newer restart took over.
        local function still()
            local deadline = os.clock() + 30
            while os.clock() < deadline and ch.Parent and hum and hum.Parent and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 do
                task.wait(0.1)
                if serial ~= F.AnimSerial or not IsAlive() then return false end
            end
            return serial == F.AnimSerial and IsAlive()
        end
        pcall(F.warmAnimations, ch, 2.5)
        if serial ~= F.AnimSerial or not IsAlive() or not still() then return end
        if not cycle() then return end
        if not resync or not Config.AnimResync then return end
        task.wait(1.2)
        if serial ~= F.AnimSerial or not IsAlive() or not still() then return end
        cycle()
    end)
end

-- DATA / v2 description codec. Legacy flat descriptions are accepted.
local Codec = {}
Codec.assetFields = {"Face", "Head", "Torso", "LeftArm", "RightArm", "LeftLeg", "RightLeg", "Shirt", "Pants", "GraphicTShirt",
    "ClimbAnimation", "FallAnimation", "IdleAnimation", "JumpAnimation", "RunAnimation", "SwimAnimation", "WalkAnimation", "MoodAnimation"}
Codec.scaleFields = {"BodyTypeScale", "DepthScale", "HeadScale", "HeightScale", "ProportionScale", "WidthScale"}
Codec.colorFields = {"HeadColor", "LeftArmColor", "RightArmColor", "LeftLegColor", "RightLegColor", "TorsoColor"}
