Codec.accessoryFields = {"HatAccessory", "HairAccessory", "FaceAccessory", "NeckAccessory", "ShouldersAccessory", "FrontAccessory", "BackAccessory", "WaistAccessory"}
function Codec.number(v, low, high)
    return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v >= low and v <= high
--|YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
end
function Codec.id(v)
    local n = tonumber(v)
    return Codec.number(n, 1, 9007199254740991) and n % 1 == 0 and n or nil
end
-- An emote list and the wheel slots that play it, made consistent: every slot (1-8) holds one emote that is in the
-- list. A slot whose emote is gone stays empty in Roblox's wheel but still counted as taken, so emotes added after it
-- all landed on slot 8, each one replacing the last.
function Codec.emoteSet(emotes, equipped)
    local list, slots, clean = {}, {}, {}
    if type(emotes) == "table" then
        for name, ids in pairs(emotes) do if type(name) == "string" and type(ids) == "table" and #ids > 0 then list[name] = ids end end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(type(equipped) == "table" and equipped or {}) do
        local slot = type(row) == "table" and tonumber(row.Slot)
        if slot and slot % 1 == 0 and slot >= 1 and slot <= 8 and not slots[slot] and type(row.Name) == "string" and list[row.Name] then
            slots[slot] = true; table.insert(clean, {Name = row.Name, Slot = slot})
        end
    end
    table.sort(clean, function(a, b) return a.Slot < b.Slot end)
    return list, clean
end
-- A name cut to a number of characters (not bytes, so an emoji is never split), without control characters.
function Codec.cut(text, limit)
    text = tostring(text or ""):gsub("%c", " ")
    if not utf8.len(text) then text = text:gsub("[\128-\255]", "") end
    if utf8.len(text) > limit then text = text:sub(1, utf8.offset(text, limit + 1) - 1) end
    return text
end
function Codec.encode(desc)
    local data = {Version = 2, Properties = {}, Colors = {}, Accessories = {}, Emotes = {}, EquippedEmotes = {}}
    for _, fields in ipairs({Codec.assetFields, Codec.scaleFields, Codec.accessoryFields}) do
        for _, field in ipairs(fields) do pcall(function() data.Properties[field] = desc[field] end) end
    end
    for _, field in ipairs(Codec.colorFields) do
        local c = desc[field]; data.Colors[field] = {c.R, c.G, c.B}
    end
    local ok, list = pcall(function() return desc:GetAccessories(true) end)
    data.HasAccessories = ok
    if ok then
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            local row = {AssetId = item.AssetId, AccessoryType = item.AccessoryType.Name, IsLayered = item.IsLayered}
            if item.Order ~= nil then row.Order = item.Order end
            if item.Puffiness ~= nil then row.Puffiness = item.Puffiness end
            for _, key in ipairs({"Position", "Rotation", "Scale"}) do
                local v = item[key]
                if typeof(v) == "Vector3" then row[key] = {v.X, v.Y, v.Z} end
            end
            table.insert(data.Accessories, row)
        end
    end
    pcall(function() data.Emotes, data.EquippedEmotes = Codec.emoteSet(desc:GetEmotes(), desc:GetEquippedEmotes()) end)
    -- Makeup (face, lip and eye layers) lives in MakeupDescription children of the description.
    data.Makeup = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(desc:GetChildren()) do
        if item.ClassName == "MakeupDescription" and #data.Makeup < 30 then
            local read, row = pcall(function() return {AssetId = item.AssetId, MakeupType = item.MakeupType.Name, Order = item.Order} end)
            if read and Codec.id(row.AssetId) then table.insert(data.Makeup, row) end
        end
    end
    return data
end
function Codec.decode(data)
    assert(type(data) == "table", "Invalid avatar data.")
    assert(data.Version == nil or data.Version == 2, "Unsupported avatar version.")
    local props = data.Version == 2 and data.Properties or data
    assert(type(props) == "table" and next(props) ~= nil, "Saved avatar data is incomplete.")
    local desc = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
    local assigned = 0
    for _, field in ipairs(Codec.assetFields) do
        local v = props[field]
        if Codec.number(v, 0, 9007199254740991) and v % 1 == 0 then
            local ok = pcall(function() desc[field] = v end); if ok then assigned = assigned + 1 end
        end
    end
    for _, field in ipairs(Codec.scaleFields) do
        if Codec.number(props[field], 0, 10) then desc[field] = props[field] end
    end
    for _, field in ipairs(Codec.accessoryFields) do
        local v = props[field]
        if type(v) == "string" and #v < 6000 and v:match("^[%d,%s]*$") then pcall(function() desc[field] = v end) end
    end
    for _, field in ipairs(Codec.colorFields) do
        local c = type(data.Colors) == "table" and data.Colors[field]
        if type(c) == "table" and Codec.number(c[1], 0, 1) and Codec.number(c[2], 0, 1) and Codec.number(c[3], 0, 1) then
            desc[field] = Color3.new(c[1], c[2], c[3])
        end
    end
    if data.HasAccessories and type(data.Accessories) == "table" then
        local accessories = {}
        for i, row in ipairs(data.Accessories) do
            if i > 150 then break end
            if type(row) == "table" and Codec.id(row.AssetId) and type(row.AccessoryType) == "string" then
                local ok, kind = pcall(function() return Enum.AccessoryType[row.AccessoryType] end)
                if ok and kind then
                    local item = {AssetId = row.AssetId, AccessoryType = kind, IsLayered = row.IsLayered == true}
                    if Codec.number(row.Order, 0, 1000) then item.Order = row.Order end
                    if Codec.number(row.Puffiness, 0, 10) then item.Puffiness = row.Puffiness end
                    for _, key in ipairs({"Position", "Rotation", "Scale"}) do
                        local v = row[key]
                        if type(v) == "table" and Codec.number(v[1], -10000, 10000) and Codec.number(v[2], -10000, 10000) and Codec.number(v[3], -10000, 10000) then
                            item[key] = Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3])
                        end
                    end
                    table.insert(accessories, item)
                end
            end
        end
        local ok, err = pcall(function() desc:SetAccessories(accessories, true) end)
        if not ok then desc:Destroy(); error("Saved accessories are incompatible: " .. tostring(err), 0) end
    end
    if type(data.Emotes) == "table" then
        local emotes = {}; local count = 0
        local function add(name, ids)
            if emotes[name] or type(name) ~= "string" or #name > 100 or type(ids) ~= "table" or count >= 250 then return end
            local valid = {}
            for i, id in ipairs(ids) do if i > 20 then break end; if Codec.id(id) then table.insert(valid, id) end end
            if #valid > 0 then emotes[name] = valid; count = count + 1 end
        end
        -- The equipped ones first, so a long emote list never pushes them out of the wheel.
        for _, row in ipairs(type(data.EquippedEmotes) == "table" and data.EquippedEmotes or {}) do
            if type(row) == "table" and type(row.Name) == "string" then add(row.Name, data.Emotes[row.Name]) end
        end
        for name, ids in pairs(data.Emotes) do add(name, ids) end
        pcall(function() desc:SetEmotes(emotes) end)
        -- Only slots whose emote is in the list (see Codec.emoteSet).
        local _, equipped = Codec.emoteSet(emotes, data.EquippedEmotes)
        pcall(function() desc:SetEquippedEmotes(equipped) end)
    end
    if type(data.Makeup) == "table" then
        for i, row in ipairs(data.Makeup) do
            if i > 30 then break end
            if type(row) == "table" and Codec.id(row.AssetId) and type(row.MakeupType) == "string" and #row.MakeupType < 40 then
                pcall(function()
                    local item = Instance.new("MakeupDescription")
                    item.AssetId = row.AssetId; item.MakeupType = Enum.MakeupType[row.MakeupType]
                    if Codec.number(row.Order, -100000, 100000) and row.Order % 1 == 0 then item.Order = row.Order end
                    item.Parent = desc
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    if assigned == 0 then desc:Destroy(); error("No valid avatar data was found.", 0) end
    return desc
end

-- Deep copy of plain saved data (tables of numbers, strings and booleans).
function Codec.copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local out = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do out[key] = Codec.copy(item) end
    return out
end

-- ITEM ADJUSTMENTS: move, turn, resize or fade single accessories of an appearance, keyed by accessory name and
-- stored in the appearance data (Data.Tweaks = {[name] = {P = {x, y, z}, R = {x, y, z}, S = size, T = fade}}).
-- Effects (fire, particles, trails) keep their own size and stay visible, so a plain item with a nice effect can
-- shrink or disappear while its effect stays. Movement and turns are around the point the item hangs from, in
-- the axes of the body attachment; layered clothing can only fade, because it is fitted to the body.
local Tweaks = {Limits = {Move = 6, Turn = 180, SizeMin = 0.05, SizeMax = 5}}
function Tweaks.empty(row)
    local function zero(v) return not v or (v[1] == 0 and v[2] == 0 and v[3] == 0) end
    return not row or (zero(row.P) and zero(row.R) and (row.S == nil or row.S == 1) and (row.T == nil or row.T == 0))
end
-- Saved, imported and shared adjustments are checked like the rest of a skin; bad entries are dropped.
function Tweaks.clean(list)
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local out, count = {}, 0
    local function vector(v, limit)
        if type(v) == "table" and Codec.number(v[1], -limit, limit) and Codec.number(v[2], -limit, limit) and Codec.number(v[3], -limit, limit) then return {v[1], v[2], v[3]} end
    end
    for name, row in pairs(list) do
        if count >= 150 then break end
        if type(name) == "string" and #name <= 120 and type(row) == "table" then
            local clean = {P = vector(row.P, Tweaks.Limits.Move), R = vector(row.R, Tweaks.Limits.Turn)}
            if Codec.number(row.S, Tweaks.Limits.SizeMin, Tweaks.Limits.SizeMax) then clean.S = row.S end
            if Codec.number(row.T, 0, 1) then clean.T = row.T end
            if not Tweaks.empty(clean) then out[name] = clean; count = count + 1 end
        end
    end
    return next(out) and out or nil
end
-- The handle attachment that matches an attachment of the body (the point the item hangs from).
function Tweaks.mount(character, handle)
    for _, item in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
        if item.ClassName == "Attachment" then
            for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if Appearance.isBody(part, character) then
                    local match = part:FindFirstChild(item.Name)
                    if match and match:IsA("Attachment") then return item, match, part end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
-- The untouched values are kept as attributes the first time, so every adjustment starts from the original
-- item, and the copies made from it (on your character, in the repair list) carry them along.
function Tweaks.base(accessory, handle)
    if handle:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseSize") ~= nil then return end
    handle:SetAttribute("Lyra_BaseSize", handle.Size); handle:SetAttribute("Lyra_BaseTransparency", handle.Transparency)
    for _, item in ipairs(handle:GetDescendants()) do
        if item.ClassName == "Attachment" and item.Parent == handle then item:SetAttribute("Lyra_BaseCFrame", item.CFrame)
        elseif item:IsA("DataModelMesh") then pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("Lyra_BaseScale", item.Scale); item:SetAttribute("Lyra_BaseOffset", item.Offset) end)
        elseif item:IsA("Decal") then item:SetAttribute("Lyra_BaseTransparency", item.Transparency) end
    end
    local mount = accessory:GetAttribute("Lyra_MountOffset")
    if typeof(mount) == "CFrame" then accessory:SetAttribute("Lyra_BaseMount", mount) end
end
-- Applies one adjustment (an empty one puts the item back as it was) to an accessory of a character or model.
function Tweaks.apply(character, accessory, row)
    local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    Tweaks.base(accessory, handle)
    row = row or {}
    local layered = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("WrapLayer") ~= nil
    local size = (not layered and row.S) or 1
    local p, r = row.P or {0, 0, 0}, row.R or {0, 0, 0}
    local turn = layered and CFrame.new() or CFrame.new(p[1], p[2], p[3]) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(r[1]), math.rad(r[2]), math.rad(r[3]))
    local fade = row.T or 0
    local function faded(base) return 1 - (1 - base) * (1 - fade) end
    local baseSize = handle:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseSize")
    if typeof(baseSize) == "Vector3" then handle.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(baseSize.X * size, 0.01), math.max(baseSize.Y * size, 0.01), math.max(baseSize.Z * size, 0.01)) end
    local baseFade = handle:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseTransparency")
    if type(baseFade) == "number" then handle.Transparency = faded(baseFade) end
    local mountAttachment, bodyAttachment, body = Tweaks.mount(character, handle)
    for _, item in ipairs(handle:GetDescendants()) do
        local baseCFrame = item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseCFrame")
        if typeof(baseCFrame) == "CFrame" and item:IsA("Attachment") then
            -- Attachments keep their place on the item as it resizes; the mount also carries the move and turn.
            local scaled = CFrame.new(baseCFrame.Position * size) * (baseCFrame - baseCFrame.Position)
            item.CFrame = item == mountAttachment and scaled * turn:Inverse() or scaled
        elseif item:IsA("DataModelMesh") and item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseScale") ~= nil then
            pcall(function() item.Scale = item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseScale") * size; item.Offset = item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseOffset") * size end)
        elseif item:IsA("Decal") and type(item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseTransparency")) == "number" then
            item.Transparency = faded(item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseTransparency"))
        end
    end
    -- A game item welded without a matching attachment moves through its saved weld offset instead.
    local baseMount = accessory:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseMount")
    if typeof(baseMount) == "CFrame" then accessory:SetAttribute("Lyra_MountOffset", CFrame.new(baseMount.Position) * turn * (baseMount - baseMount.Position)) end
    -- The weld already holding the item follows at once.
    for _, joint in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
        if joint:IsA("JointInstance") and (joint.Part0 == handle or joint.Part1 == handle) then
            local other = joint.Part0 == handle and joint.Part1 or joint.Part0
            local mountOffset = accessory:GetAttribute("Lyra_MountOffset")
            local c0, c1
            if mountAttachment and other == body then c0, c1 = bodyAttachment.CFrame, mountAttachment.CFrame
            elseif typeof(mountOffset) == "CFrame" and other and other.Name == accessory:GetAttribute("Lyra_MountBody") then c0, c1 = mountOffset, CFrame.new() end
            if c0 then
                if joint.Part1 == handle then joint.C0, joint.C1 = c0, c1 else joint.C0, joint.C1 = c1, c0 end
            end
        end
    end
end
function Tweaks.applyAll(character, list)
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") and list[item.Name] then pcall(Tweaks.apply, character, item, list[item.Name]) end
    end
end

-- Visual snapshot codec. This block is embedded in the delivered single-file hub.
local Visual = {}
-- Skin overlay and skin sync are defined after the UI; declared here so applySnapshot can reach them. So are the
-- stand-ins (copies of you that a game builds), your in-game picture and the picture pose.
local Overlay, Sync, Presence = {Active = {}}, {Peers = {}, Shown = {}}, {}
local Mirror, Thumbs, Pose, Ident = {}, {}, {}, {}
Visual.MeshCache = {}; Visual.MeshOrder = {}
function Visual.clearCache()
    for _,part in pairs(Visual.MeshCache) do part:Destroy() end
    Visual.MeshCache = {}; Visual.MeshOrder = {}
end
function Visual.remember(part)
    if not part:IsA("MeshPart") or part.MeshId=="" or Visual.MeshCache[part.MeshId] then return end
    local ok,copy=pcall(function() return part:Clone() end)
    if not ok or not copy then return end
    copy.Parent=nil
    for _,child in ipairs(copy:GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end
    Visual.MeshCache[part.MeshId]=copy; table.insert(Visual.MeshOrder,part.MeshId)
    if #Visual.MeshOrder>64 then
        local id=table.remove(Visual.MeshOrder,1); Visual.MeshCache[id]:Destroy(); Visual.MeshCache[id]=nil
    end
end
Visual.schemas = {
    Attachment = {CFrame="CFrame"}, Bone = {CFrame="CFrame"},
    SpecialMesh = {MeshId="string",TextureId="string",MeshType="Enum",Scale="Vector3",Offset="Vector3",VertexColor="Vector3"},
    BlockMesh = {Scale="Vector3",Offset="Vector3"}, CylinderMesh = {Scale="Vector3",Offset="Vector3"},
    Decal = {Texture="string",Face="Enum",Color3="Color3",Transparency="number"},
    Texture = {Texture="string",Face="Enum",Color3="Color3",Transparency="number",StudsPerTileU="number",StudsPerTileV="number",OffsetStudsU="number",OffsetStudsV="number"},
    SurfaceAppearance = {ColorMap="string",MetalnessMap="string",NormalMap="string",RoughnessMap="string",AlphaMode="Enum",Color="Color3"},
    WrapTarget = {CageMeshId="string",CageOrigin="CFrame",ImportOrigin="CFrame",Stiffness="number"},
    WrapLayer = {CageMeshId="string",CageOrigin="CFrame",ImportOrigin="CFrame",ReferenceMeshId="string",ReferenceOrigin="CFrame",BindOffset="CFrame",Order="number",Puffiness="number",Enabled="boolean",AutoSkin="Enum"},
    FaceControls = {},
}
-- Visual effects (horns, fire, sparkles, glows) are captured with their skin.
-- Effects the copier creates are tagged (Lyra_Effect), so a later skin only removes its own effects, never the game's.
Visual.effects = {
    -- How far and how fast particles travel (TimeScale, LockedToPart, VelocityInheritance, Shape*) and how an
    -- animated texture plays (Flipbook*) decide the look of a flame or aura as much as its colour and size.
    ParticleEmitter = {Enabled="boolean",Texture="string",Color="ColorSequence",Size="NumberSequence",Transparency="NumberSequence",
        Lifetime="NumberRange",Speed="NumberRange",Rate="number",SpreadAngle="Vector2",Rotation="NumberRange",RotSpeed="NumberRange",
        LightEmission="number",LightInfluence="number",Drag="number",Acceleration="Vector3",EmissionDirection="Enum",Shape="Enum",ZOffset="number",
        Brightness="number",TimeScale="number",Squash="NumberSequence",Orientation="Enum",LockedToPart="boolean",VelocityInheritance="number",
        WindAffectsDrag="boolean",ShapeStyle="Enum",ShapeInOut="Enum",ShapePartial="number",FlipbookLayout="Enum",FlipbookMode="Enum",
        FlipbookFramerate="NumberRange",FlipbookStartRandom="boolean"},
    Fire = {Enabled="boolean",Color="Color3",SecondaryColor="Color3",Heat="number",Size="number",TimeScale="number"},
    Sparkles = {Enabled="boolean",Color="Color3",SparkleColor="Color3",TimeScale="number"},
    Smoke = {Enabled="boolean",Color="Color3",Opacity="number",RiseVelocity="number",Size="number",TimeScale="number"},
    PointLight = {Enabled="boolean",Color="Color3",Brightness="number",Range="number",Shadows="boolean"},
    SpotLight = {Enabled="boolean",Color="Color3",Brightness="number",Range="number",Angle="number",Face="Enum",Shadows="boolean"},
    SurfaceLight = {Enabled="boolean",Color="Color3",Brightness="number",Range="number",Angle="number",Face="Enum",Shadows="boolean"},
    -- Trails and beams point at attachments; only sibling attachments (saved by name) can be rebuilt.
    Trail = {Enabled="boolean",Attachment0="Attachment",Attachment1="Attachment",Color="ColorSequence",Transparency="NumberSequence",
        WidthScale="NumberSequence",Texture="string",TextureLength="number",TextureMode="Enum",Lifetime="number",MinLength="number",
        MaxLength="number",LightEmission="number",LightInfluence="number",Brightness="number",FaceCamera="boolean"},
    Beam = {Enabled="boolean",Attachment0="Attachment",Attachment1="Attachment",Color="ColorSequence",Transparency="NumberSequence",
        Texture="string",TextureLength="number",TextureMode="Enum",TextureSpeed="number",Width0="number",Width1="number",
        CurveSize0="number",CurveSize1="number",Segments="number",LightEmission="number",LightInfluence="number",Brightness="number",
        FaceCamera="boolean",ZOffset="number"},
}
for class,fields in pairs(Visual.effects) do Visual.schemas[class]=fields end
function Visual.array(value, length, low, high)
    if type(value) ~= "table" or #value ~= length then return false end
    for i=1,length do if not Codec.number(value[i],low,high) then return false end end
    return true
end
function Visual.asset(value)
    return type(value)=="string" and #value<=300 and (value=="" or value:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") or value:match("^https?://[%w%.%-]+/[^%s]*[?&]id=%d+") or value:match("^rbxasset://[%w%p]+$"))
end
function Visual.pack(value, kind)
    if kind=="CFrame" then return {value:GetComponents()} end
    if kind=="Vector3" then return {value.X,value.Y,value.Z} end
    if kind=="Color3" then return {value.R,value.G,value.B} end
    if kind=="Enum" then return {tostring(value.EnumType):gsub("^Enum%.",""),value.Name} end
    if kind=="Vector2" then return {value.X,value.Y} end
    if kind=="NumberRange" then return {value.Min,value.Max} end
    if kind=="ColorSequence" then
        local keys={}
        for i,key in ipairs(value.Keypoints) do keys[i]={key.Time,key.Value.R,key.Value.G,key.Value.B} end
        return keys
    end
    if kind=="NumberSequence" then
        local keys={}
        for i,key in ipairs(value.Keypoints) do keys[i]={key.Time,key.Value,key.Envelope} end
        return keys
    end
    return value
end
function Visual.unpack(value, kind)
    if kind=="CFrame" then return CFrame.new(table.unpack(value)) end
    if kind=="Vector3" then return Vector3.new(table.unpack(value)) end
    if kind=="Color3" then return Color3.new(table.unpack(value)) end
    if kind=="Enum" then return Enum[value[1]][value[2]] end
    if kind=="Vector2" then return Vector2.new(table.unpack(value)) end
    if kind=="NumberRange" then return NumberRange.new(value[1],value[2]) end
    if kind=="ColorSequence" then
        local keys={}
        for i,key in ipairs(value) do keys[i]=ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(key[1],Color3.new(key[2],key[3],key[4])) end
        return ColorSequence.new(keys)
    end
    if kind=="NumberSequence" then
        local keys={}
        for i,key in ipairs(value) do keys[i]=NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(key[1],key[2],key[3] or 0) end
        return NumberSequence.new(keys)
    end
    return value
end
function Visual.valueValid(value, kind, effect)
    if kind=="CFrame" then
        if not Visual.array(value,12,-128,128) then return false end
        for i=4,12 do if math.abs(value[i])>1.001 then return false end end
        return true
    end
    -- Effect vectors are forces (particle acceleration such as gravity), not sizes.
    if kind=="Vector3" then local limit=effect and 100000 or 128; return Visual.array(value,3,-limit,limit) end
    -- Roblox accepts colour channels above 1 (HDR glow, used by particle, fire and light effects).
    if kind=="Color3" then return Visual.array(value,3,-100000,100000) end
    if kind=="Enum" then
        return type(value)=="table" and #value==2 and type(value[1])=="string" and #value[1]<60 and type(value[2])=="string" and #value[2]<60
    end
    if kind=="Vector2" or kind=="NumberRange" then return Visual.array(value,2,-100000,100000) end
    if kind=="ColorSequence" then
        if type(value)~="table" or #value<2 or #value>20 then return false end
        for _,key in ipairs(value) do
            if not (Visual.array(key,4,-100000,100000) and Codec.number(key[1],0,1)) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    if kind=="NumberSequence" then
        if type(value)~="table" or #value<2 or #value>20 then return false end
        for _,key in ipairs(value) do
            if not (Codec.number(key[1],0,1) and Codec.number(key[2],-100000,100000) and Codec.number(key[3] or 0,-100000,100000)) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    if kind=="Attachment" then return type(value)=="string" and #value<=120 end
    if kind=="number" then return Codec.number(value,-100000,100000) end
    return type(value)==kind and (kind~="string" or #value<=300)
end
-- The value an item has as its own avatar made it: an item adjustment (see ITEM ADJUSTMENTS) keeps the untouched value
-- as an attribute, and the game hiding your character (see GAME INVISIBILITY) keeps the item's own transparency. A
-- skin is saved untouched, with its adjustments listed apart, so they are never applied twice.
Visual.BaseAttributes = {CFrame = "Lyra_BaseCFrame", Scale = "Lyra_BaseScale", Offset = "Lyra_BaseOffset"}
function Visual.ownValue(item, field)
    if field == "Transparency" then
        -- The untouched item first (an adjusted item is listed apart), else its own value before the game hid it.
        local base = item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseTransparency")
        if type(base) == "number" then return base end
        local hidden = item:GetAttribute("Lyra_CloakBase")
        if type(hidden) == "number" then return hidden end
        return nil
    end
    if field == "Enabled" then
        local enabled = item:GetAttribute("Lyra_CloakEnabled")
        if type(enabled) == "boolean" then return enabled end
        return nil
    end
    local name = Visual.BaseAttributes[field]
    local base = name and item:GetAttribute(name)
    if base ~= nil and typeof(base) == typeof(item[field]) then return base end
    return nil
end
-- skip: instances left out of the snapshot (the composed makeup decal, rebuilt from the description instead).
function Visual.nodes(parent, depth, skip)
    assert(depth<12,"Visual hierarchy is too deep.")
    local rows={}
    for _,item in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
        local schema=Visual.schemas[item.ClassName]
        if schema and (skip and skip[item] or item:GetAttribute("Lyra_Makeup")) then schema=nil end
        if schema then
            local row={Class=item.ClassName,Name=item.Name,Properties={},Children=Visual.nodes(item,depth+1,skip)}
            for field,kind in pairs(schema) do
                local ok,value=pcall(function() return item[field] end)
                if ok and kind~="Attachment" then
                    local own=Visual.ownValue(item,field)
                    if own~=nil then value=own end
                end
                if ok and kind=="Attachment" then
                    if typeof(value)=="Instance" and value:IsA("Attachment") and value.Parent==parent then row.Properties[field]=value.Name end
                elseif ok then row.Properties[field]=Visual.pack(value,kind) end
            end
            table.insert(rows,row)
        end
    end
    return rows
end
function Visual.validateNodes(rows, depth, budget)
    assert(type(rows)=="table" and depth<12,"Invalid visual nodes.")
    for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
        budget[1]=budget[1]+1; assert(budget[1]<=4000,"Skin is too complex.")
        assert(type(row)=="table" and Visual.schemas[row.Class] and type(row.Name)=="string" and #row.Name<=120,"Invalid visual node.")
        assert(type(row.Properties)=="table","Propriedades visuais ausentes.")
        for field,value in pairs(row.Properties) do
            local kind=Visual.schemas[row.Class][field]
            if not (kind and Visual.valueValid(value,kind,Visual.effects[row.Class]~=nil)) then
                -- An effect is decoration: one value it cannot use is dropped, the rest of the skin still applies.
                assert(Visual.effects[row.Class],"Invalid visual property: "..tostring(field))
                row.Properties[field]=nil
            end
        end
        Visual.validateNodes(row.Children or {},depth+1,budget)
    end
end
function Visual.part(part, skip)
    Visual.remember(part)
    local size=part:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseSize")
    if typeof(size)~="Vector3" then size=part.Size end
    -- A body part the game hides right now (see GAME INVISIBILITY) is saved as the avatar shows it.
    local transparency=Visual.ownValue(part,"Transparency")
    if transparency==nil then
        local cloaked=Cloak.Parts and Cloak.Parts[part]
        transparency=cloaked and cloaked.Wanted or part.Transparency
    end
    if transparency>0.99 then transparency=1 end
    local row={Class=part:IsA("MeshPart") and "MeshPart" or "Part",Size=Visual.pack(size,"Vector3"),Color=Visual.pack(part.Color,"Color3"),Transparency=transparency,Nodes=Visual.nodes(part,0,skip)}
    if part:IsA("MeshPart") then row.MeshId=part.MeshId; row.TextureId=part.TextureID end
    row.Material=part.Material.Name; row.Reflectance=part.Reflectance
    local original=part:FindFirstChild("OriginalSize")
    if original and original:IsA("Vector3Value") then row.OriginalSize=Visual.pack(original.Value,"Vector3") end
    local scaleType=part:FindFirstChild("AvatarPartScaleType")
    if scaleType and scaleType:IsA("StringValue") then row.ScaleType=scaleType.Value end
    return row
end
function Visual.validate(v)
    assert(type(v)=="table" and v.Version==1 and (v.RigType=="R15" or v.RigType=="R6"),"Invalid skin format or rig.")
    assert(type(v.Body)=="table" and type(v.Accessories)=="table" and #v.Accessories<=150,"Invalid body/accessories.")
    local count,budget=0,{0}
    local function part(row)
        assert(type(row)=="table" and (row.Class=="Part" or row.Class=="MeshPart"),"Invalid part type.")
        assert(Visual.array(row.Size,3,0.001,64) and Visual.array(row.Color,3,0,1) and Codec.number(row.Transparency,0,1),"Invalid dimensions or colors.")
        if row.Class=="MeshPart" then assert(Visual.asset(row.MeshId) and row.MeshId~="" and Visual.asset(row.TextureId or ""),"Invalid mesh/texture ID.") end
        if row.Nodes then Visual.validateNodes(row.Nodes,0,budget) end
        if row.OriginalSize then assert(Visual.array(row.OriginalSize,3,0.001,64),"Invalid original dimensions.") end
        if row.ScaleType then assert(type(row.ScaleType)=="string" and #row.ScaleType<80,"Invalid scale type.") end
    end
    for name,row in pairs(v.Body) do assert(S.BD[name] and name~="HumanoidRootPart","Membro desconhecido."); part(row); count=count+1 end
    assert(count>0 and count<=20,"The skin contains no body.")
    for _,row in ipairs(v.Accessories) do
        assert(type(row)=="table" and type(row.Name)=="string" and #row.Name<=120,"Invalid accessory."); part(row.Handle)
        if row.AttachmentPoint then assert(Visual.valueValid(row.AttachmentPoint,"CFrame"),"Invalid attachment.") end
        -- The saved weld is only a fallback: a damaged one is dropped instead of rejecting the skin.
        if row.Mount~=nil and not (type(row.Mount)=="table" and type(row.Mount.Body)=="string" and S.BD[row.Mount.Body]
            and Visual.valueValid(row.Mount.Offset,"CFrame")) then row.Mount=nil end
        -- The catalog item it is (see Visual.overlay) and whether it is made of several parts are optional too.
        if row.AssetId~=nil and not Codec.id(row.AssetId) then row.AssetId=nil end
        if row.Multi~=nil and row.Multi~=true then row.Multi=nil end
    end
    for name,id in pairs(v.Clothes or {}) do assert((name=="Shirt" or name=="Pants" or name=="Graphic") and Visual.asset(id),"Invalid clothing.") end
    for name,color in pairs(v.Colors or {}) do assert(({Head=true,Torso=true,LeftArm=true,RightArm=true,LeftLeg=true,RightLeg=true})[name] and Visual.array(color,3,0,1),"Invalid color.") end
    assert(type(v.Links or {})=="table" and #(v.Links or {})<=32,"Invalid joints.")
    for _,link in ipairs(v.Links or {}) do
        assert(type(link)=="table" and S.BD[link.A] and S.BD[link.B] and Visual.valueValid(link.C0,"CFrame") and Visual.valueValid(link.C1,"CFrame"),"Invalid body connection.")
    end
    for name,value in pairs(v.Scales or {}) do
        assert(({BodyDepthScale=true,BodyHeightScale=true,BodyWidthScale=true,HeadScale=true,BodyProportionScale=true,BodyTypeScale=true})[name] and Codec.number(value,0,10),"Invalid scale.")
    end
-- cache YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    if v.HipHeight~=nil then assert(Codec.number(v.HipHeight,0,64),"Invalid height.") end
    -- The pose kept for pictures is optional: a damaged one is dropped instead of rejecting the skin.
    if v.Pose~=nil then
        local joints,valid=0,type(v.Pose)=="table"
        for name,offset in pairs(valid and v.Pose or {}) do
            joints=joints+1
            if joints>20 or type(name)~="string" or not S.BD[name] or not Visual.valueValid(offset,"CFrame") then valid=false; break end
        end
        if not valid then v.Pose=nil end
    end
    -- The rig the kept pose was made on, when it isn't the skin's own (see Looks.capture).
    if v.PoseRig~=nil and v.PoseRig~="R15" and v.PoseRig~="R6" then v.PoseRig=nil end
    -- Skins saved before poses were kept apart may still carry one in their joints.
    if not v.PoseChecked then pcall(Visual.unpose,v,false) end
    if v.RootSize then assert(Visual.array(v.RootSize,3,0.001,64),"Invalid root dimensions.") end
    assert(type(v.Animations or {})=="table" and #(v.Animations or {})<=100,"Invalid animations.")
    for _,row in ipairs(v.Animations or {}) do
        assert(type(row)=="table" and type(row.Path)=="table" and #row.Path<=12 and Visual.asset(row.Id),"Invalid animation.")
        for _,name in ipairs(row.Path) do assert(type(name)=="string" and #name<=120,"Invalid animation path.") end
        -- Weights and the whole-set mark are optional; a bad one is dropped instead of rejecting the skin.
        if row.Weight~=nil and not Codec.number(row.Weight,0,100000) then row.Weight=nil end
        if row.Full~=nil and row.Full~=true then row.Full=nil end
    end
    return v
end
-- The body part an accessory is really welded to on this character, and the handle's offset from it.
function Visual.mount(character, handle, links)
    for _,link in ipairs(links) do
        local body
        if link.B==handle and Appearance.isBody(link.A,character) then body=link.A
        elseif link.A==handle and Appearance.isBody(link.B,character) then body=link.B end
        if body then
            local offset=body.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(handle.CFrame)
            if offset.Position.Magnitude<=64 then return {Body=body.Name,Offset=Visual.pack(offset,"CFrame")} end
        end
    end
end
-- SAVED POSE: posing games bend the body by changing its joints. A skin saved like that kept the bent joints, so
-- wearing it twisted the character or lifted it off the ground. A skin is saved standing; a real pose is kept apart
-- (Visual.Pose: the offset of each bent joint from its rest) and only shows in the Roblox menu picture and the game's
-- pictures of you (see POSE).
-- R6 joints at rest, by the part they move: the parent part, the shared rotation, and where the joint sits on each
-- part for its size (a classic R6 body: torso 2x2x1, limbs 1x2x1, head 2x1x1).
do
    local function turn(...) return CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, ...) end
    local back, right, left = turn(-1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0), turn(0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, -1, 0, 0), turn(0, 0, -1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0)
    Visual.R6Rest = {
        Head = {A = "Torso", R = back, P0 = function(t) return Vector3.new(0, t.Y / 2, 0) end, P1 = function(_, b) return Vector3.new(0, -b.Y / 2, 0) end},
        Torso = {A = "HumanoidRootPart", R = back, P0 = function() return Vector3.zero end, P1 = function() return Vector3.zero end},
        ["Right Arm"] = {A = "Torso", R = right, P0 = function(t) return Vector3.new(t.X / 2, t.Y / 4, 0) end, P1 = function(_, b) return Vector3.new(-b.X / 2, b.Y / 4, 0) end},
        ["Left Arm"] = {A = "Torso", R = left, P0 = function(t) return Vector3.new(-t.X / 2, t.Y / 4, 0) end, P1 = function(_, b) return Vector3.new(b.X / 2, b.Y / 4, 0) end},
        ["Right Leg"] = {A = "Torso", R = right, P0 = function(t) return Vector3.new(t.X / 2, -t.Y / 2, 0) end, P1 = function(_, b) return Vector3.new(b.X / 2, b.Y / 2, 0) end},
        ["Left Leg"] = {A = "Torso", R = left, P0 = function(t) return Vector3.new(-t.X / 2, -t.Y / 2, 0) end, P1 = function(_, b) return Vector3.new(-b.X / 2, b.Y / 2, 0) end},
    }
end
-- Limbs: a pose bends at least one of them; a game that only turns the head or torso (looking around) is no pose.
Visual.PoseLimbs = {LeftUpperArm = true, RightUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, LeftUpperLeg = true,
    RightUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true}
Visual.PoseBends = {LeftLowerArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, LeftUpperLeg = true, RightUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true,
    ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true}
-- Rest offsets (C0, C1) of the joint from part a to part b of a saved skin, or nil when unknown. R15 joints sit on
-- the rig attachments both parts share (Roblox builds them from those); R6 joints on the classic places.
function Visual.restJoint(v, a, b)
    local rowA, rowB = v.Body[a], v.Body[b]
    if not rowA or not rowB then
        -- The root is not stored as a body part; its size is.
        if a ~= "HumanoidRootPart" or not rowB then return nil end
    end
    if v.RigType == "R15" then
        local function attachments(row)
            local list = {}
            for _, node in ipairs(row and row.Nodes or {}) do
                if node.Class == "Attachment" and type(node.Name) == "string" and node.Name:match("RigAttachment$")
                    and type(node.Properties) == "table" and Visual.valueValid(node.Properties.CFrame, "CFrame") then
                    list[node.Name] = Visual.unpack(node.Properties.CFrame, "CFrame")
                end
            end
            return list
        end
        local listA, listB = attachments(rowA), attachments(rowB)
        local best
        for name, cf in pairs(listB) do
            if listA[name] and (not best or name < best) then best = name end
        end
        if best then return listA[best], listB[best] end
        return nil
    end
    local rest = Visual.R6Rest[b]
    if not rest or rest.A ~= a then return nil end
    local sizeA = rowA and Visual.unpack(rowA.Size, "Vector3") or (v.RootSize and Visual.unpack(v.RootSize, "Vector3")) or Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
    local sizeB = Visual.unpack(rowB.Size, "Vector3")
    return CFrame.new(rest.P0(sizeA, sizeB)) * rest.R, CFrame.new(rest.P1(sizeA, sizeB)) * rest.R
end
-- Puts the bent joints of a saved skin back at rest and returns the pose they made ({[part] = packed offset}) and
-- whether it is a real pose: three or more joints bent, a limb among them, an elbow, knee or leg among them (or four
-- joints at least). force: a capture (R15 joints always go back to rest, a real pose or not); otherwise an older skin,
-- which is only changed when it holds a real pose.
function Visual.unpose(v, force)
    v.PoseChecked = true
    local rows, bent, limb, bend = {}, 0, false, false
    for index, link in ipairs(v.Links or {}) do
        local ok, r0, r1 = pcall(Visual.restJoint, v, link.A, link.B)
        if ok and r0 and r1 then
            local c0, c1 = Visual.unpack(link.C0, "CFrame"), Visual.unpack(link.C1, "CFrame")
            local offset = r0:Inverse() * c0 * c1:Inverse() * r1
            local _, angle = offset:ToAxisAngle()
            angle = math.deg(math.abs(angle))
            local distance = offset.Position.Magnitude
            if angle > 12 or distance > 0.15 then
                table.insert(rows, {Index = index, Part = link.B, R0 = r0, R1 = r1, Offset = offset})
                if angle >= 20 or distance >= 0.5 then
                    bent = bent + 1
                    if Visual.PoseLimbs[link.B] then limb = true end
                    if Visual.PoseBends[link.B] then bend = true end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local real = bent >= 3 and limb and (bend or bent >= 4)
    if force then Visual.LastPoseCheck = {Rig = v.RigType, Bent = bent, Limb = limb, Bend = bend, Real = real} end
    if not real and not (force and v.RigType == "R15") then return nil, false end
    local pose = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local link = v.Links[row.Index]
        link.C0 = Visual.pack(row.R0, "CFrame"); link.C1 = Visual.pack(row.R1, "CFrame")
        pose[row.Part] = Visual.pack(row.Offset, "CFrame")
    end
    -- An older skin that held a real pose was posed on purpose: its pictures keep it.
    if real and not force then v.Pose = pose end
    return real and pose or nil, real
end
-- Yields. Poses a model with a skin's saved pose (the same rig only); returns whether it did.
function Visual.applyPose(model, v)
    if type(v) ~= "table" or type(v.Pose) ~= "table" or not next(v.Pose) then return false end
    if F.getTrueRigType(model) ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType[v.RigType] then return false end
    local map = {}
    for name, offset in pairs(v.Pose) do map[name] = Visual.unpack(offset, "CFrame") end
    Pose.set(model, map)
    return true
end
-- A joint as the drawn avatar shows it (visual-only). It copies your character's pose either into its joints'
-- Transform or, with its joints off, by placing each part where your character's is. Either way the turn between the
-- two parts is the pose; an offset of the joint itself (a crouch) is only taken from its Transform.
function Visual.drawnJoint(link)
    local ok, c0 = pcall(function()
        local relative = link.C0:Inverse() * link.A.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(link.B.CFrame) * link.C1
        return link.C0 * CFrame.new(link.Transform.Position) * (relative - relative.Position)
    end)
    return ok and c0 or link.C0 * link.Transform
end
-- The pose a look's pictures use: the one saved with the skin, else one kept for the avatar worn now (a pose you
-- chose to keep after saving it). Returns a table with RigType and Pose, or nil.
function Visual.picturePose(snapshot)
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local v = type(snapshot.Data) == "table" and snapshot.Data.Visual or nil
    if type(v) == "table" and type(v.Pose) == "table" and next(v.Pose) then
        local rig = v.PoseRig or v.RigType
        if Enum.HumanoidRigType[rig] then return {RigType = rig, Pose = v.Pose} end
    end
    local kept = snapshot.Pose
    if type(kept) == "table" and type(kept.Pose) == "table" and next(kept.Pose) and Enum.HumanoidRigType[kept.RigType] then return kept end
    return nil
end
-- Returns the snapshot and the names of accessories it had to leave out.
-- source: the model the look is read from, your character itself or (visual-only) the avatar drawn over it, whose
-- joints are read as it shows them (see Visual.drawnJoint).
function Visual.capture(character, animations, source)
    local model=source or character
    local hum=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    assert(hum and character==lp.Character,"Wait for your character to load.")
    local v={Version=1,RigType=hum.RigType.Name,Body={},Accessories={},Clothes={},Colors={},Scales={},Links={},HipHeight=hum.HipHeight,Animations=animations or {}}
    local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    assert(root and root:IsA("BasePart"),"Wait for your character's root to load.")
    v.RootSize=Visual.pack(root.Size,"Vector3")
    -- Makeup is one decal composed from the description's makeup items. The description already carries them,
    -- so the generated decal is left out and rebuilt on apply.
    local skip={}
    for _,source in ipairs(hum:GetChildren()) do
        if source:IsA("HumanoidDescription") then
            for _,item in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
                if item.ClassName=="MakeupDescription" then
                    local ok,decal=pcall(function() return item:GetAppliedInstance() end)
                    if ok and typeof(decal)=="Instance" then skip[decal]=true end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local links,skipped=Rig.links(model),{}
    for _,part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if Appearance.isBody(part,model) and part.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" then
            local display=model:FindFirstChild("LyraVisual_"..part.Name)
            if display and display:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor")~=part.Name then display=nil end
            local row=Visual.part(display or part,skip)
            if display then
                for i=#row.Nodes,1,-1 do if row.Nodes[i].Class=="Attachment" then table.remove(row.Nodes,i) end end
                for _,node in ipairs(Visual.nodes(part,0,skip)) do if node.Class=="Attachment" then table.insert(row.Nodes,node) end end
            end
            row.Size=Visual.pack(part.Size,"Vector3"); v.Body[part.Name]=row
        elseif part:IsA("Accessory") then
            local handle=part:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                local single=true
                for _,child in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do if child:IsA("BasePart") and child~=handle then single=false; break end end
                -- A catalog item keeps its id: the skin is rebuilt with Roblox's own copy of it (see Visual.overlay).
                local assetId=Codec.id(part:GetAttribute("Lyra_AssetId"))
                -- An item built from several parts can only come back as that catalog item; without one it is left
                -- out instead of failing the whole save.
                if (single or assetId) and #v.Accessories<150 then
                    local mount=Visual.mount(model,handle,links)
                    -- A moved or turned item is saved where its avatar puts it; the move is in the skin's adjustments.
                    local baseMount=part:GetAttribute("Lyra_BaseMount")
                    if mount and typeof(baseMount)=="CFrame" and baseMount.Position.Magnitude<=64 then mount.Offset=Visual.pack(baseMount,"CFrame") end
                    table.insert(v.Accessories,{Name=part.Name,Type=part.AccessoryType.Name,Handle=Visual.part(handle,skip),
                        AttachmentPoint=Visual.pack(part.AttachmentPoint,"CFrame"),Mount=mount,AssetId=assetId,Multi=(not single) or nil})
                else table.insert(skipped,part.Name) end
            end
        elseif part:IsA("Shirt") then v.Clothes.Shirt=part.ShirtTemplate
        elseif part:IsA("Pants") then v.Clothes.Pants=part.PantsTemplate
        elseif part:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then v.Clothes.Graphic=part.Graphic
        elseif part:IsA("BodyColors") then
            for _,name in ipairs({"Head","Torso","LeftArm","RightArm","LeftLeg","RightLeg"}) do v.Colors[name]=Visual.pack(part[name.."Color3"],"Color3") end
        end
    end
    for _,name in ipairs({"BodyDepthScale","BodyHeightScale","BodyWidthScale","HeadScale","BodyProportionScale","BodyTypeScale"}) do
        local value=hum:FindFirstChild(name); if value and value:IsA("NumberValue") then v.Scales[name]=value.Value end
    end
    for _,link in ipairs(links) do
        if Appearance.isBody(link.A,model) and Appearance.isBody(link.B,model) then
            local c0=source and Visual.drawnJoint(link) or link.C0
            table.insert(v.Links,{A=link.A.Name,B=link.B.Name,C0=Visual.pack(c0,"CFrame"),C1=Visual.pack(link.C1,"CFrame")})
        end
    end
    -- Saved standing (see SAVED POSE). A real pose is offered for your pictures; one made while holding a tool is a
    -- game aiming it, not a pose.
    local pose,real=Visual.unpose(v,true)
    if not real or character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then pose=nil end
    return Visual.validate(v),skipped,pose
end
function Visual.legacy(raw)
    assert(type(raw)=="table" and (type(raw.MembrosCorpo)=="table" or type(raw.MembrosCustom)=="table"),"Old JSON not recognized.")
    local v={Version=1,RigType=raw.RigType,Body={},Accessories={},Clothes=raw.Roupas or {},Colors=raw.Cores or {},Scales=raw.Escalas or {},Links={},Animations={},Legacy=true}
    local function part(old, accessory)
        local row={Class="MeshPart",Size=old.Size,Color=old.Color,Transparency=old.Transparency or 0,MeshId=old.MeshId,TextureId=old.TextureId or "",Nodes={}}
        if old.SurfaceColorMap and old.SurfaceColorMap~="" then table.insert(row.Nodes,{Class="SurfaceAppearance",Name="SurfaceAppearance",Properties={ColorMap=old.SurfaceColorMap},Children={}}) end
        if accessory and old.AttachmentName then table.insert(row.Nodes,{Class="Attachment",Name=old.AttachmentName,Properties={CFrame=old.AttachmentCFrame},Children={}}) end
        -- These files do not record whether a Handle was a SpecialMesh or MeshPart.
        -- Non-default mesh transforms identify the SpecialMesh form unambiguously.
        local sc,off=old.Scale,old.Offset
        if accessory and ((sc and (sc[1]~=1 or sc[2]~=1 or sc[3]~=1)) or (off and (off[1]~=0 or off[2]~=0 or off[3]~=0))) then
            row.Class="Part"
            table.insert(row.Nodes,{Class="SpecialMesh",Name="Mesh",Properties={MeshType={"MeshType","FileMesh"},MeshId=old.MeshId,TextureId=old.TextureId or "",Scale=sc or {1,1,1},Offset=off or {0,0,0}},Children={}})
        end
        return row
    end
    for name,row in pairs(raw.MembrosCustom or raw.MembrosCorpo) do v.Body[name]=part(row,false) end
    for _,row in ipairs(raw.Acessorios or {}) do table.insert(v.Accessories,{Name=row.Nome or "Accessory",Handle=part(row,true)}) end
    if raw.IsHeadless and v.Body.Head then v.Body.Head.Transparency=1 end
    for name,id in pairs(raw.Animacoes or {}) do table.insert(v.Animations,{Path={name},Id=id}) end
    Visual.validate(v)
    local properties={}; for _,field in ipairs(Codec.assetFields) do properties[field]=0 end
    local map={BodyTypeScale="BodyTypeScale",BodyProportionScale="ProportionScale",HeadScale="HeadScale",BodyWidthScale="WidthScale",BodyDepthScale="DepthScale",BodyHeightScale="HeightScale"}
    for name,value in pairs(v.Scales) do properties[map[name]]=value end
    local colors={}; for name,color in pairs(v.Colors) do colors[name.."Color"]=color end
    return {Version=2,Properties=properties,Colors=colors,Accessories={},HasAccessories=true,Emotes={},EquippedEmotes={},Visual=v}
end
-- Whether a property already holds a saved value. Values that only differ in the way they are written (an asset as
-- rbxassetid:// or as a web link, a number rounded by the save file) are not written again: rewriting the textures of
-- an item Roblox made could stop them from loading.
function Visual.same(a, b, kind)
    if a == b then return true end
    if kind == "string" then return type(a) == "string" and type(b) == "string" and a ~= "" and Mirror.assetKey(a) == Mirror.assetKey(b) end
    if kind == "number" then return type(a) == "number" and type(b) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) < 1e-5 end
    if kind == "CFrame" then return Fit.same(a, b) end
    if kind == "Vector3" then return typeof(a) == "Vector3" and typeof(b) == "Vector3" and (a - b).Magnitude < 1e-4 end
    if kind == "Color3" then return typeof(a) == "Color3" and typeof(b) == "Color3" and math.abs(a.R - b.R) + math.abs(a.G - b.G) + math.abs(a.B - b.B) < 1e-4 end
    return false
end
function Visual.restoreNodes(parent, rows, preserveAttachments)
    local kept,links={},{}
    for _,row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        local item=parent:FindFirstChild(row.Name)
        if item and item.ClassName~=row.Class then item:Destroy(); item=nil end
        local effect=Visual.effects[row.Class]~=nil
        if not item then
            item=Instance.new(row.Class); item.Name=row.Name; item.Parent=parent
            if effect then item:SetAttribute("Lyra_Effect",true) end
        end
        kept[item]=true
        for field,value in pairs(row.Properties) do
            local kind=Visual.schemas[row.Class][field]
            if kind=="Attachment" then
                table.insert(links,{Item=item,Field=field,Name=value})
            else
                local ok,err=pcall(function()
                    local decoded=Visual.unpack(value,kind)
                    if not Visual.same(item[field],decoded,kind) then item[field]=decoded end
                end)
                -- A single effect property the game refuses should not block the whole skin.
                if not ok and not effect then error("Could not rebuild "..row.Class.."."..field..": "..tostring(err),0) end
            end
        end
        Visual.restoreNodes(item,row.Children,false)
    end
    -- Attachments may come after the trail/beam that uses them, so links are set once every sibling exists.
    for _,link in ipairs(links) do
        local target=parent:FindFirstChild(link.Name)
        if target and target:IsA("Attachment") then pcall(function() link.Item[link.Field]=target end) end
    end
    for _,item in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
        local ours=Visual.effects[item.ClassName]~=nil and item:GetAttribute("Lyra_Effect")==true
        local schemaOwned=Visual.schemas[item.ClassName] and Visual.effects[item.ClassName]==nil
        if (schemaOwned or ours) and not kept[item] and not (preserveAttachments and item:IsA("Attachment")) and not item:GetAttribute("Lyra_Makeup") then item:Destroy() end
    end
end
function Visual.mesh(id)
    if Visual.MeshCache[id] then return Visual.MeshCache[id]:Clone() end
    local ok,part=pcall(function() return game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromUri(id),{}) end)
    if not ok then ok,part=pcall(function() return game:GetService("InsertService"):CreateMeshPartAsync(id,Enum.CollisionFidelity.Default,Enum.RenderFidelity.Automatic) end) end
    assert(ok and part and part:IsA("MeshPart"),"Roblox could not load mesh "..id..". Your character has not been changed yet.")
    if not IsAlive() then part:Destroy(); error("Execution ended.",0) end
    Visual.remember(part)
    return part
end
function Visual.applyPart(target,row,preserveAttachments)
    if row.Class=="MeshPart" and target.MeshId~=row.MeshId then
        local mesh=Visual.mesh(row.MeshId)
        local ok,err=pcall(function() target:ApplyMesh(mesh) end); mesh:Destroy()
        assert(ok,"Falha ao preparar a malha: "..tostring(err))
    end
    target.Size=Visual.unpack(row.Size,"Vector3"); target.Color=Visual.unpack(row.Color,"Color3"); target.Transparency=row.Transparency
    if target:IsA("MeshPart") and not Visual.same(target.TextureID,row.TextureId or "","string") then target.TextureID=row.TextureId or "" end
    if row.Material then pcall(function() target.Material=Enum.Material[row.Material] end) end
    target.Reflectance=row.Reflectance or 0
    Visual.restoreNodes(target,row.Nodes,preserveAttachments)
    local original=target:FindFirstChild("OriginalSize") or Instance.new("Vector3Value")
    original.Name="OriginalSize"; original.Value=Visual.unpack(row.OriginalSize or row.Size,"Vector3"); original.Parent=target
    if row.ScaleType then
        local scaleType=target:FindFirstChild("AvatarPartScaleType") or Instance.new("StringValue")
        scaleType.Name="AvatarPartScaleType"; scaleType.Value=row.ScaleType; scaleType.Parent=target
    end
end
-- Returns the model and the names of accessories that could not be attached on this rig.
function Visual.overlay(model,v)
    Visual.validate(v)
    model:SetAttribute("Lyra_VisualSnapshot",true)
    local hum=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    assert(hum and hum.RigType.Name==v.RigType,"This skin is "..v.RigType.."; apply it to a character of the same rig type.")
    hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled=false
    if v.RootSize then model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart").Size=Visual.unpack(v.RootSize,"Vector3") end
    local oldSizes={}
    for name,row in pairs(v.Body) do
        local part=model:FindFirstChild(name); assert(part and part:IsA("BasePart"),"Missing limb: "..name)
        oldSizes[name]=part.Size
        if part.ClassName~=row.Class then
            local replacement=Instance.new(row.Class); replacement.Name=name; replacement.CFrame=part.CFrame; replacement.Size=part.Size; replacement.Parent=model
            for _,child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do child.Parent=replacement end
            for _,joint in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if joint:IsA("JointInstance") or joint:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                    if joint.Part0==part then joint.Part0=replacement end
                    if joint.Part1==part then joint.Part1=replacement end
                end
            end
            replacement.Parent=model; part:Destroy(); part=replacement
        end
        -- Generated AnimationConstraints may refer to sockets absent in an older
        -- Motor6D snapshot. Retain those instances and set their offsets below.
        Visual.applyPart(part,row,true)
    end
    local function scaleOffset(cf,ratio) return CFrame.new(cf.Position*ratio)*(cf-cf.Position) end
    local links=Rig.links(model)
    if v.Legacy then
        for name,old in pairs(oldSizes) do
            local part=model:FindFirstChild(name)
            for _,at in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do if at:IsA("Attachment") and not at:IsA("Bone") then at.CFrame=scaleOffset(at.CFrame,part.Size/old) end end
        end
    end
    for _,link in ipairs(links) do
        if Appearance.isBody(link.A,model) and Appearance.isBody(link.B,model) then
            local a,b
            for _,saved in ipairs(v.Links) do
                if saved.A==link.A.Name and saved.B==link.B.Name then a=Visual.unpack(saved.C0,"CFrame"); b=Visual.unpack(saved.C1,"CFrame"); break end
                if saved.B==link.A.Name and saved.A==link.B.Name then b=Visual.unpack(saved.C0,"CFrame"); a=Visual.unpack(saved.C1,"CFrame"); break end
            end
            if not a and v.Legacy then
                local ra=oldSizes[link.A.Name] and link.A.Size/oldSizes[link.A.Name] or Vector3.new(1,1,1)
                local rb=oldSizes[link.B.Name] and link.B.Size/oldSizes[link.B.Name] or Vector3.new(1,1,1)
                a=scaleOffset(link.C0,ra); b=scaleOffset(link.C1,rb)
            end
            assert(a and b,"The skin is missing the joints required for "..link.A.Name.." / "..link.B.Name)
            if link.Object:IsA("JointInstance") then link.Object.C0=a; link.Object.C1=b
            elseif link.Object:IsA("RigidConstraint") or link.Object:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then link.Object.Attachment0.CFrame=a; link.Object.Attachment1.CFrame=b
            else error("Body joint cannot be adjusted.",0) end
        end
    end
    -- Roblox's own copies of the skin's catalog items (built from its description) are kept aside, and an item the skin
    -- names is rebuilt from that copy instead of from scratch. Only Roblox can load a SurfaceAppearance (the textures of
    -- most new hair and hats) or fit layered clothing; the ones a script made showed nothing, so a saved skin came back
    -- bald and without its hat. The saved place, size and look still apply on top.
    local spares={}
    for _,item in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") then
            local handle=item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then item.Parent=nil; table.insert(spares,item) else item:Destroy() end
        elseif item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or item:IsA("BodyColors") then item:Destroy() end
    end
    local function meshOf(handle)
        if handle:IsA("MeshPart") then return handle.MeshId end
        local mesh=handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
        return mesh and mesh.MeshId or ""
    end
    local function savedMesh(row)
        if row.Class=="MeshPart" then return tostring(row.MeshId or "") end
        for _,node in ipairs(row.Nodes or {}) do
            if node.Class=="SpecialMesh" and type(node.Properties)=="table" then return tostring(node.Properties.MeshId or "") end
        end
        return ""
    end
    local function spare(row)
        local wanted=tonumber(row.AssetId)
        local mesh=Mirror.assetKey(savedMesh(row.Handle))
        for index,item in ipairs(spares) do
            local handle=item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            local same
            -- Skins saved before items kept their id are matched by name and mesh.
            if wanted then same=tonumber(item:GetAttribute("Lyra_AssetId"))==wanted
            else same=mesh~="" and item.Name==row.Name and Mirror.assetKey(meshOf(handle))==mesh end
            if same and handle.ClassName==row.Handle.Class then table.remove(spares,index); return item end
        end
        return nil
    end
    for name,id in pairs(v.Clothes or {}) do
        local item=Instance.new(name=="Graphic" and "ShirtGraphic" or name)
        item[name=="Graphic" and "Graphic" or name.."Template"]=id; item.Parent=model
    end
    if next(v.Colors or {}) then
        local colors=Instance.new("BodyColors")
        for name,color in pairs(v.Colors) do colors[name.."Color3"]=Visual.unpack(color,"Color3") end
        colors.Parent=model
    end
    for name,row in pairs(v.Body) do model:FindFirstChild(name).Color=Visual.unpack(row.Color,"Color3") end
    local skipped={}
    for _,row in ipairs(v.Accessories) do
        local accessory,handle=spare(row),nil
        if accessory then
            accessory.Name=row.Name; accessory.Parent=model; handle=accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        elseif not row.Multi then
            accessory=Instance.new("Accessory"); accessory.Name=row.Name; accessory.Parent=model
            handle=Instance.new(row.Handle.Class); handle.Name="Handle"; handle.Parent=accessory
--[[YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE]]
        end
        if accessory then
            if row.Type then pcall(function() accessory.AccessoryType=Enum.AccessoryType[row.Type] end) end
            if row.AttachmentPoint then accessory.AttachmentPoint=Visual.unpack(row.AttachmentPoint,"CFrame") end
            if row.Mount then
                accessory:SetAttribute("Lyra_MountBody",row.Mount.Body); accessory:SetAttribute("Lyra_MountOffset",Visual.unpack(row.Mount.Offset,"CFrame"))
            end
            Visual.applyPart(handle,row.Handle,false)
            -- One item that has no place on this rig (a game's own pet or weapon saved before mounts were recorded)
            -- is left out; the rest of the skin still applies.
            local attached,err=Appearance.attach(model,accessory)
            if not attached then table.insert(skipped,row.Name); warn("[Lyra Skin] Left out "..row.Name..": "..tostring(err)) end
        else
            -- An item made of several parts whose catalog copy is not in this skin's description.
            table.insert(skipped,row.Name)
        end
    end
    for _,item in ipairs(spares) do pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
    for name,value in pairs(v.Scales or {}) do
        local scale=hum:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("NumberValue"); scale.Name=name; scale.Value=value; scale.Parent=hum
    end
    -- A saved HipHeight is the one the game the skin was saved in had: a game that raised it made the skin float in
    -- every other game (until a Customize size change rebuilt it). An R15 skin stands on its own legs: the height is
    -- measured from its body in the rest pose (its lowest point, as for an avatar drawn with visual-only), and the saved
    -- value is kept only when it agrees.
    local measured
    if v.RigType=="R15" then
        pcall(function()
            Rig.reachable(model,true)
            local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local lowest
            for _,part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                if part~=root and Appearance.isBody(part,model) then
                    local cf,half=part.CFrame,part.Size/2
                    for _,x in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,y in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,z in ipairs({-1,1}) do
                        local point=cf*Vector3.new(half.X*x,half.Y*y,half.Z*z)
                        if not lowest or point.Y<lowest then lowest=point.Y end
                    end end end
                end
            end
            if root and lowest then measured=math.max(0,root.Position.Y-root.Size.Y/2-lowest) end
        end)
    end
    if measured and (not v.HipHeight or math.abs(v.HipHeight-measured)>0.3) then hum.HipHeight=measured
    elseif v.HipHeight then hum.HipHeight=v.HipHeight end
    return model,skipped
end
-- Returns the model, a note for the player (or nil) and whether a saved snapshot had to be dropped for this rig.
function Visual.model(data,desc,rig)
    local visual,note,rebuilt=data.Visual,nil,false
    if visual and visual.RigType~=rig.Name then
        -- A snapshot is rig-specific (joint by joint). On another rig it is rebuilt from its avatar description instead.
        note="This skin was saved on "..visual.RigType.." but your character is "..rig.Name.."; it was rebuilt from its avatar description, so custom details may differ."
        visual=nil; rebuilt=true
    end
    local model=API.model(desc,rig)
    if visual then
        local ok,err,skipped=pcall(Visual.overlay,model,visual)
        if not ok then model:Destroy(); error(err,0) end
        if skipped and #skipped>0 then
            note=(note and (note.." ") or "")..tostring(#skipped)..(#skipped==1 and " item" or " items").." from this skin had no place on this rig and were left out: "
                ..table.concat(skipped,", ",1,math.min(#skipped,4))..(#skipped>4 and "…" or "")
        end
    end
    Tweaks.applyAll(model,data.Tweaks)
    return model,note,rebuilt
end

-- BODY EFFECTS: fire, particles, lights and trails that belong to the avatar's body (a flaming head, an aura on
-- the torso). Copies are tagged, so the next avatar removes only what an earlier one added, never the game's own.
-- Defined after Visual because they use its list of effect classes.
function Appearance.clearEffects(character)
    for _,part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if Appearance.isBody(part,character) then
            for _,item in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
                if item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BodyEffect") then pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end
    end
end
function Appearance.copyEffects(character,sourceModel,copied)
    for name in pairs(copied) do
        local source,target=sourceModel:FindFirstChild(name),character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if source and target then
            local function place(from,to)
                for _,child in ipairs(from:GetChildren()) do
                    if Visual.effects[child.ClassName] then
                        local existing=to:FindFirstChild(child.Name)
                        -- The same effect is already there and not ours (your own avatar's, being restored): no duplicate.
                        if not (existing and existing.ClassName==child.ClassName and not existing:GetAttribute("Lyra_BodyEffect")) then
                            local ok,clone=pcall(function() return child:Clone() end)
                            if ok and clone then
                                clone:SetAttribute("Lyra_BodyEffect",true)
                                -- Trails and beams point at attachments of the source model; point them at the live ones.
                                for _,field in ipairs({"Attachment0","Attachment1"}) do
                                    pcall(function()
                                        local ref=child[field]
                                        if ref then
                                            local mapped=(ref.Parent==from and to or target):FindFirstChild(ref.Name)
                                            clone[field]=(mapped and mapped:IsA("Attachment")) and mapped or nil
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end
                                clone.Parent=to
                            end
                        end
                    elseif from==source and child:IsA("Attachment") and not child:IsA("Bone") then
                        local holder=target:FindFirstChild(child.Name)
                        if holder and holder:IsA("Attachment") then place(child,holder) end
                    end
                end
            end
            place(source,target)
        end
    end
end
-- Effects of your own avatar's body pause while an avatar without them is worn, and come back with your avatar.
-- Effects the game added are never touched.
function Appearance.pauseOwnEffects(character,sourceModel,copied)
    local own=S.ownEffectNames or {}
    for name in pairs(copied) do
        local source,target=sourceModel:FindFirstChild(name),character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if source and target then
            for _,item in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
                if Visual.effects[item.ClassName] and not item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BodyEffect") then
                    local paused=item:GetAttribute("Lyra_PausedEffect")
                    if paused~=nil or own[name.."/"..item.Name.."/"..item.ClassName] then
                        local keep=false
                        for _,other in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
                            if other.Name==item.Name and other.ClassName==item.ClassName then keep=true; break end
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            if paused==nil then paused=item.Enabled; item:SetAttribute("Lyra_PausedEffect",paused) end
                            if keep then item.Enabled=paused; item:SetAttribute("Lyra_PausedEffect",nil) else item.Enabled=false end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local Store = {File = "Copier_SavedProfiles.json", Favorites = {}, Recent = {}, Looks = {}, ShopFavorites = {}, EmoteSets = {}, LoadIssue = nil, Generation = 0,
    -- Item adjustments of your own avatar ("self") and of Roblox profiles you copy ("user:<id>"); a saved skin keeps
    -- its own in its data (see Tweaks.owner).
    ItemTweaks = {}}
Store.Settings = {AutoReset = false, CopyAnims = Config.CopyAnimation, AutoReapply = true, MapPersist = true,
    GlassBlur = true, MobileOrb = true, ReducedMotion = false, LowEffects = false, Keybind = "RightControl", HideOriginal = true,
    SwapEffect = true, Notifications = true, StartHidden = false, MenuReopen = true, HideTipSeen = false, MenuAvatar = true, SkinSync = true, SkinRequests = true, VisualOnly = false, VisualOnlyReset = false, UIScale = 85, ScaleMigrated = false, WindowW = 0, WindowH = 0,
    CopyDiscord = true, LoadingScreen = true, AutoRunTeleport = false, GameChange = "Yield", VisualRig = "Auto", StandIns = true, GameWear = true,
    Theme = "Lavender", Font = "Builder Sans", TextSize = 100, Language = "auto", CommunityDiscord = "",
    NameMode = "Off", Badge = "Off", CustomName = "", CustomDisplay = ""}
-- Numeric settings: 0 means automatic. Window sizes are in unscaled pixels.
Store.SettingRanges = {UIScale = {70, 130}, WindowW = {300, 4000}, WindowH = {240, 4000}, TextSize = {80, 130}}
-- Named settings and their allowed values (the first one is the default).
--   GameChange: what happens when the game changes your avatar while a copied one is on (see Repair.watchGame).
--   VisualRig: the rig a visual-only avatar is drawn as.
--   Theme and Font: the look of the window (see THEMES).
--   NameMode and Badge: the name and verified badge Roblox's menus show for you on your screen (see YOUR NAME).
Store.SettingOptions = {GameChange = {"Yield", "Keep", "Ignore"}, VisualRig = {"Auto", "R15", "R6"},
    NameMode = {"Off", "Copied", "Custom"}, Badge = {"Off", "Copied", "On"},
    Theme = {"Lavender", "Midnight", "Rose", "Mint", "Ember", "Halloween", "Christmas"},
    Font = {"Builder Sans", "Gotham", "Nunito", "Ubuntu", "Fredoka One", "Patrick Hand"},
    Language = {"auto", "en", "pt", "es", "ru", "id"}}
-- Auto-load on execute and the avatar cycle. An entry is a Roblox profile ({Kind="User"}) or a saved skin ({Kind="Look"}).
Store.Auto = {LoadEnabled = false, LoadSource = "Chosen", LoadDelay = 2, Chosen = nil, Last = nil, Games = {},
    CycleEnabled = false, Trigger = "Death", EveryDeaths = 1, TimerSeconds = 120, Order = "Sequential", Cooldown = 3,
    EndAction = "Loop", Resume = true, Notify = true, Index = 0, List = {}}
Store.AutoOptions = {LoadSource = {"Chosen", "Last", "Random", "Cycle"}, Trigger = {"Death", "Respawn", "Timer", "Both"},
    Order = {"Sequential", "Shuffle", "Random", "PingPong"}, EndAction = {"Loop", "Stop", "Restore"}}
-- Discord invite pacing: runs of this version and how many invites were shown (at most two, ever).
Store.Promo = {Runs = 0, Shown = 0, FirstAt = 0}
Store.AutoRanges = {LoadDelay = {0, 30}, EveryDeaths = {1, 50}, TimerSeconds = {10, 3600}, Cooldown = {0, 300}, Index = {0, 50}}
function Store.entry(row)
    if type(row) ~= "table" then return nil end
    if row.Kind == "Look" then
        local key = type(row.Key) == "string" and row.Key:sub(1, 80) or ""
        if key == "" then return nil end
        return {Kind = "Look", Key = key, Name = type(row.Name) == "string" and row.Name:sub(1, 48) or "Saved skin"}
    end
    local id = Codec.id(row.Id)
    local name = type(row.Name) == "string" and row.Name:sub(1, 64) or ""
    if not id and not name:match("^[%w_]+$") then return nil end
    if name == "" then name = tostring(id) end
    return {Kind = "User", Id = id, Name = name, DisplayName = type(row.DisplayName) == "string" and row.DisplayName:sub(1, 80) or name}
end
function Store.loadAuto(saved)
    if type(saved) ~= "table" then return end
    local auto = Store.Auto
    for _, key in ipairs({"LoadEnabled", "CycleEnabled", "Resume", "Notify"}) do
        if type(saved[key]) == "boolean" then auto[key] = saved[key] end
    end
    for key, range in pairs(Store.AutoRanges) do
        if type(saved[key]) == "number" and saved[key] == saved[key] then auto[key] = math.clamp(math.floor(saved[key]), range[1], range[2]) end
    end
    for key, options in pairs(Store.AutoOptions) do
        if table.find(options, saved[key]) then auto[key] = saved[key] end
    end
    auto.Chosen = Store.entry(saved.Chosen); auto.Last = Store.entry(saved.Last)
    if type(saved.Games) == "table" then
        local count = 0
        for place, row in pairs(saved.Games) do
            local entry = Store.entry(row)
            if count < 100 and type(place) == "string" and place:match("^%d+$") and entry then auto.Games[place] = entry; count = count + 1 end
        end
    end
    if type(saved.List) == "table" then
        for _, row in ipairs(saved.List) do
            local entry = Store.entry(row)
            if #auto.List >= 50 then break end
            if entry then table.insert(auto.List, entry) end
        end
    end
    if auto.Index > #auto.List then auto.Index = 0 end
end
function Store.read(file)
    if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return nil, "Storage unavailable. Data will remain in this session." end
    local knownExists = false
    if type(isfile) == "function" then local ok, exists = pcall(isfile, file); if ok and not exists then return nil end; knownExists = ok and exists end
    local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, file)
    if not ok then return nil, knownExists and "The saved file could not be opened." or nil end
    if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 16000000 then return nil, "The saved file is invalid or too large." end
    local decoded, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not decoded or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil, "The saved file could not be read." end
    return data
end
function Store.write(file, data, noBackup)
--: YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false, "File access unavailable. Changes will remain in this session." end
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(data) end)
    if not ok then return false, "The data could not be prepared." end
    return Store.writeText(file, result, noBackup)
end
-- Writes JSON text that is already encoded (see Store.write).
function Store.writeText(file, result, noBackup)
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false, "File access unavailable. Changes will remain in this session." end
    if #result > 16000000 then return false, "Storage is full (16 MB). Remove some skins to save again." end
    -- Saving a large file can freeze a phone for a moment, so nothing is written when nothing changed.
    Store.Written = Store.Written or {}
    if Store.Written[file] == result then return true end
    -- Retain the previous JSON before overwriting. A cheap shape check (a full parse is slow on large files)
    -- skips a file that an interrupted write left cut short. No deletion API is required. Once per run: the file as it
    -- was when the script started is the recovery copy, so later saves write the big file once instead of three times
    -- (read, copy, write), which froze phones for a moment after every change.
    Store.BackedUp = Store.BackedUp or {}
    if not noBackup and not Store.BackedUp[file] and type(readfile) == "function" then
        Store.BackedUp[file] = true
        local oldOK, old = pcall(readfile, file)
        if oldOK and type(old) == "string" and #old <= 16000000 and old:match("^%s*{") and old:match("}%s*$") then
            pcall(writefile, file .. ".bak", old)
        end
    end
    local written = pcall(writefile, file, result)
    if written then Store.Written[file] = result end
    return written, written and nil or "Saving failed. Your data remains available in this session."
end
-- A username typed for YOUR NAME: letters, digits and underscores, 20 at most (Roblox's own rule).
function Ident.cleanName(text)
    return (tostring(text or ""):gsub("[^%w_]", ""):sub(1, 20))
end
-- A display name typed for YOUR NAME: one line of at most 30 characters, without rich text tags or the badge sign.
function Ident.cleanDisplay(text)
    local clean = tostring(text or ""):gsub("[%c<>]", ""):gsub("\238\128\128", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if not utf8.len(clean) then return "" end
    local cut = utf8.offset(clean, 31)
    if cut then clean = clean:sub(1, cut - 1) end
    return clean
end
function Store.normalize(list, limit)
    local rows, seen = {}, {}
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return rows end
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do
        if #rows >= limit then break end
        if type(row) == "table" then
            local id = Codec.id(row.Id)
            local name = type(row.Name) == "string" and row.Name:sub(1, 64) or ""
            local key = id and tostring(id) or name:lower()
            if not seen[key] and (id or name:match("^[%w_]+$")) then
                seen[key] = true
                table.insert(rows, {Id = id, Name = name ~= "" and name or tostring(id),
                    DisplayName = type(row.DisplayName) == "string" and row.DisplayName:sub(1, 80) or name})
            end
        end
    end
    return rows
end
-- Roblox Shop favorites: catalog items and bundles starred in the shop.
function Store.shopFavorites(list)
    local rows, seen = {}, {}
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return rows end
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do
        if #rows >= 300 then break end
        local id = type(row) == "table" and Codec.id(row.Id)
        local key = id and ((row.Bundle == true and "b" or "a") .. tostring(id))
        if key and not seen[key] then
            seen[key] = true
