            table.insert(rows, {Id = id, Name = type(row.Name) == "string" and row.Name:sub(1, 80) or ("Item " .. tostring(id)), Bundle = row.Bundle == true,
                BundleKind = type(row.BundleKind) == "string" and row.BundleKind:sub(1, 40) or nil, Kind = type(row.Kind) == "string" and row.Kind:sub(1, 40) or nil})
        end
    end
    return rows
end
-- Saved emote sets: a name and up to 8 emotes with their wheel slots (see EMOTE SETS).
function Store.emoteSets(list)
    local rows, seen = {}, {}
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return rows end
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do
        if #rows >= 20 then break end
        if type(row) == "table" and type(row.Key) == "string" and #row.Key <= 60 and not seen[row.Key] and type(row.Name) == "string" then
            local emotes = {}
            for name, ids in pairs(type(row.Emotes) == "table" and row.Emotes or {}) do
                if type(name) == "string" and #name <= 100 and type(ids) == "table" then
                    local valid = {}
                    for i, id in ipairs(ids) do if i <= 20 and Codec.id(id) then table.insert(valid, id) end end
                    if #valid > 0 then emotes[name] = valid end
                end
            end
            local list2, equipped = Codec.emoteSet(emotes, row.Equipped)
            if #equipped > 0 then
                seen[row.Key] = true
                table.insert(rows, {Key = row.Key, Name = Codec.cut(row.Name, 30), Emotes = list2, Equipped = equipped,
                    Updated = Codec.number(row.Updated, 0, 9007199254740991) and row.Updated or os.time()})
            end
        end
    end
    return rows
end
function Store.load()
    local data, err = Store.read(Store.File)
    if err then
        local backup = Store.read(Store.File .. ".bak")
        if backup then data = backup; err = "A recovery copy of your data was loaded." end
    end
    Store.LoadIssue = err
    if not data then return end
    if data.Version ~= nil and (type(data.Version) ~= "number" or data.Version > 4) then Store.LoadIssue = "Unsupported data format. Saving was disabled to protect the file."; Store.ReadOnly = true; return end
    Store.Favorites = Store.normalize(data.Favorites or data.SavedUsers, 200)
    Store.Recent = Store.normalize(data.Recent, 30)
    if type(data.Looks) == "table" then
        local seen = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(data.Looks) do
            if #Store.Looks >= 100 then break end
            if type(row) == "table" and type(row.Name) == "string" and type(row.Data) == "table" then
                local name = row.Name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):sub(1, 48)
                local id = type(row.Key) == "string" and row.Key:sub(1, 80) or ""
                if name ~= "" and id ~= "" and not seen[id] then
                    -- Only the shape is checked here: building a description for every skin made starting the script
                    -- slow with a full library. Each skin's description is checked when it is used (and fails safely).
                    local valid = pcall(function()
                        if row.Data.Visual then Visual.validate(row.Data.Visual) end
                        assert(row.Data.Version == nil or row.Data.Version == 2, "Unsupported avatar version.")
                        local props = row.Data.Version == 2 and row.Data.Properties or row.Data
                        assert(type(props) == "table" and next(props) ~= nil, "Saved avatar data is incomplete.")
                    end)
                    if valid then
                        seen[id] = true
                        row.Data.Tweaks = Tweaks.clean(row.Data.Tweaks)
                        if name == "Novo visual" then name = "New skin" end
                        local source = type(row.Source) == "string" and row.Source:sub(1, 80) or "Imported"
                        source = source:gsub("^Meu personagem", "My character"):gsub("^Importado", "Imported"):gsub("^Código compartilhado", "Shared code")
                        table.insert(Store.Looks, {Key = id, Name = name, Data = row.Data,
                            Source = source,
                            Updated = Codec.number(row.Updated, 0, 9007199254740991) and row.Updated or os.time()})
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if type(data.Settings) == "table" then
        for key, value in pairs(Store.Settings) do
            local saved = data.Settings[key]
            if type(value) == "boolean" and type(saved) == "boolean" then Store.Settings[key] = saved end
        end
        if type(data.Settings.Keybind) == "string" then
            local ok, key = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[data.Settings.Keybind] end)
            if ok and key and key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then Store.Settings.Keybind = key.Name end
        end
        for key, options in pairs(Store.SettingOptions) do
            if table.find(options, data.Settings[key]) then Store.Settings[key] = data.Settings[key] end
        end
        -- The Discord username last put on a Community post.
        if type(data.Settings.CommunityDiscord) == "string" then Store.Settings.CommunityDiscord = data.Settings.CommunityDiscord:gsub("[^%w_%.#]", ""):sub(1, 37) end
        -- The name typed for YOUR NAME (Custom).
        if type(data.Settings.CustomName) == "string" then Store.Settings.CustomName = Ident.cleanName(data.Settings.CustomName) end
        if type(data.Settings.CustomDisplay) == "string" then Store.Settings.CustomDisplay = Ident.cleanDisplay(data.Settings.CustomDisplay) end
        -- The emote set on the wheel (see EMOTE SETS).
        if type(data.Settings.EmoteSet) == "string" and #data.Settings.EmoteSet <= 60 then Store.Settings.EmoteSet = data.Settings.EmoteSet end
        for key, range in pairs(Store.SettingRanges) do
            local saved = data.Settings[key]
            if type(saved) == "number" and saved == saved then
                Store.Settings[key] = saved <= 0 and 0 or math.clamp(math.floor(saved), range[1], range[2])
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(Store.loadAuto, data.Auto)
    if type(data.ItemTweaks) == "table" then
        local count = 0
        for owner, list in pairs(data.ItemTweaks) do
            if count >= 200 then break end
            if type(owner) == "string" and (owner == "self" or owner:match("^user:%d+$")) and #owner <= 40 then
                local clean = Tweaks.clean(list)
                if clean then Store.ItemTweaks[owner] = clean; count = count + 1 end
            end
        end
    end
    Store.ShopFavorites = Store.shopFavorites(data.ShopFavorites)
    Store.EmoteSets = Store.emoteSets(data.EmoteSets)
    if type(data.Promo) == "table" then
        for key, range in pairs({Runs = 1000, Shown = 2, FirstAt = 1000}) do
            local saved = data.Promo[key]
            if type(saved) == "number" and saved == saved then Store.Promo[key] = math.clamp(math.floor(saved), 0, range) end
        end
    end
    Store.MainStamp = type(data.Saved) == "number" and data.Saved == data.Saved and data.Saved or nil
    pcall(Store.loadState)
end
function Store.sync()
    Config.CopyAnimation = Store.Settings.CopyAnims
    Config.AutoReapply = Store.Settings.AutoReapply
    Config.MapPersist = Store.Settings.MapPersist
end
function Store.save()
    Store.sync()
    if Store.ReadOnly then return false, Store.LoadIssue end
    local encoded, body = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONEncode({Version = 4, Favorites = Store.Favorites, Recent = Store.Recent, Looks = Store.Looks, Settings = Store.Settings, Auto = Store.Auto, Promo = Store.Promo, ShopFavorites = Store.ShopFavorites, EmoteSets = Store.EmoteSets,
            ItemTweaks = Store.ItemTweaks})
    end)
    if not encoded or type(body) ~= "string" or body:sub(1, 1) ~= "{" then return false, "The data could not be prepared." end
    -- Nothing changed since the last save: nothing is written.
    if Store.SavedBody == body then return true end
    -- Saved: when this file was written, so the small state file (see Store.saveState) is only used when it is newer.
    local stamp = os.time()
    local ok, err = Store.writeText(Store.File, '{"Saved":' .. string.format("%d", stamp) .. "," .. body:sub(2))
    -- Only the text without the stamp is kept to compare with (one copy of a big file in memory, not two).
    if Store.Written then Store.Written[Store.File] = nil end
    if ok then Store.MainStamp = stamp; Store.SavedBody = body end
    return ok, err
end
-- SMALL SAVES: the last avatar worn, the avatar cycle's position and the Recent list change on almost every apply and
-- respawn. Writing them used to rewrite the whole save file (every saved skin, often megabytes), which froze phones for
-- a moment each time. They now go to a small file of their own, read after the main file when it is newer.
Store.StateFile = "Copier_SavedState.json"
function Store.saveState()
    if Store.ReadOnly then return false, Store.LoadIssue end
    -- A main file from an older version has no stamp to compare with: one full save first.
    if not Store.MainStamp then return Store.save() end
    return Store.write(Store.StateFile, {Version = 1, Saved = os.time(), Last = Store.Auto.Last, Index = Store.Auto.Index, Recent = Store.Recent}, true)
end
function Store.loadState()
    if not Store.MainStamp then return end
    local state = Store.read(Store.StateFile)
    if type(state) ~= "table" or state.Version ~= 1 or type(state.Saved) ~= "number" or state.Saved < Store.MainStamp then return end
    if state.Last ~= nil then Store.Auto.Last = Store.entry(state.Last) end
    if type(state.Index) == "number" and state.Index == state.Index then Store.Auto.Index = math.clamp(math.floor(state.Index), 0, 50) end
    if Store.Auto.Index > #Store.Auto.List then Store.Auto.Index = 0 end
    if type(state.Recent) == "table" then Store.Recent = Store.normalize(state.Recent, 30) end
end
Store.load()

-- LANGUAGE (Settings > Look): the window, its messages and pop-ups speak English, Português, Español, Русский or Bahasa
-- Indonesia; Automatic follows the language of your Roblox. Texts are written in English in the code and looked up when
-- shown: a whole sentence, a sentence with a name or a number in it (a pattern), or the known pieces of a longer message
-- (fragments). Words players use in English anyway (script, skin, avatar, plugin, hub, FPS, Visual-only) stay as they are;
-- the rest is written the way a player of that language says it. A text with no translation shows in English.
local Lang = {Code = "en", Exact = {}, Patterns = {}, Fragments = {}}
Lang.Codes = {"en", "pt", "es", "ru", "id"}
Lang.Names = {auto = "Automatic", en = "English", pt = "Português", es = "Español", ru = "Русский", id = "Bahasa Indonesia"}
function Lang.detect()
    local ok, locale = pcall(function() return lp.LocaleId end)
    local code = (ok and type(locale) == "string" and locale or ""):lower():sub(1, 2)
    if code == "in" then code = "id" end
    return table.find(Lang.Codes, code) and code or "en"
end
function Lang.load(choice)
    local code = choice == "auto" and Lang.detect() or choice
    if not table.find(Lang.Codes, code) then code = "en" end
    Lang.Code = code
    Lang.Exact, Lang.Patterns, Lang.Fragments = {}, {}, {}
    if code == "en" or type(Lang.Data) ~= "string" then return end
    local column = table.find(Lang.Codes, code)
    for line in Lang.Data:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local cells = {}
        for cell in (line .. "\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do table.insert(cells, (cell:gsub("\\n", "\n"))) end
        local english, text = cells[1], cells[column]
        if english and english ~= "" and text and text ~= "" then
            if english:sub(1, 1) == "~" then table.insert(Lang.Patterns, {english:sub(2), text})
            else
                Lang.Exact[english] = text
                if #english >= 8 and english:find(" ", 1, true) then table.insert(Lang.Fragments, {english, text}) end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(Lang.Fragments, function(a, b) return #a[1] > #b[1] end)
end
-- English text in, the chosen language's text out; a text with no translation comes back as it is.
function Lang.text(text)
    if Lang.Code == "en" or type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then return text end
    local exact = Lang.Exact[text]
    if exact then return exact end
    for _, pattern in ipairs(Lang.Patterns) do
        local captures = {text:match(pattern[1])}
        if #captures > 0 then
            return (pattern[2]:gsub("%%(%d)", function(n) local part = captures[tonumber(n)]; return part and Lang.text(part) or "" end))
        end
    end
    -- Messages built from pieces have punctuation or are long; a plain name (an item, a player) is left alone quickly.
    if #text < 10 or not text:find(" ", 1, true) or (#text < 40 and not text:find("[%.:·…%(%)'\"!?;,]")) then return text end
    -- Known pieces of a longer message, longest first. Each piece becomes a token until the end, so a translated piece
    -- is never matched again.
    local pieces, out = {}, text
    for _, pair in ipairs(Lang.Fragments) do
        local at = #pair[1] <= #out and string.find(out, pair[1], 1, true)
        while at do
            table.insert(pieces, pair[2])
            local token = "\1" .. #pieces .. "\2"
            out = out:sub(1, at - 1) .. token .. out:sub(at + #pair[1])
            at = string.find(out, pair[1], at + #token, true)
        end
    end
    if #pieces == 0 then return text end
    return (out:gsub("\1(%d+)\2", function(n) return pieces[tonumber(n)] end))
end
-- A pop-up's texts in the chosen language.
function Lang.toast(spec)
    if Lang.Code == "en" or type(spec) ~= "table" then return spec end
    local copy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(spec) do copy[key] = value end
    copy.Title = Lang.text(spec.Title); copy.Text = Lang.text(spec.Text)
    if type(spec.Action) == "table" then
        copy.Action = {}
        for key, value in pairs(spec.Action) do copy.Action[key] = value end
        copy.Action.Text = Lang.text(spec.Action.Text)
    end
    return copy
end
-- 85% became the default size: a saved Auto (0) from before it was a choice becomes 85 once; picking Auto later sticks.
if not Store.Settings.ScaleMigrated then
    if Store.Settings.UIScale == 0 then Store.Settings.UIScale = 85 end
    Store.Settings.ScaleMigrated = true
end
-- Visual-only is off for everyone once (it drew some avatars stiff); from then on it stays as you set it. Games that draw
-- the character their own way suggest it (see CUSTOM CHARACTERS), and Evade always uses it (see Overlay.visualOnly).
if not Store.Settings.VisualOnlyReset then
    Store.Settings.VisualOnly = false
    Store.Settings.VisualOnlyReset = true
end
Store.sync()

local App = {Busy = false, QueryToken = 0, Preview = nil, Cache = {}, History = {}, Initial = nil, Current = nil, Closed = false}
App.Creator = {Name = "lyraEz", GitHub = "https://github.com/lyraEz", Discord = "https://discord.gg/8bxXcn2Vfb"}
App.Notify = function(message, kind) if kind == "error" then warn("[Lyra] " .. message) end end
App.Refresh = function() end
function App.alive() return IsAlive() and not App.Closed end
-- Some executors put the script's chunk name and line in front of every error ("RzHHx…:11778: …"): a message for
-- the player is shown without it.
function App.report(message, kind)
    if not App.alive() then return end
    App.Notify((tostring(message):gsub("^[%w_%.%-]+:%d+: ", "", 1)), kind or "info")
end
-- Pop-up notifications go through the hub's own Lyra Toast notifier (set once the window is built).
App.ToastSink = nil
function App.toast(spec) if App.alive() and App.ToastSink and Store.Settings.Notifications then pcall(App.ToastSink, Lang.toast(spec)) end end
-- Test builds (the owner's dev loader) explain what they did, to find a problem from a phone; public builds stay quiet.
-- DEV: CHARACTER LOG (see App.startLog). Lines are only kept while "/lyralog" is recording.
App.Log = {Lines = {}, Until = 0, Start = 0, Ids = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), Next = 0}
function App.tracing() return os.clock() < App.Log.Until end
function App.trace(text)
    local log = App.Log
    if os.clock() >= log.Until or #log.Lines >= 8000 then return end
    table.insert(log.Lines, string.format("%7.2f  %s", os.clock() - log.Start, tostring(text)))
    log.Dirty = true
end
-- An instance as the log names it: class, name and a number that stays with that instance for the whole log.
function App.traceName(item)
    if typeof(item) ~= "Instance" then return tostring(item) end
    local log = App.Log
    local id = log.Ids[item]
    if not id then log.Next = log.Next + 1; id = log.Next; log.Ids[item] = id end
    return string.format("%s \"%s\" #%d", item.ClassName, item.Name, id)
end
function App.devNote(text)
    App.trace("Note: " .. tostring(text))
    if type(rawget(_G, "LyraDevBuild")) ~= "string" then return end
    warn("[Lyra dev] " .. tostring(text))
    if App.alive() and App.ToastSink then pcall(App.ToastSink, {Title = "Dev", Text = tostring(text), Kind = "info", Duration = 9}) end
end
function App.persist()
    local ok, err = Store.save(); if not ok then App.report(err, "warning") end
    return ok
end
-- The last avatar, the cycle position and Recent only (see SMALL SAVES).
function App.persistState()
    local ok, err = Store.saveState(); if not ok then App.report(err, "warning") end
    return ok
end
-- The public loader runs before this script, so it reads the start-up settings ("Copy the Discord invite on start",
-- "Show the loading screen", "Run again after a teleport") from this small file instead of the saved data. It is
-- only written when the settings differ from what the file says.
App.LoaderFlag = "LyraAvatarStudio_loader.txt"
App.LoaderUrl = "https://api.lyraez.lol/loader"
function App.writeLoaderFlag()
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
    local settings = Store.Settings
    local wanted = table.concat({"copy_discord=" .. (settings.CopyDiscord and 1 or 0), "loading_ui=" .. (settings.LoadingScreen and 1 or 0),
        "auto_teleport=" .. (settings.AutoRunTeleport and 1 or 0)}, "\n")
    local current
    pcall(function() if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(App.LoaderFlag) then current = readfile(App.LoaderFlag) end end)
    -- Without a file every option is at its default, so nothing needs writing until one changes.
    local defaults = settings.CopyDiscord and settings.LoadingScreen and not settings.AutoRunTeleport
    if current ~= wanted and not (current == nil and defaults) then pcall(writefile, App.LoaderFlag, wanted) end
end
-- "Run again after a teleport": the executor runs a line in the next server that starts the loader. That line reads
-- the setting again there (so turning it off also cancels a queued run) and skips when the script already runs.
function App.teleportQueue()
    local queue = queue_on_teleport or queueonteleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport) or (fluxus and fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
    return type(queue) == "function" and queue or nil
end
function App.queueTeleport()
    if not Store.Settings.AutoRunTeleport or _G.Copier_TeleportQueued then return end
    local queue = App.teleportQueue()
    if not queue then return end
    local code = "local skip=_G.Copier_ExecutionID~=nil;pcall(function() if isfile and readfile and isfile(\"" .. App.LoaderFlag .. "\") and string.find(readfile(\""
        .. App.LoaderFlag .. "\"),\"auto_teleport=0\",1,true) then skip=true end end);if not skip then loadstring(game:HttpGet(\"" .. App.LoaderUrl .. "\"))() end"
    if pcall(queue, code) then _G.Copier_TeleportQueued = true end
end
function App.favoriteIndex(profile)
    for i, row in ipairs(Store.Favorites) do
        if (profile.Id and row.Id == profile.Id) or row.Name:lower() == profile.Name:lower() then return i end
    end
end
function App.toggleFavorite(profile)
    if not profile then return end
    local i = App.favoriteIndex(profile)
    if i then table.remove(Store.Favorites, i) else
        if #Store.Favorites >= 200 then App.report("The 200-favorite limit has been reached.", "warning"); return end
        table.insert(Store.Favorites, 1, {Id = profile.Id, Name = profile.Name, DisplayName = profile.DisplayName})
    end
    App.Refresh(); App.persist()
end
function App.addRecent(profile)
    for i = #Store.Recent, 1, -1 do if Store.Recent[i].Id == profile.Id then table.remove(Store.Recent, i) end end
    table.insert(Store.Recent, 1, {Id = profile.Id, Name = profile.Name, DisplayName = profile.DisplayName})
    while #Store.Recent > 30 do table.remove(Store.Recent) end
    App.Refresh(); App.persistState()
end
function App.resolve(raw, valid)
    local text = tostring(raw):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):gsub("^@", "")
    local id = Codec.id(text)
    if not id and (not text:match("^[%w_]+$") or #text < 3 or #text > 20 or text:match("^%d+$")) then
        return nil, "Enter a valid username or numeric user ID."
    end
    local name, display
    if not id then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player.Name:lower() == text:lower() then id = player.UserId; name = player.Name; display = player.DisplayName; break end end
        if not id then
            local ok, value = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(text) end)
            if not valid() then return nil, "cancelled" end
            if not ok or not Codec.id(value) then return nil, "User not found or the service is unavailable. Check the username." end
            id = value
        end
    end
    if not valid() then return nil, "cancelled" end
    local cached = App.Cache[id]
    if cached and os.clock() - cached.Time < 120 then return cached.Profile end
    if not name then
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(id) end)
        if not valid() then return nil, "cancelled" end
        if not ok then return nil, "This user ID could not be retrieved. Try again." end
        name = value
    end
    local okInfo, info = pcall(function() return US:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync({id}) end)
    if not valid() then return nil, "cancelled" end
    display = (okInfo and info and info[1] and info[1].DisplayName) or display or name
    local ok, desc = pcall(API.description, id)
    if not valid() then if ok and desc then desc:Destroy() end; return nil, "cancelled" end
    if not ok then return nil, "The profile exists, but its avatar could not be loaded. Try again." end
    local profile = {Id = id, Name = name, DisplayName = display, Description = desc}
    if cached then cached.Profile.Description:Destroy() end
    App.Cache[id] = {Time = os.clock(), Profile = profile}
    local count, oldestId, oldest = 0, nil, math.huge
    for k, row in pairs(App.Cache) do count = count + 1; if row.Time < oldest and k ~= id and (not App.Preview or k ~= App.Preview.Id) then oldestId = k; oldest = row.Time end end
    if count > 20 and oldestId then App.Cache[oldestId].Profile.Description:Destroy(); App.Cache[oldestId] = nil end
    return profile
end
-- The game's description of your character: the one the server keeps on the Humanoid. It follows the outfit the game
-- gave you (a catalog game's look, a team uniform), unlike GetAppliedDescription, which can still be your profile.
-- A description the copier made (older versions replaced the game's one) is only used when there is no other.
function App.liveDescription(hum)
    if not hum then return nil end
    local tagged
    for _, item in ipairs(hum:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("HumanoidDescription") then
            if not item:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") then return item end
            tagged = tagged or item
        end
    end
    return tagged
end
-- The undo base ("Original"): your character as the game made it. It is taken again (force) right before the copier
-- first changes a character, so it is the look the game has on you at that moment, never an older one. Visual-only
-- never changes the character, so there it can also come from your profile, or be an empty placeholder.
App.InitialFor = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function App.captureInitial(char, force)
    if App.Initial and not force then return true end
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local desc
    if hum then
        local live = App.liveDescription(hum)
        if live and not live:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") then
            pcall(function()
                desc = live:Clone()
                desc:SetEmotes(live:GetEmotes()); desc:SetEquippedEmotes(live:GetEquippedEmotes())
            end)
        end
        if not desc then
            local ok, applied = pcall(function() return hum:GetAppliedDescription() end)
            if ok and applied then desc = applied end
        end
    end
    local visualOnly = Overlay.visualOnly()
    if not desc and visualOnly and not App.Initial then pcall(function() desc = API.description(lp.UserId) end) end
    local data
    if desc then
        local ok, encoded = pcall(Codec.encode, desc); pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end)
        if ok then data = encoded end
    end
    if not data then
        if not visualOnly or App.Initial then return App.Initial ~= nil and not force end
        -- Visual-only only needs to know that "Original" means: no overlay.
        App.Initial = {Name = "Initial appearance", Original = true, Animations = {}, Placeholder = true}
        if not App.Current then App.Current = App.Initial end
        return true
    end
    local snapshot = {Data = data, Name = "Initial appearance", Original = true, Animations = hum and App.captureAnimations(char) or {}}
    -- Your own avatar keeps the item adjustments you made on it (see SAVED ADJUSTMENTS).
    if Store.ItemTweaks.self then data.Tweaks = Codec.copy(Store.ItemTweaks.self) end
    if hum then
        local visualOK, visual = pcall(Visual.capture, char, snapshot.Animations)
        if visualOK then snapshot.Data.Visual = visual
        else warn("[Lyra Initial] Visual backup unavailable: " .. tostring(visual)) end
    end
    App.Initial = snapshot
    -- Each body keeps its own: a body the game swaps in for a while (see SWAPPED BODIES) is captured when the copied
    -- avatar goes on it, and yours is the undo base again when it comes back (Restore must not make you a giant).
    if char then App.InitialFor[char] = snapshot end
    -- Your own look, to recognise the copies of you a game builds (see STAND-INS).
    if hum and Mirror.learn then pcall(Mirror.learn, char) end
    -- While your own look is on, the fresh capture is what is worn now.
    if not App.Current or App.Current.Original then App.Current = snapshot end
    return true
end
-- SAVED ADJUSTMENTS: item adjustments (Customize: move, turn, resize or fade an item, for example a hat faded away so only
-- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
-- its fire shows) used to last only until you left the server, and the ones on your own avatar until the next respawn
-- or the next item you put on. They are now kept in the save file for your own avatar and for every Roblox profile you
-- copy, and come back on the next respawn, after a teleport, in the next server and when items are added or removed.
-- A saved skin already keeps them in its own data. Returns "self", "user:<id>" or nil.
function Tweaks.owner(snapshot)
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" or snapshot.LookKey then return nil end
    if snapshot.Original or snapshot.SelfEdit then return "self" end
    local id = Codec.id(snapshot.Id) or (snapshot.Catalog and Codec.id(snapshot.ThumbId)) or nil
    return id and ("user:" .. tostring(id)) or nil
end
-- A snapshot about to be worn gets the adjustments kept for it (none when it already carries its own).
function Tweaks.attach(snapshot)
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" or type(snapshot.Data) ~= "table" or snapshot.Data.Tweaks ~= nil then return end
    local owner = Tweaks.owner(snapshot)
    local saved = owner and Store.ItemTweaks[owner]
    if saved then snapshot.Data.Tweaks = Codec.copy(saved) end
end
-- Remembers the adjustments of the snapshot being worn (written with the next save).
function Tweaks.keep(snapshot)
    local owner = Tweaks.owner(snapshot)
    if not owner then return end
    local list = type(snapshot.Data) == "table" and Tweaks.clean(snapshot.Data.Tweaks) or nil
    Store.ItemTweaks[owner] = list and Codec.copy(list) or nil
end
-- Your own avatar is never rebuilt by the copier, so its adjustments are put on its items directly: after a respawn,
-- when the script starts, and when an item is added to your character.
function Tweaks.applySelf(char)
    local list = Store.ItemTweaks.self
    if not list or not char or char ~= lp.Character or (App.Current and not App.Current.Original) then return end
    for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") and list[item.Name] and item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            and not item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Script", true) and not item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("LocalScript", true) then
            pcall(Tweaks.apply, char, item, list[item.Name])
        end
    end
end
function Tweaks.watchSelf(char)
    if Tweaks.SelfWatch then Tweaks.SelfWatch:Disconnect(); Tweaks.SelfWatch = nil end
    if not char then return end
    pcall(Tweaks.applySelf, char)
    local pending = false
    Tweaks.SelfWatch = RegisterConnection(char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if pending or not child:IsA("Accessory") or not Store.ItemTweaks.self or not App.alive() then return end
        pending = true
        -- An item arrives in pieces: it is adjusted once it is complete.
        task.delay(0.3, function() pending = false; if App.alive() then pcall(Tweaks.applySelf, char) end end)
    end))
end
-- Running the script again while a copied avatar is on: the new run takes over the undo base, the timeline and the
-- kept-aside game items of the run it replaces, instead of mistaking the copied look for your own.
function App.adoptCarry()
    local carry = _G.Copier_Carry; _G.Copier_Carry = nil
    local char = lp.Character
    if type(carry) ~= "table" or not char or carry.Character ~= char or not char.Parent then return end
    if type(carry.Initial) ~= "table" or type(carry.Initial.Data) ~= "table" or type(carry.Current) ~= "table" then return end
    App.Initial = carry.Initial; App.Current = carry.Current
    App.History = type(carry.History) == "table" and carry.History or {}
    S.TouchedChar = char; S.appliedChar = char; S.fvOn = not App.Current.Original
    if type(carry.Stash) == "table" then Appearance.Stash[char] = carry.Stash end
    if type(carry.Parts) == "table" then
        Appearance.TouchedFor[char] = true
        for _, part in ipairs(carry.Parts) do if typeof(part) == "Instance" then Appearance.TouchedParts[part] = true end end
    end
end
function App.leaveCarry()
    local char = lp.Character
    _G.Copier_Carry = nil
    if not char or S.TouchedChar ~= char or not App.Initial or type(App.Initial.Data) ~= "table" or not App.Current then return end
    local parts = {}
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if Appearance.TouchedParts[part] then table.insert(parts, part) end end
    _G.Copier_Carry = {Character = char, Initial = App.Initial, Current = App.Current, History = App.History,
        Stash = Appearance.Stash[char], Parts = Appearance.TouchedFor[char] and parts or nil}
end
-- A character the game has finished loading: alive, with a root part.
function App.charReady(char)
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0 and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ~= nil and char.Parent ~= nil
end
-- Yields until every body part is joined to the root. A character the game is still building (or rebuilding, as
-- catalog games do on every try-on) is waited for instead of failing with a disconnected rig.
function App.waitRig(char, timeout)
    local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 6)
    while true do
        if #Appearance.rigMissing(char) == 0 then return true end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if os.clock() >= deadline or not App.alive() or char ~= lp.Character or not char.Parent or (hum and hum.Health <= 0) then return false end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end
-- Yields after a respawn until the character has settled: at least a second old, standing (or seated) and joined
-- up, as a game finishes placing and dressing it. Changing the body while the game still moves it could tip it over.
App.SpawnTimes = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
-- minAge: how old the character must be (a second by default). Putting the copied avatar back after a respawn waits
-- less, since the character is covered meanwhile (see COVER) and kept on its feet afterwards (App.guardUpright).
function App.waitSettled(char, limit, minAge)
    local born = App.SpawnTimes[char] or os.clock()
    minAge = minAge or 1
    local deadline = os.clock() + (limit or 6)
    local steady = {[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running] = true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics] = true,
        [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed] = true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated] = true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming] = true,
        [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing] = true}
    while os.clock() < deadline and App.alive() and char.Parent and char == lp.Character do
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local ok, state = pcall(function() return hum:GetState() end)
        local anchored = root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Anchored
        if os.clock() - born >= minAge and hum and hum.Health > 0 and ok and steady[state] and not anchored and #Appearance.rigMissing(char) == 0 then return true end
        task.wait(0.05)
    end
    return false
end
-- For a moment after the body changes, a character that was standing is kept from tipping over: if it falls over
-- without the game asking for it (no ragdoll, sit or platform stand already on), it is stood up again.
function App.guardUpright(char, seconds)
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    local okState, state = pcall(function() return hum:GetState() end)
    local calm = {[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running] = true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics] = true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed] = true,
        [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall] = true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping] = true}
    if not okState or not calm[state] or root.CFrame.UpVector.Y < 0.8 or hum.PlatformStand or hum.Sit then return end
    local fallen = {[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true}
    local deadline, fixes = os.clock() + (seconds or 2.5), 0
    task.spawn(function()
        while os.clock() < deadline and fixes < 4 and App.alive() and char.Parent and root.Parent == char and hum.Health > 0 do
            local ok, now = pcall(function() return hum:GetState() end)
            if ok and not hum.PlatformStand and not hum.Sit and now ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated and now ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
                and now ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing and (fallen[now] or root.CFrame.UpVector.Y < 0.35) then
                fixes = fixes + 1
                pcall(function()
                    local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
                    local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
                    if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flat.Unit)
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                end)
            end
            RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
    end)
end
-- COVER: after a respawn, a teleport or Auto-load, the game first builds your character with your own avatar, and it
-- showed until the copied one was put back on. Now your character is hidden on your screen from the moment it appears
-- until the copied avatar is on (at most a few seconds; it shows again whatever happens). Only LocalTransparencyModifier
-- is used, so nothing changes for the game or for other players, and held tools stay visible. The camera (zooming in,
-- first person) writes the same property: what it writes meanwhile is kept and put back when the cover comes off.
-- The cover writes the mask (see Cloak.Mask) instead of 1, so a value of 1 from the camera still shows as a change.
Cover.Items = {}
Cover.Mask = Cloak.Mask
function Cover.wanted() return Store.Settings.HideOriginal ~= false end
function Cover.add(item)
    if Cover.Items[item] ~= nil then return end
    if not (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Decal") or item:IsA("Texture")) or item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then return end
    local ok, value = pcall(function() return item.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
    if not ok then return end
    Cover.Items[item] = isMask(value) and 0 or value
    pcall(function() item.LocalTransparencyModifier = Cover.Mask end)
end
-- Hides char until Cover.finish(char), or for seconds at most.
function Cover.begin(char, seconds)
    if not char or not Cover.wanted() or not App.alive() then return end
    if Cover.Char and Cover.Char ~= char then Cover.finish() end
    Cover.Until = os.clock() + (seconds or 10)
    if Cover.Char == char then return end
    Cover.Char = char
    for _, item in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do Cover.add(item) end
    Cover.Added = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item) if Cover.Char == char then Cover.add(item) end end)
    -- Right after the camera's own update, so what is drawn this frame is always covered.
    pcall(function() RS:BindToRenderStep("LyraAvatarCover", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, Cover.step) end)
end
function Cover.step()
    local char = Cover.Char
    if not char or not char.Parent or char ~= lp.Character or os.clock() > (Cover.Until or 0) or not App.alive() then Cover.finish(); return end
    for item in pairs(Cover.Items) do
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return item.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
        if ok and not isMask(value) then
            -- The camera (or the game) set its own value: kept for later, and covered again.
            Cover.Items[item] = value
            pcall(function() item.LocalTransparencyModifier = Cover.Mask end)
        end
    end
end
-- Shows the character again (only the one given, when given).
function Cover.finish(char)
    if char and Cover.Char ~= char then return end
    pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("LyraAvatarCover") end)
    if Cover.Added then Cover.Added:Disconnect(); Cover.Added = nil end
    for item, value in pairs(Cover.Items) do
        pcall(function() if isMask(item.LocalTransparencyModifier) then item.LocalTransparencyModifier = value end end)
    end
    table.clear(Cover.Items); Cover.Char = nil
end

-- Emotes live in the description the game put on the Humanoid. They are set on that same description (as Roblox's
-- own emote setup does): a replacement description showed the copied emotes in the wheel, but Roblox only played the
-- ones the original also had. The game's own emotes are kept per description and come back with your look.
-- EMOTE SETS (Roblox Shop > Emotes): the emotes of your wheel saved under a name, so a set of dances goes on in one
-- tap. The set in use stays on the wheel whatever avatar you wear (and on the next run), until you stop using it or
-- change an emote in the shop.
local EmoteSets = {Max = 20}
function EmoteSets.active()
    local key = Store.Settings.EmoteSet
    if type(key) ~= "string" then return nil end
    for _, set in ipairs(Store.EmoteSets) do if set.Key == key then return set end end
    return nil
end
function EmoteSets.live()
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return App.liveDescription(hum)
end
-- The emotes on your wheel right now: the list and the equipped slots.
function EmoteSets.wheel()
    local live = EmoteSets.live()
    if not live then return {}, {} end
    local ok, emotes, equipped = pcall(function() return live:GetEmotes(), live:GetEquippedEmotes() end)
    if not ok then return {}, {} end
    return Codec.emoteSet(emotes, equipped)
end
-- Saves the wheel as a set (only the emotes in its slots). Returns the set, or nil and why not.
function EmoteSets.save(name)
    local emotes, equipped = EmoteSets.wheel()
    if #equipped == 0 then return nil, "Your emote wheel is empty. Add emotes in Search (filter Emotes) first." end
    if #Store.EmoteSets >= EmoteSets.Max then return nil, "You can keep up to 20 emote sets. Delete one first." end
    local kept = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(equipped) do kept[row.Name] = emotes[row.Name] end
    name = Codec.cut(tostring(name or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"), 30)
    if name == "" then name = Lang.text("Set") .. " " .. tostring(#Store.EmoteSets + 1) end
    local set = {Key = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), Name = name, Emotes = kept, Equipped = equipped, Updated = os.time()}
    table.insert(Store.EmoteSets, 1, set)
    App.persist()
    return set
end
-- Puts emotes on the live description: the set's in their slots (the rest of the list is kept), or without a set the
-- emotes of the avatar you wear.
function EmoteSets.apply()
    local live = EmoteSets.live()
    if not live then return false end
    local set = EmoteSets.active()
    if not set then
        local current = App.Current
        local data = current and not current.Original and type(current.Data) == "table" and current.Data or nil
        local desc = data and type(data.Emotes) == "table" and next(data.Emotes) ~= nil and select(2, pcall(Codec.decode, data)) or nil
        App.setEmotes(live, typeof(desc) == "Instance" and desc or nil, desc == nil)
        if typeof(desc) == "Instance" then desc:Destroy() end
        return true
    end
    App.setEmotes(live, nil, true)
    return true
end
function EmoteSets.use(set)
    Store.Settings.EmoteSet = set and set.Key or nil
    App.persist()
    return EmoteSets.apply()
end
function EmoteSets.remove(key)
    for i = #Store.EmoteSets, 1, -1 do if Store.EmoteSets[i].Key == key then table.remove(Store.EmoteSets, i) end end
    if Store.Settings.EmoteSet == key then Store.Settings.EmoteSet = nil; EmoteSets.apply() end
    App.persist()
end
App.EmoteBackup = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function App.setEmotes(live, desc, original)
    local backup = App.EmoteBackup[live]
    if not backup then
        local ok, emotes, equipped = pcall(function() return live:GetEmotes(), live:GetEquippedEmotes() end)
        backup = {Emotes = ok and type(emotes) == "table" and emotes or {}, Equipped = ok and type(equipped) == "table" and equipped or {}}
        App.EmoteBackup[live] = backup
    end
    local emotes, equipped
    if not original and desc then
        local ok, e, q = pcall(function() return desc:GetEmotes(), desc:GetEquippedEmotes() end)
        -- A look without emotes (an old skin) keeps the emotes you have.
        if ok and type(e) == "table" and next(e) ~= nil then emotes, equipped = e, type(q) == "table" and q or {} end
    end
    if not emotes then emotes, equipped = backup.Emotes, backup.Equipped end
    -- An equipped slot whose emote is missing from the list would stay dead in the wheel.
    local list, valid = Codec.emoteSet(emotes, equipped)
    -- The emote set in use fills the wheel (its emotes join the list).
    local set = EmoteSets.active()
    if set then
        for name, ids in pairs(set.Emotes) do list[name] = ids end
        list, valid = Codec.emoteSet(list, set.Equipped)
    end
    pcall(function() live:SetEmotes(list); live:SetEquippedEmotes(valid) end)
end
-- Animation rows by the character they were read from (weak keys): rows read from this very character undo the
-- copier's own changes (see restoreAnimations).
App.AnimSource = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
App.AnimFields = {"ClimbAnimation", "FallAnimation", "IdleAnimation", "JumpAnimation", "RunAnimation", "SwimAnimation", "WalkAnimation", "MoodAnimation"}
-- Starts getting an avatar's animations ready while the rest of it is built (body and accessories take a moment),
-- so they play at once when they go into Animate (see F.preloadAnimations). Returns a handle; wait() yields until
-- they are ready, a few seconds at most.
function App.prefetchAnimations(char, snapshot, desc)
    local handle = {Done = false}
    local ids, packs = {}, {}
    local data = type(snapshot.Data) == "table" and snapshot.Data or {}
    -- Animations Animate already holds are not fetched: they are on the character now. A shop or Customize change keeps
    -- the animations being played, so it waits for nothing here.
    local have = {}
    local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    for _, item in ipairs(animate and animate:GetDescendants() or {}) do
        if item:IsA("Animation") then have[F.normalizeAnimId(item.AnimationId)] = true end
    end
    for _, rows in ipairs({snapshot.Animations, type(data.Visual) == "table" and data.Visual.Animations or nil}) do
        if type(rows) == "table" then
            for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
                if type(row) == "table" and row.Id and not have[F.normalizeAnimId(row.Id)] then table.insert(ids, row.Id) end
            end
        end
    end
    if desc and (Store.Settings.CopyAnims or snapshot.ForceAnims) then
        for _, field in ipairs(App.AnimFields) do
            local ok, assetId = pcall(function() return desc[field] end)
            if ok and tonumber(assetId) and tonumber(assetId) ~= 0 then table.insert(packs, assetId) end
        end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        if #packs > 0 then
            for _, id in ipairs(F.packAnimationIds(packs)) do if not have[F.normalizeAnimId(id)] then table.insert(ids, id) end end
        end
        pcall(F.preloadAnimations, char, ids, 4)
        handle.Done = true
    end)
    function handle.wait(timeout)
        local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 3)
        while not handle.Done and os.clock() < deadline and App.alive() do task.wait(0.05) end
    end
    return handle
end
-- Whether Roblox made an animation (its default and pack animations are Roblox's). Asked once per id.
App.RobloxAnims = {}
function App.robloxAnimation(id)
    local number = tonumber(tostring(id):match("(%d+)$"))
    if not number then return false end
    local known = App.RobloxAnims[number]
    if known ~= nil then return known end
    local ok, info = pcall(function() return MPS:GetProductInfo(number, Enum.InfoType.Asset) end)
    local creator = ok and type(info) == "table" and type(info.Creator) == "table" and info.Creator or nil
    local result = creator ~= nil and (creator.CreatorTargetId == 1 or creator.Id == 1 or creator.Name == "Roblox")
    App.RobloxAnims[number] = result
    return result
end
-- Your profile's animation fields, read once: the packs Roblox puts in Animate in games that keep avatar animations.
function App.profileAnimData()
    if App.ProfileAnimData == nil then
        App.ProfileAnimData = false
        pcall(function()
            local desc = API.description(lp.UserId)
            local data = {}
            for _, field in ipairs(App.AnimFields) do
                local ok, value = pcall(function() return desc[field] end)
                if ok then data[field] = value end
            end
            pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end)
            App.ProfileAnimData = data
        end)
    end
    return App.ProfileAnimData or nil
end
-- Animation ids that belong to avatars rather than to a game: Roblox's defaults, ids the copier put in, and the
-- animation packs of your profile and of the look being worn. The game's description of you (your own look in this
-- game) is left out: a game that sets its own animations puts them there, and they must stay the game's.
function App.avatarAnimIds(snapshot)
    local ids = {}
    for id in pairs(F.DefaultAnimIds) do ids[id] = true end
    for id in pairs(F.WrittenIds) do ids[id] = true end
    local function packs(data)
        local props = type(data) == "table" and (data.Version == 2 and data.Properties or data) or nil
        if type(props) ~= "table" then return end
        for _, field in ipairs(App.AnimFields) do
            local assetId = Codec.id(props[field])
            if assetId then
                local sets = F.animationSets(assetId)
                if sets then
                    for _, list in pairs(sets) do for _, row in ipairs(list) do ids[F.normalizeAnimId(row.Id)] = true end end
                else
                    local one = F.resolveAnimationTrackId(assetId)
                    if one then ids[F.normalizeAnimId(one)] = true end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    packs(App.profileAnimData())
    if snapshot and not snapshot.Original then packs(snapshot.Data) end
    return ids
end
-- hold: change the folders only and leave the restart to the caller. Returns whether anything changed.
function App.restoreAnimations(char, snapshot, hold)
    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate and snapshot.Animations then
        local changed = false
        -- Rows read from this character undo what the copier put in. Rows from anywhere else (a saved skin, the
        -- character before a respawn) never replace a game's own animations: a folder only changes when it holds
        -- avatar animations, and only to avatar animations. A saved skin used to put the animations of the game it
        -- was saved in over another game's own ones, and a restore put back animations the game had replaced since.
        local own = App.AnimSource[snapshot.Animations] == char
        -- Avatar animations are R15 animations. On an R6 or custom rig they play nothing and the character stands
        -- stiff, so there rows from elsewhere change nothing and the game's animations stay (as with a pack).
        if not own and F.getTrueRigType(char) ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return end
        local avatar = not own and App.avatarAnimIds(snapshot) or {}
        local function isAvatar(id)
            id = F.normalizeAnimId(id)
            if id == "" or avatar[id] then return true end
            local roblox = App.robloxAnimation(id)
            if roblox then avatar[id] = true end
            return roblox
        end
        local function free(node)
            if node:IsA("Animation") then return isAvatar(node.AnimationId) end
            for _, child in ipairs(node:GetDescendants()) do
                if child:IsA("Animation") and not isAvatar(child.AnimationId) then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        -- Your own rows only undo what the copier put in: an animation the game changed since (a game that sets
        -- its own moves after you spawn) stays the game's.
        local function written(node)
            if node:IsA("Animation") then return F.WrittenIds[F.normalizeAnimId(node.AnimationId)] == true end
            for _, child in ipairs(node:GetDescendants()) do
                if child:IsA("Animation") and F.WrittenIds[F.normalizeAnimId(child.AnimationId)] then return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        -- Rows captured whole (Full) describe every animation of their folder: the folder is made to match exactly,
        -- so an animation another avatar added (a second idle, for example) goes away again. Older rows only set ids.
        local sets, order = {}, {}
        for _, row in ipairs(snapshot.Animations) do
            local path = type(row.Path) == "table" and row.Path or {}
            if row.Full and #path >= 2 then
                local key = table.concat(path, "\0", 1, #path - 1)
                if not sets[key] then sets[key] = {Path = table.move(path, 1, #path - 1, 1, {}), List = {}}; table.insert(order, key) end
                table.insert(sets[key].List, {Name = path[#path], Id = row.Id, Weight = row.Weight})
            else
                local node = animate
                for _, name in ipairs(path) do node = node and node:FindFirstChild(name) end
                if node and node ~= animate and ((own and written(node)) or (not own and isAvatar(row.Id) and free(node))) then
                    if not own then F.markWritten({row}) end
                    if node:IsA("Animation") then
                        if F.setAnimationId(node, row.Id) then changed = true end
                    else
                        for _, child in ipairs(node:GetDescendants()) do
                            if child:IsA("Animation") and F.setAnimationId(child, row.Id) then changed = true end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, key in ipairs(order) do
            local set = sets[key]
            local folder = animate
            for _, name in ipairs(set.Path) do folder = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name) end
            if folder and not folder:IsA("Animation") then
                local allowed = (own and written(folder)) or (not own and free(folder))
                if allowed and not own then
                    for _, row in ipairs(set.List) do if not isAvatar(row.Id) then allowed = false; break end end
                end
                if allowed then
                    if not own then F.markWritten(set.List) end
                    if F.applyAnimationSet(folder, set.List) then changed = true end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Unchanged ids are already playing; restarting Animate then would only interrupt them.
        if changed and not hold then F.restartAnimate(char, true) end
        return changed
    end
    return false
end
-- STALE ANIMATIONS: an avatar used to keep the animations of the one worn before it when it brought none of its own (a
-- profile copied with Copy animations off) or only some of them (a skin saved with fewer Animate folders). A new avatar
-- now starts from your character's own animations: what the copier put in Animate comes out first (only that: a game's
-- own animations stay), then the new avatar's go in, and Animate restarts once. Returns whether anything changed.
-- base: the rows to go back to, read from this character (the undo base, or visual-only's own capture).
function App.resetAnimations(char, base)
    if type(base) ~= "table" or App.AnimSource[base] ~= char then return false end
    return App.restoreAnimations(char, {Animations = base}, true) == true
end
-- An avatar's animation pack as Animate rows (each set whole, with its weights), or a single id per state when the
-- pack has no sets.
App.PackFolders = {ClimbAnimation = {"climb"}, FallAnimation = {"fall"}, IdleAnimation = {"idle"}, JumpAnimation = {"jump"},
    RunAnimation = {"run"}, SwimAnimation = {"swim", "swimidle"}, WalkAnimation = {"walk"}, MoodAnimation = {"mood"}}
function App.packRows(desc)
    local rows = {}
    for _, field in ipairs(App.AnimFields) do
        local names = App.PackFolders[field]
        local ok, asset = pcall(function() return desc[field] end)
        if names and ok and tonumber(asset) and tonumber(asset) ~= 0 then
            local sets = F.animationSets(asset)
            if sets then
                for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                    for _, row in ipairs(sets[name] or {}) do table.insert(rows, {Path = {name, row.Name}, Id = row.Id, Weight = row.Weight, Full = true}) end
                end
            else
                local one = F.resolveAnimationTrackId(asset)
                if one then table.insert(rows, {Path = {names[1]}, Id = one}) end
            end
        end
    end
    return rows
end
-- A saved skin's animations: the ones its Animate had when it was saved, with the animation pack its own items include
-- (the one the shop's Wearing list shows) taking over the states that pack covers. A skin saved in a game that keeps
-- Roblox's default animations used to lose its pack, and showed the defaults or an earlier avatar's animations.
function App.skinAnimations(data, desc)
    local pack = desc and App.packRows(desc) or {}
    local covered, rows = {}, {}
    for _, row in ipairs(pack) do
        local first = type(row.Path) == "table" and row.Path[1]
        if type(first) == "string" then covered[first:lower()] = true end
    end
    local saved = type(data) == "table" and type(data.Visual) == "table" and data.Visual.Animations or {}
    for _, row in ipairs(type(saved) == "table" and saved or {}) do
        local first = type(row) == "table" and type(row.Path) == "table" and row.Path[1]
        if not (type(first) == "string" and covered[first:lower()]) then table.insert(rows, row) end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(pack) do table.insert(rows, row) end
    return rows
end
-- VISUAL-ONLY ANIMATIONS: with Copy animations on, the avatar's animation pack is played by your character itself, not
-- only by the avatar drawn over it. The overlay copies the character's joints, so the hidden body and the avatar you
-- see move the same. Only when the overlay is of the same rig (R15) and follows the character itself, and only in
-- Animate folders that hold avatar animations (a game's own animations stay, as on a normal apply). A saved skin's own
-- animations are not put on the hidden body: that left some avatars standing stiff. Each
-- avatar starts from your character's own animations (see STALE ANIMATIONS); taking the avatar off, or wearing one
-- without a pack, gives the character its animations back.
App.VisualAnimBase = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function App.visualAnimations(char, desc, snapshot)
    local base = App.VisualAnimBase[char]
    local entry = Overlay.Active[char]
    local rig = F.getTrueRigType(char)
    if desc and rig == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and entry and entry.Target == char and F.getTrueRigType(entry.Model) == rig then
        -- Rows read from this character (a shop or Customize change, Undo, the timeline) say what to keep.
        if type(snapshot.Animations) == "table" and App.AnimSource[snapshot.Animations] == char then
            if base then App.restoreAnimations(char, snapshot) end
            return
        end
        local rows = (Store.Settings.CopyAnims or snapshot.ForceAnims) and App.packRows(desc) or {}
        if #rows > 0 then
            local changed = false
            if base then changed = App.resetAnimations(char, base)
            else App.VisualAnimBase[char] = App.captureAnimations(char) end
            changed = App.restoreAnimations(char, {Animations = rows, Data = snapshot.Data}, true) or changed
            if changed then F.restartAnimate(char, true) end
            return
        end
    end
    if base then
        App.VisualAnimBase[char] = nil
        App.restoreAnimations(char, {Animations = base})
    end
end
function App.captureAnimations(char)
    local rows = {}; local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate then for _, item in ipairs(animate:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("Animation") and #rows < 100 then
            local path, cursor = {}, item
            while cursor and cursor ~= animate do table.insert(path, 1, cursor.Name); cursor = cursor.Parent end
            local weight = item:FindFirstChild("Weight")
            F.rememberAnimateId(item.AnimationId)
            table.insert(rows, {Path = path, Id = item.AnimationId, Full = true, Weight = weight and weight:IsA("NumberValue") and weight.Value or nil})
        end
    end end
    if char then App.AnimSource[rows] = char end
    return rows
end
--: YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE

-- Incremental recovery is driven by removal events, never by full-body polling.
local Repair = {Generation = 0, Rows = {}, Connections = {}, Budget = 0}
function Repair.stop()
    Repair.Generation = Repair.Generation + 1
    for _, connection in ipairs(Repair.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(Repair.Connections)
    for _, row in ipairs(Repair.Rows) do if row.Template then row.Template:Destroy() end end
    table.clear(Repair.Rows); Repair.Budget = 0; Repair.Character = nil
    Repair.dropParked()
end
-- A new character took over while the one wearing the copied avatar may come back (a size potion swaps in a bigger
-- body for a while): its list of items is kept aside instead of thrown away, and follows it again when it is back.
function Repair.park()
    local char, rows = Repair.Character, Repair.Rows
    -- Nothing followed now (the body before was never changed): what is kept aside stays.
    if not char then return end
    Repair.Rows = {}
    Repair.stop()
    if #rows > 0 then Repair.Parked = {Character = char, Rows = rows} end
end
function Repair.dropParked()
    local parked = Repair.Parked
    Repair.Parked = nil
    for _, row in ipairs(parked and parked.Rows or {}) do if row.Template then pcall(function() row.Template:Destroy() end) end end
end
-- Follows char again with the items kept aside for it. Returns whether there were any.
function Repair.unpark(char)
    local parked = Repair.Parked
    if not parked or parked.Character ~= char then return false end
    Repair.Parked = nil
    Repair.watch({Items = parked.Rows}, char)
    return true
end
function Repair.present(row)
    if row.Instance and row.Instance.Parent == Repair.Character then return row.Instance end
    if not Repair.Character then return nil end
    for _, child in ipairs(Repair.Character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:GetAttribute("Lyra_ItemKey") == row.Key then row.Instance = child; return child end
    end
end
function Repair.queue(row)
    if row.Pending or row.Suppressed or not Config.MapPersist or App.Busy or not S.fvOn or not App.alive() then return end
    if Repair.present(row) then return end
    local generation = Repair.Generation
    row.Pending = true
    task.delay(0.8, function()
        row.Pending = false
        if generation ~= Repair.Generation or not App.alive() or App.Busy or not Config.MapPersist or not S.fvOn then return end
        local char = Repair.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not char or char ~= lp.Character or not char.Parent or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or Repair.present(row) then return end
        if row.Attempts >= 2 or Repair.Budget >= 12 then
            row.Suppressed = true
            if not Repair.Warned then Repair.Warned = true; App.report("The game keeps removing some items. Recovery was paused to prevent repeated reconstruction.", "warning") end
            return
        end
        row.Attempts = row.Attempts + 1; Repair.Budget = Repair.Budget + 1
        local ok, item = pcall(Appearance.item, row.Template, char, row.Key)
        if ok and item then row.Instance = item else row.Suppressed = true end
        -- No call to applySnapshot, no reset, no body replacement, no retry loop.
    end)
end
function Repair.watch(report, character)
    Repair.stop()
    Repair.Character = character; Repair.Rows = report and report.Items or {}; Repair.Warned = false
    if not character then return end
    table.insert(Repair.Connections, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
        for _, row in ipairs(Repair.Rows) do if row.Instance == child then Repair.queue(row); break end end
    end))
    if S.fvOn then Repair.watchGame(character) end
end
-- GAME AVATAR CHANGES: catalog games (Catalog Avatar Creator and others), morphs and outfit loaders change your
-- avatar from the server. On top of a copied avatar that used to mix both looks (pieces of each clipping together).
-- A change is recognised by a new description from the game or a replaced body part, or by at least three new
-- avatar pieces at once (clothing, and accessories worn on standard avatar attachments or layered). Game items such
-- as weapons or tools do not count, and the copier's own items are tagged and never count. Then, by GameChange:
--   Yield  - the copied avatar comes off and the game's new look becomes your starting point (Undo brings it back).
--   Keep   - what the game just added is taken off and the copied avatar is put back.
--   Ignore - nothing happens (the old behaviour).
Repair.AvatarAttachments = Appearance.AvatarAttachments
-- An accessory that looks like an avatar item: layered clothing, or worn on a standard avatar attachment, without scripts.
function Repair.avatarItem(accessory) return Appearance.avatarItem(accessory) end
function Repair.watchGame(character)
    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or Store.Settings.GameChange == "Ignore" then return end
    local generation, batch = Repair.Generation, nil
    local function signal(kind, item)
        if App.Busy or not S.fvOn or generation ~= Repair.Generation or not App.alive() then return end
        if not batch then
            batch = {Accessories = {}, Pieces = 0, Strong = false}
            local current = batch
            -- A server change arrives in pieces; it is judged once, after it settles (children have arrived by then).
            task.delay(0.8, function()
                if batch == current then batch = nil end
                if generation ~= Repair.Generation or App.Busy or not S.fvOn or not App.alive() or character ~= lp.Character then return end
                local avatarItems = {}
                for _, accessory in ipairs(current.Accessories) do
                    if accessory.Parent == character and Repair.avatarItem(accessory) then table.insert(avatarItems, accessory) end
                end
                current.Accessories = avatarItems
                if current.Strong or current.Pieces + #avatarItems >= 3 then Repair.gameChanged(character, current) end
            end)
        end
        if kind == "accessory" then table.insert(batch.Accessories, item)
        elseif kind == "clothing" then batch.Pieces = batch.Pieces + 1
        else batch.Strong = true; if kind == "description" then batch.Description = item else batch.Body = true end end
    end
    table.insert(Repair.Connections, hum.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:IsA("HumanoidDescription") and not child:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") then signal("description", child) end
    end))
    -- The game's description stays on the Humanoid (the copier only changes its emotes), so a catalog game that edits
    -- it from the server (try-ons, refinements) is noticed as well.
    local live = App.liveDescription(hum)
    if live and not live:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") then
        local watched = {}
        for _, fields in ipairs({Codec.assetFields, Codec.scaleFields, Codec.colorFields, Codec.accessoryFields}) do
            -- Animations are not part of the look: a game that gives you its own moves through the description
            -- (Violence District) is not changing your avatar.
            for _, field in ipairs(fields) do if not field:find("Animation", 1, true) then watched[field] = true end end
        end
        table.insert(Repair.Connections, live.Changed:Connect(function(property)
            if watched[property] and live.Parent == hum then signal("description", live) end
        end))
    end
    table.insert(Repair.Connections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") or child:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor") then return end
        if child:IsA("Accessory") then signal("accessory", child)
        elseif child:IsA("Shirt") or child:IsA("Pants") or child:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then signal("clothing", child)
        elseif child:IsA("BasePart") and S.BD[child.Name] and child.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then signal("body", child) end
    end))
end
Repair.GameReactions = {}
-- Everything a description shows (body, clothing, colours, sizes, accessories), animations and emotes left out.
-- noScales: the body's size left out too.
function App.lookKey(desc, noScales)
    local parts = {}
    local ok = pcall(function()
        for _, field in ipairs(Codec.assetFields) do if not field:find("Animation", 1, true) then table.insert(parts, tostring(desc[field])) end end
        if not noScales then
            for _, field in ipairs(Codec.scaleFields) do table.insert(parts, string.format("%.3f", desc[field])) end
        end
        for _, field in ipairs(Codec.colorFields) do
            local color = desc[field]
            table.insert(parts, string.format("%d,%d,%d", math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)))
        end
        local ids = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(desc:GetAccessories(true)) do table.insert(ids, tostring(row.AssetId)) end
        table.sort(ids)
        table.insert(parts, table.concat(ids, ","))
    end)
    return ok and table.concat(parts, "|") or nil
end
function Repair.gameChanged(character, batch)
    local mode = Store.Settings.GameChange
    App.trace(string.format("Game changed the avatar (%s): description=%s body=%s clothing=%d avatar items=%d", tostring(mode),
        batch.Description and App.traceName(batch.Description) or "none", tostring(batch.Body == true), batch.Pieces, #batch.Accessories))
    if mode == "Ignore" or not App.Current or App.Current.Original then return end
    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    -- A game that re-applies its look every time ours goes on would loop: at most 3 reactions a minute.
    local now = os.clock()
    for i = #Repair.GameReactions, 1, -1 do if now - Repair.GameReactions[i] > 60 then table.remove(Repair.GameReactions, i) end end
    if #Repair.GameReactions >= 3 then return end
    table.insert(Repair.GameReactions, now)
    -- A new description that only changes animations or emotes (a game giving you its own moves) is not a new look.
    if batch.Description and batch.Description.Parent and not batch.Body and batch.Pieces == 0 and #batch.Accessories == 0 and S.gameDescription then
        local before, after = App.lookKey(S.gameDescription), App.lookKey(batch.Description)
        if before and before == after then
            pcall(function() local old = S.gameDescription; S.gameDescription = batch.Description:Clone(); old:Destroy() end)
            table.remove(Repair.GameReactions)
            return
        end
    end
    -- Only the body's size changed (a potion or power-up that makes you bigger or smaller): the same look at another
    -- size. The copied avatar stays on and takes the new size (see GAME SIZE CHANGES).
    if batch.Description and batch.Description.Parent and S.gameDescription then
        local before, after = App.lookKey(S.gameDescription, true), App.lookKey(batch.Description, true)
        if before and before == after then
            pcall(function() local old = S.gameDescription; S.gameDescription = batch.Description:Clone(); old:Destroy() end)
            table.remove(Repair.GameReactions)
            -- The game may have rebuilt limbs or items at the new size: the avatar goes on again either way.
            local rebuilt = batch.Body or batch.Pieces > 0 or #batch.Accessories > 0
            task.delay(0.6, function() if App.alive() then pcall(Scale.check, character, rebuilt) end end)
            return
        end
    end
    -- The game's look is new, so the list of its avatar items is rebuilt before the next application.
    S.gameAccNames = nil
    if batch.Description and batch.Description.Parent then
        if S.gameDescription then pcall(function() S.gameDescription:Destroy() end) end
        S.gameDescription = batch.Description:Clone()
    end
    if mode == "Keep" then
        -- What the game just added is kept aside (see STASH) and comes back with your own look.
        for _, item in ipairs(batch.Accessories) do if item.Parent == character then Appearance.stash(character, item) end end
        App.toast({Title = "Avatar kept", Text = "The game changed your avatar; the copied one was put back on.", Kind = "info", Icon = "shirt", Duration = 4})
        task.spawn(App.applySnapshot, App.Current, "reapply", character)
        return
    end
    -- Yield: rebuild your body, clothing and colours from the game's new look (its accessories are already on
    -- the character) and make it the new starting point.
    -- Only a description that came with this change describes the new look (an older one would bring the old body back).
    local source = batch.Description and batch.Description.Parent and batch.Description or nil
    local ok, data = pcall(function() return Codec.encode(source) end)
    if not ok or not data then
        -- No new description came with this change: your own look comes back (the undo base, with the game's items as
        -- the game has them now). Undo brings the copied avatar back.
        if not App.Initial then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            if App.applySnapshot(App.Initial, "yield", character) then
                App.toast({Title = "The game changed your avatar", Text = "The copied avatar was taken off so the two looks don't mix. Undo puts it back.",
                    Kind = "info", Icon = "shirt", Duration = 7, Action = {Text = "Put it back", Callback = function() App.undo() end}})
            end
        end)
        return
    end
    local snapshot = {Data = data, Name = "Game appearance", Original = true, GameLook = true,
        Animations = App.Initial and App.Initial.Animations or App.captureAnimations(character)}
    task.spawn(function()
        if App.applySnapshot(snapshot, "game", character) then
            App.Initial = snapshot; App.InitialFor[character] = snapshot
            App.toast({Title = "The game changed your avatar", Text = "The copied avatar was taken off so the two looks don't mix. Undo puts it back.",
                Kind = "info", Icon = "shirt", Duration = 7, Action = {Text = "Put it back", Callback = function() App.undo() end}})
        end
    end)
end
function Repair.resume()
    if not Config.MapPersist then return end
    -- Changing the toggle does not reset a repeatedly rejected item's budget.
    for _, row in ipairs(Repair.Rows) do if not Repair.present(row) then Repair.queue(row) end end
end

-- GAME INVISIBILITY: games make your character invisible (an invisibility cloak, a ghost or stealth power) by changing
-- the transparency of its body parts. What the copier adds is its own: copied accessories, the local copies drawn
-- over limbs that would not take a new mesh (a Korblox leg, for example), copied faces and body effects. They stayed
-- visible, so a hat, a face or a whole leg walked around on their own. Now the transparency the game gives each body
-- part is followed: everything the copier put on that part fades with it, and when the game shows the part again the
-- copied avatar's own look comes back (a headless head stays headless). Body parts the copier keeps hidden itself use
-- the mask (Cloak.Mask) instead of 1, so the game's own 1 still shows as a change.
Cloak.Known = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Cloak.Connections = {}
-- How much the game hides a body part right now: 0 (as the game shows it) to 1 (invisible).
function Cloak.hidden(row)
    if row.Normal >= 0.5 then return 0 end
    return math.clamp((row.Known - row.Normal) / (1 - row.Normal), 0, 1)
end
-- Whether the game's value of this part can be read (the copier does not keep it at 1 itself).
function Cloak.readable(row)
    return row.Normal < 0.5 and (row.Wanted < 0.99 or row.Covered ~= nil)
end
-- The body part an accessory hangs from, by name.
function Cloak.mountOf(accessory, char)
    local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    for _, joint in ipairs(handle and handle:GetChildren() or {}) do
        if joint:IsA("JointInstance") or joint:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
            for _, part in ipairs({joint.Part0, joint.Part1}) do
                if part and part ~= handle and Appearance.isBody(part, char) then return part.Name end
            end
        end
    end
    local body = accessory:GetAttribute("Lyra_MountBody")
    return type(body) == "string" and body or nil
end
-- Fades one of the copier's own parts or decals by f, keeping its own transparency to give back later.
function Cloak.fadeOne(item, f)
    local base, set = item:GetAttribute("Lyra_CloakBase"), item:GetAttribute("Lyra_CloakSet")
    if f <= 0.001 then
        if type(base) == "number" then
            -- Something else changed it meanwhile (an item adjustment): that value stays.
            if type(set) ~= "number" or math.abs(item.Transparency - set) < 1e-4 then item.Transparency = base end
            item:SetAttribute("Lyra_CloakBase", nil); item:SetAttribute("Lyra_CloakSet", nil)
        end
        return
    end
    if type(base) ~= "number" or (type(set) == "number" and math.abs(item.Transparency - set) > 1e-4) then
        base = item.Transparency; item:SetAttribute("Lyra_CloakBase", base)
    end
    local value = 1 - (1 - base) * (1 - f)
    item:SetAttribute("Lyra_CloakSet", value)
    if math.abs(item.Transparency - value) > 1e-4 then item.Transparency = value end
end
-- Effects stop while the part they are on is invisible, and start again with it.
function Cloak.effect(item, f)
    local saved = item:GetAttribute("Lyra_CloakEnabled")
    if f >= 0.99 then
        if saved == nil then
            local ok, enabled = pcall(function() return item.Enabled end)
            if ok and type(enabled) == "boolean" then item:SetAttribute("Lyra_CloakEnabled", enabled); pcall(function() item.Enabled = false end) end
        end
    elseif type(saved) == "boolean" then
-- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
        item:SetAttribute("Lyra_CloakEnabled", nil); pcall(function() item.Enabled = saved end)
    end
end
function Cloak.fadeAll(root, f)
    for _, item in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Decal") then pcall(Cloak.fadeOne, item, f)
        elseif Visual.effects[item.ClassName] then pcall(Cloak.effect, item, f) end
    end
    if root:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(Cloak.fadeOne, root, f) end
end
function Cloak.update()
    local char = Cloak.Character
    if not char or not char.Parent or char ~= lp.Character or not App.alive() then return end
    -- A part whose game value cannot be read follows the whole body (the least hidden part that can be read).
    local body, count = 1, 0
    for part, row in pairs(Cloak.Parts) do
        if part.Parent == char and Cloak.readable(row) then body = math.min(body, Cloak.hidden(row)); count = count + 1 end
    end
    if count == 0 then body = 0 end
    local factors = {}
    for part, row in pairs(Cloak.Parts) do
        if part.Parent == char then
            local f = Cloak.readable(row) and Cloak.hidden(row) or body
            factors[part.Name] = f
            -- The copied avatar's own transparency, faded as much as the game fades this part. A part the game always
            -- hides is left to the game, and so is one the game keeps changing back (no tug of war, at most 8 writes
            -- in 3 seconds). A cloak fading in and out uses those writes up on a limb the copied avatar hides (a Korblox
            -- leg), and the game's last step (0, shown) stayed: the part is looked at again once writes are allowed.
            local wanted = row.Covered and Cloak.Mask or (1 - (1 - row.Wanted) * (1 - f))
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - (row.WindowAt or 0) > 3 then row.WindowAt = now; row.Writes = 0 end
            if row.Normal < 0.5 and math.abs(part.Transparency - wanted) > 0.005 then
                if (row.Writes or 0) < 8 then
