                    row.Writes = (row.Writes or 0) + 1; row.Pending = wanted; pcall(function() part.Transparency = wanted end)
                elseif not Cloak.Retry then
                    Cloak.Retry = true
                    task.delay(3.1 - (now - row.WindowAt), function() Cloak.Retry = false; if App.alive() then Cloak.schedule() end end)
                end
            end
            for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Decal") then
                    -- A face the copier copied fades; the game's own face under a local copy stays hidden.
                    if child:GetAttribute("Lyra_CopiedSurface") then pcall(Cloak.fadeOne, child, f)
                    elseif row.Covered and child:GetAttribute("Lyra_BeforeOverlay") ~= nil and child.Transparency < 1 then pcall(function() child.Transparency = 1 end) end
                end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
                if item:GetAttribute("Lyra_BodyEffect") then pcall(Cloak.effect, item, f) end
            end
        end
    end
    Cloak.Body = body
    if App.tracing() then
        local rows = {}
        for name, f in pairs(factors) do if f > 0.005 then table.insert(rows, string.format("%s %.2f", name, f)) end end
        table.sort(rows)
        local summary = string.format("Cloak: whole body %.2f; hidden parts: %s", body, #rows > 0 and table.concat(rows, ", ") or "none")
        if summary ~= Cloak.LastTrace then Cloak.LastTrace = summary; App.trace(summary) end
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") and item:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") then
            Cloak.fadeAll(item, factors[Cloak.mountOf(item, char) or ""] or body)
        elseif item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor") then
            Cloak.fadeAll(item, factors[tostring(item:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor"))] or body)
        end
    end
end
function Cloak.schedule()
    if Cloak.Scheduled then return end
    Cloak.Scheduled = true
    task.defer(function() Cloak.Scheduled = false; pcall(Cloak.update) end)
end
function Cloak.changed(row)
    local value = row.Part.Transparency
    if row.Pending and math.abs(value - row.Pending) < 1e-4 then row.Pending = nil; return end
    row.Pending = nil
    -- The copier's own mark on a limb drawn by a local copy.
    if row.Covered and isMask(value) then return end
    row.Known = value
    Cloak.schedule()
end
-- Follows the character the copier just reshaped (your own character, not visual-only).
function Cloak.watch(char)
    Cloak.stop()
    if not char or not char.Parent then return end
    Cloak.Character = char
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if Appearance.isBody(part, char) and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            local normal = part:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameTransparency")
            if type(normal) ~= "number" then normal = 0 end
            local covered = char:FindFirstChild("LyraVisual_" .. part.Name)
            if covered and covered:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor") ~= part.Name then covered = nil end
            local row = {Part = part, Normal = normal, Wanted = covered and Cloak.Mask or part.Transparency, Covered = covered}
            -- What the game did before the copier changed the body is still true (a cloak worn while the avatar went on).
            row.Known = Cloak.Known[part] or normal
            Cloak.Parts[part] = row
            table.insert(Cloak.Connections, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function() Cloak.changed(row) end))
        end
    end
    -- Items put back later (Keep avatar between rounds) follow at once.
    table.insert(Cloak.Connections, char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") or child:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor") then Cloak.schedule() end
    end))
    Cloak.update()
end
function Cloak.stop()
    for _, connection in ipairs(Cloak.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(Cloak.Connections)
    for part, row in pairs(Cloak.Parts) do Cloak.Known[part] = row.Known end
    table.clear(Cloak.Parts)
    Cloak.Character = nil
end

-- GAME SIZE CHANGES: potions and power-ups make your character bigger or smaller by resizing its body parts. On a copied
-- avatar that gave the copied meshes the game's sizes and joints (a Korblox leg grew huge and split from the body) and
-- left the copied items at their old size (a hat or hair sank inside a giant head). Changing the body's size through
-- the game's description also counted as a new avatar, so the copied one came off. Now a size change by the game is
-- measured against the size the game had when the copied avatar went on, and the copied avatar is put back on at the
-- same scale (and at its own size again when the effect ends). At most four times in half a minute.
Scale.Connections = {}
Scale.Reactions = {}
function Scale.stop()
    for _, connection in ipairs(Scale.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(Scale.Connections)
    Scale.Character = nil
end
-- Records the sizes the copier just gave the body and follows the game's changes to them.
function Scale.watch(char)
    Scale.stop()
    if not char or not char.Parent then return end
    Scale.Character = char
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if Appearance.isBody(part, char) and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and typeof(part:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameSize")) == "Vector3" then
            part:SetAttribute("Lyra_SetSize", part.Size)
            table.insert(Scale.Connections, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function() Scale.changed(char) end))
        end
    end
end
function Scale.changed(char)
    if App.Busy or Scale.Pending or not App.alive() or char ~= Scale.Character then return end
    Scale.Pending = true
    -- A resize arrives part by part: it is measured once it has settled.
    task.delay(0.5, function()
        Scale.Pending = false
        if App.alive() and char == Scale.Character then pcall(Scale.check, char, false) end
    end)
end
-- The scale the game has given the body now, relative to the size it had when the copied avatar went on (nil when the
-- game did not resize it evenly), and whether any part was resized by the game.
function Scale.measure(char)
    local ratios, touched = {}, false
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        local before, set = part:GetAttribute("Lyra_GameSize"), part:GetAttribute("Lyra_SetSize")
        if Appearance.isBody(part, char) and typeof(before) == "Vector3" and typeof(set) == "Vector3" and (part.Size - set).Magnitude > 1e-3 then
            touched = true
            local size = part.Size
            local x, y, z = size.X / math.max(before.X, 1e-3), size.Y / math.max(before.Y, 1e-3), size.Z / math.max(before.Z, 1e-3)
            local low, high = math.min(x, y, z), math.max(x, y, z)
            if low > 0.05 and high / low < 1.15 then table.insert(ratios, (x + y + z) / 3) end
        end
    end
    if #ratios == 0 then return nil, touched end
    table.sort(ratios)
    local middle = ratios[math.ceil(#ratios / 2)]
    for _, ratio in ipairs(ratios) do if math.abs(ratio - middle) > middle * 0.1 then return nil, touched end end
    -- Back to the game's own size: exactly 1.
    if math.abs(middle - 1) < 0.02 then middle = 1 end
    return middle, touched
end
-- force: the game rebuilt part of the body or its items along with the size change, so the avatar goes on again even
-- when the scale stays the same.
function Scale.check(char, force)
    if App.Busy or not App.alive() or char ~= lp.Character or char ~= S.TouchedChar or not App.Current or App.Current.Original then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or Overlay.visualOnly() then return end
    local factor, touched = Scale.measure(char)
    if not touched and not force then return end
    factor = factor or Scale.Factor
    local now = os.clock()
    for i = #Scale.Reactions, 1, -1 do if now - Scale.Reactions[i] > 30 then table.remove(Scale.Reactions, i) end end
    if #Scale.Reactions >= 4 then return end
    table.insert(Scale.Reactions, now)
    App.devNote(string.format("Game resized the body: scale %.2f -> %.2f", Scale.Factor, factor))
    Scale.Factor = factor
    task.spawn(App.applySnapshot, App.Current, "reapply", char)
end
-- SWAPPED BODIES: some games resize you by putting a whole new body in your place for a while (a giant potion that
-- swaps in a bigger copy of you, then puts your own back). The new body is the game's, so it showed your own avatar,
-- and the copied avatar would have gone on it at its usual size. The scale of a body is read from its
-- HumanoidRootPart, which the copier never reshapes: the copied avatar goes on the new body as much bigger or smaller
-- as its root is than the root of the body it replaced (only while that one is still alive: after a death, a new
-- body is your usual size). Each body keeps the scale its copied avatar was built at, for when it comes back.
Scale.Factors = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Scale.Roots = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function Scale.rootSize(char)
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    return root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Size or nil
end
-- How many times bigger size is than base, or nil when it is not resized evenly (or not at all measurable).
function Scale.ratio(size, base)
    if typeof(size) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(base) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
    local x, y, z = size.X / math.max(base.X, 1e-3), size.Y / math.max(base.Y, 1e-3), size.Z / math.max(base.Z, 1e-3)
    local low, high = math.min(x, y, z), math.max(x, y, z)
    if low <= 0.05 or high / low > 1.15 then return nil end
    local ratio = (x + y + z) / 3
    if math.abs(ratio - 1) < 0.02 then return 1 end
    return ratio
end
-- A new body took over: its scale is worked out from the body it replaced (see SWAPPED BODIES).
function Scale.arrived(char, previous)
    Scale.From = nil
    if Scale.Factors[char] then Scale.Factor = Scale.Factors[char]; return end
    Scale.Factor = 1
    local hum = previous and previous ~= char and previous:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum.Health > 0 and Scale.Factors[previous] and Scale.Roots[previous] then
        Scale.From = {Char = char, Factor = Scale.Factors[previous], Root = Scale.Roots[previous]}
    end
end
-- The scale the copied avatar takes on char.
function Scale.factorFor(char)
    local from = Scale.From
    if from and from.Char == char then
        local ratio = Scale.ratio(Scale.rootSize(char), from.Root)
        return math.clamp(from.Factor * (ratio or 1), 0.1, 10)
    end
    return char == S.TouchedChar and Scale.Factor or 1
end
-- The copied avatar went on char at factor.
function Scale.remember(char, factor)
    Scale.Factor = factor; Scale.Factors[char] = factor; Scale.Roots[char] = Scale.rootSize(char)
    if Scale.From and Scale.From.Char == char then Scale.From = nil end
end
-- Gives a freshly built avatar model the game's scale (a copy of the cached model, never the cache itself).
function Scale.apply(model, factor)
    if not model or not factor or math.abs(factor - 1) < 0.01 then return end
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hip = hum and hum.HipHeight
    local ok = pcall(function() model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * factor) end)
    -- ScaleTo leaves HipHeight as it was on some versions: it follows the legs.
    if ok and hum and hip and math.abs(hum.HipHeight - hip) < 1e-3 then pcall(function() hum.HipHeight = hip * factor end) end
end

-- SWAP EFFECT
-- A short local glow over the character and a sparkle burst at the moment of the change, so a swap doesn't pop.
-- Created in the camera (never inside the character), so the appearance transaction never touches it.
F.Swap = {Tweens = game:GetService("TweenService"), Color = Color3.fromRGB(188, 167, 246)}
function F.Swap.begin(char)
    if not Store.Settings.SwapEffect or Store.Settings.ReducedMotion or not char then return nil end
    local fx = {}
    pcall(function()
        local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
        glow.Name = "LyraSwapGlow"; glow.Adornee = char; glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
        glow.FillColor = F.Swap.Color; glow.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(244, 239, 255)
        glow.FillTransparency = 1; glow.OutlineTransparency = 1
        glow.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace
        fx.Glow = glow
        F.Swap.Tweens:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {FillTransparency = 0.3, OutlineTransparency = 0.1}):Play()
    end)
    return fx
end
function F.Swap.burst(fx, char)
    if not fx or Store.Settings.LowEffects then return end
    pcall(function()
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not root then return end
        local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
        anchor.Name = "LyraSwapBurst"; anchor.Anchored = true; anchor.CanCollide = false; anchor.CanQuery = false; anchor.CanTouch = false
        anchor.Transparency = 1; anchor.Size = Vector3.new(2, 4, 1); anchor.CFrame = root.CFrame
        local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
        emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(F.Swap.Color, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        emitter.LightEmission = 1; emitter.Rate = 0; emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9)
        emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 9); emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
        emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
        emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
        emitter.Parent = anchor
        anchor.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace
        emitter:Emit(36)
        task.delay(1.5, function() pcall(function() anchor:Destroy() end) end)
    end)
end
function F.Swap.finish(fx)
    if not fx or not fx.Glow then return end
    local glow = fx.Glow; fx.Glow = nil
    pcall(function() F.Swap.Tweens:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1}):Play() end)
    task.delay(0.5, function() pcall(function() glow:Destroy() end) end)
end

-- Auto-load and avatar cycle state. Its functions are defined after Looks; declared here so applySnapshot can reach it.
local Auto = {Deaths = 0, DeathsSince = 0, LastSwitch = -math.huge, TimerStart = os.clock(), Pending = nil, Switching = false,
    Bag = {}, Direction = 1, SkipDeath = false, SkipRespawn = false, Rng = Random.new(), OnChange = function() end, OnTick = function() end}

-- One mutation path for apply, undo, restore and respawn on your screen. Previews never enter it (App.applySnapshot
-- decides between this and the game's own outfit menu, see CATALOG AVATAR CREATOR).
-- inPlace: change the character even when visual-only is on (used to take a copied avatar off the character when
-- switching to visual-only).
function App.applyLocal(snapshot, mode, readyChar, inPlace)
    if App.Busy or not App.alive() then return false end
    local char = readyChar or lp.Character
    -- Visual-only draws the avatar over the character and never touches the character itself.
    local visualOnly = Overlay.visualOnly() and not inPlace
    if not char or (not App.captureInitial(char) and not visualOnly) then App.report("Wait for your character to load.", "warning"); return false end
    -- The undo base is your character as the game made it, taken again while the copier has not changed it yet.
    if not visualOnly and S.TouchedChar ~= char and App.charReady(char) then App.captureInitial(char, true) end
    -- "Original" always means the current undo base (older timeline entries point at an earlier capture).
    local requested = snapshot
    if snapshot.Original and not snapshot.GameLook and App.Initial then snapshot = App.Initial end
    -- Read while the character is still the game's (see CUSTOM CHARACTERS): once reshaped, its hidden body shows again.
    local customRig
    if not visualOnly and not snapshot.Original and not App.SuggestedVisual[game.GameId] and S.TouchedChar ~= char
        and App.charReady(char) and os.clock() - (App.SpawnTimes[char] or 0) >= 3 then
        customRig = App.customCharacter(char)
    end
    App.Busy = true; S.applyBusy = true; App.Refresh()
    App.report(mode == "undo" and "Returning to the previous appearance…" or (mode == "restore" or mode == "yield") and "Restoring your own appearance…" or "Preparing the avatar…", "loading")
    local desc, dummy, oldAnchored, anchorPart, oldRequiresNeck, applicationReport, rigNote, rigRebuilt, swapFx, reshaped, prefetch, coveredHere
    local previous = App.Current
    if previous and previous.Original and not previous.GameLook and App.Initial then previous = App.Initial end
    if previous and mode ~= "reapply" then previous.Animations = App.captureAnimations(char) end
    -- A catalog edit keeps the animations being played unless it changed an animation item.
    if (mode == "catalog" or mode == "customize") and previous and not snapshot.ForceAnims and not snapshot.Animations then snapshot.Animations = previous.Animations end
    -- Builds the avatar model, reusing an untouched copy of the last one built for this snapshot and
    -- rig, so reapplying after a respawn skips the slow rebuild.
    local builtFactor = 1
    local function build(rig)
        -- The game's size for this character (see GAME SIZE CHANGES and SWAPPED BODIES); the cached model always stays
        -- at its own size.
        local factor = not visualOnly and Scale.factorFor(char) or 1
        builtFactor = factor
        local cache = App.ModelCache
        if cache and cache.Snapshot == snapshot and cache.Rig == rig then
            local cloned, copy = pcall(function() return cache.Model:Clone() end)
            if cloned and copy then Scale.apply(copy, factor); return copy, cache.Note, cache.Rebuilt end
        end
        local model, note, rebuilt = Visual.model(snapshot.Data, desc, rig)
        -- The game already put its own accessories on; only body, clothing and colours are rebuilt.
        if snapshot.GameLook then for _, item in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Accessory") then item:Destroy() end end end
        local copied, copy = pcall(function() return model:Clone() end)
        if copied and copy then
            if cache then pcall(function() cache.Model:Destroy() end) end
            App.ModelCache = {Snapshot = snapshot, Rig = rig, Model = copy, Note = note, Rebuilt = rebuilt}
        end
        Scale.apply(model, factor)
        return model, note, rebuilt
    end
    local ok, err = xpcall(function()
        -- Your own look on a character the copier has not changed (or drawn over with visual-only): nothing to rebuild.
        local nothing = snapshot.Original and not snapshot.GameLook and (visualOnly or S.TouchedChar ~= char)
        local rig
        if not nothing then
            assert(type(snapshot.Data) == "table", "This appearance has no avatar data.")
            desc = Codec.decode(snapshot.Data)
            prefetch = App.prefetchAnimations(char, snapshot, desc)
            -- A visual-only avatar can be drawn as R6 or R15 whatever the game's rig is (Settings > VisualRig).
            local chosenRig = visualOnly and Store.Settings.VisualRig ~= "Auto" and Enum.HumanoidRigType[Store.Settings.VisualRig] or nil
            -- Drawn as R15 because the game's R6 body can't show it (see R15 AVATARS IN R6 GAMES).
            if visualOnly and not chosenRig and Overlay.Auto then chosenRig = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 end
            -- A custom character with no standard body still gets an overlay (R15); it then follows the root.
            rig = visualOnly and (chosenRig or Overlay.rigType(char) or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) or F.getTrueRigType(char)
            assert(rig, "The character rig could not be identified.")
            dummy, rigNote, rigRebuilt = build(rig)
        end
        assert(App.alive(), "Execution ended.")
        if Store.Settings.AutoReset and mode == "apply" and not visualOnly and not nothing then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                App.report("Waiting for your character to respawn…", "loading")
                -- This respawn is ours: the avatar cycle must not count it as a death.
                Auto.SkipDeath = true; Auto.SkipRespawn = true
                task.delay(15, function() Auto.SkipDeath = false; Auto.SkipRespawn = false end)
                local old = char; hum.Health = 0; local deadline = os.clock() + 12
                repeat
                    task.wait(0.1); char = lp.Character
                    -- The new character stays covered until the avatar is on (see COVER).
                    if char and char ~= old and not coveredHere then coveredHere = char; Cover.begin(char, 15) end
                until not App.alive() or (char and char ~= old and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) or os.clock() >= deadline
                assert(App.alive(), "Execution ended.")
                if char and char ~= old and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local appearanceDeadline = os.clock() + 5
                    while not lp:HasAppearanceLoaded() and os.clock() < appearanceDeadline and App.alive() do task.wait(0.1) end
                    App.waitSettled(char, 5)
                    if F.getTrueRigType(char) ~= rig then
                        dummy:Destroy(); rig = F.getTrueRigType(char); dummy, rigNote, rigRebuilt = build(rig)
                    end
                    -- The fresh character is the game's: it becomes the undo base.
                    App.captureInitial(char, true)
                else
                    -- Round-based games can block or delay respawning. Keep going on the current character when it is still alive.
                    char = lp.Character
                    local liveHum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    assert(liveHum and liveHum.Health > 0 and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
                        "This game did not respawn your character. Turn off \"Reset character first\" in Settings, wait until you can move, and try again.")
                    App.report("This game blocked the respawn, so the avatar is being applied to your current character…", "loading")
                end
            end
        end
        assert(char == lp.Character and char.Parent and App.alive(), "Your character changed during the operation. Try again.")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if visualOnly then
            -- Some games (Evade) drive the character without a Humanoid: the overlay only needs something to follow.
            assert(not hum or hum.Health > 0, "Wait for your character to respawn.")
            assert(nothing or Overlay.rootOf(char), "Your character has not loaded yet. Wait for it to appear and try again.")
        else
            assert(hum and hum.Health > 0, "Wait for your character to respawn.")
        end
        S.operationSerial = (S.operationSerial or 0) + 1
        if not visualOnly and not nothing then
            anchorPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); oldAnchored = anchorPart and anchorPart.Anchored
            oldRequiresNeck = hum.RequiresNeck
            F.ensureOriginalTagsScanned(char)
            F.getSafeAccessoryNames()
            -- A character the game is still building is waited for (catalog games rebuild it on every try-on).
            if not App.waitRig(char, 6) then
                error(mode == "reapply" and "Your character is still loading. The avatar goes back on when it has loaded."
                    or "Your character is not fully loaded yet (some body parts are not connected). Wait a moment and try again.", 0)
            end
        end
        -- The swap glow marks a new avatar; adding or removing one item (shop, Customize) changes it without one.
        if mode ~= "reapply" and mode ~= "catalog" and mode ~= "customize" and not nothing then swapFx = F.Swap.begin(char); if swapFx then task.wait(0.14) end end
        assert(App.alive() and char == lp.Character and char.Parent and (not hum or hum.Health > 0), "Your character changed. Wait and try again.")
        -- The game retains camera/controller ownership during cosmetic application.
        App.report("Applying appearance, clothing, and accessories…", "loading")
        -- The copier is about to change the body itself: it stops following the game's changes to it until it is done.
        Cloak.stop(); Scale.stop()
        if visualOnly then
            -- The game's character is left untouched: the avatar is drawn over it (see SKIN OVERLAY).
            Repair.stop()
            if snapshot.Original then Overlay.clear(char) else Overlay.showLocal(char, dummy) end
            if prefetch then prefetch.wait(2.5) end
            App.visualAnimations(char, not snapshot.Original and desc or nil, snapshot)
        elseif nothing then
            Overlay.clear(char)
        else
            Overlay.clear(char)
            Appearance.checkLiveRig(char)
            App.Dirty = true
            Repair.stop()
            -- From here on this character carries the copier's changes until your own look is fully back.
            S.TouchedChar = char; reshaped = true
            applicationReport = F.aAv(char, dummy, snapshot.Original and {Original = true, KeepAccessories = snapshot.GameLook == true} or nil)
        end
        F.Swap.burst(swapFx, char)
        assert(App.alive() and char == lp.Character and char.Parent, "Your character changed while the avatar was being applied.")
        if reshaped then
            -- The game's description stays on the Humanoid: catalog games keep editing it, and Roblox's emote wheel
            -- plays emotes from it. It is remembered (it tells the game's avatar items apart) and only its emotes change.
            local live = App.liveDescription(hum)
            if live and not live:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") then
                if S.gameDescription then pcall(function() S.gameDescription:Destroy() end) end
                pcall(function() S.gameDescription = live:Clone() end)
            end
            if not live then
--: YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
                live = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription"); live.Name = "HumanoidDescription"; live:SetAttribute("Lyra_Description", true); live.Parent = hum
            end
            -- Older versions left their own copy next to the game's description.
            for _, item in ipairs(hum:GetChildren()) do
                if item:IsA("HumanoidDescription") and item ~= live and item:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") then pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
            end
            App.setEmotes(live, desc, snapshot.Original == true)
            if prefetch then prefetch.wait(2.5) end
            -- A new avatar starts from your own animations (see STALE ANIMATIONS). Rows read from this character (a shop
            -- or Customize change, Undo, the timeline, your own look) already say what to keep.
            local ownRows = type(snapshot.Animations) == "table" and App.AnimSource[snapshot.Animations] == char
            local animChanged = false
            if not ownRows and App.Initial then animChanged = App.resetAnimations(char, App.Initial.Animations) end
            if snapshot.Animations then
                animChanged = App.restoreAnimations(char, snapshot, true) or animChanged
            elseif snapshot.Data.Visual and not rigRebuilt then
                animChanged = App.restoreAnimations(char, {Animations = App.skinAnimations(snapshot.Data, desc), Data = snapshot.Data}, true) or animChanged
            elseif Store.Settings.CopyAnims or snapshot.ForceAnims then
                animChanged = F.applyAnimationIdsToAnimate(char, desc) or animChanged
            end
            if animChanged then F.restartAnimate(char, true) end
            -- Existing tag instances were retained by the appearance transaction.
            local currentHead=char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if currentHead then F.ensureTagsVisible(currentHead) end
        end
        -- Attachments and game links are restored synchronously by the transaction.
        assert(App.alive() and char == lp.Character and char.Parent, "Your character changed before the operation finished.")
        App.Dirty = false
        if mode == "undo" then table.remove(App.History)
        elseif mode ~= "reapply" and previous and previous ~= snapshot then
            -- Jumping back through the timeline moves that entry out of the history instead of duplicating it.
            if mode == "history" then for i = #App.History, 1, -1 do if App.History[i] == snapshot or App.History[i] == requested then table.remove(App.History, i); break end end end
            table.insert(App.History, previous); while #App.History > 12 do table.remove(App.History, 1) end
        end
        App.Current = snapshot
        if dummy then
            if S.cD and S.cD ~= dummy then pcall(function() S.cD:Destroy() end) end
            S.cD = dummy; dummy = nil
        end
        S.cU = snapshot.Id or "SAVED"; S.tN = snapshot.Name or "SavedAvatar"
        if desc then
            if S.customDesc then S.customDesc:Destroy() end
            S.customDesc = desc:Clone()
        end
        S.fvOn = not snapshot.Original; S.hdOn = false
        S.appliedChar = char; S.currentRigType = F.getTrueRigType(char)
        _G.Copier_TargetID = nil
        if reshaped then
            Repair.watch(applicationReport, char)
            -- The game hiding or resizing the copied avatar is followed from now on (see GAME INVISIBILITY and GAME SIZE CHANGES).
            if not snapshot.Original then Scale.remember(char, builtFactor); Cloak.watch(char); Scale.watch(char)
            else Scale.Factor = 1; Scale.Factors[char] = nil end
            if snapshot.Original then
                Appearance.releaseGeometry(hum)
                -- Nothing of the copier is left and the game's own pieces are back: the character is the game's again,
                -- so the next avatar takes a fresh undo base from it.
                local leftover = false
                for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if item:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") then leftover = true; break end end
                if not leftover then S.TouchedChar = nil end
            end
        end
        if oldRequiresNeck ~= nil then hum.RequiresNeck = oldRequiresNeck end
    end, function(e) return tostring(e) end)
    if anchorPart and oldAnchored ~= nil then pcall(function() anchorPart.Anchored = oldAnchored end) end
    if char and oldRequiresNeck ~= nil then pcall(function() char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").RequiresNeck = oldRequiresNeck end) end
    pcall(F.unlockCamera); pcall(F.resumeCamScripts)
    F.Swap.finish(swapFx)
    table.clear(S_SafeTools)
    if desc then desc:Destroy() end; if dummy then dummy:Destroy() end
    App.Busy = false; S.applyBusy = false
    -- The new body settles in the next physics steps; a character that was standing is kept on its feet.
    if ok and reshaped then App.guardUpright(char, 2.5) end
    App.trace(string.format("Apply (%s) of %s on %s: %s", tostring(mode), snapshot.Original and "your own look" or ("\"" .. tostring(snapshot.Name) .. "\""),
        App.traceName(char), ok and string.format("done, scale %.2f", builtFactor) or ("failed: " .. tostring(err))))
    if ok then Repair.resume() end
    -- Copies of you in the game (lobby, cutscenes) and your picture follow the new look.
    if ok then task.spawn(Mirror.refresh) end
    -- The picture in the Roblox menu (Esc) is made ready a moment later, so it already shows the new avatar when opened.
    if ok and not snapshot.Original and Store.Settings.MenuAvatar then
        task.delay(1.5, function() if App.alive() and App.Current == snapshot and not App.Busy then pcall(Thumbs.model) end end)
    end
    if ok and not snapshot.Original and Auto.remember(snapshot) then App.persistState() end
    -- Wearing someone from any list also puts them in Recent, so they are easy to find again.
    if ok and mode == "apply" and snapshot.Id and not snapshot.LookKey then
        App.addRecent({Id = snapshot.Id, Name = tostring(snapshot.Name or snapshot.Id), DisplayName = snapshot.DisplayName or snapshot.Name})
    end
    if not ok then
        if applicationReport then for _, row in ipairs(applicationReport.Items or {}) do if row.Template then row.Template:Destroy() end end end
        S.lastError = err; S.operationSerial = (S.operationSerial or 0) + 1; S.fvOn = false; App.report(err .. (App.Dirty and " Use Restore to recover your appearance." or ""), "error") else
        App.report(mode == "undo" and "Previous appearance restored." or mode == "restore" and "Your own appearance is back." or mode == "yield" and "The game changed your avatar, so the copied one came off. Undo puts it back." or mode == "reapply" and "Avatar reapplied." or mode == "catalog" and "Catalog change applied." or mode == "customize" and "Change applied." or mode == "cycle" and ("Avatar cycle: now wearing " .. tostring(snapshot.Name or "the next avatar") .. ".") or mode == "history" and ("Back to " .. (snapshot.Original and "your own appearance" or tostring(snapshot.Name or "that avatar")) .. ".") or mode == "game" and "The game's new look is on. Undo puts the copied avatar back."  or ((char and not visualOnly and F.getTrueRigType(char) ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) and "Avatar applied. This game does not use an R15 rig, so its own animations were kept." or "Avatar applied. Tap Customize to remove its items or add new ones."), "success")
    end
    if ok and rigNote then
        App.report(rigNote, "warning")
    elseif ok and applicationReport and (#applicationReport.Skipped > 0 or #applicationReport.BodyErrors > 0) then
        App.report("Avatar applied with limitations: " .. tostring(#applicationReport.Skipped + #applicationReport.BodyErrors) .. " unavailable items/body parts in this game.", "warning")
    elseif ok and snapshot.Data and snapshot.Data.Visual and snapshot.Data.Visual.Legacy then
        App.report("Old JSON applied. Attachments were estimated because the backup contains no joints.", "warning")
    end
    if customRig or (not ok and not visualOnly and tostring(err):find("none of the expected body parts", 1, true)) then
        task.delay(1, App.suggestVisualOnly, customRig or "nobody")
    end
    if App.alive() then App.Refresh() end
    return ok
end
-- CATALOG AVATAR CREATOR: every player there may wear any catalog item, and the game's own outfit menu sends the
-- outfit to the server through its CatalogGuiRemote. The copier sends the avatar you apply the same way, so the game
-- itself puts it on your character and everyone in the server sees it, not only you. Undo, Restore, the timeline,
-- shop and Customize changes and the avatar cycle go through the game too. When the game does not take it (no
-- remote, an error, nothing changes on your character), the avatar is applied on your screen as before. Visual-only
-- keeps it on your screen only. Settings > Advanced > "Wear through Catalog Avatar Creator" turns this off.
local CAC = {PlaceId = 7041939546}
CAC.RigidFields = {Hat = "HatAccessory", Hair = "HairAccessory", Face = "FaceAccessory", Neck = "NeckAccessory", Shoulder = "ShouldersAccessory",
    Front = "FrontAccessory", Back = "BackAccessory", Waist = "WaistAccessory", TShirt = "TShirtAccessory", Shirt = "ShirtAccessory",
    Pants = "PantsAccessory", Jacket = "JacketAccessory", Sweater = "SweaterAccessory", Shorts = "ShortsAccessory", LeftShoe = "ShoesAccessory",
    RightShoe = "ShoesAccessory", DressSkirt = "DressSkirtAccessory", Eyebrow = "EyebrowAccessory", Eyelash = "EyelashAccessory"}
function CAC.remote()
    if game.PlaceId ~= CAC.PlaceId then return nil end
    local events = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Events")
    local remote = events and events:FindFirstChild("CatalogGuiRemote")
    return remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") and remote or nil
end
function CAC.enabled() return Store.Settings.GameWear ~= false and CAC.remote() ~= nil end
-- Whether an application goes through the game: not with visual-only, not when the character is changed in place
-- (switching modes), and not for the copier's own reaction to the game changing your avatar.
function CAC.handles(mode, inPlace)
    return not inPlace and mode ~= "game" and mode ~= "yield" and not Overlay.visualOnly() and CAC.enabled()
end
-- The game's outfit format: colours as 0-255 tables, vectors as tagged tables.
function CAC.color(c)
    return {r = math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), g = math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), b = math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5), IsRGBTable = true}
end
function CAC.vector(v, default)
    v = typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v or default
    return {X = v.X, Y = v.Y, Z = v.Z, Vector3 = true}
end
function CAC.properties(desc)
    local props = {}
    for _, field in ipairs(Codec.assetFields) do props[field] = tonumber(desc[field]) or 0 end
    for _, field in ipairs(Codec.colorFields) do props[field] = CAC.color(desc[field]) end
    for _, field in ipairs(Codec.scaleFields) do props[field] = tonumber(desc[field]) or 1 end
    local lists, layered, refinements = {}, {}, {}
    for _, field in pairs(CAC.RigidFields) do lists[field] = {} end
    for _, row in ipairs(desc:GetAccessories(true)) do
        local typeName = typeof(row.AccessoryType) == "EnumItem" and row.AccessoryType.Name or tostring(row.AccessoryType or "Unknown")
        if row.IsLayered then
            table.insert(layered, {AssetId = row.AssetId, AccessoryType = typeName, Order = row.Order or 1, IsLayered = true, Puffiness = row.Puffiness or 0.5,
                Position = CAC.vector(row.Position, Vector3.zero), Rotation = CAC.vector(row.Rotation, Vector3.zero), Scale = CAC.vector(row.Scale, Vector3.one)})
        else
            local field = CAC.RigidFields[typeName]
            if field then table.insert(lists[field], tostring(row.AssetId)) end
            -- An item moved, turned or resized (Customize, or the copied avatar's own fitting).
            local ref = {}
            if typeof(row.Position) == "Vector3" and row.Position.Magnitude > 1e-4 then ref.Position = CAC.vector(row.Position) end
            if typeof(row.Rotation) == "Vector3" and row.Rotation.Magnitude > 1e-4 then ref.Rotation = CAC.vector(row.Rotation) end
            if typeof(row.Scale) == "Vector3" and (row.Scale - Vector3.one).Magnitude > 1e-4 then ref.Scale = CAC.vector(row.Scale) end
            if next(ref) then refinements[tostring(row.AssetId)] = ref end
        end
    end
    for field, ids in pairs(lists) do props[field] = table.concat(ids, ",") end
    props.LayeredAccessories = layered
    props.AccessoryRefinements = refinements
    local makeup = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(desc:GetChildren()) do
        if item.ClassName == "MakeupDescription" and tonumber(item.AssetId) and item.AssetId > 0 then
            table.insert(makeup, {AssetId = item.AssetId, MakeupType = item.MakeupType.Name, Order = item.Order})
        end
    end
    props.MakeupItems = makeup
    local headShape = ""
    pcall(function()
        for _, item in ipairs(desc:GetChildren()) do
            if item.ClassName == "BodyPartDescription" and item.BodyPart == Enum.BodyPart.Head and type(item.HeadShape) == "string" then headShape = item.HeadShape; break end
        end
    end)
    props.HeadShape = headShape
    local okFacial, facial = pcall(function() return desc.StaticFacialAnimation end)
    props.StaticFacialAnimation = okFacial and facial == true
    return props
end
-- What an outfit is made of (clothing, face, body parts and accessories), to see when the game has put it on.
function CAC.key(desc)
    local parts = {}
    local ok = pcall(function()
        for _, field in ipairs({"Shirt", "Pants", "GraphicTShirt", "Face", "Head", "Torso", "LeftArm", "RightArm", "LeftLeg", "RightLeg"}) do
            table.insert(parts, tostring(tonumber(desc[field]) or 0))
        end
        local ids = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(desc:GetAccessories(true)) do table.insert(ids, tostring(row.AssetId)) end
        table.sort(ids)
        table.insert(parts, table.concat(ids, ","))
    end)
    return ok and table.concat(parts, "|") or nil
end
-- The key of the outfit the game has on your character right now.
function CAC.liveKey()
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local live = hum and App.liveDescription(hum)
    return live and not live:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") and CAC.key(live) or nil
end
-- Yields until the game has put the outfit on: "full" when it matches, "partial" when the game changed your outfit
-- and kept it that way (it leaves out items it does not allow), nil when nothing changed.
-- failed: tells when the game refused the outfit, so there is no need to wait any longer.
function CAC.wait(wanted, before, timeout, failed)
    local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 8)
    local changedAt, lastKey
    while os.clock() < deadline and App.alive() do
        if failed and failed() then break end
        local key = CAC.liveKey()
        if key and key == wanted then return "full" end
        if key and key ~= before then
            if key ~= lastKey then lastKey = key; changedAt = os.clock()
            elseif os.clock() - changedAt >= 1.5 then return "partial" end
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
    return lastKey and "partial" or nil
end
-- Puts a snapshot on through the game. Falls back to applying it on your screen when the game does not take it.
function App.serverWear(requested, mode, readyChar)
    if App.Busy or not App.alive() then return false end
    local char = readyChar or lp.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then App.report("Wait for your character to respawn.", "warning"); return false end
    local current = App.Current
    -- The undo base is your own outfit: taken again unless what you wear is the outfit the copier sent.
    local sentOn = current and current.Server and current.ServerKey ~= nil and CAC.liveKey() == current.ServerKey
    if not sentOn and S.TouchedChar ~= char and App.charReady(char) then App.captureInitial(char, true) end
    local snapshot = requested
    if snapshot.Original and not snapshot.GameLook and App.Initial then snapshot = App.Initial end
    if type(snapshot.Data) ~= "table" then return App.applyLocal(requested, mode, readyChar) end
    local decoded, desc = pcall(Codec.decode, snapshot.Data)
    if not decoded then return App.applyLocal(requested, mode, readyChar) end
    local wanted = CAC.key(desc)
    -- Already on (after a respawn the game keeps the outfit it was sent): nothing to send.
    if mode == "reapply" and wanted and CAC.liveKey() == wanted then
        desc:Destroy(); S.appliedChar = char
        return true
    end
    -- A copy drawn on this character on your screen only comes off first, so the game's outfit is all that shows.
    if S.TouchedChar == char and App.Initial then
        local kept = #App.History
        App.applyLocal(App.Initial, "restore", char)
        while #App.History > kept do table.remove(App.History) end
        App.Current = current
    end
    if App.Busy or not App.alive() then desc:Destroy(); return false end
    -- Your own outfit that is already on needs nothing from the game.
    local already = snapshot.Original and wanted ~= nil and CAC.liveKey() == wanted
    App.Busy = true; S.applyBusy = true; App.Refresh()
    App.report(snapshot.Original and "Putting your own outfit back on through the game…" or "Putting the avatar on through the game, so everyone sees it…", "loading")
    local before = CAC.liveKey()
    local rig = F.getTrueRigType(char) or hum.RigType
    local result = already and "full" or nil
    local built, props = pcall(CAC.properties, desc)
    if built and not already then
        -- Sent on its own thread: a game that never answers cannot leave the copier waiting. What counts is what the
        -- game then puts on your character.
        local remote, refused = CAC.remote(), false
        task.spawn(function()
            local sent = pcall(function()
                remote:InvokeServer({Properties = props, Action = "CreateAndWearHumanoidDescription", RigType = rig})
            end)
            if not sent then refused = true end
        end)
        result = CAC.wait(wanted, before, 8, function() return refused end)
    end
    App.Busy = false; S.applyBusy = false
    if not result then
        desc:Destroy()
        if not App.alive() then return false end
        App.report("The game did not take the avatar, so it is put on for you only.", "warning")
        return App.applyLocal(requested, mode, readyChar)
    end
    local newChar = lp.Character
    local newHum = newChar and newChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local live = newHum and App.liveDescription(newHum)
    -- Emotes are not part of the game's outfit: the emote wheel gets the avatar's emotes on your screen.
    if live then App.setEmotes(live, desc, snapshot.Original == true) end
    local previous = App.Current
    if previous and previous.Original and not previous.GameLook and App.Initial then previous = App.Initial end
    if mode == "undo" then table.remove(App.History)
    elseif mode ~= "reapply" and previous and previous ~= snapshot then
        if mode == "history" then for i = #App.History, 1, -1 do if App.History[i] == snapshot or App.History[i] == requested then table.remove(App.History, i); break end end end
        table.insert(App.History, previous); while #App.History > 12 do table.remove(App.History, 1) end
    end
    snapshot.Server = not snapshot.Original or nil
    snapshot.ServerKey = CAC.liveKey()
    App.Current = snapshot
    S.cU = snapshot.Id or "SAVED"; S.tN = snapshot.Name or "SavedAvatar"
    if S.customDesc then pcall(function() S.customDesc:Destroy() end) end
    S.customDesc = desc
    S.fvOn = false; S.hdOn = false; S.appliedChar = newChar
    S.operationSerial = (S.operationSerial or 0) + 1
    task.spawn(Mirror.refresh)
    if not snapshot.Original and Auto.remember(snapshot) then App.persistState() end
    if mode == "apply" and snapshot.Id and not snapshot.LookKey then
        App.addRecent({Id = snapshot.Id, Name = tostring(snapshot.Name or snapshot.Id), DisplayName = snapshot.DisplayName or snapshot.Name})
    end
    App.report(snapshot.Original and "Your own outfit is back on." or result == "full" and "Avatar on through the game: everyone in this server sees it."
        or "Avatar on through the game. The game left out the items it does not allow.", "success")
    App.Refresh()
    return true
end
-- Every application, undo, restore and respawn goes through here: through the game in Catalog Avatar Creator, else
-- on your character (or drawn over it with visual-only).
-- R15 AVATARS IN R6 GAMES: Roblox can't put layered clothing (jackets, shirts, pants, shoes made to wrap the body) on
-- an R6 body, and a skin saved on R15 keeps its exact look only on R15. Worn on an R6 character (A Bizarre Run and
-- other R6 games), such an avatar came out as plain blocks with only its hair and hats. It is now drawn as R15 over
-- the character (visual-only, see SKIN OVERLAY), which follows the character's moves, tools and the game's own
-- animations. This stays on for the game until the script closes; the notice it shows can put avatars back on the R6
-- body instead, and turning Visual-only off in Settings does too.
Overlay.AutoDeclined = {}
-- Whether an avatar only shows right on R15: layered clothing, or a skin saved on R15.
function App.wantsR15(data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
    if type(data.Visual) == "table" and data.Visual.RigType == "R15" then return true end
    for _, row in ipairs(type(data.Accessories) == "table" and data.Accessories or {}) do
        if type(row) == "table" and row.IsLayered == true then return true end
    end
    return false
end
-- Turns R15 drawing on for this game before snapshot goes on char, when it needs it. Yields (the character first gets
-- its own body back when the copier had reshaped it).
function App.autoR15(snapshot, mode, char)
    if Overlay.Auto or Overlay.visualOnly() or Overlay.AutoDeclined[game.GameId] or App.Busy then return end
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" or snapshot.Original or not App.wantsR15(snapshot.Data) then return end
    if Store.Settings.VisualRig == "R6" then return end
    if not char or F.getTrueRigType(char) ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then return end
    -- Nothing of the copier may stay on the R6 body under the drawn avatar: it gets its own look back first, and the
    -- timeline is left as it was (the avatar worn until now stays the one Undo goes back to).
    if S.TouchedChar == char and App.Initial then
        local current, history = App.Current, #App.History
        if not App.applyLocal(App.Initial, "restore", char, true) then return end
        while #App.History > history do table.remove(App.History) end
        App.Current = current
    end
    Overlay.Auto = true
    App.devNote("This avatar needs R15 (layered clothing or a skin saved on R15) and this game's character is R6: drawn over it as R15.")
    App.toast({Title = "Drawn as R15 in this game", Kind = "info", Icon = "eye", Duration = 12,
        Text = "This game uses R6 bodies, which can't show layered clothing, so the avatar is drawn as R15 over your character. Only you see it, as always.",
        Action = {Text = "Use the R6 body", Callback = function()
            if not App.alive() or not Overlay.Auto then return end
            Overlay.Auto = false; Overlay.AutoDeclined[game.GameId] = true
            App.switchVisualOnly(false)
        end}})
end
function App.applySnapshot(snapshot, mode, readyChar, inPlace)
    -- The item adjustments kept for this avatar go on with it (see SAVED ADJUSTMENTS).
    Tweaks.attach(snapshot)
    if not inPlace and not CAC.handles(mode, inPlace) then pcall(App.autoR15, snapshot, mode, readyChar or lp.Character) end
    local ok
    if CAC.handles(mode, inPlace) then ok = App.serverWear(snapshot, mode, readyChar)
    else ok = App.applyLocal(snapshot, mode, readyChar, inPlace) end
    -- The avatar is on: your character shows again (see COVER).
    if ok then Cover.finish(readyChar or lp.Character) end
    return ok
end
-- Yields. Builds the avatar model of a snapshot ahead of time (Auto-load builds it while the window is being made), so
-- applying it only copies the model. Nothing happens when a model is already cached.
function App.prebuild(snapshot, rig)
    if App.ModelCache or App.Busy or type(snapshot) ~= "table" or type(snapshot.Data) ~= "table" or not rig then return end
    local desc = Codec.decode(snapshot.Data)
    local ok, model, note, rebuilt = pcall(Visual.model, snapshot.Data, desc, rig)
    pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end)
    if not ok or not model then return end
    if App.ModelCache or not App.alive() then pcall(function() model:Destroy() end); return end
    App.ModelCache = {Snapshot = snapshot, Rig = rig, Model = model, Note = note, Rebuilt = rebuilt}
end
function App.applyPreview()
    if not App.Preview or App.Busy then return end
    local profile = App.Preview
    local snapshot = {Data = profile.SnapshotData or Codec.encode(profile.Description), Id = profile.Id, Name = profile.Name, LookKey = profile.LookKey}
    -- What a player wears in this game is not their profile: it keeps their picture but not their id.
    if profile.Live then snapshot.Id = nil; snapshot.ThumbId = profile.Id; snapshot.Name = tostring(profile.Name) .. " (in game)" end
    task.spawn(App.applySnapshot, snapshot, "apply")
end
function App.undo()
    if #App.History > 0 and not App.Busy then task.spawn(App.applySnapshot, App.History[#App.History], "undo") end
end
-- Timeline: go straight back to any earlier appearance of this session.
function App.jump(snapshot)
    if not snapshot or snapshot == App.Current or App.Busy then return end
    task.spawn(App.applySnapshot, snapshot, "history")
end
-- One-tap wear from a list (Server, Favorites, Recent) without opening the 3D preview first.
function App.wearProfile(profile)
    if not profile or App.Busy then return end
    App.report("Loading " .. tostring(profile.DisplayName or profile.Name) .. "…", "loading")
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, resolved, err = pcall(App.resolve, tostring(profile.Id or profile.Name), App.alive)
        if not ok then err = tostring(resolved); resolved = nil end
        if not resolved then if err ~= "cancelled" then App.report(err or "This profile is unavailable.", "error") end; return end
        App.applySnapshot({Data = Codec.encode(resolved.Description), Id = resolved.Id, Name = resolved.Name}, "apply")
    end)
end
function App.restore()
    if App.Initial and not App.Busy then task.spawn(App.applySnapshot, App.Initial, "restore") end
end
-- Switching between changing the character and drawing over it while an avatar is on (Store.Settings.VisualOnly is
-- already the new value): the character first gets your own look back, or the overlay comes off, then the same
-- avatar goes on the new way. Nothing is left of the old way.
function App.switchVisualOnly(on)
    local current, char = App.Current, lp.Character
    -- Turning it off also ends the drawing an R6 game turned on by itself (see R15 AVATARS IN R6 GAMES).
    if not on and Overlay.Auto then Overlay.Auto = false; Overlay.AutoDeclined[game.GameId] = true end
    if App.Busy or not App.alive() or not current or current.Original or not char or game.GameId == Overlay.EvadeGame then
        App.report("Applies the next time you wear an avatar.", "info"); return
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        local restored = false
        if on and S.TouchedChar == char and App.Initial then
            restored = App.applySnapshot(App.Initial, "restore", char, true)
            if not restored then return end
        elseif not on then
            Overlay.clear(char)
        end
        -- After a restore the copied avatar is the newest timeline entry: "undo" puts it back and takes it out again.
        App.applySnapshot(current, restored and "undo" or "reapply", char)
    end)
end
-- Clean reset: respawns your character so the game builds it again with its own avatar, with nothing of the copier
-- left on it. The copied avatar stays in the timeline. With visual-only the character was never changed, so the
-- overlay simply comes off.
function App.cleanReset()
    if App.Busy or App.CleanReset or not App.alive() then return end
    local char = lp.Character
    if Overlay.visualOnly() then App.restore(); return end
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then App.report("Wait for your character to respawn.", "warning"); return end
    App.CleanReset = true; App.Refresh()
    App.report("Respawning with the game's avatar…", "loading")
    task.spawn(function()
        -- This respawn is ours: the avatar cycle must not count it, and the copied avatar must not go back on.
        Auto.SkipDeath = true; Auto.SkipRespawn = true
        task.delay(15, function() Auto.SkipDeath = false; Auto.SkipRespawn = false end)
        Repair.stop()
        pcall(function() hum.Health = 0 end)
        local deadline, fresh = os.clock() + 15, nil
        repeat task.wait(0.2); fresh = lp.Character until not App.alive() or (fresh and fresh ~= char and fresh.Parent) or os.clock() >= deadline
        if not App.alive() then return end
        if fresh and fresh ~= char then
            if App.Current and not App.Current.Original then
                table.insert(App.History, App.Current); while #App.History > 12 do table.remove(App.History, 1) end
            end
            S.fvOn = false; S.TouchedChar = nil; S.appliedChar = fresh
            Appearance.Stash[char] = nil
            -- The new character is the game's: it becomes the undo base once it has loaded.
            local loaded = os.clock() + 6
            while not lp:HasAppearanceLoaded() and os.clock() < loaded and App.alive() do task.wait(0.15) end
            fresh:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
            App.captureInitial(fresh, true)
            App.Current = App.Initial
            App.CleanReset = false
            App.report("Your character respawned with the game's avatar. The copied one is in the timeline.", "success")
        else
--YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
            App.CleanReset = false
            App.report("This game did not respawn your character. Use Restore instead.", "warning")
        end
        App.Refresh()
    end)
end

    [78] = {Name = "MoodAnimation", Field = "MoodAnimation", Label = "Mood", Rank = 40},

    [88] = {Name = "FaceMakeup", Makeup = "Face", Label = "Face makeup", Rank = 2},
    [89] = {Name = "LipMakeup", Makeup = "Lip", Label = "Lip makeup", Rank = 2},
    [90] = {Name = "EyeMakeup", Makeup = "Eye", Label = "Eye makeup", Rank = 2},
    [61] = {Name = "EmoteAnimation", Emote = true, Label = "Emote", Rank = 45},
}
Catalog.ByName = {}
for _, row in pairs(Catalog.Types) do Catalog.ByName[row.Name:lower()] = row end
Catalog.ByName.hair = Catalog.Types[41]
Catalog.BundleKinds = {[1] = "BodyParts", [2] = "Animations", [3] = "Shoes", [4] = "DynamicHead", [5] = "DynamicHeadAvatar"}
Catalog.BundleLabels = {BodyParts = "Body", Animations = "Animation pack", Shoes = "Shoes", DynamicHead = "Head", DynamicHeadAvatar = "Avatar"}
-- Filters for the search. Asset and bundle types are never mixed in one request.
Catalog.Filters = {"All", "Limiteds", "Bodies", "Heads", "Hair", "Hats", "Accessories", "Clothing", "Faces", "Animations", "Emotes"}
Catalog.Categories = {
    All = {},
    -- Limited and collectible items only (Roblox's "Collectibles" sales type), from every category.

    Bodies = {Bundles = {"BodyParts"}},

    Faces = {Assets = {"Face", "EyebrowAccessory", "EyelashAccessory", "FaceMakeup", "LipMakeup", "EyeMakeup"}},
    Animations = {Bundles = {"Animations"}},
    Emotes = {Assets = {"EmoteAnimation"}},
}
-- Second level for the two broad groups, so a player can go straight to classic shirts, pants or T-shirts, or to
-- one kind of accessory.
Catalog.Subs = {
    Clothing = {"All", "Shirts", "Pants", "T-Shirts", "Layered"},
    Accessories = {"All", "Face", "Neck", "Shoulder", "Front", "Back", "Waist"},
}
Catalog.SubLabels = {Shirts = "Classic shirts", Pants = "Classic pants", ["T-Shirts"] = "Classic T-shirts", Layered = "Layered clothing"}
Catalog.SubCategories = {
    ["Clothing/Shirts"] = {Assets = {"Shirt"}}, ["Clothing/Pants"] = {Assets = {"Pants"}}, ["Clothing/T-Shirts"] = {Assets = {"TShirt"}},
    ["Clothing/Layered"] = {Assets = {"TShirtAccessory", "ShirtAccessory", "PantsAccessory", "JacketAccessory", "SweaterAccessory",

    ["Accessories/Face"] = {Assets = {"FaceAccessory"}}, ["Accessories/Neck"] = {Assets = {"NeckAccessory"}},

    ["Accessories/Back"] = {Assets = {"BackAccessory"}}, ["Accessories/Waist"] = {Assets = {"WaistAccessory"}},
}
function Catalog.filterFor(query)
    local sub = query.Sub and query.Sub ~= "All" and Catalog.SubCategories[tostring(query.Category) .. "/" .. query.Sub]
    return sub or Catalog.Categories[query.Category] or Catalog.Categories.All
end
-- Roblox's own sort and price filters. Popular (most favorited of all time) is the default, so a
-- search such as "korblox" or "headless" leads with the original, most wanted item.
Catalog.Sorts = {
    {Value = "Popular", Label = "Most popular", Enum = {"MostFavorited"}, Web = 1, AllTime = true},
    {Value = "BestSelling", Label = "Best selling", Enum = {"Bestselling", "BestSelling"}, Web = 2, AllTime = true},
    {Value = "Relevance", Label = "Best match", Enum = {"Relevance"}, Web = 0},
    {Value = "Newest", Label = "Newest", Enum = {"RecentlyCreated", "RecentlyUpdated"}, Web = 3},
    {Value = "PriceLow", Label = "Price: low to high", Enum = {"PriceLowToHigh"}, Web = 4},
    {Value = "PriceHigh", Label = "Price: high to low", Enum = {"PriceHighToLow"}, Web = 5},
}
Catalog.Prices = {
    {Value = "Any", Label = "Any price"},
    {Value = "ForSale", Label = "For sale only", ForSale = true},
    {Value = "Free", Label = "Free", Min = 0, Max = 0, ForSale = true},
    {Value = "Low", Label = "Up to R$ 100", Min = 1, Max = 100, ForSale = true},
    {Value = "Mid", Label = "R$ 100 to 1,000", Min = 100, Max = 1000, ForSale = true},
    {Value = "High", Label = "R$ 1,000 and up", Min = 1000, ForSale = true},
}
function Catalog.option(list, value)
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do if row.Value == value then return row end end
    return list[1]
end
-- Accepts a type id, an Enum item or a type name (as the search and GetProductInfo return them).
function Catalog.kind(value)
    if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then value = value.Name end
    if type(value) == "string" and tonumber(value) then value = tonumber(value) end
    if type(value) == "number" then return Catalog.Types[value] end
    if type(value) == "string" then return Catalog.ByName[(value:lower():gsub("[%s_]", ""))] end
end
function Catalog.bundleKind(value)
    if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then return value.Name end
    if type(value) == "string" and tonumber(value) then value = tonumber(value) end
    if type(value) == "number" then return Catalog.BundleKinds[value] end
    if type(value) == "string" then return value end
end
-- Yields. Product info is cached per session.
function Catalog.info(id)
    local cached = Catalog.Info[id]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached or nil end
    local ok, info = pcall(function() return MPS:GetProductInfo(id, Enum.InfoType.Asset) end)
    Catalog.Info[id] = ok and type(info) == "table" and info or false
    return Catalog.Info[id] or nil
end
function Catalog.normalize(raw)
    if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local id = Codec.id(raw.Id or raw.id)
    if not id then return nil end
    local item = {Id = id, Name = tostring(raw.Name or raw.name or ("Item " .. id)), Creator = raw.CreatorName or raw.creatorName,
        Price = tonumber(raw.Price or raw.price or raw.LowestPrice or raw.lowestPrice)}
    local status = tostring(raw.PriceStatus or raw.priceStatus or ""):lower()
    item.OffSale = raw.IsOffSale == true or raw.isOffSale == true or status:find("off") ~= nil
    -- Limited, Limited U and collectible items. Unknown (nil) when the answer has no restrictions list.
    local restrictions = raw.ItemRestrictions or raw.itemRestrictions
    if type(restrictions) == "table" then
        item.Limited = false
        for _, value in ipairs(restrictions) do
            local name = tostring(value):lower()
            if name:find("limited") or name:find("collectible") then item.Limited = true; break end
        end
    end
    if tostring(raw.ItemType or raw.itemType or "Asset"):lower():find("bundle") then
        item.Bundle = true; item.BundleKind = Catalog.bundleKind(raw.BundleType or raw.bundleType)
    else
        -- A known type that has no place on an avatar (gear, emotes…) is shown but cannot be added.
        local assetType = raw.AssetType or raw.assetType
        item.Kind = Catalog.kind(assetType)
        item.Unwearable = assetType ~= nil and item.Kind == nil
    end
    return item
end
function Catalog.accepts(item, filter)
    if not filter.Assets and not filter.Bundles then return true end
    if item.Bundle then return filter.Bundles ~= nil and table.find(filter.Bundles, item.BundleKind) ~= nil end
    return filter.Assets ~= nil and item.Kind ~= nil and table.find(filter.Assets, item.Kind.Name) ~= nil
end
-- The search already filters by price; this guards the web fallback and items without a price.
function Catalog.priced(item, price)
    if item.Bundle and not price.Min and not price.Max then return not (price.ForSale and item.OffSale) end
    if price.ForSale and item.OffSale then return false end
    if price.Min or price.Max then
        if not item.Price then return false end
        if price.Min and item.Price < price.Min then return false end
        if price.Max and item.Price > price.Max then return false end
    end
    return true
end
function Catalog.read(list, query)
    local items = {}
    local price, filter = Catalog.option(Catalog.Prices, query.Price), Catalog.filterFor(query)
    for _, raw in ipairs(type(list) == "table" and list or {}) do
        local item = Catalog.normalize(raw)
        if item and Catalog.accepts(item, filter) and Catalog.priced(item, price) and not (filter.Limited and item.Limited == false) then table.insert(items, item) end
    end
    return items
end
function Catalog.params(query)
    local params = CatalogSearchParams.new()
    params.SearchKeyword = query.Keyword
    local filter = Catalog.filterFor(query)
    local function enums(enum, names)
        local list = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do local ok, item = pcall(function() return enum[name] end); if ok and item then table.insert(list, item) end end
        return list
    end
    if filter.Assets then params.AssetTypes = enums(Enum.AvatarAssetType, filter.Assets) end
    if filter.Bundles then params.BundleTypes = enums(Enum.BundleType, filter.Bundles) end
    if filter.Limited then pcall(function() params.SalesTypeFilter = Enum.SalesTypeFilter.Collectibles end) end
    local sort, price = Catalog.option(Catalog.Sorts, query.Sort), Catalog.option(Catalog.Prices, query.Price)
    for _, name in ipairs(sort.Enum) do
        local ok, item = pcall(function() return Enum.CatalogSortType[name] end)
        if ok and item then pcall(function() params.SortType = item end); break end
    end
    if sort.AllTime then pcall(function() params.SortAggregation = Enum.CatalogSortAggregation.AllTime end) end
    -- Off-sale items still load on a local avatar, so they are included unless a price filter is set.
    pcall(function() params.IncludeOffSale = not price.ForSale end)
    if price.Min then pcall(function() params.MinPrice = price.Min end) end
    if price.Max then pcall(function() params.MaxPrice = price.Max end) end
    return params
end
-- Executor HTTP fallback for games where the in-game catalog search is unavailable.
function Catalog.web(query)
    local sort, price = Catalog.option(Catalog.Sorts, query.Sort), Catalog.option(Catalog.Prices, query.Price)
    local url = "https://catalog.roblox.com/v1/search/items/details?Limit=30&SortType=" .. sort.Web .. (sort.AllTime and "&SortAggregation=5" or "")
        .. "&IncludeNotForSale=" .. (price.ForSale and "false" or "true") .. "&Keyword=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(query.Keyword)
    if price.Min then url = url .. "&MinPrice=" .. price.Min end
    if price.Max then url = url .. "&MaxPrice=" .. price.Max end
    if Catalog.filterFor(query).Limited then url = url .. "&SalesTypeFilter=2" end
    if query.Cursor then url = url .. "&Cursor=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(query.Cursor) end
    local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
    assert(ok and type(body) == "string", "The catalog is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.")
    local decoded, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
    assert(decoded and type(data) == "table" and type(data.data) == "table", "The catalog returned an unexpected answer.")
    query.Cursor = type(data.nextPageCursor) == "string" and data.nextPageCursor ~= "" and data.nextPageCursor or nil
    query.Finished = query.Cursor == nil
    return Catalog.read(data.data, query)
end
-- An item ID, or a catalog / bundle link, typed in the search box: (id, "Asset" | "Bundle" | nil when unknown).
function Catalog.idFrom(keyword)
    local text, kind = tostring(keyword):lower(), nil
    local id = text:match("/catalog/(%d+)")
    if id then kind = "Asset" else
        id = text:match("/bundles/(%d+)")
        if id then kind = "Bundle" else id = text:match("^#?(%d+)$") end
    end
    id = Codec.id(id)
    if not id then return nil end
    return id, kind
end
-- Yields. The exact item with that ID. A bare number is tried as an item first and as a bundle when it is not a
-- wearable item (item and bundle IDs overlap).
function Catalog.byId(id, kind)
    local asset
    if kind ~= "Bundle" then
        local info = Catalog.info(id)
        if info and info.AssetTypeId then
            asset = Catalog.normalize({Id = id, Name = info.Name, AssetType = info.AssetTypeId, Price = info.IsForSale and info.PriceInRobux or nil,
                IsOffSale = info.IsForSale == false, CreatorName = type(info.Creator) == "table" and info.Creator.Name or nil,
                ItemRestrictions = (info.IsLimited or info.IsLimitedUnique or info.CollectibleItemId) and {"Limited"} or {}})
            if asset and not asset.Unwearable then return asset end
        end
    end
    if kind ~= "Asset" then
        local ok, details = pcall(function() return Catalog.Assets:GetBundleDetailsAsync(id) end)
        if ok and type(details) == "table" and details.Name then
            return Catalog.normalize({Id = id, Name = details.Name, ItemType = "Bundle", BundleType = details.BundleType})
        end
    end
    return asset
end
-- Yields. query = {Keyword, Category, Sort, Price}; it keeps the paging state, so "more" continues the same search.
function Catalog.search(query, more)
    if not more then
        local id, kind = Catalog.idFrom(query.Keyword)
        if id then
            query.Finished = true
            local item = Catalog.byId(id, kind)
            assert(item, "No catalog item or bundle was found with the ID " .. tostring(id) .. ".")
            return {item}
        end
    end
    if more then
        assert(not query.Finished, "There are no more results.")
        if query.Pages then
            query.Pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync(); query.Finished = query.Pages.IsFinished
            return Catalog.read(query.Pages:GetCurrentPage(), query)
        end
        return Catalog.web(query)
    end
    local ok, pages = pcall(function() return Catalog.AvatarEditor:SearchCatalog(Catalog.params(query)) end)
    if ok and pages then
        query.Pages = pages; query.Finished = pages.IsFinished
        return Catalog.read(pages:GetCurrentPage(), query)
    end
    warn("[Lyra Catalog] In-game search unavailable, using the web catalog: " .. tostring(pages))
    return Catalog.web(query)
end
-- Yields. A bundle's assets with their types, body parts first (head, torso, arms, legs).
function Catalog.bundle(id)
    if Catalog.Bundles[id] then return Catalog.Bundles[id] end
    local ok, details = pcall(function() return Catalog.Assets:GetBundleDetailsAsync(id) end)
    assert(ok and type(details) == "table" and type(details.Items) == "table", "This bundle could not be loaded. Try again.")
    local parts, pending = {}, 0
    for _, entry in ipairs(details.Items) do
        local assetId = Codec.id(entry.Id)
        if assetId and tostring(entry.Type) == "Asset" then
            local part = {Id = assetId, Name = tostring(entry.Name or ("Item " .. assetId))}
            table.insert(parts, part); pending = pending + 1
            task.spawn(function()
                local info = Catalog.info(assetId)
                part.Kind = info and Catalog.kind(info.AssetTypeId)
                pending = pending - 1
            end)
        end
    end
    local deadline = os.clock() + 15
    while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline and App.alive() do task.wait(0.05) end
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if not part.Kind then
            -- Names such as "Robloxian 2.0 - Left Arm" still identify a limb when product info fails.
            local name = part.Name:lower()
            for typeId, pattern in pairs({[29] = "left arm", [28] = "right arm", [30] = "left leg", [31] = "right leg", [27] = "torso", [17] = "head"}) do
                if name:find(pattern, 1, true) then part.Kind = Catalog.Types[typeId]; break end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(parts, function(a, b)
        local ra, rb = a.Kind and a.Kind.Rank or 99, b.Kind and b.Kind.Rank or 99
        if ra ~= rb then return ra < rb end
        return a.Id < b.Id
    end)
    local bundle = {Id = id, Name = tostring(details.Name or ("Bundle " .. id)), Parts = parts}
    Catalog.Bundles[id] = bundle
    return bundle
end
-- The snapshot being worn: the last applied one, or the appearance the script started with.
function Catalog.base()
    if not App.Current and not App.Initial then App.captureInitial(lp.Character) end
    return App.Current or App.Initial
end
-- The same, for an edit: while your own look is on and the copier has not changed your character, your look is taken
-- again first (a catalog game may have changed it since), so the edit starts from what you really wear.
function Catalog.freshBase()
    local char = lp.Character
    if (not App.Current or App.Current.Original) and not Overlay.visualOnly() and char and S.TouchedChar ~= char and App.charReady(char) then
        App.captureInitial(char, true)
    end
    return Catalog.base()
end
-- Asset id -> {Field = description field} or {Accessory = type name} for everything in the worn snapshot.
function Catalog.worn()
    local snapshot = Catalog.base()
    if Catalog.WornFor == snapshot and Catalog.WornSetKey == Store.Settings.EmoteSet and Catalog.WornSet then return Catalog.WornSet end
    local set = {}
    local data = snapshot and snapshot.Data
    if type(data) == "table" then
        local props = data.Version == 2 and data.Properties or data
        if type(props) == "table" then
            for _, field in ipairs(Codec.assetFields) do local id = Codec.id(props[field]); if id then set[id] = {Field = field} end end
        end
        if data.HasAccessories and type(data.Accessories) == "table" then
            for _, row in ipairs(data.Accessories) do
                local id = type(row) == "table" and Codec.id(row.AssetId)
                if id then set[id] = {Accessory = tostring(row.AccessoryType or "Accessory")} end
            end
        elseif type(props) == "table" then
            for _, field in ipairs(Codec.accessoryFields) do
                if type(props[field]) == "string" then
                    for value in props[field]:gmatch("%d+") do local id = Codec.id(tonumber(value)); if id then set[id] = {Accessory = (field:gsub("Accessory$", ""))} end end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if type(data) == "table" and type(data.Makeup) == "table" then
        for _, row in ipairs(data.Makeup) do
            local id = type(row) == "table" and Codec.id(row.AssetId)
            if id then set[id] = {Makeup = tostring(row.MakeupType or "Face")} end
        end
    end
    -- Emotes count when they are on the wheel (the emote set in use when there is one); the rest of an avatar's
    -- emote list is not worn.
    local emoteSet = EmoteSets.active()
    local emotes, equipped
    if emoteSet then emotes, equipped = emoteSet.Emotes, emoteSet.Equipped
    elseif type(data) == "table" and type(data.Emotes) == "table" then emotes, equipped = Codec.emoteSet(data.Emotes, data.EquippedEmotes) end
    if emotes then
        local onWheel = #equipped > 0 and {} or nil
        for _, row in ipairs(equipped) do onWheel[row.Name] = true end
        for name, ids in pairs(emotes) do
            if not onWheel or onWheel[name] then
                for _, value in ipairs(type(ids) == "table" and ids or {}) do local id = Codec.id(value); if id then set[id] = {Emote = true} end end
            end
        end
    end
    Catalog.WornFor = snapshot; Catalog.WornSet = set; Catalog.WornSetKey = Store.Settings.EmoteSet
    return set
end
function Catalog.slotLabel(slot)
    if slot.Emote then return "Emote", 45 end
    for _, row in pairs(Catalog.Types) do
        if (slot.Field and row.Field == slot.Field) or (slot.Accessory and row.Accessory == slot.Accessory) or (slot.Makeup and row.Makeup == slot.Makeup) then return row.Label, row.Rank end
    end
    return tostring(slot.Accessory or slot.Field or slot.Makeup or "Item"), 99
end
-- ITEM IDS: every item of the appearance being worn as "Label: id" lines, accessories first (hat, hair, face,
-- neck, shoulder, front, back, waist), then clothing (classic shirt, pants, T-shirt, then layered), then the rest.
Catalog.CopyAccessories = {Hat = 1, Hair = 2, Face = 3, Neck = 4, Shoulder = 5, Front = 6, Back = 7, Waist = 8,
    TShirt = 13, Shirt = 14, Pants = 15, Jacket = 16, Sweater = 17, Shorts = 18, DressSkirt = 19, LeftShoe = 20, RightShoe = 21}
Catalog.CopyFields = {Shirt = 10, Pants = 11, GraphicTShirt = 12}
function Catalog.copyRank(slot)
    local rank = slot.Accessory and Catalog.CopyAccessories[slot.Accessory] or slot.Field and Catalog.CopyFields[slot.Field]
    if rank then return rank end
    local _, shopRank = Catalog.slotLabel(slot)
    return 100 + shopRank
end
function Catalog.idList()
    local rows = {}
    for id, slot in pairs(Catalog.worn()) do
        table.insert(rows, {Id = id, Label = (Catalog.slotLabel(slot)), Rank = Catalog.copyRank(slot)})
    end
    table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.Rank ~= b.Rank then return a.Rank < b.Rank end return a.Id < b.Id end)
    local lines = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do table.insert(lines, row.Label .. ": " .. tostring(row.Id)) end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n"), #rows
end
-- SHOP FAVORITES
function Catalog.favoriteIndex(item)
    for index, row in ipairs(Store.ShopFavorites) do
        if row.Id == item.Id and row.Bundle == (item.Bundle == true) then return index end
    end
end
function Catalog.toggleFavorite(item)
    local index = Catalog.favoriteIndex(item)
    if index then table.remove(Store.ShopFavorites, index); App.persist(); return false end
    if #Store.ShopFavorites >= 300 then App.report("The 300 shop favorites limit has been reached.", "warning"); return false end
    local info = not item.Bundle and Catalog.Info[item.Id]
    table.insert(Store.ShopFavorites, 1, {Id = item.Id, Name = tostring(item.Name or (info and info.Name) or ("Item " .. tostring(item.Id))):sub(1, 80),
        Bundle = item.Bundle == true, BundleKind = item.BundleKind, Kind = item.Kind and item.Kind.Name or nil})
    App.persist(); return true
end
-- A saved favorite as a shop item (its type comes back from the saved name; prices are not stored).
function Catalog.fromFavorite(row)
    if row.Bundle then return {Id = row.Id, Name = row.Name, Bundle = true, BundleKind = row.BundleKind} end
    return {Id = row.Id, Name = row.Name, Kind = row.Kind and Catalog.kind(row.Kind) or nil}
end
-- Taking accessories off the avatar being worn: the model already built for it, without those accessories, is the
-- new avatar's model, so nothing is rebuilt (rebuilding the whole avatar took seconds for one item). Only for an
-- avatar drawn from its items (a saved skin's snapshot is rebuilt from its items on any shop change) and only when
-- every accessory is found in that model. Returns whether it did.
function Catalog.reuseModel(base, snapshot, ids)
    local cache = App.ModelCache
    if not cache or cache.Snapshot ~= base or base ~= App.Current or base.Original or type(base.Data) ~= "table" or type(base.Data.Visual) == "table" then return false end
    local found = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(cache.Model:GetChildren()) do
        local id = item:IsA("Accessory") and item:GetAttribute("Lyra_AssetId")
