    local accessory = joint:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory")
    if accessory and accessory:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") then return false end
    if joint:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then return true end
    local a, b
    if joint:IsA("Constraint") then
        a = joint.Attachment0 and joint.Attachment0.Parent; b = joint.Attachment1 and joint.Attachment1.Parent
    else a, b = joint.Part0, joint.Part1 end
    local bodyA, bodyB = a and Appearance.isBody(a, char), b and Appearance.isBody(b, char)
    return (bodyA and not bodyB) or (bodyB and not bodyA) or false
end
function App.logState(char)
    local current = App.Current
    return string.format("copier: wearing=%s busy=%s applied=%s changed=%s cloak=%s scale=%s factor=%.2f repair=%s visualOnly=%s r15Drawn=%s covered=%s",
        current and (current.Original and "own look" or ("\"" .. tostring(current.Name) .. "\"")) or "nothing", tostring(App.Busy), tostring(S.appliedChar == char),
        tostring(S.TouchedChar == char), tostring(Cloak.Character == char), tostring(Scale.Character == char), Scale.Factor or 1,
        tostring(Repair.Character == char), tostring(Overlay.visualOnly()), tostring(Overlay.Auto == true), tostring(Cover.Char == char))
end
function App.logPart(part)
    local ltm = 0
    pcall(function() ltm = part.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
    local text = string.format("%s size=%s T=%.3f LTM=%.3f %s %s", App.traceName(part), App.logValue(part.Size), part.Transparency, ltm,
        part.Material.Name, App.logValue(part.Color))
    local notes = {}
    if Appearance.TouchedParts[part] then table.insert(notes, "reshaped") end
    for _, key in ipairs({"Lyra_GameSize", "Lyra_SetSize", "Lyra_GameTransparency", "Lyra_BeforeOverlay"}) do
        local value = part:GetAttribute(key)
        if value ~= nil then table.insert(notes, key:sub(6) .. "=" .. App.logValue(value)) end
    end
    return #notes > 0 and (text .. " [" .. table.concat(notes, " ") .. "]") or text
end
function App.logCharacter(char, why)
    local scaleOk, scale = pcall(function() return char:GetScale() end)
    App.trace(string.format("== %s: %s in %s, model scale %s", why, App.traceName(char), char.Parent and char.Parent:GetFullName() or "nil", scaleOk and App.logValue(scale) or "?"))
    App.trace("   " .. App.logState(char))
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        local values = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(hum:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("NumberValue") then table.insert(values, item.Name .. "=" .. App.logValue(item.Value))
            elseif item:IsA("HumanoidDescription") then
                local ok, line = pcall(function()
                    return string.format("description %s height=%.2f width=%.2f depth=%.2f head=%.2f%s", App.traceName(item), item.HeightScale, item.WidthScale,
                        item.DepthScale, item.HeadScale, item:GetAttribute("Lyra_Description") and " (copier's)" or "")
                end)
                if ok then table.insert(values, line) end
            end
        end
        App.trace(string.format("   %s rig=%s health=%.0f hip=%.2f autoScale=%s %s", App.traceName(hum), hum.RigType.Name, hum.Health, hum.HipHeight,
            tostring(hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled), table.concat(values, " ")))
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") then App.trace("   part " .. App.logPart(child))
        elseif child:IsA("Accessory") then
            local handle = child:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            App.trace(string.format("   accessory %s%s handle T=%s on %s", App.traceName(child), child:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") and " (copied)" or "",
                handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and App.logValue(handle.Transparency) or "?", tostring(Cloak.mountOf(child, char) or "?")))
        else App.trace("   " .. App.traceName(child)) end
    end
    for _, joint in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if App.logCarries(joint, char) then App.trace("   joint " .. App.logJoint(joint, char)) end
    end
end
Fit.Trace = function(joint, body, field, before, after, note)
    if not App.tracing() then return end
    local item = field == "C0" and joint.Part1 or joint.Part0
    App.trace(string.format("Fit moved %s on %s: %s %s -> %s", item and App.traceName(item) or "?", body.Name, field, App.logValue(before), App.logValue(after))
        .. " (joint " .. App.traceName(joint) .. ")" .. (note and (": " .. note) or ""))
end
function App.startLog()
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then App.report("This executor can't write files.", "warning"); return end
    local log = App.Log
    log.Until = os.clock() + 180
    if log.Running then App.report("Character log: 3 more minutes.", "info"); return end
    log.Running = true; log.Start = os.clock(); table.clear(log.Lines); log.Dirty = true
    App.report("Character log on for 3 minutes: do what goes wrong (a potion, a cloak, a tool), then wait 5 seconds.", "info")
    local connections, followed, pending = {}, setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), {}
    local function on(signal, callback)
        local ok, connection = pcall(function() return signal:Connect(function(...) if App.tracing() then pcall(callback, ...) end end) end)
        if ok then table.insert(connections, connection) end
    end
    -- One line per change at most every gap seconds, with the newest value.
    local function later(key, gap, callback)
        if pending[key] then return end
        pending[key] = true
        task.delay(gap, function() pending[key] = nil; if App.tracing() then pcall(callback) end end)
    end
    local function watchPart(part, char, carried)
        local name = App.traceName(part)
        for _, property in ipairs(carried and {"Transparency", "Size"} or {"Size", "Transparency", "LocalTransparencyModifier", "Material", "Color"}) do
            on(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
                later(name .. property, property == "LocalTransparencyModifier" and 0.4 or 0.15, function()
                    App.trace(string.format("%s %s = %s%s", name, property, App.logValue(part[property]), part.Parent == char and "" or " (not in the character)"))
                end)
            end)
        end
    end
    local function watchItem(item, char)
        if item:IsA("BasePart") and Appearance.isBody(item, char) then watchPart(item, char, false)
        elseif item:IsA("Accessory") or item:IsA("Tool") then
            for _, part in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then watchPart(part, char, true) end end
        end
    end
    local function follow(char)
        if not char or followed[char] then return end
        followed[char] = true
        App.logCharacter(char, "Character")
        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do watchItem(child, char) end
        on(char.AncestryChanged, function() App.trace(App.traceName(char) .. " moved to " .. (char.Parent and char.Parent:GetFullName() or "nil")) end)
        on(char.ChildAdded, function(child)
            App.trace("Added to " .. App.traceName(char) .. ": " .. (child:IsA("BasePart") and App.logPart(child) or App.traceName(child))
                .. (child:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") and " (copier's)" or ""))
            watchItem(child, char)
            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                task.delay(0.6, function()
                    if not App.tracing() or child.Parent ~= char then return end
                    for _, part in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then App.trace("   tool part " .. App.logPath(part, char) .. " " .. App.logPart(part)) end end
                    for _, joint in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do if App.logCarries(joint, char) then App.trace("   joint " .. App.logJoint(joint, char)) end end
--- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
                end)
            end
        end)
        on(char.ChildRemoved, function(child) App.trace("Removed from " .. App.traceName(char) .. ": " .. App.traceName(child)) end)
        on(char.DescendantAdded, function(item)
            if item:IsA("JointInstance") or item:IsA("WeldConstraint") or item:IsA("Constraint") then
                task.delay(0.2, function() if App.tracing() and item:IsDescendantOf(char) and App.logCarries(item, char) then App.trace("New joint " .. App.logJoint(item, char)) end end)
            elseif item:IsA("Highlight") or item:IsA("ForceField") or item:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or item:IsA("HumanoidDescription") then
                App.trace("New " .. App.traceName(item) .. " in " .. App.logPath(item.Parent, char))
            end
        end)
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            on(hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("HipHeight"), function() later(App.traceName(hum) .. "hip", 0.15, function() App.trace("HipHeight = " .. App.logValue(hum.HipHeight)) end) end)
            for _, item in ipairs(hum:GetChildren()) do
                if item:IsA("NumberValue") then on(item.Changed, function() App.trace(item.Name .. " = " .. App.logValue(item.Value)) end) end
            end
        end
    end
    on(lp:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Character"), function()
        App.trace("Player.Character = " .. (lp.Character and App.traceName(lp.Character) or "nil"))
        if lp.Character then task.delay(0.3, function() if App.tracing() then follow(lp.Character) end end) end
    end)
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if camera then
        on(camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraSubject"), function()
            local subject = camera.CameraSubject
            App.trace("Camera follows " .. (subject and (App.traceName(subject) .. " of " .. (subject.Parent and App.traceName(subject.Parent) or "nil")) or "nothing"))
        end)
    end
    App.trace(string.format("Settings: AutoReapply=%s HideOriginal=%s GameChange=%s VisualOnly=%s MapPersist=%s",
        tostring(Config.AutoReapply), tostring(Store.Settings.HideOriginal), tostring(Store.Settings.GameChange), tostring(Store.Settings.VisualOnly), tostring(Config.MapPersist)))
    follow(lp.Character)
    -- Bodies the game builds besides the characters (a rhythm game's stage copies, a lobby display): where each one
    -- is, whose it was taken for and how visible its body is, when the log starts, as they appear and 3 s later. At
    -- most 40 of them, for games full of NPCs.
    local bodies = 0
    local function bodyLine(model)
        local parts, least = 0, 1
        for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and S.BD[part.Name] and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then parts = parts + 1; least = math.min(least, part.Transparency) end
        end
        local root, mine = Overlay.rootOf(model), lp.Character and Overlay.rootOf(lp.Character)
        local who, dressed = Mirror.Known[model], Mirror.Dressed[model]
        return string.format("%s in %s: %s, %d body parts, least transparency %.2f, %s studs from you, %s%s", App.traceName(model),
            model.Parent and model.Parent:GetFullName() or "nil", tostring(F.getTrueRigType(model)), parts, parts > 0 and least or 0,
            (root and mine) and string.format("%.0f", (root.Position - mine.Position).Magnitude) or "?",
            who == nil and "not taken for a player" or who == lp.UserId and "taken for you" or "taken for a script user",
            dressed and (dressed.Drawn and ", avatar drawn over it" or ", dressed") or "")
    end
    local function body(model, why)
        if bodies >= 40 or not model:IsA("Model") or followed[model] or model == lp.Character or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            or (Overlay.Folder and model:IsDescendantOf(Overlay.Folder)) then return end
        followed[model] = true; bodies = bodies + 1
        App.trace(why .. " " .. bodyLine(model))
        task.delay(3, function() if App.tracing() and model.Parent then App.trace("   3 s later: " .. bodyLine(model)) end end)
    end
    for model in pairs(Mirror.Seen) do if model.Parent then pcall(body, model, "Body already there:") end end
    on(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(item)
        if item:IsA("Humanoid") then task.delay(0.5, function() if App.tracing() and item.Parent then pcall(body, item.Parent, "New body:") end end) end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        local executor = "?"
        pcall(function() executor = tostring((identifyexecutor())) end)
        local header = string.format("Avatar Studio character log · dev %s · place %d · game %d · %s · %s\n",
            tostring(rawget(_G, "LyraDevBuild")), game.PlaceId, game.GameId, executor, os.date("!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
        local lastState = 0
        while App.alive() and App.tracing() do
            task.wait(2)
            -- The copier's state every 10 seconds, so a change without an event still shows.
            if os.clock() - lastState >= 10 and lp.Character then lastState = os.clock(); App.trace(App.logState(lp.Character)) end
            if log.Dirty then log.Dirty = false; pcall(writefile, "LyraLog_Character.txt", header .. table.concat(log.Lines, "\n")) end
        end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        pcall(writefile, "LyraLog_Character.txt", header .. table.concat(log.Lines, "\n"))
        log.Running = false
        if App.alive() then App.report("Character log written: LyraLog_Character.txt (" .. #log.Lines .. " lines).", "success") end
    end)
end
_G.Copier_ToolsGiverToggle = function()
    _G.ToolsGiverActive = not _G.ToolsGiverActive
    if _G.ToolsGiverActive then F.startToolsGiverLoop() end
    App.report(_G.ToolsGiverActive and "ToolsGiver enabled." or "ToolsGiver disabled.", "info")
end


-- =============================================================================
-- LYRA TOAST · in-GUI notifications (does not use Roblox's SendNotification)
-- =============================================================================
-- Self-contained: it only needs TweenService, TextService and the Instances it creates,
-- so the whole block (from here to "END LYRA TOAST") can be copied into another script.
--
-- CREATE ONE NOTIFIER PER GUI
--   local notifier = Toast.new({
--       Parent = someFrameOrScreenGui,  -- required; toasts stack in its bottom-right corner
--       Theme = {                       -- optional; every key has a default (see Toast.DefaultTheme)
--           Background = Color3, Text = Color3, Muted = Color3, Line = Color3,
--           Kinds = {info = Color3, success = Color3, warning = Color3, error = Color3},
--       },
--       Icon = function(parent, name, position, color) end, -- optional; draws a 24x24 icon by name for
--                                       -- spec.Icon. If it errors, the kind's built-in glyph is used.
--       Font = {Regular = Enum.Font.X, Bold = Enum.Font.Y},  -- optional
--       Width = 264,                    -- optional; shrinks automatically on small screens
--       Max = 4,                        -- optional; the oldest toast leaves when a new one exceeds it
--       Margin = 12,                    -- optional; distance from the parent's bottom-right corner
--       Lift = 0,                       -- optional; extra bottom space (e.g. above a mobile jump button)
--       ReducedMotion = function() return false end,        -- optional; true = no slide/fade
--   })
--
-- SHOW A TOAST
--   local handle = notifier:Notify({
--       Title = "Saved",                -- required
--       Text = "Your skin was saved.",  -- optional second line (wraps)
--       Kind = "success",               -- "info" (default), "success", "warning" or "error": sets colour and glyph
--       Icon = "circle-check",          -- optional; drawn with the Icon option instead of the kind's glyph
--       Duration = 4,                   -- optional seconds (default 4); 0 keeps it until tapped
--       Image = "rbxasset…",            -- optional picture in the badge instead of an icon
--       Action = {Text = "Open", Callback = function() end}, -- optional button under the text
--       Featured = true,                -- optional; wider card, larger badge, stronger accent
--       Dismissible = false,            -- optional; a tap on the card does not close it (timer or action only)
--   })
--   handle:Dismiss()                    -- close it early
--
-- OTHER CALLS
--   notifier:Clear()                    -- close every toast
--   notifier:Destroy()                  -- remove the notifier and its container
--
-- Layout: heights are measured from the text with TextService (no AutomaticSize), so a toast is
-- always exactly as tall as its content.
-- Behaviour: a toast slides in from the right and fades, a hairline under it shows the time left,
-- and a tap closes it. Newest toasts sit closest to the corner.
local Toast = {}
Toast.__index = Toast
Toast.Tweens = game:GetService("TweenService")
Toast.Text = game:GetService("TextService")
Toast.DefaultTheme = {
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(24, 22, 36), Text = Color3.fromRGB(244, 239, 255),
    Muted = Color3.fromRGB(201, 193, 223), Line = Color3.fromRGB(78, 69, 101),
    Kinds = {info = Color3.fromRGB(188, 167, 246), success = Color3.fromRGB(137, 221, 187),
        warning = Color3.fromRGB(239, 205, 143), error = Color3.fromRGB(244, 151, 171)},
}
-- Built-in glyph for each kind, drawn in vectors so it stays sharp without the icon sheet.
Toast.KindGlyphs = {info = "info", success = "check", warning = "alert", error = "cross"}
Toast.Badge = 24

function Toast.new(options)
    assert(type(options) == "table" and options.Parent, "Toast.new needs {Parent = Instance}")
    local self = setmetatable({}, Toast)
    self.Options = options
    -- Copies, so the caller's tables and the defaults are never modified.
    local theme, kinds = {}, {}
    for key, value in pairs(Toast.DefaultTheme) do theme[key] = value end
    for key, value in pairs(options.Theme or {}) do theme[key] = value end
    for key, value in pairs(Toast.DefaultTheme.Kinds) do kinds[key] = value end
    for key, value in pairs(type(options.Theme) == "table" and type(options.Theme.Kinds) == "table" and options.Theme.Kinds or {}) do kinds[key] = value end
    self.Theme, self.Kinds = theme, kinds
    self.Font = options.Font or {Regular = Enum.Font.Gotham, Bold = Enum.Font.GothamBold}
    self.Width, self.Max, self.Margin, self.Lift = options.Width or 264, options.Max or 4, options.Margin or 12, options.Lift or 0
    self.Active = {}
    self.Container = Instance.new("Frame")
    self.Container.Name = "LyraToasts"; self.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1; self.Container.ZIndex = 200
    self.Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
    self.Container.Position = UDim2.new(1, -self.Margin, 1, -(self.Margin + self.Lift))
    self.Container.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Width, 1, -(self.Margin * 2 + self.Lift))
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
    layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
    layout.Parent = self.Container
    self.Container.Parent = options.Parent
    self.Order = 0
    return self
end

function Toast:_reduced()
    local check = self.Options.ReducedMotion
    return type(check) == "function" and check() == true
end
function Toast:_tween(item, goal, duration)
    if self:_reduced() then for key, value in pairs(goal) do item[key] = value end; return nil end
    local tween = Toast.Tweens:Create(item, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal)
    tween:Play(); return tween
end
local function toastNew(class, props, parent)
    local item = Instance.new(class)
    for key, value in pairs(props) do item[key] = value end
    item.Parent = parent
    return item
end
-- Glyphs are laid out on the badge's 24x24 grid with rounded 2 px strokes.
function Toast.glyph(parent, name, color)
    local function stroke(x1, y1, x2, y2)
        local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
        local item = toastNew("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 2, 2), Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)),
            BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 203}, parent)
        toastNew("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, item)
    end
    local function dot(x, y)
        local item = toastNew("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2.6, 2.6),
            BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 203}, parent)
        toastNew("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, item)
    end
    if name == "check" then stroke(7.5, 12.5, 10.5, 15.5); stroke(10.5, 15.5, 16.5, 9)
    elseif name == "cross" then stroke(8.5, 8.5, 15.5, 15.5); stroke(15.5, 8.5, 8.5, 15.5)
    elseif name == "alert" then stroke(12, 7.5, 12, 12.5); dot(12, 16.2)
    else dot(12, 7.8); stroke(12, 11, 12, 16.5) end
end

function Toast:Notify(spec)
    assert(type(spec) == "table" and spec.Title, "Notify needs {Title = string}")
    local kind = self.Kinds[spec.Kind or "info"] and (spec.Kind or "info") or "info"
    local color, theme = self.Kinds[kind], self.Theme
    local duration = spec.Duration == nil and 4 or spec.Duration
    -- Fit narrow screens: never wider than the parent minus the margins.
    -- A featured toast is wider, with a larger picture badge and a stronger accent.
    local featured = spec.Featured == true
    local parentWidth = self.Options.Parent.AbsoluteSize.X
    local wanted = featured and self.Width + 56 or self.Width
    local width = parentWidth > 0 and math.min(wanted, parentWidth - self.Margin * 2) or wanted
    self.Container.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.min(self.Width, width), 1, -(self.Margin * 2 + self.Lift))
    self.Order = self.Order + 1

    -- Fixed layout: every height is measured from the text, so nothing relies on AutomaticSize
    -- (which can feed back on itself and stretch the card). Left: 10 pad + badge + 10 gap.
    local title, text = tostring(spec.Title), spec.Text and tostring(spec.Text) or ""
    local badgeSize = featured and 40 or Toast.Badge
    local textLeft, textRight = 20 + badgeSize, 14
    local textWidth = math.max(60, width - textLeft - textRight)
    local function measure(value, size, font)
        if value == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, bounds = pcall(function() return Toast.Text:GetTextSize(value, size, font, Vector2.new(textWidth, 10000)) end)
        return ok and math.ceil(bounds.Y) or size + 4
    end
    local titleHeight = measure(title, 13, self.Font.Bold)
    local textHeight = measure(text, 12, self.Font.Regular)
    -- Optional action button under the text: {Text = "Open", Callback = function() end}.
    local action = type(spec.Action) == "table" and spec.Action or nil
    local actionHeight = action and 38 or 0
    local contentHeight = math.max(badgeSize, titleHeight + (textHeight > 0 and textHeight + 1 or 0) + actionHeight)
    local height = 10 + contentHeight + 11

    -- holder keeps the list slot; card slides inside it.
    local holder = toastNew("Frame", {Name = "Toast", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height), LayoutOrder = self.Order, ZIndex = 200}, self.Container)
    local card = toastNew("CanvasGroup", {BackgroundColor3 = theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.06, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 0), GroupTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 200}, holder)
    toastNew("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)}, card)
    toastNew("UIStroke", {Color = featured and color or theme.Line, Transparency = featured and 0.25 or 0.4, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, card)
    -- Soft wash of the kind's colour from the left edge, fading out across the card.
    local wash = toastNew("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 200}, card)
    toastNew("UIGradient", {Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, featured and 0.7 or 0.84), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, featured and 0.92 or 0.97), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})}, wash)
    -- Badge with the glyph, the caller's icon or picture, in the kind's colour.
    local badgeTop = 10 + math.floor((contentHeight - badgeSize) / 2)
    if featured then badgeTop = 10 end
    local badge = toastNew("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, badgeTop), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(badgeSize, badgeSize), BackgroundColor3 = color,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 201}, card)
    toastNew("UICorner", {CornerRadius = featured and UDim.new(0, 12) or UDim.new(1, 0)}, badge)
    toastNew("UIStroke", {Color = color, Transparency = 0.55, Thickness = 1}, badge)
    local drew = false
    if type(spec.Image) == "string" and spec.Image ~= "" then
        local picture = toastNew("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = spec.Image, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 202}, badge)
        toastNew("UICorner", {CornerRadius = featured and UDim.new(0, 12) or UDim.new(1, 0)}, picture)
        drew = true
-- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    end
    if not drew and spec.Icon and type(self.Options.Icon) == "function" then
        local holderIcon = toastNew("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 202}, badge)
        toastNew("UIScale", {Scale = featured and 1 or 0.62}, holderIcon)
        drew = pcall(self.Options.Icon, holderIcon, spec.Icon, UDim2.new(), color)
        if not drew then holderIcon:Destroy() end
    end
    if not drew then Toast.glyph(badge, Toast.KindGlyphs[kind], color) end
    -- Title and optional text, vertically centred next to the badge when short.
    local top = 10 + math.floor((contentHeight - titleHeight - (textHeight > 0 and textHeight + 1 or 0) - actionHeight) / 2)
    toastNew("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textLeft, top), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(textWidth, titleHeight), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = title,
        TextColor3 = theme.Text, Font = self.Font.Bold, TextSize = 13, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 201}, card)
    if textHeight > 0 then
        toastNew("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textLeft, top + titleHeight + 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(textWidth, textHeight), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text,
            TextColor3 = theme.Muted, Font = self.Font.Regular, TextSize = 12, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 201}, card)
    end
    -- Hairline along the bottom, shrinking over the toast's lifetime.
    local fill = toastNew("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -2), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
        BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 202, Visible = duration > 0}, card)
    -- Whole card is tappable to dismiss (unless Dismissible = false); the action button sits above that tap area.
    local hit = spec.Dismissible ~= false and toastNew("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 204}, card) or nil
    local actionButton
    if action then
        local label = tostring(action.Text or "Open")
        local ok, bounds = pcall(function() return Toast.Text:GetTextSize(label, 13, self.Font.Bold, Vector2.new(1000, 40)) end)
        local buttonWidth = math.clamp((ok and math.ceil(bounds.X) or 80) + 28, 90, textWidth)
        actionButton = toastNew("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textLeft, top + titleHeight + (textHeight > 0 and textHeight + 1 or 0) + 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(buttonWidth, 30),
            BackgroundColor3 = color, Text = label, TextColor3 = theme.Background, Font = self.Font.Bold, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 205}, card)
        toastNew("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)}, actionButton)
    end

    local handle = {Closed = false}
    local notifier = self
    function handle:Dismiss()
        if handle.Closed then return end
        handle.Closed = true
        for i, item in ipairs(notifier.Active) do if item == handle then table.remove(notifier.Active, i); break end end
        if notifier:_reduced() then holder:Destroy(); return end
        notifier:_tween(card, {GroupTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 0)}, 0.2)
        task.delay(0.22, function() if holder.Parent then holder:Destroy() end end)
    end
    if hit then hit.Activated:Connect(function() handle:Dismiss() end) end
    if actionButton then
        actionButton.Activated:Connect(function()
            handle:Dismiss()
            if type(action.Callback) == "function" then task.spawn(action.Callback) end
        end)
    end
    table.insert(self.Active, handle)
    while #self.Active > self.Max do self.Active[1]:Dismiss() end

    self:_tween(card, {GroupTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)}, 0.3)
    if duration > 0 then
        if not self:_reduced() then
            Toast.Tweens:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)}):Play()
        end
        task.delay(duration, function() handle:Dismiss() end)
    end
    return handle
end
function Toast:Clear()
    for i = #self.Active, 1, -1 do self.Active[i]:Dismiss() end
end
function Toast:Destroy()
    self.Active = {}
    if self.Container then self.Container:Destroy(); self.Container = nil end
end

-- END LYRA TOAST
-- =============================================================================

-- The seasonal themes are marked in the theme list: their emoji, a tag and the colour of the row.

function UI.palette(name)
    local theme = UI.Themes[name] or UI.Themes.Lavender
    local colors = {}
    for key, rgb in pairs(theme) do if key ~= "Sheen" then colors[key] = Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]) end end
    return colors, theme
end
UI.FontList = {
    {Name = "Builder Sans", Regular = "BuilderSansMedium", Bold = "BuilderSansBold"},
    {Name = "Gotham", Regular = "Gotham", Bold = "GothamBold"},
    {Name = "Nunito", Regular = "Nunito"},
    {Name = "Ubuntu", Regular = "Ubuntu"},
    {Name = "Fredoka One", Regular = "FredokaOne"},
    {Name = "Patrick Hand", Regular = "PatrickHand"},
}
-- The regular and bold faces of a font, or nil when this Roblox build does not have it.
function UI.fontFaces(name)
    for _, row in ipairs(UI.FontList) do
        if row.Name == name then
            local ok, regular, bold = pcall(function()
                local plain = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font[row.Regular])
                local strong = row.Bold and Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font[row.Bold]) or Font.new(plain.Family, Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
                return plain, strong
            end)
            if ok and regular and bold then return regular, bold end
            return nil
        end
    end
    return nil
end
-- Applies the saved look before the window is built: palette, font faces (none for the default font) and text scale.
function UI.loadStyle()
    local colors = UI.palette(Store.Settings.Theme)
    for key, color in pairs(colors) do UI.C[key] = color end
    UI.FaceRegular, UI.FaceBold = nil, nil
    if Store.Settings.Font ~= "Builder Sans" then UI.FaceRegular, UI.FaceBold = UI.fontFaces(Store.Settings.Font) end
    if (Store.Settings.TextSize or 0) <= 0 then Store.Settings.TextSize = 100 end
    UI.TextScale = Store.Settings.TextSize / 100
end
function UI.sheenColors()
    local theme = UI.Themes[Store.Settings.Theme] or UI.Themes.Lavender
    local top, bottom = theme.Sheen[1], theme.Sheen[2]
    return ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(top[1], top[2], top[3])), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(bottom[1], bottom[2], bottom[3]))})
end
UI.TextScale = 1
-- Every label is nudged up one step so 9-11 px captions become readable on phones, then scaled by the text size.
function UI.size(n)
    n = n or 14
    if n <= 10 then n = 12 elseif n <= 12 then n = 13 elseif n <= 13 then n = 14 end
    return math.max(8, math.floor(n * (UI.TextScale or 1) + 0.5))
end
pcall(UI.loadStyle)

-- Decodes an embedded base64 PNG, checks its size, writes it to the executor workspace and returns its asset id.
function UI.embeddedAsset(text, size, path)
    local asset = type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset or type(getsynasset) == "function" and getsynasset
    assert(asset and type(writefile) == "function", "Custom assets are unavailable")
    -- Written by an earlier run (same name, same size): used as it is instead of being decoded and written again.
    local okFile, existing = pcall(function() return type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(path) and readfile(path) end)
    if okFile and type(existing) == "string" and #existing == size and existing:sub(2, 4) == "PNG" then
        local okAsset, id = pcall(asset, path)
        if okAsset and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then return id end
    end
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local lookup = {}; for i = 1, #alphabet do lookup[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
    local data = text:gsub("[^%w%+/]", "")
    local parts = {}
    for i = 1, #data, 4 do
        local remaining = #data - i + 1
        local a, b = lookup[data:byte(i)], lookup[data:byte(i + 1)]
        local c, d = lookup[data:byte(i + 2) or 0] or 0, lookup[data:byte(i + 3) or 0] or 0
        local value = a * 262144 + b * 4096 + c * 64 + d
        if remaining >= 4 then parts[#parts + 1] = string.char(math.floor(value / 65536), math.floor(value / 256) % 256, value % 256)
        elseif remaining == 3 then parts[#parts + 1] = string.char(math.floor(value / 65536), math.floor(value / 256) % 256)
        else parts[#parts + 1] = string.char(math.floor(value / 65536)) end
    end
    local bytes = table.concat(parts)
    assert(#bytes == size and bytes:sub(2, 4) == "PNG", "Embedded image is corrupted")
    writefile(path, bytes)
    local id = asset(path)
    assert(type(id) == "string" and id ~= "", "The image could not be loaded")
    return id
end
function UI.loadIcons()
    if UI.IconSheet ~= nil then return end
    UI.IconSheet = false
    local ok, result = pcall(UI.embeddedAsset, UI.IconData, UI.IconBytes, "LyraAvatarStudio_icons_v26_1.png")
    if ok then UI.IconSheet = result
    else warn("[Lyra Avatar Studio] Icon pack unavailable, using built-in icons: " .. tostring(result)) end
    local logoOK, logo = pcall(UI.embeddedAsset, UI.LogoData, UI.LogoBytes, "LyraAvatarStudio_logo_v15.png")
    UI.LogoImage = logoOK and logo or nil
end
-- Yields nothing; the seasonal sheet is written and loaded the first time a seasonal theme needs it.
function UI.seasonSheet()
    if UI.SeasonSheet == nil then
        local ok, result = pcall(UI.embeddedAsset, UI.SeasonData, UI.SeasonBytes, "LyraAvatarStudio_season_v1.png")
        UI.SeasonSheet = ok and result or false
    end
    return UI.SeasonSheet or nil
end
-- An ImageLabel showing one piece of the seasonal sheet, or nil without custom assets.
function UI.seasonImage(parent, name, props)
    local sheet = UI.seasonSheet()
    local index = sheet and table.find(UI.SeasonNames, name)
    if not index then return nil end
    local image = UI.new("ImageLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Image = sheet, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
        ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(((index - 1) % 4) * 128, math.floor((index - 1) / 4) * 128), ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(128, 128)}, parent)
    for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do image[key] = value end
    return image
end
-- The brand mark inside a rounded frame: the logo image, or "AC" when custom assets are unavailable.
function UI.brandMark(parent, radius, textSize)
    if UI.LogoImage then
        local image = UI.new("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Image = UI.LogoImage, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop}, parent)
        UI.round(image, radius)
        return image
    end
    local letters = UI.text(parent, "AC", textSize or 15, UI.C.Text, true)
    letters.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); letters.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    return letters
end
function UI.new(class, props, parent)
    local item = Instance.new(class)
    for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do item[key] = value end
    -- A chosen font replaces the default one, bold labels staying bold. A label with a font of its own (code) keeps it.
    if class == "TextLabel" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox" then
        local font = props and props.Font
        if font and font ~= UI.Font.Regular and font ~= UI.Font.Bold then item:SetAttribute("LyraOwnFont", true)
        elseif UI.FaceRegular then pcall(function() item.FontFace = font == UI.Font.Bold and UI.FaceBold or UI.FaceRegular end) end
        -- Every label keeps its English text, so another language can relabel the open window (a text box's text is
        -- what the player typed and stays).
        local text = props and props.Text
        if class ~= "TextBox" and type(text) == "string" and text ~= "" then item:SetAttribute("LyraText", text); item.Text = Lang.text(text) end
        local hint = props and props.PlaceholderText
        if type(hint) == "string" and hint ~= "" then item:SetAttribute("LyraHint", hint); item.PlaceholderText = Lang.text(hint) end
    end
    item.Parent = parent
    return item
end
function UI.connect(event, fn) return RegisterConnection(event:Connect(function(...) if App.alive() then fn(...) end end)) end
-- Sets a label's text from English (translated now, and again when the language changes).
function UI.setText(label, text)
    if not label then return end
    text = tostring(text or "")
    label:SetAttribute("LyraText", text)
    label.Text = Lang.text(text)
end
-- The labels still showing their English text's translation (a label the code later filled with a name or a number
-- keeps that), to be written again in another language.
function UI.labelsToRelabel()
    local list = {}
    for _, root in ipairs({UI.Gui, UI.InspectOverlay}) do
        for _, item in ipairs(root and root:GetDescendants() or {}) do
            local text = item:GetAttribute("LyraText")
            if type(text) == "string" then
                local ok, shown = pcall(function() return item.Text end)
                if ok and shown == Lang.text(text) then table.insert(list, {item, "Text", text}) end
            end
            local hint = item:GetAttribute("LyraHint")
            if type(hint) == "string" then table.insert(list, {item, "PlaceholderText", hint}) end
        end
    end
    return list
end
function UI.setLanguage(choice)
    local labels = UI.labelsToRelabel()
    Store.Settings.Language = choice
    Lang.load(choice)
    for _, row in ipairs(labels) do pcall(function() row[1][row[2]] = Lang.text(row[3]) end) end
    pcall(UI.refresh); pcall(UI.refreshReopenCard)
    pcall(UI.selectTab, UI.Tab)
    App.persist()
end
function UI.round(item, radius) return UI.new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 14)}, item) end
function UI.stroke(item, transparency, color) return UI.new("UIStroke", {Color = color or UI.C.Line, Transparency = transparency or 0.3, Thickness = 1}, item) end
function UI.tween(item, goal, duration, style, direction)
    if not item or not App.alive() then return end
    local previous = UI.Tweens[item]; if previous then previous:Cancel(); UI.Tweens[item] = nil end
    if Store.Settings.ReducedMotion or Store.Settings.LowEffects or (duration or 0.18) == 0 then for k, v in pairs(goal) do item[k] = v end; return end
    local tween = UI.TweenService:Create(item, TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.18, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal)
    UI.Tweens[item] = tween
    local connection
    connection = tween.Completed:Connect(function() if UI.Tweens[item] == tween then UI.Tweens[item] = nil end; connection:Disconnect() end)
    tween:Play()
end
function UI.text(parent, value, size, color, bold)
    return UI.new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = value, TextSize = UI.size(size), TextColor3 = color or UI.C.Text,
        Font = bold and UI.Font.Bold or UI.Font.Regular, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent)
end
function UI.card(parent, height)
    local card = UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Card, BackgroundTransparency = 0.22, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent)
    UI.round(card, 16); UI.stroke(card, 0.55)
    return card
end
function UI.autoCard(parent, order, gap, padding)
    local card = UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Card, BackgroundTransparency = 0.22, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order or 0}, parent)
    UI.round(card, 16); UI.stroke(card, 0.55)
    UI.new("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 10)}, card)
    UI.new("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, padding or 16), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, padding or 16), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, padding or 16), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, padding or 16)}, card)
    return card
end
function UI.paragraph(parent, value, size, color, bold, order)
    local label = UI.text(parent, value, size, color, bold)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0); label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; label.TextWrapped = true
    label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None; label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top; label.LayoutOrder = order or 0
    return label
end
function UI.icon(parent, name, position, color)
    local root = UI.new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), Position = position or UDim2.new()}, parent)
    color = color or UI.C.Muted
    local spriteName = UI.IconAlias[name] or name
    local index = UI.IconIndex[spriteName]
    if UI.IconSheet and index then
        UI.new("ImageLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Image = UI.IconSheet,
            ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(((index - 1) % 8) * 64, math.floor((index - 1) / 8) * 64), ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(64, 64),
            ImageColor3 = color, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit}, root)
        return root
    end
    name = UI.VectorAlias[name] or name
    local function line(x1, y1, x2, y2)
        local dx, dy = x2-x1, y2-y1
        local item = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy), 1.8), Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0}, root)
        UI.round(item, 2)
    end
    local function box(x, y, w, h, radius, filled)
        local item = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x,y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w,h), BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = filled and 0 or 1, BorderSizePixel = 0}, root)
        UI.round(item, radius or 3); if not filled then UI.stroke(item, 0, color) end
    end
    if name == "avatar" then box(8,3,8,8,8); line(5,21,5,18); line(5,18,8,15); line(8,15,16,15); line(16,15,19,18); line(19,18,19,21)
    elseif name == "players" then box(3,4,7,7,7); box(14,5,6,6,6); line(1,20,3,15); line(3,15,10,15); line(10,15,12,20); line(15,15,20,15); line(20,15,22,20)
    elseif name == "collection" then box(3,5,14,16,3); line(8,2,21,2); line(21,2,21,16); line(7,10,13,10); line(7,14,12,14)
    elseif name == "settings" then for _, row in ipairs({{5,8},{12,16},{19,10}}) do line(3,row[1],21,row[1]); box(row[2]-2,row[1]-2,4,4,4,true) end
    elseif name == "creator" or name == "code" then line(8,6,2,12); line(2,12,8,18); line(16,6,22,12); line(22,12,16,18); line(14,3,10,21)
    elseif name == "search" then box(3,3,12,12,12); line(14,14,21,21)
    elseif name == "close" then line(6,6,18,18); line(18,6,6,18)
    elseif name == "menu" then line(4,6,20,6); line(4,12,20,12); line(4,18,20,18)
    elseif name == "expand" then line(4,9,4,4); line(4,4,9,4); line(15,4,20,4); line(20,4,20,9); line(4,15,4,20); line(4,20,9,20); line(15,20,20,20); line(20,20,20,15)
    elseif name == "minus" then line(5,12,19,12)
    elseif name == "plus" then line(5,12,19,12); line(12,5,12,19)
    elseif name == "undo" then line(8,5,3,10); line(3,10,8,15); line(3,10,15,10); line(15,10,19,14); line(19,14,19,18)
    elseif name == "copy" then box(3,7,13,14,3); line(8,3,21,3); line(21,3,21,16)
    elseif name == "github" then box(4,3,5,5,5); box(15,15,5,5,5); box(4,15,5,5,5); line(6.5,8,6.5,15); line(9,5.5,17.5,5.5); line(17.5,5.5,17.5,15)
    elseif name == "star" then
        local points = {}; for i=0,9 do local angle=-math.pi/2+i*math.pi/5; local r=i%2==0 and 10 or 4.5; points[i+1]={12+math.cos(angle)*r,12+math.sin(angle)*r} end
        for i=1,10 do local a,b=points[i],points[i%10+1]; line(a[1],a[2],b[1],b[2]) end
    elseif name == "check" then line(4,12,10,18); line(10,18,21,6)
    elseif name == "arrow" then line(4,12,20,12); line(14,6,20,12); line(20,12,14,18)
    elseif name == "reset" then line(5,9,8,5); line(8,5,17,5); line(17,5,21,12); line(21,12,17,19); line(17,19,8,19); line(8,19,4,15); line(3,4,3,10); line(3,10,9,10)
    end
    return root
end
function UI.button(parent, text, primary, callback, icon, rowKey)
    local button = UI.new("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,44), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = primary and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent)
    UI.round(button, 12)
    local label = UI.text(button, text, 13, primary and UI.C.Base or UI.C.Text, true)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(icon and 40 or 8,0); label.Size = UDim2.new(1, icon and -48 or -16,1,0); label.TextXAlignment = icon and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    -- A longer word in another language shrinks to fit the button instead of being cut.
    label.TextScaled = true; UI.new("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = label.TextSize, MinTextSize = 8}, label)
    local iconFrame = icon and UI.icon(button, icon, UDim2.new(0,10,0.5,-12), primary and UI.C.Base or UI.C.Accent)
    local entry = {Root = button, Label = label, Icon = iconFrame}
    -- A selected button (see UI.setSelected) keeps its highlight through hovers and taps.
    local function base() return entry.Selected and UI.C.AccentDark or primary and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Raised end
    local connect = rowKey and function(event, fn) UI.rowConnect(rowKey, event, fn) end or UI.connect
    connect(button.MouseEnter, function() if button.Active then UI.tween(button, {BackgroundColor3 = base():Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1), 0.08)}) end end)
    connect(button.MouseLeave, function() UI.tween(button, {BackgroundColor3 = base()}) end)
    connect(button.InputBegan, function(input) if button.Active and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then UI.tween(button, {BackgroundColor3 = base():Lerp(UI.C.Base,0.18)},0.08) end end)
    connect(button.InputEnded, function(input) if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then UI.tween(button, {BackgroundColor3 = base()}) end end)
    connect(button.Activated, function() if button.Active and callback then callback() end end)
    return entry
end
-- Marks a button as the one in use (the pencil of the skin being edited, an open fold): accent fill and edge.
function UI.setSelected(entry, on)
    entry.Selected = on == true
    entry.Root.BackgroundColor3 = entry.Selected and UI.C.AccentDark or UI.C.Raised
    local edge = entry.Root:FindFirstChild("LyraSelected")
    if entry.Selected and not edge then edge = UI.stroke(entry.Root, 0.35, UI.C.Accent); edge.Name = "LyraSelected" end
    if edge then edge.Enabled = entry.Selected end
    if entry.Icon then UI.recolor(entry.Icon, entry.Selected and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Accent) end
end
-- SEGMENTS: tabs inside one bar where the one in use sits on a sliding highlight (My skins / Community, the Community
-- sorts, Favorites / Recent, the shop's views). specs = {{Key, Label, Icon}, ...}; get() returns the key in use and
-- pick(key) is called on a tap. refresh() moves the highlight (call it whenever the key changes).
function UI.segments(parent, specs, get, pick, height)
    local count = #specs
    local track = UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 44), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Base, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent)
    UI.round(track, 14); UI.stroke(track, 0.62)
    local glide = UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -8, 1, -8), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.AccentDark, BorderSizePixel = 0}, track)
    UI.round(glide, 11); UI.stroke(glide, 0.4, UI.C.Accent)
    local group = {Root = track, Items = {}, Glide = glide}
    for index, spec in ipairs(specs) do
        local button = UI.new("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale((index - 1) / count, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, track)
        -- Icon and label centred together; on a narrow bar the icon goes first, then the label shrinks to fit.
        local holder = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, button)
        UI.new("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)}, holder)
        local icon = spec[3] and UI.smallIcon(holder, spec[3], 20, UI.C.Muted)
        if icon then icon.LayoutOrder = 1 end
        local label = UI.text(holder, spec[2], 13, UI.C.Muted, true)
        label.LayoutOrder = 2; label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22); label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
        local item = {Key = spec[1], Button = button, Holder = holder, Icon = icon, Label = label}
        local function fit()
            local room = button.AbsoluteSize.X - 14
            if room <= 0 then return end
            if item.Squeezed then
                -- A wider bar later (a bigger window) tries the full label and icon again.
                if room < item.Squeezed + 40 then return end
                item.Squeezed = nil
                local limit = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")
                if limit then label.TextSize = limit.MaxTextSize; limit:Destroy() end
                label.TextScaled = false; label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22); label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
                holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22); holder.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
                if icon then icon.Visible = true end
                return
            end
            if holder.AbsoluteSize.X > room then
                if icon and icon.Visible then icon.Visible = false; return end
                item.Squeezed = room
                holder.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None; holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 22)
                label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None; label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                label.TextScaled = true; UI.new("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = label.TextSize, MinTextSize = 8}, label)
            elseif icon and not icon.Visible and holder.AbsoluteSize.X + icon.AbsoluteSize.X * 1.4 < room then
                icon.Visible = true
            end
        end
        UI.connect(holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), fit)
        UI.connect(button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), fit)
        UI.connect(button.MouseEnter, function() if get() ~= item.Key then label.TextColor3 = UI.C.Text end end)
        UI.connect(button.MouseLeave, function() if get() ~= item.Key then label.TextColor3 = UI.C.Muted end end)
        UI.connect(button.Activated, function() if get() ~= item.Key then pick(item.Key) end; group.refresh() end)
        group.Items[index] = item
    end
    function group.refresh()
        local key = get()
        for index, item in ipairs(group.Items) do
            local on = item.Key == key
            if on then UI.tween(glide, {Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / count, 4, 0, 4)}, 0.22) end
            item.Label.TextColor3 = on and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted
            if item.Icon then UI.recolor(item.Icon, on and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted) end
        end
    end
    group.refresh()
    return group
end

        Text = "", PlaceholderText = placeholder, PlaceholderColor3 = UI.C.Muted, TextColor3 = UI.C.Text,

    UI.connect(box.FocusLost, function() UI.tween(border,{Color=UI.C.Line,Transparency=0.55}) end)
    return frame, box
end
function UI.section(parent, title, sub)
    local frame = UI.new("Frame", {Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,sub and 50 or 26),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},parent)
    UI.new("UIPadding",{PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,sub and 4 or 0),PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,2)},frame)

function UI.page(name)
    local page = UI.new("ScrollingFrame", {Name=name, Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), BackgroundTransparency=1, BorderSizePixel=0,
        ScrollBarThickness=3, ScrollBarImageColor3=UI.C.AccentDark, CanvasSize=UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Visible=false, ClipsDescendants=true},UI.Content)
    UI.new("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,2),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,6),PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,2),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,10)},page)
    -- An open dropdown list would drift away from its button, so scrolling closes it.
    UI.connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"),function() if UI.OpenDrop then UI.closeDropdown() end end)
    UI.trackScroll(name,page)
    UI.Pages[name]=page; return page
end
-- SCROLL MEMORY: every tab keeps where it was scrolled to: when the window is hidden or minimized and shown again,
-- when you come back from another tab, and the next time the script runs (with the tab that was open). It lives in a
-- small file of its own, so scrolling never rewrites the big save file.
UI.HubStateFile="Copier_HubState.json"
UI.Scroll={}; UI.Restoring={}
function UI.trackScroll(name,page)
    UI.connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"),function()
        -- A hidden page can be pushed back to the top while it is not shown; only real scrolling counts.
        if UI.Restoring[name] or not UI.Visible or UI.Minimized or UI.Tab~=name or not page.Visible or not (UI.Main and UI.Main.Visible) then return end
        UI.Scroll[name]=math.floor(page.CanvasPosition.Y+0.5)
        UI.saveHubState()
    end)
end
-- Scrolls a tab back to where it was. The page may still be filling in, so it tries for a moment.
function UI.restoreScroll(name)
    local page=UI.Pages and UI.Pages[name]
    local y=UI.Scroll[name]
    if not page or type(y)~="number" or y<=0 then return end
    UI.RestoreSerial=(UI.RestoreSerial or 0)+1
    local serial=UI.RestoreSerial
    UI.Restoring[name]=true
    task.spawn(function()
        for _=1,45 do
            if not App.alive() or serial~=UI.RestoreSerial or UI.Tab~=name then break end
            pcall(function() page.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(page.CanvasPosition.X,y) end)
            if math.abs(page.CanvasPosition.Y-y)<1 and UI.Visible and UI.Main.Visible then break end
            RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        if serial==UI.RestoreSerial then UI.Restoring[name]=nil end
    end)
end
function UI.saveHubState(now)
    UI.HubStateToken=(UI.HubStateToken or 0)+1
    local token=UI.HubStateToken
    local function write()
        if token~=UI.HubStateToken then return end
        local scroll={}
        for name,y in pairs(UI.Scroll) do if type(y)=="number" and y>0 then scroll[name]=y end end
        pcall(Store.write,UI.HubStateFile,{Version=1,Tab=UI.Tab,Scroll=scroll})
    end
    if now then write() else task.delay(1.5,function() if App.alive() then write() end end) end
end
function UI.loadHubState()
    local data=Store.read(UI.HubStateFile)
    if type(data)~="table" then return nil end
    for name,y in pairs(type(data.Scroll)=="table" and data.Scroll or {}) do
        if type(name)=="string" and table.find(UI.NavOrder,name) and type(y)=="number" and y==y and y>0 and y<200000 then UI.Scroll[name]=math.floor(y) end
    end
    return type(data.Tab)=="string" and table.find(UI.NavOrder,data.Tab) and data.Tab or nil
end
function UI.stack(parent, gap)
    return UI.new("UIListLayout", {SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Padding=UDim.new(0,gap or 12)},parent)
end
-- DROPDOWN: a styled picker for settings with several named options (shop sort and price, Auto & Cycle
-- modes). The list floats above the window so no scrolling container clips it; tapping outside closes it.
-- options = {{Value = any, Label = string}, ...}; get() returns the current value, set(value) stores a new one.
function UI.dropdown(parent,options,get,set)
    local button=UI.new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40),Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0},parent); UI.round(button,12)
    local stroke=UI.stroke(button,0.6)
    local label=UI.text(button,"",12,UI.C.Text,true); label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,0); label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-42,1,0)
    local chevron=UI.icon(button,"chevron-down",UDim2.new(1,-32,0.5,-12),UI.C.Accent)
    local drop={Root=button,Label=label,Options=options,Get=get,Set=set,Chevron=chevron,Stroke=stroke}
    function drop.refresh()
        local current=get()
        for _,option in ipairs(options) do if option.Value==current then UI.setText(label,option.Label) end end
    end
    UI.connect(button.Activated,function() if UI.OpenDrop==drop then UI.closeDropdown() else UI.openDropdown(drop) end end)
    UI.connect(button.MouseEnter,function() UI.tween(button,{BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.06)}) end)
    UI.connect(button.MouseLeave,function() UI.tween(button,{BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised}) end)
    drop.refresh(); return drop
end
function UI.openDropdown(drop)
    UI.closeDropdown(true)
    if not UI.DropLayer then
        UI.DropLayer=UI.new("Frame",{Name="DropdownLayer",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=70,Visible=false},UI.Main)
        local catcher=UI.new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false},UI.DropLayer)
        UI.connect(catcher.Activated,function() UI.closeDropdown() end)
    end
    -- Children of the window are laid out before its UIScale, so absolute pixels are divided by it.
    local scale=UI.WindowScale.Scale>0 and UI.WindowScale.Scale or 1
    local at=(drop.Root.AbsolutePosition-UI.Main.AbsolutePosition)/scale
    local buttonSize=drop.Root.AbsoluteSize/scale
    local area=UI.Main.AbsoluteSize/scale
    local rowHeight=38
    local width=math.max(drop.MinWidth or 180,buttonSize.X)
    local height=math.min(#drop.Options,7)*rowHeight+8
    local below=at.Y+buttonSize.Y+6
    local up=below+height>area.Y-8
    local x=math.clamp(at.X+buttonSize.X-width,8,math.max(8,area.X-width-8))
    local y=up and math.max(8,at.Y-height-6) or below
    local list=UI.new("CanvasGroup",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y+(up and 6 or -6)),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Card,
        BorderSizePixel=0,GroupTransparency=1},UI.DropLayer); UI.round(list,12); UI.stroke(list,0.45,UI.C.Accent)
    local scroll=UI.new("ScrollingFrame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,1,-8),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=2,
        ScrollBarImageColor3=UI.C.AccentDark,CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#drop.Options*rowHeight),ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y},list)
    UI.Rows.dropdown={}
    local current=drop.Get()
    for index,option in ipairs(drop.Options) do
        local selected=option.Value==current
        -- A special option (a seasonal theme) has a tinted row of its own colour.
        local special=option.Special
        local rest=special and (selected and 0.35 or 0.72) or (selected and 0.4 or 1)
        local row=UI.new("TextButton",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,(index-1)*rowHeight),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,rowHeight-2),Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,
            BackgroundColor3=special and special.Color or UI.C.AccentDark,BackgroundTransparency=rest,BorderSizePixel=0},scroll); UI.round(row,9)
        if special then UI.stroke(row,0.45,special.Color) end
        local left=10
        -- Theme options show three dots of their colours.
        for dot,color in ipairs(option.Swatch or {}) do
            local swatch=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.new(0,left+(dot-1)*11,0.5,-5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10),BackgroundColor3=color,BorderSizePixel=0},row); UI.round(swatch,10)
            UI.new("UIStroke",{Color=Color3.new(1,1,1),Transparency=0.7,Thickness=1},swatch)
        end
        if option.Swatch then left=left+#option.Swatch*11+6 end
        -- A seasonal option shows its own piece of artwork.
        if option.Icon and UI.seasonImage(row,option.Icon,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(22,22),Position=UDim2.new(0,left-2,0.5,-11)}) then left=left+24 end
        local text=UI.text(row,option.Label,12,(selected or special) and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted,selected or special~=nil); text.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(left,0); text.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(left+30+(special and 56 or 0)),1,0)
        -- Font options are written in their own font.
        if option.Face then pcall(function() text.FontFace=option.Face; text:SetAttribute("LyraOwnFont",true) end) end
        if special and special.Tag then
            local tag=UI.new("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,selected and -30 or -6,0.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(52,18),BackgroundColor3=special.Color,
                BackgroundTransparency=0.15,Text=special.Tag,TextColor3=UI.C.Base,Font=UI.Font.Bold,TextSize=10,BorderSizePixel=0},row); UI.round(tag,9)
        end
        if selected then UI.icon(row,"check",UDim2.new(1,-30,0.5,-12),UI.C.Accent) end
        UI.rowConnect("dropdown",row.MouseEnter,function() if not selected then UI.tween(row,{BackgroundTransparency=special and 0.5 or 0.75}) end end)
        UI.rowConnect("dropdown",row.MouseLeave,function() if not selected then UI.tween(row,{BackgroundTransparency=rest}) end end)
        UI.rowConnect("dropdown",row.Activated,function()
            UI.closeDropdown()
            if option.Value~=drop.Get() then drop.Set(option.Value); drop.refresh() end
        end)
    end
    if #drop.Options>7 then
        for index,option in ipairs(drop.Options) do if option.Value==current then scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,(index-4)*rowHeight)) end end
    end
    UI.OpenDrop=drop; UI.DropList=list; UI.DropLayer.Visible=true
    UI.tween(list,{GroupTransparency=0,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)},0.16)
    UI.tween(drop.Chevron,{Rotation=180},0.16); UI.tween(drop.Stroke,{Color=UI.C.Accent,Transparency=0.2},0.16)
end
function UI.closeDropdown(instant)
    local drop,list=UI.OpenDrop,UI.DropList
    if not drop then return end
    UI.OpenDrop=nil; UI.DropList=nil
    for _,connection in ipairs(UI.Rows.dropdown or {}) do connection:Disconnect() end
    UI.Rows.dropdown={}
    UI.tween(drop.Chevron,{Rotation=0},instant and 0 or 0.16); UI.tween(drop.Stroke,{Color=UI.C.Line,Transparency=0.6},instant and 0 or 0.16)
    if instant or Store.Settings.ReducedMotion or Store.Settings.LowEffects then list:Destroy(); UI.DropLayer.Visible=false; return end
    UI.tween(list,{GroupTransparency=1},0.1)
    task.delay(0.11,function()
        list:Destroy()
        if not UI.OpenDrop and UI.DropLayer then UI.DropLayer.Visible=false end
    end)
end
-- Where the window lives. PlayerGui is visible to the game's own scripts (which can inspect, hide or remove it), so
-- the executor's hidden container (gethui) comes first, then CoreGui (protected with syn.protect_gui when the
-- executor has it). PlayerGui is the last resort.
function UI.guiParents()
    local list={}
    pcall(function() if type(gethui)=="function" then local hidden=gethui(); if typeof(hidden)=="Instance" then table.insert(list,hidden) end end end)
    pcall(function() table.insert(list,game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
    return list
end
function UI.mount(gui,pg)
    for _,parent in ipairs(UI.guiParents()) do
        pcall(function()
            if parent:IsA("CoreGui") and type(syn)=="table" and type(syn.protect_gui)=="function" then syn.protect_gui(gui) end
        end)
        if pcall(function() gui.Parent=parent end) and gui.Parent==parent then return parent end
    end
    gui.Parent=pg; return pg
end
function UI.buildShell()

    for _,container in ipairs(containers) do
        pcall(function()
            for _, name in ipairs({"CopierHubGUI","CopierMobileControls"}) do local old=container:FindFirstChild(name); if old then old:Destroy() end end
        end)
    end
    local lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")
    for _, name in ipairs({"CopierLiquidBlur","CopierLiquidColor"}) do local old=lighting:FindFirstChild(name); if old then old:Destroy() end end
    UI.Gui=UI.new("ScreenGui",{Name="CopierHubGUI",ResetOnSpawn=false,DisplayOrder=990,ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,IgnoreGuiInset=false})

    -- With Start hidden the window is created closed, so it never shows for a frame on execute.

    -- The native post-effect samples the live scene. The sheen follows camera motion.
