-- Fills a creators row (key names its taps), only when the list changed.
function UI.fillCreators(box, list, key, shown)
    local creators = Community.Creators
    box.Visible = shown ~= false and #creators > 0
    local parts = {}
    for _, creator in ipairs(creators) do table.insert(parts, tostring(creator.User) .. ":" .. creator.Name) end
    local signature = table.concat(parts, ",")
    if list:GetAttribute("LyraCreators") == signature and UI.Rows[key] then return end
    list:SetAttribute("LyraCreators", signature)
    UI.clearRows(key, list)
    for index, creator in ipairs(creators) do
        local chip = UI.new("TextButton", {LayoutOrder = index, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false}, list)
        local face = UI.new("ImageLabel", {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -18, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. string.format("%d", creator.Look or creator.User) .. "&w=48&h=48"}, chip)
        UI.round(face, 18); UI.creatorRing(face, 1.5)
        local mark = UI.smallIcon(chip, "badge-check-solid", 14, UI.C.Accent, UDim2.new(0.5, 9, 0, 26)); mark.ZIndex = 2
        local label = UI.text(chip, "", 9, UI.C.Text, true); label.Text = creator.Name ~= "" and creator.Name or "?"
        label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 42); label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        if creator.Name ~= "" then
            UI.rowConnect(key, chip.Activated, function()
                UI.CommunitySort = "new"
                if UI.CommunitySearch then UI.CommunitySearch.Text = creator.Name end
                UI.setLooksView("Community")
            end)
        end
    end
end
function UI.renderChatCreators()
    if UI.ChatCreators then UI.fillCreators(UI.ChatCreatorsBox, UI.ChatCreators, "chatCreators") end
end
function UI.renderChat()
    if not UI.ChatList then return end
    local list = UI.ChatList
    local atBottom = list.CanvasPosition.Y >= list.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - list.AbsoluteSize.Y - 40
    UI.clearRows("chat", list)
    UI.renderChatCreators()
    local rows = Chat.ordered()
    for index, row in ipairs(rows) do UI.chatRow(row, index) end
    UI.ChatEmpty.Visible = #rows == 0
    UI.setText(UI.ChatEmpty, "No messages yet. Say hi!")
    UI.setText(UI.ChatStatus, Chat.Active == 1 and "1 player chatted in the last 15 minutes" or (tostring(Chat.Active) .. " players chatted in the last 15 minutes"))
    UI.ChatStatus.TextColor3 = UI.C.Muted
    if atBottom or UI.ChatJump then
        UI.ChatJump = nil
        task.defer(function() if list.Parent then list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, list.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y)) end end)
    end
end
-- Reads the room while the chat is open on screen.
function UI.openChat()
    UI.ChatJump = true
    if UI.ChatPolling then return end
    UI.ChatPolling = true
    task.spawn(function()
        if Chat.Last == 0 then UI.setText(UI.ChatStatus, "Loading…") end
        while App.alive() and UI.LooksView == "Chat" and UI.Tab == "Looks" and UI.Visible and not UI.Minimized do
            local changed, why = Chat.fetch()
            if not App.alive() then break end
            if changed then UI.renderChat()
            elseif why then UI.setText(UI.ChatStatus, why); UI.ChatStatus.TextColor3 = UI.C.Red end
            task.wait(Chat.Interval)
        end
        UI.ChatPolling = false
    end)
end
function UI.sendChat()
    if UI.ChatSending then return end
    local text = UI.ChatInput.Text
    if text:match("^%s*$") then return end
    UI.ChatSending = true; UI.enabled(UI.ChatSend, false)
    task.spawn(function()
        local done, why = Chat.send(text)
        UI.ChatSending = false
        if not App.alive() then return end
        UI.enabled(UI.ChatSend, true)
        if done then UI.ChatInput.Text = ""; UI.ChatJump = true; UI.renderChat() else App.report(why, "warning") end
    end)
end
-- The ids of a skin's items, listed with its post (60 at most): accessories and clothing first (the post's picture
-- shows the first four), then the body, face, animations and the rest.
function Community.items(data)
    local list, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(id)
        id = Codec.id(id)
        if id and not seen[id] and #list < 60 then seen[id] = true; table.insert(list, id) end
    end
    if type(data) == "table" then
        for _, row in ipairs(type(data.Accessories) == "table" and data.Accessories or {}) do if type(row) == "table" then add(row.AssetId) end end
        local props = data.Version == 2 and data.Properties or data
        if type(props) == "table" then for _, field in ipairs({"Shirt", "Pants", "GraphicTShirt", "Face"}) do add(props[field]) end end
    end
    local rest = {}
    for id in pairs(UI.inspectIds(data)) do if not seen[id] then table.insert(rest, id) end end
    table.sort(rest)
    for _, id in ipairs(rest) do add(id) end
    return list
end
-- Badges a post earns with uses (or the owner gives it): their text, icon and colour.
UI.CommunityBadges = {popular = {Text = "POPULAR", Icon = "flame", Color = "Red"}, verified = {Text = "VERIFIED", Icon = "badge-check", Color = "Green"},
    featured = {Text = "FEATURED", Icon = "crown", Color = "Gold"}}
-- An icon drawn at another size than 24.
function UI.smallIcon(parent, name, size, color, position)
    local icon = UI.icon(parent, name, position, color)
    if UI.IconSheet then icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size) else UI.new("UIScale", {Scale = size / 24}, icon) end
    return icon
end
-- A badge: a tinted capsule with the badge's icon and name in its colour.
function UI.badgePill(parent, style)
    local color = UI.C[style.Color]
    local pill = UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = 0.84, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent)
    UI.round(pill, 10); UI.stroke(pill, 0.45, color)
    UI.new("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)}, pill)
    UI.new("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)}, pill)
    UI.smallIcon(pill, style.Icon, 13, color).LayoutOrder = 1
    local label = UI.text(pill, style.Text, 9, color, true)
    label.LayoutOrder = 2; label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20); label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
    return pill
end
-- A horizontal strip of pieces (icons and labels) that keeps its own height.
function UI.strip(parent, gap)
    local strip = UI.new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true}, parent)
    UI.new("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 6)}, strip)
    return strip
end
function UI.stripText(strip, text, size, color, bold, order)
    local label = UI.text(strip, "", size, color, bold)
    label.Text = text; label.LayoutOrder = order; label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0); label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
    return label
end
function UI.usesText(uses)
    uses = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(uses) or 0))
    return uses == 1 and "1 use" or (tostring(uses) .. " uses")
end
-- When a post went up (its time is in milliseconds), in words; nil when unknown.
function UI.postedAgo(at)
    at = tonumber(at)
    if not at or at <= 0 then return nil end
    local days = math.floor(math.max(0, os.time() - math.floor(at / 1000)) / 86400)
    if days < 1 then return "Posted today" elseif days == 1 then return "Posted yesterday" end
    return "Posted " .. tostring(days) .. " days ago"
end
-- COMMUNITY view (see COMMUNITY): Newest, Popular or your own posts, a search, and a card per post with Wear, Preview
-- and a fold with the author, the description, the items, Save, Copy IDs and Report (Delete on yours).
UI.CommunitySort = "new"
function UI.buildCommunity(parent)
    local order = 0
    local function add(item) order = order + 1; item.LayoutOrder = order; return item end
    add(UI.section(parent, "Community", "Skins posted by Avatar Studio players. Wear or save any of them. To post one of yours, tap its pencil in My skins, then Post."))
    UI.CommunitySorts = UI.segments(parent, {{"new", "Newest", "clock"}, {"top", "Popular", "flame"}, {"mine", "Mine", "user"}},
        function() return UI.CommunitySort end, function(key) UI.CommunitySort = key; UI.loadCommunity(true) end, 42)
    add(UI.CommunitySorts.Root)
    UI.CommunityCreatorsBox, UI.CommunityCreators = UI.creatorsRow(parent); add(UI.CommunityCreatorsBox)
    local searchFrame, search = UI.input(parent, "Search by skin name or username"); add(searchFrame); UI.CommunitySearch = search
    UI.CommunityCount = add(UI.text(parent, "", 11, UI.C.Muted)); UI.CommunityCount.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
    UI.CommunityList = add(UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, parent))
    UI.stack(UI.CommunityList, 8)
    UI.CommunityMore = UI.button(parent, "Load more", false, function() UI.loadCommunity(false) end, "chevron-down")
    add(UI.CommunityMore.Root); UI.CommunityMore.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40); UI.CommunityMore.Root.Visible = false
    UI.connect(search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
        UI.CommunitySearchToken = (UI.CommunitySearchToken or 0) + 1
        local token = UI.CommunitySearchToken
        task.delay(0.6, function() if App.alive() and token == UI.CommunitySearchToken and UI.LooksView == "Community" then UI.loadCommunity(true) end end)
    end)
end
-- Loads the first page (reset) or the next one.
function UI.loadCommunity(reset)
    if not UI.CommunityList then return end
    UI.CommunityToken = (UI.CommunityToken or 0) + 1
    local token = UI.CommunityToken
    UI.CommunitySorts.refresh()
    if reset then
        UI.CommunityOffset, UI.CommunityPosts, UI.CommunityOpen, UI.CommunityHasMore = 0, {}, nil, false
        UI.CommunityLoaded, UI.CommunityStale = true, false
        UI.clearRows("community", UI.CommunityList)
    end
    UI.CommunityMore.Root.Visible = false
    UI.setText(UI.CommunityCount, "Loading…")
    task.spawn(function()
        local sort = UI.CommunitySort
        local query = UI.CommunitySearch.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local posts, more, verify = Community.list(sort == "mine" and "new" or sort, query, UI.CommunityOffset, sort == "mine")
        if not App.alive() or token ~= UI.CommunityToken then return end
        if not posts then
            UI.renderCommunity()
            UI.setText(UI.CommunityCount, tostring(more)); UI.CommunityCount.TextColor3 = UI.C.Red
            UI.CommunityStale = true
            return
        end
        for _, post in ipairs(posts) do if type(post) == "table" and type(post.id) == "string" then table.insert(UI.CommunityPosts, post) end end
        UI.CommunityOffset = UI.CommunityOffset + #posts
        UI.CommunityHasMore = more == true
        if sort == "mine" and verify then UI.CommunityVerify = verify end
        UI.renderCommunity()
    end)
end
function UI.renderCommunity()
    if not UI.CommunityList then return end
    UI.clearRows("community", UI.CommunityList)
    local posts, mine = UI.CommunityPosts or {}, UI.CommunitySort == "mine"
    if UI.CommunityCreators then UI.fillCreators(UI.CommunityCreatorsBox, UI.CommunityCreators, "communityCreators", not mine) end
    if mine and UI.CommunityVerify then UI.verifyCard(UI.CommunityVerify) end
    for index, post in ipairs(posts) do
        UI.communityRow(post, index)
        if UI.CommunityOpen == post.id then UI.communityDetails(post, index) end
    end
    UI.CommunityCount.TextColor3 = UI.C.Muted
    UI.setText(UI.CommunityCount, #posts == 0 and "" or ("Skins: " .. tostring(#posts)))
    if #posts == 0 then
        UI.emptyList(UI.CommunityList, mine and "You have not posted yet" or "No skins found",
            mine and "Tap the pencil on one of your skins in My skins, then Post." or "Try another search, or be the first to post one.")
    end
    UI.CommunityMore.Root.Visible = UI.CommunityHasMore == true
end
-- The verified creator card at the top of Mine: where you stand (best skin and skins at 25+ uses, with bars) and the
-- request button once you reach both; or the state of a request already sent, or your mark.
function UI.verifyCard(status)
    local card = UI.autoCard(UI.CommunityList, -1, 8, 14)
    local edge = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"); if edge then edge:Destroy() end
    UI.creatorRing(card, 1, status.Creator and 0.2 or 0.5)
    local head = UI.strip(card, 6); head.LayoutOrder = 1; head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    UI.smallIcon(head, "badge-check-solid", 18, UI.C.Accent).LayoutOrder = 1
    local title = UI.stripText(head, "", 13, UI.C.Text, true, 2)
    if status.Creator then
        UI.setText(title, "You're a verified creator")
        UI.paragraph(card, "Your mark shows next to your name on every skin and in the chat.", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 2)
        return
    end
    UI.setText(title, "Get the verified creator mark")
    if status.State == "pending" then
        UI.paragraph(card, "Request sent. The owner will review it soon.", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 2)
        return
    end
-- cache YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    UI.paragraph(card, "Verified creators get a mark on their skins and a highlighted name in the chat.", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 2)
    local function bar(order, label, value, goal)
        local row = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = order, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, card)
        local text = UI.text(row, "", 11, UI.C.Text); text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 16); UI.setText(text, label)
        local count = UI.text(row, "", 11, value >= goal and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Muted, true); count.Text = tostring(math.min(value, goal)) .. "/" .. tostring(goal)
        count.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 0); count.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 16); count.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        local track = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 21), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0}, row)
        UI.round(track, 3)
        local fill = UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(value / goal, 0, 1), 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0}, track)
        UI.round(fill, 3)
        UI.new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(UI.C.Accent, UI.C.Gold)}, fill)
    end
    bar(3, "Uses on your best skin", status.Top, status.NeedTop)
    bar(4, "Skins with " .. tostring(status.NeedMin) .. "+ uses", status.Count, status.NeedCount)
    if status.State == "declined" then
        UI.paragraph(card, "Your last request was declined. You can ask again a week after it.", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 5)
        return
    end
    local ask = UI.button(card, "Request verification", true, function()
        if UI.VerifyAsking then return end
        UI.VerifyAsking = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local done, why, now = Community.askVerify()
            UI.VerifyAsking = false
            if not App.alive() then return end
            UI.CommunityVerify = done or now or UI.CommunityVerify
            if done then App.report("Request sent. The owner will review it soon.", "success") else App.report(why, "warning") end
            if UI.CommunitySort == "mine" then UI.renderCommunity() end
        end)
    end, "badge-check")
    ask.Root.LayoutOrder = 6; ask.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    UI.enabled(ask, status.Eligible)
    if not status.Eligible then UI.paragraph(card, "Reach " .. tostring(status.NeedTop) .. " uses on one skin and " .. tostring(status.NeedCount) .. " skins with " .. tostring(status.NeedMin) .. "+ uses to ask.", 10, UI.C.Muted, false, 7) end
end
-- A post's card: its items as a picture, the name with its badge, the author (and their verified mark), uses, a line
-- of the description, and Wear / Preview / more. A narrow window puts the buttons under the text.
function UI.communityRow(post, index)
    local open = UI.CommunityOpen == post.id
    local stacked = UI.Narrow == true
    local about = type(post.about) == "string" and post.about:gsub("%s+", " ") or ""
    local top = about ~= "" and 78 or 66
    local height = stacked and top + 44 or top
    local card = UI.card(UI.CommunityList, height); card.LayoutOrder = index * 2
    local style = UI.CommunityBadges[post.badge]
    local edge = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if open then edge.Color = UI.C.Accent; edge.Transparency = 0
    elseif style then edge.Color = UI.C[style.Color]; edge.Transparency = 0.6 end
    local function toggle() UI.CommunityOpen = not open and post.id or nil; UI.renderCommunity() end
    -- A tap on the card opens or closes its details; the buttons on it keep their own taps.
    local hit = UI.new("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false}, card)
    UI.rowConnect("community", hit.Activated, toggle)
    -- The picture: the skin's first four items, two by two.
    local frame = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, math.floor((top - 54) / 2)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0}, card)
    UI.round(frame, 14)
-- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    local items = type(post.items) == "table" and post.items or {}
    if #items == 0 then UI.icon(frame, "shirt", UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0.5, -12), UI.C.Accent) end
    for i = 1, (#items == 1 and 1 or (#items > 0 and 4 or 0)) do
        local whole = #items == 1
        local tile = UI.new("Frame", {Position = whole and UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3) or UDim2.fromOffset(3 + ((i - 1) % 2) * 25, 3 + math.floor((i - 1) / 2) * 25),
            Size = whole and UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48) or UDim2.fromOffset(23, 23), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Base, BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0}, frame)
        UI.round(tile, whole and 11 or 7)
        local id = Codec.id(items[i])
        if id then UI.new("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. string.format("%d", id) .. "&w=150&h=150"}, tile) end
    end
    local left = 76
    local controls = stacked and 10 or (70 + 6 + 40 + 6 + 40 + 10 + 8)
    local width = UDim2.new(1, -(left + controls), 0, 0)
    local y = about ~= "" and 9 or 10
    -- Name and badge. A long name is cut so the badge stays in view.
    local titleRow = UI.strip(card, 6); titleRow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left, y); titleRow.Size = width + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22)
    local title = UI.stripText(titleRow, tostring(post.name or "Skin"), 14, open and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Text, true, 1)
    title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    if style then
        local pill = UI.badgePill(titleRow, style); pill.LayoutOrder = 2
        local natural
        local function fit()
            local ratio = card.AbsoluteSize.Y / height
            if ratio <= 0 then return end
            if title.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.X then natural = title.AbsoluteSize.X / ratio end
            if not natural then return end
            local room = (titleRow.AbsoluteSize.X - pill.AbsoluteSize.X) / ratio - 6
            if natural > room then title.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None; title.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(0, math.floor(room)), 1, 0)
            elseif title.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.None then title.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) end
        end
        for _, item in ipairs({titleRow, title, pill}) do UI.rowConnect("community", item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), fit) end
        task.defer(fit)
    end
    -- Author, verified mark and uses (or why the post is hidden).
    local meta = UI.strip(card, 5); meta.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left, y + 24); meta.Size = width + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20)
    local userId = Codec.id(post.user)
    local faceId = Codec.id(post.look) or userId
    local face = UI.new("ImageLabel", {LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Image = faceId and ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. string.format("%d", faceId) .. "&w=48&h=48") or ""}, meta)
    UI.round(face, 9)
    UI.stripText(meta, "@" .. tostring(post.uname or "?"), 11, UI.C.Text, true, 2)
    if post.creator then UI.smallIcon(meta, "badge-check-solid", 15, UI.C.Accent).LayoutOrder = 3 end
    if post.hidden then
        UI.stripText(meta, "·", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 4)
        local hidden = UI.stripText(meta, "", 11, UI.C.Red, true, 5); UI.setText(hidden, "Hidden after reports")
    else
        UI.stripText(meta, "·", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 4)
        UI.smallIcon(meta, "users", 14, UI.C.Muted).LayoutOrder = 5
        local uses = UI.stripText(meta, "", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 6); UI.setText(uses, UI.usesText(post.uses))
        if not UI.Compact and (post.rig == "R6" or post.rig == "R15") then
            UI.stripText(meta, "·", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 7)
            UI.stripText(meta, post.rig, 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 8)
        end
    end
    if about ~= "" then
        local line = UI.text(card, "", 11, UI.C.Muted); line.Text = about
        line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left, y + 47); line.Size = width + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18)
    end
    -- Wear, Preview and the fold.
    local wear = UI.button(card, "Wear", true, function() UI.useCommunity(post, "wear") end, nil, "community")
    local preview = UI.button(card, "", false, function() UI.useCommunity(post, "preview") end, "eye", "community")
    local more = UI.button(card, "", false, toggle, open and "chevron-up" or "chevron-down", "community")
    if open then UI.setSelected(more, true) end
    if stacked then
        local row = top + 1
        wear.Root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, row); wear.Root.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -16, 0, 36)
        preview.Root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, row); preview.Root.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -6, 0, 36)
        more.Root.Position = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0, row); more.Root.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -10, 0, 36)
    else
        local middle = math.floor(top / 2) - 19
        wear.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 38); wear.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(70 + 6 + 40 + 6 + 40 + 10), 0, middle)
        preview.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 38); preview.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(40 + 6 + 40 + 10), 0, middle)
        more.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 38); more.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, middle)
    end
end
function UI.communityDetails(post, index)
    local panel = UI.autoCard(UI.CommunityList, index * 2 + 1, 10, 12)
    panel.BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised
    local frameEdge = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"); frameEdge.Color = UI.C.Accent; frameEdge.Transparency = 0.65
    -- Who made it: picture, @name with the verified mark, and what the skin is.
    local author = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, panel)
    local userId = Codec.id(post.user)
    local faceId = Codec.id(post.look) or userId
    local face = UI.new("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Base, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Image = faceId and ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. string.format("%d", faceId) .. "&w=150&h=150") or ""}, author)
    UI.round(face, 22); UI.stroke(face, post.creator and 0.15 or 0.6, post.creator and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Line)
    local nameRow = UI.strip(author, 6); nameRow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 1); nameRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 22)
    UI.stripText(nameRow, "@" .. tostring(post.uname or "?"), 14, UI.C.Text, true, 1)
    if post.creator then
        UI.smallIcon(nameRow, "badge-check-solid", 17, UI.C.Accent).LayoutOrder = 2
        local tag = UI.stripText(nameRow, "", 11, UI.C.Accent, true, 3); UI.setText(tag, "Verified creator")
    end
    local facts = {}
    if post.rig == "R6" or post.rig == "R15" then table.insert(facts, post.rig) end
    local ago = UI.postedAgo(post.at)
    if ago then table.insert(facts, Lang.text(ago)) end
    table.insert(facts, Lang.text(UI.usesText(post.uses)))
    local factLine = UI.text(author, "", 11, UI.C.Muted); factLine.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 24); factLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 18)
    factLine.Text = table.concat(facts, "  ·  ")
    -- Their Discord username: a chip that copies it.
    local discordName = type(post.discord) == "string" and post.discord or ""
    if discordName ~= "" then
        local chip = UI.new("TextButton", {LayoutOrder = 2, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Base,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, panel)
        UI.round(chip, 17); UI.stroke(chip, 0.5)
        UI.new("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)}, chip)
        UI.new("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)}, chip)
        UI.smallIcon(chip, "discord", 18, UI.C.Accent).LayoutOrder = 1
        UI.stripText(chip, discordName, 12, UI.C.Text, true, 2)
        UI.smallIcon(chip, "copy", 15, UI.C.Muted).LayoutOrder = 3
        UI.rowConnect("community", chip.Activated, function()
            local clipboard = type(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard or type(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard or nil
            if clipboard and pcall(clipboard, discordName) then App.report("Discord username copied: " .. discordName, "success")
            else App.report("Discord: " .. discordName, "info") end
        end)
    end
    -- The description, as a quote.
    local about = type(post.about) == "string" and post.about or ""
    if about ~= "" then
        local block = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = 3, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Base,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0}, panel)
        UI.round(block, 12)
        UI.new("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 22), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)}, block)
        local bar = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-12, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0}, block); UI.round(bar, 2)
        local text = UI.paragraph(block, "", 12, UI.C.Text, false, 1); text.Text = about
    end
    -- The items: a picture of each (a tap copies its ID), the first 24 shown.
    local ids = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(type(post.items) == "table" and post.items or {}) do if Codec.id(id) then table.insert(ids, string.format("%d", id)) end end
    local head = UI.paragraph(panel, "", 12, UI.C.Text, true, 4); UI.setText(head, "Items (" .. tostring(#ids) .. ")")
    if #ids > 0 then
        local grid = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = 5, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, panel)
        UI.new("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 78), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, grid)
        for i, id in ipairs(ids) do
            if i > 24 then
                local rest = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = i, BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Base, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0}, grid); UI.round(rest, 10)
                local count = UI.text(rest, "", 13, UI.C.Muted, true); count.Text = "+" .. tostring(#ids - 24); count.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); count.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                break
            end
            local cell = UI.new("TextButton", {LayoutOrder = i, BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Base, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, grid)
            UI.round(cell, 10)
            UI.new("ImageLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=150&h=150"}, cell)
            local caption = UI.text(cell, "", 9, UI.C.Muted); caption.Text = id
            caption.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 56); caption.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 16); caption.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            caption.TextScaled = true; UI.new("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = UI.size(9), MinTextSize = 6}, caption)
            UI.rowConnect("community", cell.Activated, function()
                local clipboard = type(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard or type(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard or nil
                if clipboard and pcall(clipboard, id) then App.report("Item ID copied: " .. id, "success") else App.report("Item ID: " .. id, "info") end
            end)
        end
    end
    -- Shown only when the clipboard is unavailable, holding the IDs to copy by hand.
    local box = UI.new("TextBox", {LayoutOrder = 6, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Base, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false,
        TextEditable = false, ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextWrapped = true, MultiLine = true, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = UI.size(12), TextColor3 = UI.C.Text,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top}, panel)
    UI.round(box, 10)
    UI.new("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)}, box)
    local grid = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = 7, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, panel)
    UI.new("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 38), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, grid)
    local function action(order, text, icon, callback) local button = UI.button(grid, text, false, callback, icon, "community"); button.Root.LayoutOrder = order end
    action(1, "Save", "save", function() UI.useCommunity(post, "save") end)
    action(2, "Copy IDs", "copy", function()
        if #ids == 0 then App.report("This skin lists no item IDs.", "info"); return end
        local text = table.concat(ids, ", ")
        local clipboard = type(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard or type(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard or nil
        if clipboard and pcall(clipboard, text) then App.report("Item IDs copied.", "success")
        else box.Text = text; box.Visible = true; App.report("Select the IDs in the box and copy them.", "info") end
    end)
    if tonumber(post.user) == lp.UserId then
        action(3, "Delete", "trash-2", function()
            UI.confirm("Delete this post?", "It leaves the Community. The skin stays in My skins.", function()
                task.spawn(function()
                    local done = Community.remove(post.id)
                    if not App.alive() then return end
                    if done then App.report("Post deleted.", "success"); UI.loadCommunity(true)
                    else App.report("Only the device that posted it can delete it.", "error") end
                end)
            end, {Confirm = "Delete"})
        end)
    else
        action(3, "Report", "flag", function()
            UI.confirm("Report this post?", "Report skins with offensive names, descriptions or items. A post several players report is hidden.", function()
                Community.report(post.id); App.report("Thanks, the post was reported.", "success")
            end, {Confirm = "Report"})
        end)
    end
end
-- Yields. Wears, saves or previews a post's skin.
function UI.useCommunity(post, how)
    if UI.CommunityBusy then return end
    if how == "wear" and App.Busy then App.report("Wait for the current change to finish.", "warning"); return end
    UI.CommunityBusy = true
    App.report(how == "preview" and "Loading the preview…" or "Loading the skin…", "loading")
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, data = pcall(Community.fetch, post.id, how ~= "preview")
        UI.CommunityBusy = false
        if not App.alive() then return end
        if not ok then App.report(tostring(data), "error"); return end
        local name = Looks.name(post.name) or "Community skin"
        if how == "wear" then App.applySnapshot({Data = Codec.copy(data), Name = name, ThumbId = Codec.id(post.user), Shared = true}, "apply")
        elseif how == "save" then
            local saved, row = pcall(Looks.addReceived, data, name, "Community · @" .. tostring(post.uname or "?"))
            if not saved then App.report(tostring(row), "error"); return end
            if UI.Tab == "Looks" then UI.renderLooks() end
            App.report("Saved in My skins as " .. row.Name .. ".", "success")
        else UI.previewLook({Name = name, Data = Codec.copy(data)}) end
    end)
end

-- ROBLOX SHOP page: search the Roblox catalog and add items to (or remove them from) the avatar being worn.
-- A bundle opens inside the page with every part listed (head, torso, arms, legs…), to add it whole or part by part.
-- Wearing lists what the current avatar has, so a copied avatar can be customized item by item.
UI.CatalogView="Search"; UI.CatalogFilter="All"; UI.CatalogSub="All"; UI.CatalogSort="Popular"; UI.CatalogPrice="Any"; UI.CatalogCards={}; UI.CatalogCount=0
UI.CatalogGroups={{Label="Body & face",Max=19},{Label="Accessories",Max=29},{Label="Clothing",Max=39},{Label="Animations",Max=49},{Label="Other",Max=math.huge}}
function UI.catalogThumb(item)
    return "rbxthumb://type="..(item.Bundle and "BundleThumbnail" or "Asset").."&id="..tostring(item.Id).."&w=150&h=150"
end
function UI.catalogCaption(item)
    if item.Caption then return item.Caption end
    local kind=item.Bundle and (Catalog.BundleLabels[item.BundleKind] or "Bundle") or (item.Kind and item.Kind.Label) or "Item"
    if item.Limited then kind=kind.."  ·  Limited" end
    if item.Price==0 then return kind.."  ·  Free" elseif item.Price then return kind.."  ·  R$ "..tostring(item.Price) end
    return item.OffSale and (kind.."  ·  Off sale") or kind
end
function UI.catalogClear(key,container) UI.clearRows(key,container); UI.CatalogCards[key]={} end
-- Add / Remove button that follows the item's state. refreshCatalog updates every one of them.
function UI.catalogAction(parent,key,item)
    local button=UI.new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Accent},parent); UI.round(button,10)
    local label=UI.text(button,"",12,UI.C.Base,true); label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    local entry={Root=button,Label=label,Item=item}
    function entry.update()
        local worn=not item.Bundle and Catalog.worn()[item.Id]~=nil
        entry.Worn=worn
        if entry.Badge then entry.Badge.Visible=worn end
        local idle=not App.Busy and not UI.CatalogPending
        if item.Bundle then UI.setText(label,"View parts")
        elseif item.Unwearable then UI.setText(label,"Not wearable")
        else UI.setText(label,worn and "Remove" or "Add") end
        local primary=not item.Bundle and not worn and not item.Unwearable
        button.BackgroundColor3=primary and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Raised
        label.TextColor3=primary and UI.C.Base or (worn and UI.C.Red or UI.C.Text)
        button.Active=item.Bundle or (idle and not item.Unwearable)
        label.TextTransparency=button.Active and 0 or 0.5
        button.BackgroundTransparency=button.Active and 0 or 0.45
    end
    UI.rowConnect(key,button.Activated,function()
        if not button.Active then return end
        if item.Bundle then UI.openBundle(item) else UI.catalogRun({item},entry.Worn) end
    end)
    table.insert(UI.CatalogCards[key],entry)
    entry.update(); return entry
end
function UI.catalogRun(items,remove,context,slotChosen)
    if App.Busy or UI.CatalogPending then App.report("Wait for the current change to finish.","warning"); return end
    -- One emote being added asks where it goes on the wheel first.
    if not remove and not slotChosen and #items==1 and not items[1].Bundle then
        local item=items[1]
        UI.CatalogPending=true; UI.refreshCatalog()
        task.spawn(function()
            if not item.Kind then local info=Catalog.info(item.Id); item.Kind=info and Catalog.kind(info.AssetTypeId) end
            UI.CatalogPending=nil
            if not App.alive() then return end
            UI.refreshCatalog()
            if item.Kind and item.Kind.Emote then
                UI.pickEmoteSlot(item,function(slot) item.Slot=slot; UI.catalogRun(items,false,context,true) end)
            else UI.catalogRun(items,false,context,true) end
        end)
        return
    end
    UI.CatalogPending=true; UI.refreshCatalog()
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,err=pcall(Catalog.edit,items,remove,context)
        if not ok then App.report(tostring(err),"error") end
        UI.CatalogPending=nil
        if App.alive() then UI.refreshCatalog() end
    end)
end
-- EMOTE SLOT PICKER: adding an emote in the shop asks where it goes, on a wheel laid out like Roblox's (slot 1 at the
-- top, then clockwise). Each slot shows the emote it holds; the one tapped gets the new emote (what was there leaves).
function UI.pickEmoteSlot(item,done)
    if UI.EmotePicker then pcall(function() UI.EmotePicker:Destroy() end) end
    local connections={}
    local layer=UI.new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0),BackgroundTransparency=0.35,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,ZIndex=55},UI.Main)
    UI.EmotePicker=layer
    local function close()
        for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        if layer.Parent then layer:Destroy() end
        if UI.EmotePicker==layer then UI.EmotePicker=nil end
    end
    local function on(event,fn) table.insert(connections,event:Connect(function(...) if App.alive() then fn(...) end end)) end
    on(layer.Activated,close)
    local card=UI.new("TextButton",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(320,416),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Card,
        Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0},layer)
    UI.round(card,20); UI.stroke(card,0.35,UI.C.Accent)
    -- Fits small windows.
    local main=UI.Main.Size
    UI.new("UIScale",{Scale=math.clamp(math.min((main.X.Offset-24)/320,(main.Y.Offset-24)/416),0.55,1)},card)
    local title=UI.text(card,"Choose a slot",16,UI.C.Text,true); title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,16); title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,24)
    local name=UI.text(card,"",12,UI.C.Muted); name.Text=tostring(item.Name or "Emote"); name.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,42); name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,18)
    local wheel=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-130,0,70),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(260,260),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Base,BackgroundTransparency=0.2,BorderSizePixel=0},card)
    UI.round(wheel,130); UI.stroke(wheel,0.55)
    -- The new emote in the middle.
    local middle=UI.new("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(92,92),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.AccentDark,BackgroundTransparency=0.35,BorderSizePixel=0},wheel)
    UI.round(middle,46); UI.stroke(middle,0.3,UI.C.Accent)
    UI.new("ImageLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.46),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(58,58),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Image=UI.catalogThumb(item)},middle)
    local newLabel=UI.text(middle,"NEW",9,UI.C.Text,true); newLabel.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-20); newLabel.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,14); newLabel.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    local emotes,equipped=EmoteSets.wheel()
    local bySlot={}
    for _,row in ipairs(equipped) do bySlot[row.Slot]=row.Name end
    for slot=1,8 do
        local angle=math.rad(-90+(slot-1)*45)
        local x,y=130+96*math.cos(angle),130+96*math.sin(angle)
        local held=bySlot[slot]
        local button=UI.new("TextButton",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x-31,y-31),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(62,62),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0},wheel)
        UI.round(button,31)
        local edge=UI.stroke(button,0.5)
        local id=held and emotes[held] and Codec.id(emotes[held][1])
        if id then
            UI.new("ImageLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.55),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,40),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ImageTransparency=0.25,Image="rbxthumb://type=Asset&id="..string.format("%d",id).."&w=150&h=150"},button)
        end
        local number=UI.text(button,"",11,held and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Muted,true); number.Text=tostring(slot)
        number.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,id and 3 or 0); number.Size=id and UDim2.new(1,0,0,16) or UDim2.fromScale(1,1); number.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        on(button.MouseEnter,function() button.BackgroundColor3=UI.C.AccentDark; edge.Color=UI.C.Accent; edge.Transparency=0.2 end)
        on(button.MouseLeave,function() button.BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised; edge.Color=UI.C.Line; edge.Transparency=0.5 end)
        on(button.Activated,function() close(); done(slot) end)
    end
    local hint=UI.paragraph(card,"",11,UI.C.Muted,false,0); UI.setText(hint,"Tap a slot. An emote already there is replaced.")
    hint.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,338); hint.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,18); hint.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    local cancel=UI.button(card,"Cancel",false,close,"x"); cancel.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0,20,1,-56); cancel.Root.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,40)
end
-- Gives an icon (sprite or vector fallback) a new colour in place.
function UI.recolor(root,color)
    for _,item in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("ImageLabel") then item.ImageColor3=color
        elseif item:IsA("Frame") then item.BackgroundColor3=color
        elseif item:IsA("UIStroke") then item.Color=color end
    end
end
-- Copies text to the clipboard. Without clipboard access the text is shown in a box to copy by hand.
function UI.copy(text,what,fallbackBox)
    local copy=type(setclipboard)=="function" and setclipboard or type(toclipboard)=="function" and toclipboard or nil
    if copy and pcall(copy,text) then App.report(what.." copied.","success"); return true end
    if fallbackBox then
        fallbackBox.Text=text; fallbackBox.Visible=true
        pcall(function() fallbackBox:CaptureFocus(); fallbackBox.SelectionStart=1; fallbackBox.CursorPosition=#text+1 end)
    end
    App.report("Clipboard access is unavailable. Select the text and copy it by hand.","warning")
    return false
end
-- Star that adds a shop item or bundle to the Roblox Shop favorites. It is registered like the Add buttons, so
-- refreshCatalog keeps every star of the same item in step.
function UI.shopStar(parent,key,item,size)
    local button=UI.new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size or 28,size or 28),Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Base,BackgroundTransparency=0.25},parent)
    UI.round(button,(size or 28)/2)
    local icon=UI.icon(button,"star",UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),UI.C.Muted)
    icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5); UI.new("UIScale",{Scale=(size or 28)/34},icon)
    local entry={Root=button,Item=item}
    function entry.update()
        local starred=Catalog.favoriteIndex(item)~=nil
        button.BackgroundColor3=starred and UI.C.Gold or UI.C.Base
        button.BackgroundTransparency=starred and 0 or 0.25
        UI.recolor(icon,starred and UI.C.Base or UI.C.Text)
    end
    UI.rowConnect(key,button.Activated,function()
        local added=Catalog.toggleFavorite(item)
        App.report(added and ((item.Name or "Item").." added to your shop favorites.") or ((item.Name or "Item").." removed from your shop favorites."),"info")
        UI.refreshCatalog()
        if UI.CatalogView=="Favorites" then UI.renderShopFavorites() end
    end)
    table.insert(UI.CatalogCards[key],entry)
    entry.update(); return entry
end

-- Cells are sized in whole pixels so every column fits the row exactly (scale-based cells could round
-- one column onto the next row and leave an empty gap on the right). Two columns on phones, more as it widens.
function UI.catalogColumns()
    if not UI.CatalogGridLayout then return end
    local scale=UI.WindowScale.Scale>0 and UI.WindowScale.Scale or 1
    -- The search, favorites and ideas grids share one width; whichever is shown is measured.
    local grid
    for _,candidate in ipairs({UI.CatalogGrid,UI.CatalogFavGrid,UI.CatalogIdeasGrid}) do
        if candidate and candidate.AbsoluteSize.X>0 then grid=candidate; break end
    end
    local width=grid and math.floor(grid.AbsoluteSize.X/scale) or 0
    if width<=0 then return end
    local columns=math.clamp(math.floor((width+8)/158),2,6)
    local cell=math.floor((width-8*(columns-1))/columns)
    if columns==UI.CatalogColumns and cell==UI.CatalogCell then return end
    UI.CatalogColumns=columns; UI.CatalogCell=cell
    for _,layout in ipairs({UI.CatalogGridLayout,UI.CatalogFavLayout,UI.CatalogIdeasLayout}) do
        if layout then layout.FillDirectionMaxCells=columns; layout.CellSize=UDim2.fromOffset(cell,200) end
    end
end
-- A filter chip: the one in use is filled with the accent and edged.
function UI.chipState(chip,selected)
    chip.BackgroundColor3=selected and UI.C.AccentDark or UI.C.Raised; chip.TextColor3=selected and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted
    local edge=chip:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or UI.stroke(chip,0.7)
    edge.Color=selected and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Line; edge.Transparency=selected and 0.35 or 0.75
end
function UI.catalogChips()
    for name,chip in pairs(UI.CatalogChips) do UI.chipState(chip,name==UI.CatalogFilter) end
end
function UI.catalogSubs()
    local list=Catalog.Subs[UI.CatalogFilter]
    UI.clearRows("catalogSub",UI.CatalogSubRow)
    UI.CatalogSubRow.Visible=list~=nil
    if not list then return end
    for index,name in ipairs(list) do
        local selected=name==UI.CatalogSub
        local chip=UI.new("TextButton",{LayoutOrder=index,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,30),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,Text=Catalog.SubLabels[name] or name,Font=UI.Font.Bold,
            TextSize=UI.size(11),TextColor3=selected and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted,BackgroundColor3=selected and UI.C.AccentDark or UI.C.Raised,AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0},UI.CatalogSubRow)
        UI.round(chip,15); UI.new("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,12),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,12)},chip); UI.chipState(chip,selected)
        UI.rowConnect("catalogSub",chip.Activated,function() if UI.CatalogSub~=name then UI.CatalogSub=name; UI.catalogSubs(); UI.catalogSearch(false) end end)
    end
end
function UI.catalogSearch(more)
    local query=UI.CatalogQuery
    if more then
        if not query or query.Loading or query.Finished then return end
    else
        query={Keyword=UI.CatalogBox.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):sub(1,50),Category=UI.CatalogFilter,Sub=UI.CatalogSub,Sort=UI.CatalogSort,Price=UI.CatalogPrice}
        UI.CatalogQuery=query; UI.closeBundle()
        UI.catalogClear("catalog",UI.CatalogGrid); UI.CatalogCount=0
    end
    query.Loading=true; UI.CatalogMore.Root.Visible=false
    UI.setText(UI.CatalogStatus,more and "Loading more…" or "Searching the Roblox catalog…"); UI.CatalogStatus.TextColor3=UI.C.Muted
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,items=pcall(Catalog.search,query,more)
        if not App.alive() or UI.CatalogQuery~=query then return end
        query.Loading=false
        if not ok then
            UI.CatalogStatus.Text=tostring(items); UI.CatalogStatus.TextColor3=UI.C.Red
            UI.CatalogMore.Root.Visible=UI.CatalogCount>0 and not query.Finished and not UI.CatalogBundleItem
            return
        end
        for _,item in ipairs(items) do UI.CatalogCount=UI.CatalogCount+1; UI.catalogCard(item,UI.CatalogCount) end
        UI.catalogColumns()
        local sort=Catalog.option(Catalog.Sorts,query.Sort).Label
        UI.setText(UI.CatalogStatus,UI.CatalogCount==0 and "Nothing found. Try another name, filter or price."
            or (sort.."  ·  "..tostring(UI.CatalogCount).." items"..(query.Keyword~="" and (" for \""..query.Keyword.."\"") or "").."  ·  tap a BUNDLE to pick its parts"))
        UI.CatalogMore.Root.Visible=not query.Finished and not UI.CatalogBundleItem
    end)
end
-- One row of the bundle and Wearing lists: picture, title, detail and an Add / Remove button.
-- onCopy (Wearing list): a copy button that copies this item's "Label: id" line.
function UI.catalogItemRow(parent,order,item,title,detail,key,onCopy)
    local row=UI.card(parent,58); row.LayoutOrder=order
    local frame=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(42,42),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true},row); UI.round(frame,10)
    UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Image=UI.catalogThumb(item)},frame)
    local buttonWidth=UI.Compact and 86 or 104
    -- Star (and copy) sit left of the Add / Remove button.
    local right=buttonWidth+10+(onCopy and 80 or 40)
    local name=UI.text(row,title,13,nil,true); name.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(60,9); name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(68+right),0,20)
    local sub=UI.text(row,detail,11,UI.C.Muted); sub.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(60,30); sub.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(68+right),0,18)
    local holder=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.new(1,-(buttonWidth+10),0.5,-18),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(buttonWidth,36),BackgroundTransparency=1},row)
    UI.catalogAction(holder,key,item)
    local star=UI.shopStar(row,key,item,34); star.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-(buttonWidth+10+40),0.5,-17)
    if onCopy then
        local copy=UI.button(row,"",false,onCopy,"copy",key); copy.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(34,34); copy.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-(buttonWidth+10+80),0.5,-17)
    end
    return row,sub
end
function UI.openBundle(item)
    UI.CatalogBundleItem=item; UI.CatalogBundleData=nil
    UI.CatalogBundleToken=(UI.CatalogBundleToken or 0)+1; local token=UI.CatalogBundleToken
    UI.catalogClear("catalogBundle",UI.CatalogBundleBody)
    UI.CatalogGrid.Visible=false; UI.CatalogMore.Root.Visible=false; UI.CatalogBundle.Visible=true
    UI.CatalogPage.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
    local body=UI.CatalogBundleBody
    -- A clear way back to the results, first thing in the panel.
    local backRow=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=1,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40),BackgroundTransparency=1},body)
    local back=UI.button(backRow,"Back to results",false,UI.closeBundle,"arrow","catalogBundle"); back.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(176,40)
    if back.Icon then back.Icon.Rotation=180 end
    local head=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=2,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,64),BackgroundTransparency=1},body)
    local frame=UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(64,64),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true},head); UI.round(frame,12)
    UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Image=UI.catalogThumb(item)},frame)
    local title=UI.text(head,item.Name,15,nil,true); title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(76,8); title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,22)
    local caption=UI.text(head,(Catalog.BundleLabels[item.BundleKind] or "Bundle").."  ·  loading parts…",11,UI.C.Muted); caption.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(76,32); caption.Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,18)
    local star=UI.shopStar(head,"catalogBundle",item,36); star.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-38,0,14)
    local actions=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=3,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,42),BackgroundTransparency=1},body)
    local context={Id=item.Id,Name=item.Name,Bundle=true}
    UI.BundleAddAll=UI.button(actions,"Add all",true,function()
        local bundle=UI.CatalogBundleData; if not bundle then return end
        local worn,list=Catalog.worn(),{}
        for _,part in ipairs(bundle.Parts) do if not worn[part.Id] then table.insert(list,part) end end
        if #list>0 then UI.catalogRun(list,false,context) end
    end,"plus","catalogBundle"); UI.BundleAddAll.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-4,1,0)
    UI.BundleRemoveAll=UI.button(actions,"Remove all",false,function()
        local bundle=UI.CatalogBundleData; if not bundle then return end
        local worn,list=Catalog.worn(),{}
        for _,part in ipairs(bundle.Parts) do if worn[part.Id] then table.insert(list,part) end end
        if #list>0 then UI.catalogRun(list,true,context) end
    end,"trash-2","catalogBundle"); UI.BundleRemoveAll.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,4,0,0); UI.BundleRemoveAll.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-4,1,0)
    UI.enabled(UI.BundleAddAll,false); UI.enabled(UI.BundleRemoveAll,false)
    UI.paragraph(body,"Add every part at once, or tap Add on just the parts you want. A removed body part goes back to the default Roblox shape.",11,UI.C.Muted,false,4)
    local list=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=5,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},body); UI.stack(list,6)
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,bundle=pcall(Catalog.bundle,item.Id)
        if not App.alive() or token~=UI.CatalogBundleToken then return end
        if not ok then caption.Text=tostring(bundle); caption.TextColor3=UI.C.Red; return end
        UI.CatalogBundleData=bundle
        UI.setText(caption,(Catalog.BundleLabels[item.BundleKind] or "Bundle").."  ·  "..tostring(#bundle.Parts)..(#bundle.Parts==1 and " part" or " parts"))
        for index,part in ipairs(bundle.Parts) do UI.catalogItemRow(list,index,part,part.Kind and part.Kind.Label or "Item",part.Name,"catalogBundle") end
        if #bundle.Parts==0 then UI.emptyList(list,"No wearable parts","This bundle has no items that can be added to an avatar.") end
        UI.refreshCatalog()
    end)
end
function UI.closeBundle()
    UI.CatalogBundleToken=(UI.CatalogBundleToken or 0)+1
    UI.CatalogBundleItem=nil; UI.CatalogBundleData=nil; UI.BundleAddAll=nil; UI.BundleRemoveAll=nil
    UI.catalogClear("catalogBundle",UI.CatalogBundleBody)
    UI.CatalogBundle.Visible=false; UI.CatalogGrid.Visible=true
    local query=UI.CatalogQuery
    UI.CatalogMore.Root.Visible=query~=nil and not query.Finished and not query.Loading and UI.CatalogCount>0
end
-- Who is being customized: the copied profile, a saved skin or your own avatar.
function UI.catalogWho(base)
    local userId=base and (base.Id or base.ThumbId) or lp.UserId
    UI.CatalogWhoThumb.Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..tostring(userId).."&w=150&h=150"
    local name="your own avatar"
    if base and not base.Original then name=(tostring(base.Name or "this avatar"):gsub(" %(edited%)$","")) end
    UI.setText(UI.CatalogWhoTitle,"Customizing "..name)
end
-- Everything on the appearance being worn, grouped, each with a Remove button.
function UI.renderWearing()
    if not UI.CatalogWearList then return end
    local base=Catalog.base(); UI.CatalogWornFor=base
    UI.catalogWho(base)
    UI.catalogClear("catalogWear",UI.CatalogWearList)
    local rows={}
    for id,slot in pairs(Catalog.worn()) do
        local label,rank=Catalog.slotLabel(slot)
        table.insert(rows,{Id=id,Label=label,Rank=rank})
    end
    table.sort(rows,function(a,b) if a.Rank~=b.Rank then return a.Rank<b.Rank end return a.Id<b.Id end)
    local note=base and type(base.Data)=="table" and base.Data.Visual and "  ·  editing this saved skin rebuilds it from its items" or ""
    UI.setText(UI.CatalogWearCount,tostring(#rows)..(#rows==1 and " item" or " items").." on your current appearance"..note)
    local order,group=0,nil
    for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
        local current
        for _,candidate in ipairs(UI.CatalogGroups) do if row.Rank<=candidate.Max then current=candidate; break end end
        if current~=group then
            group=current; order=order+1
            local header=UI.text(UI.CatalogWearList,string.upper(current.Label),10,UI.C.Accent,true); header.LayoutOrder=order; header.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,22)
        end
        order=order+1
        local item={Id=row.Id}
        local _,sub=UI.catalogItemRow(UI.CatalogWearList,order,item,row.Label,"ID "..tostring(row.Id),"catalogWear",function()
            UI.copy(row.Label..": "..tostring(row.Id),row.Label.." ID",UI.CatalogIdBox)
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            local info=Catalog.info(row.Id)
            if info and type(info.Name)=="string" then
                item.Name=info.Name; item.Kind=Catalog.kind(info.AssetTypeId)
                if sub.Parent then sub.Text=info.Name.."  ·  ID "..tostring(row.Id) end
            end
        end)
    end
    UI.enabled(UI.CatalogCopyIds,#rows>0)
    if #rows==0 then UI.emptyList(UI.CatalogWearList,"No catalog items","Add items from Search and they will be listed here.") end
end
-- Shop favorites, newest first, as shop cards (Add / Remove and the star work as in Search).
function UI.renderShopFavorites()
    if not UI.CatalogFavGrid then return end
    UI.catalogClear("catalogFav",UI.CatalogFavGrid)
    local count=#Store.ShopFavorites
    for index,row in ipairs(Store.ShopFavorites) do UI.catalogCard(Catalog.fromFavorite(row),index,UI.CatalogFavGrid,"catalogFav") end
    UI.setText(UI.CatalogFavCount,count==0 and "" or (tostring(count)..(count==1 and " favorite" or " favorites").."  ·  tap the star on any item to add or remove it"))
    UI.CatalogFavEmpty.Visible=count==0
    UI.catalogColumns()
end
-- The last catalog change with its picture and an Undo button.
function UI.catalogUndoBar()
    local bar=UI.CatalogUndo
    if not bar then return end
    local current=App.Current
    local change=current and current.Change
    bar.Visible=change~=nil and #App.History>0
    if not bar.Visible then return end
    if UI.CatalogUndoFor~=current then
        UI.CatalogUndoFor=current
        UI.CatalogUndoThumb.Image=UI.catalogThumb({Id=change.Id,Bundle=change.Bundle})
        UI.CatalogUndoText.Text=change.Text
    end
    UI.enabled(UI.CatalogUndoButton,not App.Busy and not UI.CatalogPending)
end
function UI.refreshCatalog()
    if not UI.CatalogPage then return end
    for _,group in pairs(UI.CatalogCards) do for _,entry in ipairs(group) do if entry.Root.Parent then entry.update() end end end
    if UI.CatalogView=="Wearing" and UI.CatalogWornFor~=Catalog.base() then UI.renderWearing() end
    UI.catalogUndoBar()
    local bundle=UI.CatalogBundleData
    if bundle and UI.BundleAddAll then
        local worn,missing,wearing=Catalog.worn(),0,0
        for _,part in ipairs(bundle.Parts) do if worn[part.Id] then wearing=wearing+1 else missing=missing+1 end end
        local idle=not App.Busy and not UI.CatalogPending
        UI.enabled(UI.BundleAddAll,idle and missing>0); UI.enabled(UI.BundleRemoveAll,idle and wearing>0)
        UI.setText(UI.BundleAddAll.Label,missing>0 and ("Add all ("..tostring(missing)..")") or "All added")
    end
end
function UI.renderCatalog()
    if not UI.CatalogPage then return end
    local view=UI.CatalogView
    local search=view=="Search"
    UI.CatalogSearchView.Visible=search; UI.CatalogWearView.Visible=view=="Wearing"; UI.CatalogFavView.Visible=view=="Favorites"
    UI.CatalogEmoteView.Visible=view=="Emotes"; UI.CatalogIdeasView.Visible=view=="Ideas"
    UI.CatalogTabs.refresh()
    UI.catalogChips()
    if search then
        if not UI.CatalogQuery then UI.catalogSearch(false) end
--: YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
        UI.catalogColumns()
    elseif view=="Favorites" then UI.renderShopFavorites()
    elseif view=="Emotes" then UI.renderEmoteSets()
    elseif view=="Ideas" then UI.renderIdeas(false)
    else UI.renderWearing() end
    UI.refreshCatalog()
end
-- Trending here (see IDEAS), read when the Ideas view opens; again with Refresh, when it is opened a minute later, or
-- when another player's avatar is opened in Copy Avatar (then that avatar's items are listed instead, see FROM A PLAYER).
function UI.renderIdeas(force)
    if not UI.CatalogIdeasGrid then return end
    local player=Catalog.ideasPlayer()
    local key=player and ("user:"..tostring(player.Id)..":"..tostring(player.Live==true)) or "server"
    if not force and UI.CatalogIdeasAt and UI.CatalogIdeasKey==key and os.clock()-UI.CatalogIdeasAt<60 then UI.catalogColumns(); return end
    UI.CatalogIdeasAt=os.clock(); UI.CatalogIdeasKey=key
    UI.CatalogIdeasToken=(UI.CatalogIdeasToken or 0)+1
    local token=UI.CatalogIdeasToken
    UI.catalogClear("catalogIdeas",UI.CatalogIdeasGrid)
    local who=player and ("@"..tostring(player.Name or player.Id)) or nil
    UI.setText(UI.CatalogTrendTitle,who and ("FROM "..who) or "TRENDING HERE")
    UI.setText(UI.CatalogTrendStatus,who and "Looking at this avatar's items…" or "Looking at what the players here wear…"); UI.CatalogTrendStatus.TextColor3=UI.C.Muted
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,rows,players
        if player then ok,rows=pcall(Catalog.fromAvatar,player.Description,40)
        else ok,rows,players=pcall(Catalog.trending,24) end
        if not App.alive() or token~=UI.CatalogIdeasToken then return end
        if not ok then UI.CatalogTrendStatus.Text=tostring(rows); UI.CatalogTrendStatus.TextColor3=UI.C.Red; return end
        -- Names and prices come from the catalog, read side by side.
        local pending=#rows
        for _,row in ipairs(rows) do task.spawn(function() pcall(Catalog.info,row.Id); pending=pending-1 end) end
        local deadline=os.clock()+6
        while pending>0 and os.clock()<deadline and App.alive() do task.wait(0.1) end
        if not App.alive() or token~=UI.CatalogIdeasToken then return end
        local shown=0
        for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
            local info=Catalog.Info[row.Id] or nil
            local kind=row.Kind or (info and Catalog.kind(info.AssetTypeId))
            if kind then
                shown=shown+1
                local item={Id=row.Id,Name=info and info.Name or ("Item "..tostring(row.Id)),Kind=kind,
                    Caption=who and kind.Label or (kind.Label.."  ·  "..(row.Count==1 and "1 player here" or (tostring(row.Count).." players here")))}
                UI.catalogCard(item,shown,UI.CatalogIdeasGrid,"catalogIdeas")
            end
        end
        UI.catalogColumns(); UI.refreshCatalog()
        if who then
            UI.setText(UI.CatalogTrendStatus,shown==0 and "You already wear everything this avatar has."
                or (tostring(shown).." items from "..who.."'s avatar, to mix into yours"))
            return
        end
        UI.setText(UI.CatalogTrendStatus,players==0 and "No other players here yet. Trending shows what the players in this server wear."
            or shown==0 and "The players here wear nothing you don't have already."
            or (tostring(shown).." items worn by the "..tostring(players).." players here"))
    end)
end

-- One wheel slot: its number, the emote's picture and name (an empty slot shows only the number).
function UI.emoteSlot(parent,slot,name,id)
    local tile=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=slot,BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Base,BackgroundTransparency=0.35,BorderSizePixel=0},parent); UI.round(tile,12)
    local number=UI.text(tile,"",10,name and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Muted,true); number.Text=tostring(slot); number.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(7,3); number.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(20,16)
    if id then
        UI.new("ImageLabel",{Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-22,0,10),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,44),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            Image="rbxthumb://type=Asset&id="..string.format("%d",id).."&w=150&h=150"},tile)
    end
    local label=UI.text(tile,"",9,name and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted,false); label.Text=name or ""
    label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,58); label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,22); label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    label.TextScaled=true; UI.new("UITextSizeConstraint",{MaxTextSize=UI.size(9),MinTextSize=6},label)
    return tile
end
function UI.renderEmoteSets()
    if not UI.EmoteWheel then return end
    UI.clearRows("emoteWheel",UI.EmoteWheel); UI.clearRows("emoteSets",UI.EmoteSetList)
    local emotes,equipped=EmoteSets.wheel()
    local bySlot={}
    for _,row in ipairs(equipped) do bySlot[row.Slot]=row.Name end
    for slot=1,8 do
        local name=bySlot[slot]
        UI.emoteSlot(UI.EmoteWheel,slot,name,name and emotes[name] and Codec.id(emotes[name][1]))
    end
    local active=EmoteSets.active()
    UI.EmoteInUse.Text=""
    if active then UI.EmoteInUse.Text=Lang.text("In use")..": "..active.Name; UI.EmoteInUse.TextColor3=UI.C.Accent end
    UI.EmoteStop.Root.Visible=active~=nil
    UI.setText(UI.EmoteSetCount,"Saved sets: "..tostring(#Store.EmoteSets).."/20")
    for index,set in ipairs(Store.EmoteSets) do
        local using=active==set
        local card=UI.card(UI.EmoteSetList,74); card.LayoutOrder=index
        if using then local edge=card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"); edge.Color=UI.C.Accent; edge.Transparency=0 end
        local title=UI.text(card,"",13,using and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Text,true); title.Text=set.Name
        title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,8); title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(12+96+6+40+12),0,20)
        local strip=UI.strip(card,4); strip.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,34); strip.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(12+96+6+40+12),0,30)
        for order,row in ipairs(set.Equipped) do
            local ids=set.Emotes[row.Name]
            local id=ids and Codec.id(ids[1])
            local frame=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=order,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(30,30),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Base,BackgroundTransparency=0.35,BorderSizePixel=0},strip); UI.round(frame,8)
            if id then UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Image="rbxthumb://type=Asset&id="..string.format("%d",id).."&w=150&h=150"},frame) end
        end
        local use=UI.button(card,using and "In use" or "Use",not using,function()
            if using then return end
            EmoteSets.use(set); UI.renderEmoteSets(); UI.refreshCatalog()
            App.report("Emote set on your wheel: "..set.Name..".","success")
        end,using and "check" or nil,"emoteSets")
        use.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(96,38); use.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-(96+6+40+12),0.5,-19)
        if using then UI.setSelected(use,true) end
        local delete=UI.button(card,"",false,function()
            UI.confirm("Delete this emote set?","The set '"..set.Name.."' will be removed. The emotes stay in the catalog.",function()
                EmoteSets.remove(set.Key); UI.renderEmoteSets()
            end,{Confirm="Delete"})
        end,"trash-2","emoteSets")
        delete.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,38); delete.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-52,0.5,-19)
    end
    if #Store.EmoteSets==0 then UI.emptyList(UI.EmoteSetList,"No emote sets yet","Put emotes on your wheel, name the set above and tap Save set.") end
end

-- One adjustment line: name, value, minus and plus.
function UI.miniStepper(parent,order,label,get,set,step,low,high,format,key)
    local row=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=order,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,36),BackgroundTransparency=1},parent)
    local name=UI.text(row,label,12,UI.C.Muted,true); name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-156,1,0)
    local value=UI.text(row,"",12,UI.C.Text,true); value.Position=UDim2.new(1,-114,0,0); value.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(74,36); value.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    local function show() value.Text=format(get()) end
    local function change(direction)
        local wanted=math.clamp(get()+direction*step,low,high)
        set(math.floor(wanted*1000+0.5)/1000); show()
    end
    local minus=UI.button(row,"",false,function() change(-1) end,"minus",key); minus.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,36); minus.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-150,0,0)
    local plus=UI.button(row,"",false,function() change(1) end,"plus",key); plus.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,36); plus.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,0)
    show(); return show
end
function UI.tweakSummary(row,layered)
    if Tweaks.empty(row) then return "Not adjusted" end
    local parts={}
    local function moved(v) return v and (v[1]~=0 or v[2]~=0 or v[3]~=0) end
    if not layered and moved(row.P) then table.insert(parts,"moved") end
    if not layered and moved(row.R) then table.insert(parts,"turned") end
    if not layered and row.S and row.S~=1 then table.insert(parts,tostring(math.floor(row.S*100+0.5)).."% size") end
    if row.T and row.T>=1 then table.insert(parts,"hidden") elseif row.T and row.T>0 then table.insert(parts,tostring(math.floor(row.T*100+0.5)).."% faded") end
    return #parts>0 and table.concat(parts,"  ·  ") or "Not adjusted"
end

        end)

    add(UI.section(page,"Body size","Pick the sizes, then tap Apply. A saved skin is rebuilt from its items, so custom details may change."))

            or {0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.85,0.9,0.95,1,1.05,1.1,1.2,1.3,1.5,1.75,2}
        UI.BodyDraft[key]=UI.BodyDraft[key] or 1

    local rig=UI.dropdown(rigCard,{{Value="Auto",Label="Same as the game"},{Value="R15",Label="R15"},{Value="R6",Label="R6"}},function() return Store.Settings.VisualRig end,function(value)
        Store.Settings.VisualRig=value; App.persist()
        if Overlay.visualOnly() then
            if App.Current and not App.Current.Original then task.spawn(App.applySnapshot,App.Current,"reapply") end
        elseif value~="Auto" then

            UI.confirm("Turn on Visual-only?","The game decides your character's rig, so an "..value.." avatar can only be drawn over your character. Visual-only does that and leaves the character itself untouched.",function()
                Store.Settings.VisualOnly=true; App.persist()
                if UI.Toggles and UI.Toggles.VisualOnly then UI.Toggles.VisualOnly() end
                App.switchVisualOnly(true)
            end,{Confirm="Turn on"})

    end)
    rig.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(150,40); rig.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-162,0.5,-20)

    add(UI.section(page,"Items","Move, turn, resize or fade single items. Effects such as fire and sparkles keep their size, so a tiny or hidden item still shows its effect."))
    UI.CustomizeItems=add(UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},page)); UI.stack(UI.CustomizeItems,6)
    add(UI.section(page,"Clothing layers","Layered clothing, outermost first. Move a layer up to wear it over the others."))
    UI.CustomizeLayers=add(UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},page)); UI.stack(UI.CustomizeLayers,6)
    UI.clearRows("customizeItems",UI.CustomizeItems); UI.clearRows("customizeLayers",UI.CustomizeLayers)
end
function UI.renderCustomize()
    if not UI.CustomizePage then return end
    UI.CustomizeFor=App.Current
    local base=Catalog.base()
    UI.CustomizeThumb.Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..tostring(base and (base.Id or base.ThumbId) or lp.UserId).."&w=150&h=150"
    local name=base and not base.Original and tostring(base.Name or "this avatar"):gsub(" %(edited%)$","") or nil
    UI.setText(UI.CustomizeTitle,name and ("Customizing "..name) or "Customizing your own avatar")
    local look=App.Current and App.Current.LookKey and Looks.find(App.Current.LookKey)
    UI.setText(UI.CustomizeHint,look and ("Saved skin: item changes are kept with it.") or "Save the result as a skin to keep it.")
    UI.enabled(UI.CustomizeUpdate,look~=nil)
    for key,value in pairs(Customize.scales()) do UI.BodyDraft[key]=value end
    for _,field in ipairs(UI.BodyFields) do local show=UI.Steppers and UI.Steppers[field[1]]; if show then show() end end
    UI.renderCustomizeItems(); UI.renderCustomizeLayers()
end
function UI.renderCustomizeItems()
    if not UI.CustomizeItems then return end
    UI.clearRows("customizeItems",UI.CustomizeItems)
    local rows=Customize.items()
    if #rows==0 then
        UI.emptyList(UI.CustomizeItems,"No items to adjust",App.Current and not App.Current.Original and "This avatar has no accessories." or "Wear an avatar or a saved skin first; the items of your own avatar can be adjusted too.")
        return
    end
    local pictures={}
    for index,row in ipairs(rows) do
        local tweak=Customize.tweak(row.Name)
        local selected=UI.CustomizeSelected==row.Name
        local card=UI.card(UI.CustomizeItems,58); card.LayoutOrder=index*2
        if selected then local stroke=card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"); stroke.Color=UI.C.Accent; stroke.Transparency=0 end
        local frame=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(42,42),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true},card); UI.round(frame,10)
        UI.icon(frame,"shirt",UDim2.new(0.5,-12,0.5,-12),UI.C.AccentDark)
        pictures[row.Name]=UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Visible=false},frame)
        local title=UI.text(card,row.Name,13,nil,true); title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(60,9); title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-180,0,20)
        local sub=UI.text(card,(row.Layered and "Layered clothing" or row.Type).."  ·  "..UI.tweakSummary(tweak,row.Layered),11,UI.C.Muted); sub.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(60,30); sub.Size=UDim2.new(1,-180,0,18)
        local edit=UI.button(card,selected and "Done" or "Adjust",selected,function()
            UI.CustomizeSelected=not selected and row.Name or nil; UI.renderCustomizeItems()
        end,nil,"customizeItems"); edit.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(104,38); edit.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-114,0.5,-19)
        if selected then UI.tweakEditor(row,index*2+1,sub) end
    end
    -- An item whose name matches a worn catalog item gets its picture.
    task.spawn(function()
        for id,slot in pairs(Catalog.worn()) do
            if slot.Accessory then
                local info=Catalog.info(id); local picture=info and pictures[info.Name]
                if picture and picture.Parent then picture.Image=UI.catalogThumb({Id=id}); picture.Visible=true end
            end
        end
    end)
end
function UI.tweakEditor(row,order,sub)
    local panel=UI.autoCard(UI.CustomizeItems,order,2,10); panel.BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised
    local tweak=Customize.tweak(row.Name)
    local function commit()
        if not Customize.setTweak(row.Name,tweak) then App.report("Wait for the current change to finish.","warning") end
        UI.setText(sub,(row.Layered and "Layered clothing" or row.Type).."  ·  "..UI.tweakSummary(tweak,row.Layered))
    end
    local index=0
    local function control(label,get,set,step,low,high,format)
        index=index+1
        UI.miniStepper(panel,index,label,get,function(value) set(value); commit() end,step,low,high,format,"customizeItems")
    end
    local function studs(v) return string.format("%.2f",v) end
    local function degrees(v) return tostring(math.floor(v+0.5)).."°" end
    local function percent(v) return tostring(math.floor(v*100+0.5)).."%" end
    if not row.Layered then
        for axis,label in ipairs({"Move left / right","Move up / down","Move back / front"}) do
            control(label,function() return (tweak.P or {0,0,0})[axis] end,function(v) tweak.P=tweak.P or {0,0,0}; tweak.P[axis]=v end,0.05,-Tweaks.Limits.Move,Tweaks.Limits.Move,studs)
        end
        for axis,label in ipairs({"Tilt","Turn","Roll"}) do
            control(label,function() return (tweak.R or {0,0,0})[axis] end,function(v) tweak.R=tweak.R or {0,0,0}; tweak.R[axis]=v end,5,-Tweaks.Limits.Turn,Tweaks.Limits.Turn,degrees)
        end
        control("Size",function() return tweak.S or 1 end,function(v) tweak.S=v end,0.05,Tweaks.Limits.SizeMin,Tweaks.Limits.SizeMax,percent)
    else
        index=index+1; UI.paragraph(panel,"Layered clothing is fitted to the body, so it can only fade.",11,UI.C.Muted,false,index)
    end
    control("Fade",function() return tweak.T or 0 end,function(v) tweak.T=v end,0.1,0,1,percent)
    index=index+1
    local buttons=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=index,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40),BackgroundTransparency=1},panel)
    local hide=UI.button(buttons,(tweak.T or 0)>=1 and "Show item" or "Hide item, keep effects",false,function()
        tweak.T=(tweak.T or 0)>=1 and 0 or 1; commit(); UI.renderCustomizeItems()
    end,"eye-off","customizeItems"); hide.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.62,-4,1,0)
    local reset=UI.button(buttons,"Reset",false,function()
        tweak={}; commit(); UI.renderCustomizeItems()
    end,"reset","customizeItems"); reset.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0.62,4,0,0); reset.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.38,-4,1,0)
end
function UI.renderCustomizeLayers()
    if not UI.CustomizeLayers then return end
    UI.clearRows("customizeLayers",UI.CustomizeLayers)
    local rows=Customize.layers()
    if #rows==0 then UI.emptyList(UI.CustomizeLayers,"No layered clothing","Layered jackets, shirts, pants and shoes of the avatar appear here.") return end
    local count=#rows
    for position=1,count do
        local index=count-position+1
        local row=rows[index]
        local card=UI.card(UI.CustomizeLayers,54); card.LayoutOrder=position
        local frame=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,6),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(42,42),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true},card); UI.round(frame,10)
        if row.Id then UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Image=UI.catalogThumb({Id=row.Id})},frame)
        else UI.icon(frame,"shirt",UDim2.new(0.5,-12,0.5,-12),UI.C.AccentDark) end
        local title=UI.text(card,row.Name,13,nil,true); title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(60,8); title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-160,0,20)
        local hint=position==1 and "Outermost" or position==count and "Closest to the body" or ("Layer "..tostring(index))
        local sub=UI.text(card,hint,11,UI.C.Muted); sub.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(60,28); sub.Size=UDim2.new(1,-160,0,18)
        local up=UI.button(card,"",false,function() if not App.Busy then task.spawn(Customize.moveLayer,index,1) end end,"chevron-up","customizeLayers")
        up.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,38); up.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-92,0.5,-19); UI.enabled(up,index<count)
        local down=UI.button(card,"",false,function() if not App.Busy then task.spawn(Customize.moveLayer,index,-1) end end,"chevron-down","customizeLayers")
        down.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,38); down.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-48,0.5,-19); UI.enabled(down,index>1)
        if row.Id then
            task.spawn(function()
                local info=Catalog.info(row.Id)
                if info and type(info.Name)=="string" and title.Parent then title.Text=info.Name end
            end)
        end
    end
end
