end

function UI.toggle(parent,title,description,key,onChange,store)
    store=store or Store.Settings
    local card=UI.controlCard(parent,title,description,58)
    local button=UI.new("TextButton",{Position=UDim2.new(1,-62,0.5,-15),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(50,30),Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0},card); UI.round(button,30)
    local knob=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(22,22),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Text,BorderSizePixel=0},button); UI.round(knob,22)
    local function refresh()
        local val=store[key]
        UI.tween(button,{BackgroundColor3=val and UI.C.AccentDark or UI.C.Raised})
        UI.tween(knob,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(val and 24 or 4,4),BackgroundColor3=val and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted})
    end
    UI.connect(button.Activated,function() store[key]=not store[key]; refresh(); if onChange then onChange(store[key]) end; App.persist() end)
    UI.Toggles=UI.Toggles or {}; UI.Toggles[(store==Store.Auto and "Auto." or "")..key]=refresh
    refresh(); return card
end
-- Live status of every way to bring the hidden window back, so a player can see what works on this device.
function UI.reopenCard(parent)
    local card=UI.autoCard(parent,0,6,14)
    UI.ReopenRows={}
    for index=1,4 do
        local row=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=index,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,22),BackgroundTransparency=1},card)
        local name=UI.text(row,"",12,UI.C.Text,true); name.Size=UDim2.new(0.58,0,1,0)
        local state=UI.text(row,"",12,UI.C.Muted,true); state.Position=UDim2.new(0.58,0,0,0); state.Size=UDim2.new(0.42,0,1,0); state.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        UI.ReopenRows[index]={Name=name,State=state}
    end
    UI.ReopenWarning=UI.paragraph(card,"",11,UI.C.Gold,true,10)
    return card
end
function UI.refreshReopenCard()
    if not UI.ReopenRows then return end
    local orb,menu,keyboard=Store.Settings.MobileOrb==true,Store.Settings.MenuReopen==true,UIS.KeyboardEnabled
    local chat=UI.ChatOK==false and {"Blocked on this account",UI.C.Gold} or UI.ChatOK==true and {"Ready",UI.C.Green} or UI.ChatChecked and {"Not detected",UI.C.Muted} or {"Checking…",UI.C.Muted}
    local rows={
        {"Floating button",orb and "On" or "Off",orb and UI.C.Green or UI.C.Muted},
        {"Roblox menu shortcut",menu and "On" or "Off",menu and UI.C.Green or UI.C.Muted},
        {"Shortcut key ("..Store.Settings.Keybind..")",keyboard and "Ready" or "No keyboard",keyboard and UI.C.Green or UI.C.Gold},
        {"Chat  /e copier",chat[1],chat[2]},
    }
    for index,row in ipairs(rows) do
        local entry=UI.ReopenRows[index]
        entry.Name.Text=row[1]; entry.State.Text=row[2]; entry.State.TextColor3=row[3]
    end
    UI.setText(UI.ReopenWarning,UI.canReopen() and "" or "Nothing can reopen the window right now. Turn on the floating button or the Roblox menu shortcut.")
    UI.ReopenWarning.Visible=not UI.canReopen()
end
-- A group of options that stays folded until opened (progressive disclosure), so a page starts short.
function UI.collapsible(parent)
    local holder=UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},parent)
    UI.stack(holder,6)
    local body=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=2,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false},holder)
    UI.stack(body,6)
    local head
    head=UI.button(holder,"Show advanced options",false,function()
        body.Visible=not body.Visible
        UI.setText(head.Label,body.Visible and "Hide advanced options" or "Show advanced options")
        if head.Icon then head.Icon.Rotation=body.Visible and 180 or 0 end
    end,"chevron-down")
    head.Root.LayoutOrder=1
    return holder,body
end

-- AUTO & CYCLE page
UI.AutoLabels={LoadSource={Chosen="Chosen avatar",Last="Last applied",Random="Random favorite",Cycle="Cycle position"},
    Trigger={Death="On death",Respawn="On respawn",Timer="On a timer",Both="Death or timer"},
    Order={Sequential="In order",Shuffle="Shuffle",Random="Random",PingPong="Ping-pong"},
--[==[YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE]==]
    EndAction={Loop="Start over",Stop="Stay on last",Restore="Restore mine"}}
function UI.duration(seconds)
    if seconds<60 then return tostring(seconds).." s" end
    if seconds%60==0 then return tostring(seconds/60).." min" end
    return string.format("%d:%02d",math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60)
end
function UI.clock(seconds)
    seconds=math.max(0,math.ceil(seconds))
    return string.format("%d:%02d",math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60)
end
-- A settings card with a control on the right; the description wraps under the title.
function UI.controlCard(parent,title,description,controlWidth)
    -- Compact: the card grows with its title and description (both wrap, so longer languages fit), from 58 px.
    local card=UI.card(parent,58)
    local column=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,8),Size=UDim2.new(1,-(controlWidth+26),0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},card)
    UI.new("UIListLayout",{SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Padding=UDim.new(0,3)},column)
    local name=UI.text(column,title,13,nil,true); name.LayoutOrder=1; name.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); name.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    name.TextWrapped=true; name.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None; name.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    local hint=UI.text(column,description,11,UI.C.Muted); hint.LayoutOrder=2; hint.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); hint.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    hint.TextWrapped=true; hint.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None; hint.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    card.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; UI.new("UIPadding",{PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,9)},card)
    return card
end
-- A dropdown with every option of an Auto & Cycle mode.
function UI.choice(parent,title,description,key,onChange)
    local card=UI.controlCard(parent,title,description,150)
    local options={}
    for _,value in ipairs(Store.AutoOptions[key]) do table.insert(options,{Value=value,Label=UI.AutoLabels[key][value]}) end
    local drop=UI.dropdown(card,options,function() return Store.Auto[key] end,function(value)
        Store.Auto[key]=value
        if onChange then onChange(value) end
        App.persist(); UI.renderAuto()
    end)
    drop.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(150,40); drop.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-162,0.5,-20)
    UI.Choices=UI.Choices or {}; UI.Choices[key]=drop
    return card
end
function UI.stepper(parent,title,description,key,values,format,store,onChange)
    store=store or Store.Auto
    local card=UI.controlCard(parent,title,description,140)
    local box=UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(140,38),Position=UDim2.new(1,-152,0.5,-19),BackgroundTransparency=1},card)
    local value=UI.text(box,"",13,nil,true); value.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(38,0); value.Size=UDim2.new(1,-76,1,0); value.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    local function show() UI.setText(value,format(store[key])) end
    local function step(direction)
        local index=1
        for i,item in ipairs(values) do if item<=store[key] then index=i end end
        store[key]=values[math.clamp(index+direction,1,#values)]; show(); App.persist()
        if store==Store.Auto then UI.renderAuto() end
        if onChange then onChange(store[key]) end
    end
    local minus=UI.button(box,"",false,function() step(-1) end,"minus"); minus.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,38)
    local plus=UI.button(box,"",false,function() step(1) end,"plus"); plus.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,38); plus.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,0)
    UI.Steppers=UI.Steppers or {}; UI.Steppers[key]=show
    show(); return card
end
-- Picks an avatar from the current preview (profile or saved skin) or from what you are wearing.
function UI.entryCard(parent,order,title,hint,get,set)
    local card=UI.autoCard(parent,order,8,14)
    UI.paragraph(card,title,13,UI.C.Text,true,1)
    UI.paragraph(card,hint,11,UI.C.Muted,false,2)
    local value=UI.paragraph(card,"",13,UI.C.Accent,true,3)
    local row=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=4,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40),BackgroundTransparency=1},card)
    local function choose(entry,missing)
        if not entry then App.report(missing,"warning"); return end
        set(entry); App.persist(); UI.renderAuto(); App.report(title..": "..Auto.name(entry)..".","success")
    end
    local preview=UI.button(row,"Preview",false,function() choose(Auto.entryFrom(App.Preview),"Preview a profile or a saved skin first.") end,"box")
    preview.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.38,-6,1,0)
    local current=UI.button(row,"Current",false,function() choose(Auto.entryFrom(App.Current),"Apply a profile or a saved skin first.") end,"user")
    current.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0.38,0,0,0); current.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.38,-6,1,0)
    local clear=UI.button(row,"Clear",false,function() set(nil); App.persist(); UI.renderAuto() end)
    clear.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0.76,0,0,0); clear.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.24,0,1,0)
    table.insert(UI.AutoEntryLabels,{Label=value,Get=get})
    return card
end
function UI.addCycle(entry)
    if not entry then return false end
    for _,row in ipairs(Store.Auto.List) do if Auto.same(row,entry) then return false end end
    if #Store.Auto.List>=50 then return false end
    table.insert(Store.Auto.List,entry); return true
end
function UI.buildAuto()

    UI.ThumbWorld=UI.new("WorldModel",{},UI.new("ViewportFrame",{Visible=false},UI.Gui))
    local order=0
    local function add(item) order=order+1; item.LayoutOrder=order; return item end
    local function resetCycle() Auto.DeathsSince=0; Auto.TimerStart=os.clock(); Auto.Pending=nil; table.clear(Auto.Bag); Auto.Direction=1 end
    UI.AutoEntryLabels={}
    add(UI.section(page,"Auto & Cycle","Put an avatar on automatically when the script runs, and rotate through a list of avatars while you play."))
    add(UI.section(page,"Auto-load on execute"))
    add(UI.toggle(page,"Apply an avatar on start","Puts an avatar on as soon as the script runs and your character is ready.","LoadEnabled",nil,Store.Auto))
    add(UI.choice(page,"Which avatar to apply","The chosen avatar, the last one you wore, a random favorite or the cycle's current one. An avatar set for this game always wins.","LoadSource"))
    order=order+1; UI.entryCard(page,order,"Chosen avatar","Used when \"Avatar to load\" is Chosen avatar. Preview a profile or saved skin, then tap Preview.",
        function() return Store.Auto.Chosen end,function(entry) Store.Auto.Chosen=entry end)
    local place=tostring(game.PlaceId)
    order=order+1; UI.entryCard(page,order,"This game only","Overrides the avatar to load whenever you play this experience (place "..place..").",
        function() return Store.Auto.Games[place] end,function(entry) Store.Auto.Games[place]=entry end)
    add(UI.stepper(page,"Delay before loading","Waits after your character spawns, for games that change your look on spawn.","LoadDelay",{0,1,2,3,5,8,10,15,20,30},UI.duration))
    UI.AutoLast=add(UI.text(page,"",11,UI.C.Muted)); UI.AutoLast.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,20)

    add(UI.section(page,"Avatar cycle"))
    add(UI.toggle(page,"Cycle avatars","Switches to the next avatar in your list on its own.","CycleEnabled",function() resetCycle(); UI.renderAuto() end,Store.Auto))
    -- Cycle details are folded: most people only need the toggle and the list.
    local advHolder,advBody=UI.collapsible(page); add(advHolder)
    local advOrder=0
    local function addAdv(item) advOrder=advOrder+1; item.LayoutOrder=advOrder; return item end

    addAdv(UI.choice(advBody,"At the end of the list","For In order: start over, stay on the last avatar, or go back to your own avatar.","EndAction"))
    addAdv(UI.stepper(advBody,"Cooldown","Minimum time between two switches, so quick deaths don't skip avatars.","Cooldown",{0,1,2,3,5,10,15,20,30,45,60,90,120,180,300},UI.duration))
    addAdv(UI.toggle(advBody,"Remember position","Continues from the same avatar the next time you run the script.","Resume",nil,Store.Auto))
    addAdv(UI.toggle(advBody,"Notify on switch","Shows a small notification with the new avatar's name. Needs Show notifications on in Settings.","Notify",nil,Store.Auto))

    local status=add(UI.autoCard(page,0,8,14))
    UI.paragraph(status,"CYCLE STATUS",10,UI.C.Accent,true,1)
    UI.CycleStatus=UI.paragraph(status,"",13,UI.C.Text,true,2)
    UI.CycleDetail=UI.paragraph(status,"",11,UI.C.Muted,false,3)
    local controls=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=4,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40),BackgroundTransparency=1},status)
    UI.CyclePrev=UI.button(controls,"Previous",false,function() Auto.switchNow(-1) end,"undo"); UI.CyclePrev.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.36,-6,1,0)

        resetCycle(); Auto.Deaths=0; Store.Auto.Index=0; App.persist(); UI.renderAuto()
        App.report("Cycle counters reset. The next switch starts at the top of the list.","info")
    end); reset.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0.72,0,0,0); reset.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.28,0,1,0)

    add(UI.section(page,"Cycle list","Up to 50 profiles or saved skins. Drag the number or picture to reorder; tap Wear to jump to one now."))
    local tools=add(UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,92),BackgroundTransparency=1},page))
    local function added(entry,missing)
        if not entry then App.report(missing,"warning"); return end
        if UI.addCycle(entry) then App.persist(); UI.renderAuto(); App.report(Auto.name(entry).." added to the cycle.","success")
        else App.report(#Store.Auto.List>=50 and "The cycle list is full (50)." or "That avatar is already in the cycle.","warning") end
    end
    local addPreview=UI.button(tools,"Add preview",false,function() added(Auto.entryFrom(App.Preview),"Preview a profile or a saved skin first.") end,"plus")
    addPreview.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-6,0,42)
    local addCurrent=UI.button(tools,"Add current",false,function() added(Auto.entryFrom(App.Current),"Apply a profile or a saved skin first.") end,"user")
    addCurrent.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,6,0,0); addCurrent.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-6,0,42)
    local addFavorites=UI.button(tools,"Add favorites",false,function()
        local count=0
        for _,row in ipairs(Store.Favorites) do if UI.addCycle(Store.entry({Kind="User",Id=row.Id,Name=row.Name,DisplayName=row.DisplayName})) then count=count+1 end end
        if count>0 then App.persist() end; UI.renderAuto()
        App.report(count>0 and (tostring(count).." favorites added to the cycle.") or "No new favorites to add.",count>0 and "success" or "info")
    end,"star"); addFavorites.Root.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,50); addFavorites.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-6,0,42)
    UI.CycleClear=UI.button(tools,"Clear list",false,function()
        UI.confirm("Clear the cycle list?","Every avatar is removed from the cycle. Your current appearance is unchanged.",function()
            Store.Auto.List={}; Store.Auto.Index=0; resetCycle(); App.persist(); UI.renderAuto()
        end)
    end,"trash-2"); UI.CycleClear.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,6,0,50); UI.CycleClear.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-6,0,42)
    UI.CycleCount=add(UI.text(page,"",11,UI.C.Muted)); UI.CycleCount.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,20)
    UI.CycleList=add(UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},page)); UI.stack(UI.CycleList,6)
    add(UI.paragraph(page,"Chat shortcuts: /e next, /e prev, and /e cycle to turn the cycle on or off.",11,UI.C.Muted,false,0))
    Auto.OnChange=function() if App.alive() and UI.Tab=="Auto" then UI.renderAuto() end end
    Auto.OnTick=function() if UI.Tab=="Auto" and UI.Visible then UI.autoStatus() end end
    UI.renderAuto()
end
-- Cycle thumbnails: profiles use the Roblox headshot; saved skins are rendered once (one at a time) and cached as a posed template.
UI.ThumbCache={}; UI.ThumbQueue={}
function UI.runThumbQueue()
    if UI.ThumbBusy then return end
    UI.ThumbBusy=true
    task.spawn(function()
        while App.alive() and #UI.ThumbQueue>0 do
            local job=table.remove(UI.ThumbQueue,1)
            local slot=UI.ThumbCache[job.Id]
            local row=Looks.find(job.Key)
            local model
            local ok,err=pcall(function()
                assert(row,"The saved skin no longer exists.")
                local desc=Codec.decode(row.Data)
                local rig=row.Data.Visual and Enum.HumanoidRigType[row.Data.Visual.RigType] or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
                local built,made=pcall(Visual.model,row.Data,desc,rig); desc:Destroy()
                assert(built and made,tostring(made))
                model=made
                UI.preparePreview(model,UI.ThumbWorld)
                -- A client-made SurfaceAppearance cannot load its PBR maps, and every clone of it logs a
                -- warning; the thumbnail is tiny, so its colour map becomes the mesh texture instead.
                for _,item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if item:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                        local part=item.Parent
                        pcall(function() if part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.TextureID=="" and item.ColorMap~="" then part.TextureID=item.ColorMap end end)
                        item:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                model.Archivable=true
                for _,item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do pcall(function() item.Archivable=true end) end
            end)
            if ok then slot.Model=model
            else
                slot.Failed=true
                if model then pcall(function() model:Destroy() end) end
                warn("[Lyra Thumbnail] "..tostring(err))
            end
            for _,show in ipairs(slot.Waiters) do pcall(show,slot.Model) end
            slot.Waiters={}
        end
        UI.ThumbBusy=false
    end)
end
function UI.lookThumb(frame,key)
    local row=Looks.find(key)
    local placeholder=UI.icon(frame,"shirt",UDim2.new(0.5,-12,0.5,-12),UI.C.AccentDark)
    if not row then return end
    local viewport=UI.new("ViewportFrame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(195,186,213),LightColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,233),LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-1,-1)},frame)
    local function show(template)
        if not template or not viewport.Parent or not App.alive() then return end
        local ok=pcall(function()
            local model=template:Clone(); model.Parent=viewport
            local head=model:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local focus=head and head.Position or model:GetBoundingBox().Position
            local size=head and math.max(head.Size.X,head.Size.Y,0.6) or 2
            local camera=UI.new("Camera",{FieldOfView=30},viewport); viewport.CurrentCamera=camera
            -- The rig faces -Z after preparePreview, so the camera sits in front of the face.
            camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(focus+Vector3.new(0,size*0.12,-size*3.4),focus)
        end)
        if ok then placeholder:Destroy() end
    end
    -- Updating a skin changes its timestamp, which invalidates the cached thumbnail.
    local id=key..":"..tostring(row.Updated)
    local slot=UI.ThumbCache[id]
    if slot and slot.Model then show(slot.Model); return end
    if slot and slot.Failed then return end
    if not slot then
        slot={Waiters={}}; UI.ThumbCache[id]=slot
        table.insert(UI.ThumbQueue,{Id=id,Key=key}); UI.runThumbQueue()
    end
    table.insert(slot.Waiters,show)
end
function UI.cycleThumb(parent,entry)
    local frame=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(43,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,44),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true},parent); UI.round(frame,12)
    if entry.Kind=="User" and entry.Id then
        UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..tostring(entry.Id).."&w=150&h=150"},frame)
    elseif entry.Kind=="Look" then UI.lookThumb(frame,entry.Key)
    else UI.icon(frame,"user",UDim2.new(0.5,-12,0.5,-12),UI.C.AccentDark) end
    return frame
end
-- Drag the number/picture of a row to move it. A line marks where it will land; the list scrolls near the edges.
UI.CycleStep=64 -- row height 58 + list gap 6
function UI.startCycleDrag(index,row,input)
    if UI.CycleDrag or #Store.Auto.List<2 or not UI.AutoPage then return end
    local touch=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
    local drag={From=index,Slot=nil,Connections={}}
    UI.CycleDrag=drag
    UI.AutoPage.ScrollingEnabled=false
    local stroke=row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if stroke then stroke.Color=UI.C.Accent; stroke.Transparency=0 end
    row.BackgroundTransparency=0.55
    local width=UI.CycleList.AbsoluteSize.X
    drag.Line=UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,3),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Accent,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=40},UI.Surface); UI.round(drag.Line,2)
    drag.Ghost=UI.new("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(260,width-24),36),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.AccentDark,BackgroundTransparency=0.05,TextColor3=UI.C.Text,
        Text="  "..Auto.name(Store.Auto.List[index]),Font=UI.Font.Bold,TextSize=UI.size(13),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=41,BorderSizePixel=0},UI.Surface)
    UI.round(drag.Ghost,10); UI.stroke(drag.Ghost,0.2,UI.C.Accent)
    local function update(y)
        local list=UI.CycleList; local top=list.AbsolutePosition.Y; local surface=UI.Surface.AbsolutePosition
        -- Rows live inside the scaled window, so one step on screen is CycleStep times the window scale.
        local step=UI.CycleStep*(UI.CurrentScale or 1)
        drag.Slot=math.clamp(math.floor((y-top)/step+0.5),0,#Store.Auto.List)
        drag.Line.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(list.AbsolutePosition.X-surface.X,top+drag.Slot*step-4-surface.Y)
        drag.Ghost.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(list.AbsolutePosition.X-surface.X+12,y-18-surface.Y)
        local page=UI.AutoPage; local pageTop=page.AbsolutePosition.Y; local pageBottom=pageTop+page.AbsoluteSize.Y
        if y<pageTop+48 then page.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,page.CanvasPosition.Y-14))
        elseif y>pageBottom-48 then page.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,page.CanvasPosition.Y+14) end
    end
    local function finish()
        for _,connection in ipairs(drag.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        UI.CycleDrag=nil
        pcall(function() drag.Line:Destroy(); drag.Ghost:Destroy() end)
        if UI.AutoPage then UI.AutoPage.ScrollingEnabled=true end
        if drag.Slot and App.alive() then
            -- Slot s is the gap before item s+1 in the original order.
            local target=drag.Slot>=drag.From and drag.Slot or drag.Slot+1
            if Auto.move(drag.From,target) then App.persist() end
        end
-- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
        if App.alive() then UI.renderAuto() end
    end
    table.insert(drag.Connections,RegisterConnection(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(changed)
        if touch and changed~=touch then return end
        if not touch and changed.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
        update(changed.Position.Y)
    end)))
    table.insert(drag.Connections,RegisterConnection(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended)
        if (touch and ended==touch) or (not touch and ended.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then finish() end
    end)))
    update(input.Position.Y)
end
function UI.cycleRow(entry,index)
    local list=Store.Auto.List
    local current=index==Store.Auto.Index
    local row=UI.card(UI.CycleList,58); row.LayoutOrder=index
    if current then local stroke=row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"); stroke.Color=UI.C.Accent; stroke.Transparency=0.1 end
    local badge=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(9,15),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(28,28),BackgroundColor3=current and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0},row); UI.round(badge,9)
    local number=UI.text(badge,tostring(index),12,current and UI.C.Base or UI.C.Text,true); number.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); number.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    UI.cycleThumb(row,entry)
    local controls=58+6+40+12
    local title=UI.text(row,Auto.name(entry),13,nil,true); title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(96,7); title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(96+controls),0,22)
    local sub=UI.text(row,(entry.Kind=="Look" and "Saved skin" or "Roblox profile")..(current and "  ·  wearing now" or ""),11,current and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Muted); sub.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(96,30); sub.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(96+controls),0,20)
    -- Transparent grip over the number and picture.
    local grip=UI.new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.new(0,92,1,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0},row)
    UI.rowConnect("cycle",grip.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then UI.startCycleDrag(index,row,input) end
    end)
    local wear=UI.button(row,"Wear",false,function() Auto.switchNow(1,index) end,nil,"cycle")
    wear.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(58,38); wear.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-controls,0.5,-19)
    local remove=UI.button(row,"",false,function()
        table.remove(list,index)
        if Store.Auto.Index>=index then Store.Auto.Index=math.max(0,Store.Auto.Index-1) end
        table.clear(Auto.Bag); App.persist(); UI.renderAuto()
    end,"x","cycle"); remove.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,38); remove.Root.Position=UDim2.new(1,-52,0.5,-19)
end
function UI.autoStatus()
    if not UI.CycleStatus then return end
    local auto=Store.Auto; local count=#auto.List
    local wearing=(auto.Index>=1 and auto.Index<=count) and (tostring(auto.Index).."/"..tostring(count).."  ·  "..Auto.name(auto.List[auto.Index])) or nil
    local detail
    if not auto.CycleEnabled then
        UI.setText(UI.CycleStatus,"Cycle is off")
        detail=count==0 and "Add avatars below, then turn on Cycle avatars." or ("Avatars ready: "..tostring(count)..(wearing and ("  ·  last: "..wearing) or ""))
    elseif count==0 then
        UI.setText(UI.CycleStatus,"Cycle is on, but the list is empty"); detail="Add avatars to the cycle list below."
    else
        UI.setText(UI.CycleStatus,wearing and ("Wearing "..wearing) or "Waiting for the first switch")
        local parts={}
        if Auto.Switching or Auto.Pending then table.insert(parts,"loading the next avatar…") end
        if auto.Trigger~="Timer" then
            table.insert(parts,(auto.Trigger=="Respawn" and "Respawns to switch: " or "Deaths to switch: ")..tostring(math.max(0,auto.EveryDeaths-Auto.DeathsSince)))
        end
        if auto.Trigger=="Timer" or auto.Trigger=="Both" then table.insert(parts,"timer "..UI.clock(auto.TimerSeconds-(os.clock()-Auto.TimerStart))) end
        local cooldown=auto.Cooldown-(os.clock()-Auto.LastSwitch)
        if cooldown>0 then table.insert(parts,"cooldown "..tostring(math.ceil(cooldown)).." s") end
        table.insert(parts,"Deaths this session: "..tostring(Auto.Deaths))
        detail=table.concat(parts,"  ·  ")
    end
    UI.setText(UI.CycleDetail,detail)
    local ready=count>0 and not App.Busy and not Auto.Switching
    UI.enabled(UI.CyclePrev,ready); UI.enabled(UI.CycleNext,ready)
end
function UI.renderAuto()
    if not UI.CycleList then return end
    -- Rebuilding rows mid-drag would drop the grip; the drag re-renders when it ends.
    if UI.CycleDrag then UI.autoStatus(); return end
    for _,row in ipairs(UI.AutoEntryLabels) do row.Label.Text=Auto.name(row.Get()) end
    UI.setText(UI.AutoLast,"Last applied: "..Auto.name(Store.Auto.Last))
    for key,refresh in pairs(UI.Toggles or {}) do if key:sub(1,5)=="Auto." then refresh() end end
    for _,drop in pairs(UI.Choices or {}) do drop.refresh() end
    UI.clearRows("cycle",UI.CycleList)
    for index,entry in ipairs(Store.Auto.List) do UI.cycleRow(entry,index) end
    UI.setText(UI.CycleCount,tostring(#Store.Auto.List).."/50 avatars in the cycle")
    UI.enabled(UI.CycleClear,#Store.Auto.List>0)
    if #Store.Auto.List==0 then UI.emptyList(UI.CycleList,"Your cycle is empty","Preview a profile or saved skin and tap Add preview, or add all your favorites.") end
    UI.autoStatus()
end

function UI.loadCreatorPhoto()
    if UI.PhotoRequested or not UI.CreatorPhoto then return end
    UI.PhotoRequested=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local asset=type(getcustomasset)=="function" and getcustomasset or type(getsynasset)=="function" and getsynasset
        if not asset or type(writefile)~="function" then return end
        local path="LyraAvatarStudio_github_lyraEz.png"
        local ok,image=pcall(function()
            local cached=type(isfile)=="function" and isfile(path)
            if not cached then
                local requestFn=type(request)=="function" and request or type(http_request)=="function" and http_request or (type(syn)=="table" and type(syn.request)=="function" and syn.request)
                local body
                if requestFn then
                    local response=requestFn({Url="https://github.com/lyraEz.png?size=256",Method="GET"})
                    assert(response and response.StatusCode==200,"Profile photo unavailable")
                    body=response.Body
                else body=game:HttpGet("https://github.com/lyraEz.png?size=256") end
                assert(type(body)=="string" and #body>16 and #body<2097152,"Invalid profile photo")
                assert(body:sub(1,8)=="\137PNG\13\10\26\10" or body:sub(1,3)=="\255\216\255","Invalid image format")
                writefile(path,body)
            end
            return asset(path)
        end)
        if ok and type(image)=="string" and App.alive() then UI.CreatorPhoto.Image=image end
        -- Initial remains visible below the image if HTTP/custom assets are unavailable.
    end)
end

function UI.buildCreator()
    local page=UI.page("Creator"); UI.stack(page,10)
    UI.section(page,"Made by lyraEz","Find me and my other scripts here. Tap a link to copy it.")
    local LINK_RGB=Color3.fromRGB(108,180,255)
    local LINK_HEX="#6CB4FF"
    local function copyLink(label,url,linkButton,fallback,button)
        local copy=type(setclipboard)=="function" and setclipboard or type(toclipboard)=="function" and toclipboard or nil
        if copy and pcall(copy,url) then
            UI.setText(button.Label,"Copied!"); App.report(label.." link copied.","success")
            task.delay(1.5,function() if App.alive() and button and button.Label then UI.setText(button.Label,"Copy link") end end)
            return
        end
        linkButton.Visible=false; fallback.Visible=true; fallback:CaptureFocus(); fallback.SelectionStart=1; fallback.CursorPosition=#url+1
        App.report("Automatic clipboard access is unavailable. Select the link and copy it manually.","warning")
    end
    -- Blue, underlined link (tap to copy) followed by a copy button.
    local function finishCard(card,order,label,url)
        local holder=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=order,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1},card)
        local linkButton=UI.new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1,AutoButtonColor=false,RichText=true,
            Text='<u><font color="'..LINK_HEX..'">'..url..'</font></u>',TextColor3=LINK_RGB,TextSize=UI.size(13),Font=UI.Font.Regular,TextWrapped=true,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top},holder)
        local fallback=UI.new("TextBox",{Visible=false,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=url,TextEditable=false,
            ClearTextOnFocus=false,TextColor3=LINK_RGB,TextSize=UI.size(13),Font=UI.Font.Regular,TextWrapped=true,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top},holder)
        local button
        button=UI.button(card,"Copy link",false,function() copyLink(label,url,linkButton,fallback,button) end,"copy")
        button.Root.LayoutOrder=order+1
        UI.connect(linkButton.Activated,function() copyLink(label,url,linkButton,fallback,button) end)
        UI.connect(fallback.FocusLost,function() fallback.Visible=false; linkButton.Visible=true end)
    end
    local function simpleCard(order,title,subtitle,icon,label,url)
        local card=UI.autoCard(page,order,12,16)
        local header=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=1,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,44),BackgroundTransparency=1},card)
        local badge=UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,44),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0},header); UI.round(badge,13); UI.icon(badge,icon,UDim2.fromOffset(10,10),UI.C.Accent)
        local heading=UI.text(header,title,17,nil,true); heading.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(58,0); heading.Size=UDim2.new(1,-58,0,24)
        local caption=UI.text(header,subtitle,12,UI.C.Muted); caption.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(58,25); caption.Size=UDim2.new(1,-58,0,20)
        finishCard(card,2,label,url)
        return card
    end

    -- 1) Discord first, then a compact GitHub card (photo, name, bio, link).
    simpleCard(1,"Discord","Join the community","discord","Discord",App.Creator.Discord)
    local github=UI.autoCard(page,2,8,12)
    UI.new("UIGradient",{Color=ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,UI.C.AccentDark),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,UI.C.Card)}),Rotation=28},github)
    local header=UI.new("Frame",{LayoutOrder=1,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,52),BackgroundTransparency=1},github)
    local portrait=UI.new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(52,52),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Accent,BorderSizePixel=0},header); UI.round(portrait,16); UI.stroke(portrait,0.32,UI.C.Accent)
    local letter=UI.text(portrait,"L",28,UI.C.Base,true); letter.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); letter.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    UI.CreatorPhoto=UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Image="",BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=2,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop},portrait); UI.round(UI.CreatorPhoto,16)
    local platform=UI.text(header,"GITHUB PROFILE",10,UI.C.Accent,true); platform.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(64,0); platform.Size=UDim2.new(1,-64,0,16)
    local name=UI.text(header,App.Creator.Name,19,nil,true); name.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(64,15); name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-64,0,24)
    local handle=UI.text(header,"@lyraEz",11,UI.C.Muted); handle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(64,37); handle.Size=UDim2.new(1,-64,0,16)
    local bio=UI.paragraph(github,"The moon reminds me that even in darkness, there's always a <b><font color=\"#CBB8FF\">beautiful light</font></b>",12,UI.C.Text,false,2)
    bio.RichText=true
    finishCard(github,3,"GitHub",App.Creator.GitHub)
end

    local card=UI.new("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),Size=UDim2.new(1,-48,0,224),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Card,BorderSizePixel=0},UI.Modal); UI.round(card,18); UI.stroke(card,0.1)
    UI.new("UISizeConstraint",{MaxSize=Vector2.new(440,224)},card)

    local cancel=UI.button(card,"Cancel",false,function() UI.ModalToken=(UI.ModalToken or 0)+1; UI.Modal.Visible=false; UI.ModalAction=nil end); cancel.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0,16,1,-60); cancel.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-22,0,44)
    local confirm=UI.button(card,"Confirm",true,function() UI.ModalToken=(UI.ModalToken or 0)+1; local fn=UI.ModalAction; UI.ModalAction=nil; UI.Modal.Visible=false; if fn then fn() end end); confirm.Root.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,6,1,-60); confirm.Root.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-22,0,44)
    UI.ModalCancel=cancel; UI.ModalConfirm=confirm
end
-- options: Confirm and Cancel set the button labels; Seconds closes the question as a Cancel after that
-- long if nobody answers, counting down on the Cancel button.
function UI.confirm(title,description,action,options)
    options=options or {}
    UI.ModalToken=(UI.ModalToken or 0)+1; local token=UI.ModalToken
    UI.setText(UI.ModalTitle,title); UI.setText(UI.ModalText,description); UI.ModalAction=action; UI.Modal.Visible=true
    local cancelText=Lang.text(options.Cancel or "Cancel")
    UI.setText(UI.ModalConfirm.Label,options.Confirm or "Confirm"); UI.setText(UI.ModalCancel.Label,options.Cancel or "Cancel")
    if not options.Seconds then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        for left=options.Seconds,1,-1 do
            if not App.alive() or token~=UI.ModalToken then return end
            UI.ModalCancel.Label.Text=cancelText.." ("..tostring(left)..")"
            task.wait(1)
        end
        if App.alive() and token==UI.ModalToken then UI.ModalToken=token+1; UI.Modal.Visible=false; UI.ModalAction=nil; UI.setText(UI.ModalCancel.Label,options.Cancel or "Cancel") end
    end)
end
function UI.toggleFavorite(profile)
    if not profile then return end
    if App.favoriteIndex(profile) then
        UI.confirm("Remove favorite?",profile.Name.." will be removed from your favorites.",function() App.toggleFavorite(profile) end)
    else App.toggleFavorite(profile) end
end
function UI.timelineThumb(frame,snapshot)
    if snapshot.Original then
        UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..tostring(lp.UserId).."&w=150&h=150"},frame)
    elseif snapshot.Change then
        UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Image=UI.catalogThumb({Id=snapshot.Change.Id,Bundle=snapshot.Change.Bundle})},frame)
    elseif snapshot.LookKey and Looks.find(snapshot.LookKey) then UI.lookThumb(frame,snapshot.LookKey)
    elseif snapshot.Id or snapshot.ThumbId then
        UI.new("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..tostring(snapshot.Id or snapshot.ThumbId).."&w=150&h=150"},frame)
    else UI.icon(frame,"user",UDim2.new(0.5,-12,0.5,-12),UI.C.AccentDark) end
end
function UI.renderTimeline()
    if not UI.TimelineStrip then return end
    local items=table.clone(App.History)
    if App.Current then table.insert(items,App.Current) end
    -- Rebuild only when the history or the busy state changed.
    local signature={tostring(App.Busy)}
    for _,snapshot in ipairs(items) do table.insert(signature,tostring(snapshot)) end
    signature=table.concat(signature,"|")
    if signature==UI.TimelineSignature then return end
    UI.TimelineSignature=signature
    UI.clearRows("timeline",UI.TimelineStrip)
    if #items==0 then
        local empty=UI.text(UI.TimelineStrip,"Avatars you wear appear here.",11,UI.C.Muted); empty.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
        return
    end
    for index,snapshot in ipairs(items) do
        local current=snapshot==App.Current
        local tile=UI.new("TextButton",{LayoutOrder=index,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(58,64),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0},UI.TimelineStrip)
        local frame=UI.new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(7,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,44),BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true},tile); UI.round(frame,12)
        UI.stroke(frame,current and 0 or 0.6,current and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Line).Thickness=current and 2 or 1
        UI.timelineThumb(frame,snapshot)
        local name=snapshot.Original and "Original" or tostring(snapshot.Name or "Avatar")
        local label=UI.text(tile,current and "Now" or name,10,current and UI.C.Accent or UI.C.Muted,current)
        label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,46); label.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,18); label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        if not current then
            UI.rowConnect("timeline",tile.Activated,function() if not App.Busy then App.jump(snapshot) end end)
            UI.rowConnect("timeline",tile.MouseEnter,function() UI.tween(frame,{BackgroundColor3=UI.C.AccentDark}) end)
            UI.rowConnect("timeline",tile.MouseLeave,function() UI.tween(frame,{BackgroundColor3=UI.C.Raised}) end)
        end
        if App.Busy and not current then tile.Active=false; label.TextTransparency=0.5 end
    end
    -- Keep the newest (current) appearance in view.
    task.defer(function()
        if App.alive() and UI.TimelineStrip then
            UI.TimelineStrip.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(math.max(0,UI.TimelineStrip.AbsoluteCanvasSize.X-UI.TimelineStrip.AbsoluteWindowSize.X),0)
        end
    end)
end
function UI.refresh()
    if not UI.Apply then return end
    UI.enabled(UI.Apply,App.Preview~=nil and not App.Busy)
    if UI.PickItems then UI.enabled(UI.PickItems,App.Preview~=nil and App.Preview.Description~=nil) end
    if UI.LiveLook then
        local live=App.LiveLook and App.Preview and (App.Preview.Profile or App.Preview).Id==App.LiveLook.Id
        UI.LiveLook.Root.Visible=live==true
        UI.setText(UI.LiveLook.Label,App.Preview and App.Preview.Live and "See profile avatar" or "See in-game look")
    end
    UI.enabled(UI.Favorite,App.Preview~=nil and App.Preview.Id~=nil)
    UI.enabled(UI.Undo,#App.History>0 and not App.Busy)
    UI.enabled(UI.Restore,App.Initial~=nil and (App.Dirty or App.Current~=App.Initial) and not App.Busy)
    UI.enabled(UI.Customize,(App.Current~=nil or App.Initial~=nil) and not App.Busy)
    UI.setText(UI.Apply.Label,App.Busy and "Applying…" or "Apply avatar")
    UI.Favorite.Label.Text=UI.favoriteText()
    UI.setText(UI.HistoryText,#App.History>0 and (tostring(#App.History)..(#App.History==1 and " earlier look · tap to go back" or " earlier looks · tap to go back")) or "No changes yet")
    UI.renderTimeline()
    if UI.Tab=="Looks" and UI.LooksCurrent~=App.Current then UI.LooksCurrent=App.Current; UI.renderLooks() end
    if UI.Tab=="Collection" then UI.renderCollection() end
    if UI.Tab=="Catalog" then UI.refreshCatalog() end
    if UI.Tab=="Customize" and UI.CustomizeFor~=App.Current then UI.renderCustomize() end
end
-- Reopen by opening and closing the Roblox menu 3 times within 5 seconds. It needs no chat and no on-screen
-- control: only a hidden window reacts, and the window coming back is the only visible sign. This is the
-- one reopen method that explains itself with a notice, so a player who did it by accident learns how to
-- turn it off; chat, the shortcut key and the floating button show nothing.
-- ROBLOX MENU AVATAR: the Players page of the Roblox menu shows a picture of every player. On your screen only,
-- yours becomes the avatar you are wearing: the copied profile's own Roblox picture (with its pose or emote) when
-- the avatar is that profile as it is, else a 3D view of it posed like Roblox's pictures. Nothing is sent to anyone.
-- Everything is wrapped in pcall: if the menu changes, it just does nothing.
UI.MenuAvatarSerial=0
-- Yields. An appearance posed for a picture: the pose saved with the skin (see SAVED POSE), else posed like Roblox's
-- own pictures (see POSE). A kept pose was made on its own rig, so the picture is built on that rig. note(text) hears
-- what happened to a kept pose.
function UI.posedModel(snapshot,rig,note)
    local kept=Visual.picturePose(snapshot)
    rig=kept and Enum.HumanoidRigType[kept.RigType] or rig or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
    -- The model already built for your character (this look on this rig) is copied instead of built again, so the
    -- picture is ready at once.
    local made
    local cache=App.ModelCache
    if cache and cache.Snapshot==snapshot and cache.Rig==rig then pcall(function() made=cache.Model:Clone() end) end
---- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    if not made then
        local desc=Codec.decode(snapshot.Data)
        local built,model=pcall(Visual.model,snapshot.Data,desc,rig); desc:Destroy()
        assert(built and model,tostring(model))
        made=model
    end
    UI.preparePreview(made,UI.ThumbWorld)
    local posed,custom=pcall(Visual.applyPose,made,kept)
    if kept and note then note((posed and custom) and ("kept pose on "..kept.RigType) or ("kept pose not applied ("..tostring(posed and "rig "..tostring(F.getTrueRigType(made)) or custom)..")")) end
    if not (posed and custom) then pcall(Pose.apply,made) end
    for _,item in ipairs(made:GetDescendants()) do
        pcall(function() item.Archivable=true end)
        if item:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
            local part=item.Parent
            pcall(function() if part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.TextureID=="" and item.ColorMap~="" then part.TextureID=item.ColorMap end end)
            item:Destroy()
        end
    end
    made.Archivable=true
    return made
end
function UI.menuAvatarModel()
    local snapshot=App.Current
    if not snapshot or snapshot.Original then return nil end
    if UI.MenuAvatar and UI.MenuAvatar.Snapshot==snapshot then return UI.MenuAvatar.Model,UI.MenuAvatar.Serial end
    local ok,model=pcall(UI.posedModel,snapshot,F.getTrueRigType(lp.Character),function(text) App.devNote("Menu picture: "..text) end)
    if not ok or not model then return nil end
    if UI.MenuAvatar then pcall(function() UI.MenuAvatar.Model:Destroy() end) end
    UI.MenuAvatarSerial=UI.MenuAvatarSerial+1
    UI.MenuAvatar={Snapshot=snapshot,Model=model,Serial=UI.MenuAvatarSerial}
    return model,UI.MenuAvatarSerial
end
function UI.menuAvatarView(label,model,serial)
    local view=Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    view.Name="LyraMenuAvatar"; view.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); view.BackgroundTransparency=1; view.BorderSizePixel=0
    view.ZIndex=label.ZIndex+1; view.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(195,186,213); view.LightColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,233); view.LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-1,-1)
    view:SetAttribute("Serial",serial)
    local clone=model:Clone(); clone.Parent=view
    -- Full body, framed like the other players' pictures: fit the whole body (height and width) in the card.
    local focus,box=Pose.bounds(clone)
    local card=label.AbsoluteSize
    local aspect=card.X>0 and card.Y>0 and math.clamp(card.X/card.Y,0.5,2) or 1
    local fov=30
    local fit=math.max(box.Y,box.X/aspect)
    local distance=(fit*0.5/math.tan(math.rad(fov/2))+box.Z*0.5)*1.12
    local camera=Instance.new("Camera"); camera.FieldOfView=fov
    camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(focus+Vector3.new(0,box.Y*0.04,-distance),focus); camera.Parent=view; view.CurrentCamera=camera
    local corner=label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); if corner then corner:Clone().Parent=view end
    label.ImageTransparency=1
    view.Parent=label
end
-- ROBLOX INSPECT MENU: Roblox's own avatar panel (tap yourself in the Players tab, or the button in Customize) lists
-- the items of the avatar you are wearing. It goes through Roblox's API for this (InspectPlayerFromHumanoidDescription),
-- so the panel stays Roblox's; on your screen its items then read as owned (see YOUR PANEL, OWNED). Your own avatar
-- keeps Roblox's normal panel.
-- Asset ids of a saved appearance: body parts, clothing, animations, accessories, makeup and emotes.
function UI.inspectIds(data)
    local ids={}
    if type(data)~="table" then return ids end
    local props=data.Version==2 and data.Properties or data
    if type(props)=="table" then
        for _,field in ipairs(Codec.assetFields) do local id=Codec.id(props[field]); if id then ids[id]=true end end
        for _,field in ipairs(Codec.accessoryFields) do
            if type(props[field])=="string" then for id in props[field]:gmatch("%d+") do local n=Codec.id(tonumber(id)); if n then ids[n]=true end end end
        end
    end
    for _,list in ipairs({data.Accessories,data.Makeup}) do
        if type(list)=="table" then for _,row in ipairs(list) do if type(row)=="table" and Codec.id(row.AssetId) then ids[row.AssetId]=true end end end
    end
    if type(data.Emotes)=="table" then
        for _,list in pairs(data.Emotes) do if type(list)=="table" then for _,id in ipairs(list) do if Codec.id(id) then ids[id]=true end end end end
    end
    return ids
end
-- Simpler versions of the avatar, for when Roblox's panel keeps showing your own items: level 2 leaves out makeup,
-- emotes, animations and item fitting; level 3 also sends the accessories as Roblox's classic item lists, which
-- leaves out layered clothing.
function UI.inspectData(data,level)
    if level<=1 then return data end
    local copy=Codec.copy(data)
    copy.Makeup=nil; copy.Emotes=nil; copy.EquippedEmotes=nil; copy.Visual=nil
    local props=copy.Version==2 and copy.Properties or copy
    for _,field in ipairs(Codec.assetFields) do if field:find("Animation",1,true) then props[field]=0 end end
    if type(copy.Accessories)=="table" then
        for _,row in ipairs(copy.Accessories) do
            if type(row)=="table" then row.Position=nil; row.Rotation=nil; row.Scale=nil; row.Puffiness=nil end
        end
    end
    if level>=3 then
        local fields={Hat="HatAccessory",Hair="HairAccessory",Face="FaceAccessory",Neck="NeckAccessory",Shoulder="ShouldersAccessory",
            Front="FrontAccessory",Back="BackAccessory",Waist="WaistAccessory"}
        local lists={}
        for _,row in ipairs(type(copy.Accessories)=="table" and copy.Accessories or {}) do
            local field=type(row)=="table" and not row.IsLayered and fields[row.AccessoryType]
            if field and Codec.id(row.AssetId) then lists[field]=lists[field] or {}; table.insert(lists[field],string.format("%d",row.AssetId)) end
        end
        for field,ids in pairs(lists) do props[field]=table.concat(ids,",") end
        copy.HasAccessories=false; copy.Accessories=nil
    end
    return copy
end
-- Attempts in order: the full avatar, the same again (the panel may still have been loading your profile), then the
-- two simpler versions.
UI.InspectLevels={1,1,2,3}
-- who: the user id of a script user sharing a skin through Skin sync, to open the panel on the skin they wear (see
-- THEIR PANEL); nil is you.
function UI.inspectWorn(silent,attempt,who)
    attempt=attempt or 1
    local snapshot,name=App.Current,lp.Name
    if who then
        local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(who)
        snapshot=player and Sync.snapshot(who) or nil
        if not snapshot then return false end
        name=player.Name
    end
    if not snapshot or snapshot.Original or type(snapshot.Data)~="table" then
        if not silent then App.report("Wear an avatar first. Your own avatar already shows in Roblox's menu.","info") end
        return false
    end
    local data=UI.inspectData(snapshot.Data,UI.InspectLevels[attempt] or 1)
    local decoded,desc=pcall(Codec.decode,data)
    if not decoded then
        if not silent then App.report("This avatar could not be read.","error") end
        return false
    end
    local shown=pcall(function() game:GetService("GuiService"):InspectPlayerFromHumanoidDescription(desc,name) end)
    -- The previous description is released once the panel has the new one.
    if UI.InspectDesc then pcall(function() UI.InspectDesc:Destroy() end) end
    UI.InspectDesc=desc
    if not shown and not silent then App.report("Roblox's avatar panel is unavailable in this game.","warning") end
    if shown then UI.trackInspect(attempt,UI.inspectIds(data),who) end
    return shown
end
-- The panel draws a 3D avatar for a profile but hides it for an outfit. While the panel shows you, the avatar you are
-- wearing is drawn in that empty space by a view of ours, centred on the panel just above your name. Roblox's own
-- (hidden) 3D view is left alone, and nothing in the panel is changed.
function UI.onScreen(item)
    local cursor=item
    while cursor do
        if cursor:IsA("GuiObject") and not cursor.Visible then return false end
        if cursor:IsA("LayerCollector") then return cursor.Enabled end
        cursor=cursor.Parent
    end
    return false
end
-- Roblox's panel while it is open: it is mounted as "InspectAndBuy" in the Roblox menu's layer, and unmounted when it
-- closes.
function UI.inspectRoot()
    local rgui=game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
    return rgui and rgui:FindFirstChild("InspectAndBuy")
end
-- The panel's title ("<name>'s Avatar" in any language): a short visible label that contains the username (yours, or
-- the script user's whose skin the panel shows) but is not just the name itself (player cards) nor a chat line. It is
-- looked for in the panel first, else anywhere in CoreGui.
function UI.inspectTitle(name)
    local core=game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local root=UI.inspectRoot()
    if root then
        local found=UI.inspectTitleIn(root,name)
        if found then return found end
    end
    return UI.inspectTitleIn(core,name)
end
function UI.inspectTitleIn(holder,name)
    local chat=game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("ExperienceChat")
    name=name or lp.Name; local best
    local ok,items=pcall(function() return holder:GetDescendants() end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    for _,item in ipairs(items) do
        -- One protected or half-built element must not end the search, so each one is checked on its own.
        pcall(function()
            if not (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
            -- Rich text tags (bold, colour) are not part of what is shown; a name changed by YOUR NAME still counts.
            local text=Ident.raw(item):gsub("<[^>]+>","")
            if #text<=#name+30 and text~=name and text~="@"..name and text:find(name,1,true) and not text:find(":",1,true)
                and not (UI.Gui and item:IsDescendantOf(UI.Gui)) and not (UI.InspectView and item:IsDescendantOf(UI.InspectView))
                and not (chat and item:IsDescendantOf(chat)) and item.AbsoluteSize.Y>=6 and UI.onScreen(item) then
                if not best or item.AbsoluteSize.Y>best.AbsoluteSize.Y then best=item end
            end
        end)
    end
    return best
end
-- The panel itself: the first frame around the title that reaches well above it. The frames in between only hold
-- the title row and the item list, which start at the title.
function UI.inspectPanel(title)
    local room=math.max(title.AbsoluteSize.Y*3,40)
    local cursor=title.Parent
    while cursor and cursor:IsA("GuiObject") do
        if title.AbsolutePosition.Y-cursor.AbsolutePosition.Y>=room and cursor.AbsoluteSize.X>=title.AbsoluteSize.X then return cursor end
        cursor=cursor.Parent
    end
    return nil
end
-- Which items Roblox's panel lists, read from the item pictures: each one is loaded from the item's asset id.
function UI.panelAssetIds(panel)
    local found={}
    for _,item in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton") then
            local image=item.Image
            if image~="" then
                local id
                if image:find("rbxthumb",1,true) then
                    if image:match("type=(%a+)")=="Asset" then id=image:match("[&?]id=(%d+)") end
                else
                    id=image:match("[Aa]sset[Ii]d=(%d+)")
                end
                local n=id and Codec.id(tonumber(id))
                if n then found[n]=true end
            end
        end
    end
    return found
end
function UI.drawInspectAvatar(view,model,wanted)
    for _,child in ipairs(view:GetChildren()) do if child:GetAttribute("LyraInspect") then child:Destroy() end end
    local clone=model:Clone(); clone:SetAttribute("LyraInspect",true); clone.Parent=view
    local focus,box=Pose.bounds(clone)
    -- A view made this frame has no measured size yet, so the size it is being given is used.
    local size=wanted or view.AbsoluteSize
    local aspect=size.X>0 and size.Y>0 and math.clamp(size.X/size.Y,0.4,2.5) or 1
    local fit=math.max(box.Y,box.X/aspect)
    local camera=Instance.new("Camera"); camera:SetAttribute("LyraInspect",true); camera.FieldOfView=30
    camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(focus+Vector3.new(0,box.Y*0.04,-((fit*0.5/math.tan(math.rad(15))+box.Z*0.5)*1.1)),focus)
    camera.Parent=view; view.CurrentCamera=camera
end
-- The 3D view lives in the same screen layer as the panel's title, so both share one set of coordinates (no
-- top-bar inset maths). Without a layer to share, it gets a screen layer of its own.
-- picture: a user id whose own full-body Roblox picture is shown instead of a 3D view (a profile worn as it is, so the
-- panel shows the same pose as the Roblox menu).
function UI.inspectView(layer,picture)
    local class=picture and "ImageLabel" or "ViewportFrame"
    local view=UI.InspectView
    if view and view.Parent and (view.Parent==layer or not layer) and view.ClassName==class then return view end
    if view then pcall(function() view:Destroy() end) end
    view=Instance.new(class); view.Name="LyraInspectAvatar"; view.BackgroundTransparency=1; view.BorderSizePixel=0; view.Visible=false
    view.ZIndex=1000
    if picture then
        view.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        view.Image=string.format("rbxthumb://type=Avatar&id=%d&w=720&h=720",picture)
    else
        view.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(195,186,213); view.LightColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,233); view.LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-1,-1)
    end
    local placed=layer and pcall(function() view.Parent=layer end) and view.Parent==layer
    if not placed then
        if not (UI.InspectOverlay and UI.InspectOverlay.Parent) then
            local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui"); gui.Name="LyraInspectAvatar"; gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true; gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
            gui.DisplayOrder=5000; gui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            UI.mount(gui,lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")); UI.InspectOverlay=gui
        end
        view.Parent=UI.InspectOverlay
    end
    UI.InspectView=view
    return view
end
-- Roblox's newer panel is one rounded frame named ContainerView: the item list on the left, and on the right the
-- space where a profile's 3D avatar goes, above the total and the Buy button. Older and narrow layouts put the avatar
-- above the title instead (UI.inspectPanel).
function UI.inspectContainer(title)
    local cursor=title.Parent
    while cursor and not cursor:IsA("LayerCollector") do
        if cursor.Name=="ContainerView" and cursor:IsA("GuiObject") then return cursor end
        cursor=cursor.Parent
    end
    return nil
end
-- The item list: the largest scrolling list on screen in the panel.
function UI.inspectList(container)
    local best,area=nil,0
    for _,item in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and UI.onScreen(item) then
            local size=item.AbsoluteSize.X*item.AbsoluteSize.Y
            if size>area then best,area=item,size end
        end
    end
    return best
end
-- The empty space beside the item list, from the panel's top down to the total and the Buy button: {X,Y,W,H} on
-- screen, or nil when the list takes the whole width (a narrow layout).
function UI.inspectSide(container,title)
    local cPos,cSize=container.AbsolutePosition,container.AbsoluteSize
    local list=UI.inspectList(container)
    local split=list and (list.AbsolutePosition.X+list.AbsoluteSize.X) or (title.AbsolutePosition.X+title.AbsoluteSize.X)
    local right=cPos.X+cSize.X
    if right-split<math.max(cSize.X*0.22,80) then return nil end
    -- The first text or button below the top third of that side (the total row) ends the space. A layer that covers
    -- the whole side (Roblox's hidden 3D view, a drag area) starts at the top, so it never counts.
    local bottom=cPos.Y+cSize.Y
    for _,item in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
        if (item:IsA("GuiButton") or (item:IsA("TextLabel") and item.Text~="")) and not (UI.InspectView and item:IsDescendantOf(UI.InspectView)) then
            local pos,size=item.AbsolutePosition,item.AbsoluteSize
            if size.Y>0 and pos.X>=split-2 and pos.Y>cPos.Y+cSize.Y*0.3 and pos.Y<bottom and UI.onScreen(item) then bottom=pos.Y end
        end
    end
    return {X=split,Y=cPos.Y,W=right-split,H=bottom-cPos.Y}
end
-- YOUR PANEL, OWNED: the panel lists what you wear against your real inventory, so items you don't own showed their
-- price and an active Buy button. On your screen only, it now reads as it does for the avatar's owner: each item says
-- Owned (Roblox's own word, in your language), the total is 0 and the Buy button is greyed out and blocked, so no
-- purchase starts from it. On an item's page the Buy button says Owned. Text Roblox writes again is marked again, and
-- everything goes back when the panel is left.
function UI.ownedText()
    if UI.OwnedText then return UI.OwnedText end
    local key,text="InGame.InspectMenu.Label.Owned",nil
    local function usable(value) return type(value)=="string" and value~="" and #value<=40 and not value:find("InGame.",1,true) end
    pcall(function()
        local tbl=game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("CoreScriptLocalization")
        local translator=tbl and tbl:GetTranslator(game:GetService("LocalizationService").RobloxLocaleId)
        text=translator and translator:FormatByKey(key)
    end)
    if not usable(text) then
        pcall(function() text=require(game:GetService("CorePackages").Workspace.Packages.RobloxTranslator):FormatByKey(key) end)
    end
    UI.OwnedText=usable(text) and text or "Owned"
    return UI.OwnedText
end
-- A price as the panel writes it: digits and separators, with or without the Robux sign (U+E002).
function UI.isPrice(text)
    if type(text)~="string" or #text>40 then return false end
    local plain=text:gsub("<[^>]+>",""):gsub("\238\128\130",""):gsub("\194\160",""):gsub("\226\128\175",""):gsub("%s","")
    return plain:match("^%d[%d,%.']*$")~=nil
end
-- The word Roblox itself writes in this list for an item you have (it can differ from the menu's general one), read
-- from an item of your own avatar that the worn one shares: its price line, when it is not a price nor ours. Free
-- items also show a word there, so only items you surely own are read.
function UI.panelOwnedWord(container,state,own)
    if not own or not next(own) then return nil end
    for _,image in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
        if image:IsA("ImageLabel") and image.Name=="ItemCardThumbnailImage" then
            local kind,id=image.Image:match("type=(%a+)"),tonumber(image.Image:match("[?&]id=(%d+)"))
            if kind=="Asset" and id and own[id] then
                local row=image.Parent
                while row and row~=container and not (row:IsA("GuiButton") and row.Name:match("^Item%d")) do row=row.Parent end
                local amount=row and row~=container and row:FindFirstChild("ItemCardPriceLineAmount",true)
                if amount and amount:IsA("TextLabel") and amount.Text~="" and not state.Labels[amount] and not UI.isPrice(amount.Text) then return amount.Text end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
function UI.ownedState() return {Labels={},Hidden={},Covers={},Buttons={},Roots={}} end
-- The text Roblox wrote in a label, also while ours is showing.
function UI.ownedRaw(state,label)
    local row=state.Labels[label]
    if row and label.Text==row.Written then return row.Text end
    return label.Text
end
function UI.ownedWrite(state,label,text)
    state.Labels[label]={Text=UI.ownedRaw(state,label),Written=text}
    if label.Text~=text then label.Text=text end
end
function UI.ownedHide(state,item)
    if state.Hidden[item]==nil then state.Hidden[item]=item.Visible end
    if item.Visible then item.Visible=false end
end
-- A property as shown: Roblox's newer menus set many of them through styles, which reading the property misses.
function UI.styled(item,prop)
    local ok,value=pcall(function() return item:GetStyled(prop) end)
    if ok and value~=nil then return value end
    return item[prop]
end
-- The Robux sign next to a price: a small picture beside it, in the same row.
function UI.isIconText(label)
    local ok,family=pcall(function() return label.FontFace.Family end)
    return (ok and tostring(family):find("BuilderIcons",1,true)~=nil) or label.Text=="robux"
end
function UI.ownedSign(state,label)
    local lPos,lSize=label.AbsolutePosition,label.AbsoluteSize
    for _,holder in ipairs({label.Parent,label.Parent and label.Parent.Parent}) do
        if holder then
            for _,item in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
                -- A picture, or a text drawn in Roblox's icon font (BuilderIcons: the word "robux" draws the sign).
                local picture=(item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton") or (item:IsA("TextLabel") and item~=label and UI.isIconText(item))) and item or nil
                if picture and not label:IsDescendantOf(picture) and picture.Visible then
                    local pos,size=picture.AbsolutePosition,picture.AbsoluteSize
                    local beside=pos.X<lPos.X+2 and math.abs((pos.Y+size.Y/2)-(lPos.Y+lSize.Y/2))<lSize.Y
                    if beside and size.X>0 and size.X<=lSize.Y*1.8 and size.Y<=lSize.Y*1.8 then UI.ownedHide(state,picture) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
-- The Buy button: the largest filled button with a short text (Buy items, Buy Item) outside the item lists. Item rows
-- hold several texts, the back and close buttons have none, and Try On or favourite pills are smaller.
function UI.ownedBuyButton(container,lists)
    -- Roblox's own name for it first (the panel names it BuyButton).
    local named=container:FindFirstChild("BuyButton",true)
    if named and named:IsA("GuiButton") and UI.onScreen(named) then return named end
    local best,area=nil,0
--YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    for _,item in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("GuiButton") and not item:GetAttribute("LyraOwned") and UI.onScreen(item) then
            local size=item.AbsoluteSize
            local inList=false
            for list in pairs(lists) do if item:IsDescendantOf(list) then inList=true; break end end
            if not inList and size.X>=80 and size.Y>=20 and size.Y<=160 and size.X<container.AbsoluteSize.X*0.8 and size.X*size.Y>area then
                local texts,filled=0,false
                local parts=item:GetDescendants(); table.insert(parts,item)
                for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
                    if (part:IsA("TextLabel") or part:IsA("TextButton")) and part.Text~="" and part.Visible then texts=texts+1 end
                    if part:IsA("GuiObject") and part.Visible and UI.styled(part,"BackgroundTransparency")<0.5 and part.AbsoluteSize.X>=size.X*0.6 then filled=true end
                end
                if filled and texts>=1 and texts<=2 then best,area=item,size.X*size.Y end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end
-- The whole button: from the part found, up to the largest frame around it that still holds only its text (the blue
-- shape can sit a level or two above the part that takes the taps).
function UI.ownedButtonRoot(container,button)
    local function texts(holder)
        local count=0
        local items=holder:GetDescendants(); table.insert(items,holder)
        for _,item in ipairs(items) do if (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton")) and item.Text~="" and item.Visible and not item:GetAttribute("LyraOwned") then count=count+1 end end
        return count
    end
    local root,own=button,texts(button)
    for _=1,4 do
        local parent=root.Parent
        if not (parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent~=container and parent:IsDescendantOf(container)) then break end
        local size=parent.AbsoluteSize
        if size.X>container.AbsoluteSize.X*0.6 or size.Y>160 or texts(parent)~=own then break end
        root=parent
    end
    return root
end
-- Greyed out as Roblox greys out a button with nothing to buy (the button at half strength over the panel): a dark
-- layer of ours at half strength over the whole button, which also takes the taps. It sits in the panel's screen
-- layer, outside the button, and follows the button's place on screen: inside it, the button's padding and row layout
-- shrank it to the size of the text.
function UI.ownedButton(state,button,relabel,container)
    local root=container and UI.ownedButtonRoot(container,button) or button
    local cover=state.Covers[button]
    if not (cover and cover.Parent) then
        local layer=root:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
        if not layer then return end
        cover=Instance.new("TextButton")
        cover.Name="LyraOwned"; cover:SetAttribute("LyraOwned",true); cover.Text=""; cover.AutoButtonColor=false; cover.Selectable=false
        cover.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0); cover.BackgroundTransparency=0.5; cover.BorderSizePixel=0; cover.ZIndex=1001
        -- The button's own rounding, and its border line (drawn just outside it) covered too.
        local corner=root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        local stroke=root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        local edge=0
        if stroke then local ok,thickness=pcall(function() return UI.styled(stroke,"Thickness") end); edge=ok and tonumber(thickness) or 1 end
        edge=math.clamp(math.ceil(edge),0,4)
        cover:SetAttribute("LyraEdge",edge)
        local radius=corner and corner.CornerRadius or UDim.new(0,math.max(4,math.floor(root.AbsoluteSize.Y*0.2+0.5)))
        local round=Instance.new("UICorner"); round.CornerRadius=UDim.new(radius.Scale,radius.Offset+edge); round.Parent=cover
        cover.Parent=layer
        state.Covers[button]=cover
    end
    state.Roots[button]=root
    UI.ownedPlace(cover,root)
    if relabel then
        -- On an item's page the button's own text says Owned, as on an item you have.
        local text
        local items=root:GetDescendants(); table.insert(items,root)
        for _,item in ipairs(items) do
            if (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton")) and item.Text~="" and not item:GetAttribute("LyraOwned")
                and (not text or item.AbsoluteSize.X*item.AbsoluteSize.Y>text.AbsoluteSize.X*text.AbsoluteSize.Y) then text=item end
        end
        if text then UI.ownedWrite(state,text,relabel) end
    end
end
function UI.ownedPlace(cover,root)
    local layer=cover.Parent
    local origin=layer and layer:IsA("LayerCollector") and layer.AbsolutePosition or Vector2.zero
    local edge=cover:GetAttribute("LyraEdge") or 0
    cover.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(root.AbsolutePosition.X-origin.X-edge,root.AbsolutePosition.Y-origin.Y-edge)
    cover.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(root.AbsoluteSize.X+edge*2,root.AbsoluteSize.Y+edge*2)
    cover.Visible=root.Parent~=nil and UI.onScreen(root)
end
-- Every tick of the panel's loop: the layers follow their buttons (the panel scrolls and moves).
function UI.ownedTrack(states)
    for _,state in ipairs({states.List,states.Detail}) do
        for button,cover in pairs(state.Covers) do
            local root=state.Roots[button]
            if root and cover.Parent then pcall(UI.ownedPlace,cover,root) end
        end
    end
end
function UI.ownedRestore(state)
    for label,row in pairs(state.Labels) do pcall(function() if label.Parent and label.Text==row.Written then label.Text=row.Text end end) end
    for item,visible in pairs(state.Hidden) do pcall(function() if item.Parent and not item.Visible then item.Visible=visible end end) end
    for _,cover in pairs(state.Covers) do pcall(function() cover:Destroy() end) end
    for key,list in pairs(state) do table.clear(list) end
end
-- states: {List, Detail}; listPage: the panel shows the avatar's item list (with its title), else an item's page.
function UI.markOwned(states,container,listPage,own)
    if not Store.Settings.MenuAvatar then return end
    local state=listPage and states.List or states.Detail
    UI.ownedRestore(listPage and states.Detail or states.List)
    states.Word=UI.panelOwnedWord(container,state,own) or states.Word
    local owned=states.Word or UI.ownedText()
    local width=container.AbsoluteSize.X
    -- Prices on screen, and the item lists: a scrolling list holding two prices or more (and, on the list page, the
    -- largest one), so a list is never taken for a total.
    local prices,perList={},{}
    for _,item in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
        if (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton")) and not item:GetAttribute("LyraOwned") and UI.isPrice(UI.ownedRaw(state,item)) and UI.onScreen(item) then
            -- Counts on small buttons (favourites) are not prices.
            local button=item:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiButton")
            if not (button and button:IsDescendantOf(container) and button.AbsoluteSize.X<width*0.3) then
                table.insert(prices,item)
                local scroller=item:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
                if scroller and scroller:IsDescendantOf(container) then perList[scroller]=(perList[scroller] or 0)+1 end
            end
        end
    end
    local lists={}
    for scroller,count in pairs(perList) do if count>=2 then lists[scroller]=true end end
    if listPage then local main=UI.inspectList(container); if main then lists[main]=true end end
    local totals={}
    for _,item in ipairs(prices) do
        local inList=false
        for list in pairs(lists) do if item:IsDescendantOf(list) then inList=true; break end end
        if inList then UI.ownedWrite(state,item,owned); UI.ownedSign(state,item)
        else table.insert(totals,item) end
    end
    -- Once greyed out the button no longer looks filled, so the one found stays while it is on screen.
    local button
    for item in pairs(state.Buttons) do if item.Parent and item:IsDescendantOf(container) and UI.onScreen(item) then button=item; break end end
    if not button then
        table.clear(state.Buttons)
        button=UI.ownedBuyButton(container,lists)
        if button then state.Buttons[button]=true end
    end
    for _,total in ipairs(totals) do
        local hidden=false
        if not listPage then
            -- An owned item's page has no total: the small row holding it is hidden (never a list, never a block
            -- with the button or with more than a few texts); otherwise it reads 0.
            local row=total
            while row.Parent and row.Parent~=container and not (button and button:IsDescendantOf(row.Parent)) do row=row.Parent end
            local texts,big=0,row:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame",true)~=nil
            for _,part in ipairs(row:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("TextLabel") and part.Text~="" then texts=texts+1 end end
            if row~=total and row:IsA("GuiObject") and not big and texts<=3 and row.AbsoluteSize.Y<=math.max(total.AbsoluteSize.Y*4,60)
                and not (button and button:IsDescendantOf(row)) then
                UI.ownedHide(state,row); hidden=true
            end
        end
        if not hidden then UI.ownedWrite(state,total,"0") end
    end
    for item in pairs(state.Buttons) do
        if item.Parent and item:IsDescendantOf(container) then UI.ownedButton(state,item,not listPage and owned or nil,container) end
    end
end
UI.InspectSerial=0
-- who: a script user whose synced skin the panel shows (see THEIR PANEL). Their items keep Roblox's prices and Buy
-- button: the owned marks are only for your own panel.
function UI.trackInspect(attempt,wanted,who)
    UI.InspectSerial=UI.InspectSerial+1; local serial=UI.InspectSerial
    attempt=attempt or 1; wanted=wanted or {}
    local name=lp.Name
    if who then
        local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(who)
        if not player then return end
        name=player.Name
    end
    local own=not who and App.Initial and UI.inspectIds(App.Initial.Data) or {}
    local owned={List=UI.ownedState(),Detail=UI.ownedState()}
    task.spawn(function()
        -- A profile worn as it is shows its own Roblox picture, the same one as in the Roblox menu; any other look is
        -- drawn in 3D. A script user's skin is drawn in 3D, as in their pictures.
        local picture=not who and Thumbs.userFor(App.Current) or nil
        local model
        if who then model=Sync.pictureModel(who) elseif not picture then model=UI.menuAvatarModel() end
        if not picture and not model then return end
        local title,lastSearch,drawn=nil,0,nil
        -- The panel stays yours while it stays open: an item's page (tap an item) has no title. The list counts as
        -- shown for a moment after its title was last seen, so a title Roblox redraws is not taken for an item's page.
        local container,lastOwned,titleAt=nil,0,-math.huge
        -- Item check: from 1.5 s after the panel is found, once a second, until it is settled. A skin saved from an
        -- old file or as a visual copy has no catalog items, so there is nothing to check.
        local checkAt,strikes,settled,unreadable=nil,0,next(wanted)==nil,0
        -- Followed while the panel is open; it stops 20 s after the panel was last seen.
        local deadline=os.clock()+20
        while App.alive() and serial==UI.InspectSerial and os.clock()<deadline do
            pcall(function()
                if not (title and title.Parent and UI.onScreen(title) and Ident.raw(title):find(name,1,true)) then
                    title=nil
                    if os.clock()-lastSearch>=0.3 then lastSearch=os.clock(); title=UI.inspectTitle(name) end
                end
                if container and not (container.Parent and UI.onScreen(container)) then container=nil end
                if title then container=UI.inspectContainer(title) or container; titleAt=os.clock() end
                if not who then
                    if container and os.clock()-lastOwned>=0.3 then lastOwned=os.clock(); pcall(UI.markOwned,owned,container,os.clock()-titleAt<1.5,own) end
                    pcall(UI.ownedTrack,owned)
                end
                if not title then
                    if UI.InspectView then UI.InspectView.Visible=false end
                    if container then deadline=os.clock()+20 end
                    return
                end
                deadline=os.clock()+20
                if not who then pcall(Ident.title,title) end
                local panel=container or UI.inspectPanel(title)
                local layer=title:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
                local view=UI.inspectView(layer,picture)
                -- Coordinates relative to the layer the view is in (the panel's own one, or ours).
                local origin=view.Parent and view.Parent:IsA("LayerCollector") and view.Parent.AbsolutePosition or Vector2.zero
                if view.Parent==UI.InspectOverlay and layer and not layer.IgnoreGuiInset then origin=origin-game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset() end
                local x,y,width,height
                local side=container and UI.inspectSide(container,title)
                if side then
                    -- Newer panel: the space beside the item list, where Roblox draws a profile's avatar.
                    x,y,width,height=side.X+10,side.Y+10,side.W-20,side.H-20
                else
                    -- The empty space between the panel's top edge and the title, centred on the panel.
                    local tPos,tSize=title.AbsolutePosition,title.AbsoluteSize
                    local top=panel and panel.AbsolutePosition.Y or (tPos.Y-math.max(tSize.Y*8,100))
                    height=tPos.Y-top-12
                    width=math.min(height*0.8,(panel and panel.AbsoluteSize.X or tSize.X*2)*0.6)
                    local center=panel and (panel.AbsolutePosition.X+panel.AbsoluteSize.X/2) or (tPos.X+tSize.X/2)
                    x,y=center-width/2,top+6
                end
                local fits=height>=40 and width>=30
                if fits then
                    view.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
                    view.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x-origin.X,y-origin.Y)
                    -- The camera is framed again when the view's size changes.
                    if model and (not drawn or math.abs(drawn.X-width)>4 or math.abs(drawn.Y-height)>4 or not view:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")) then
                        drawn=Vector2.new(width,height); UI.drawInspectAvatar(view,model,drawn)
                    end
