                end
                view.Visible=fits
                if panel and not settled then
                    checkAt=checkAt or os.clock()+1.5
                    if os.clock()>=checkAt then
                        checkAt=os.clock()+1
                        local listed=UI.panelAssetIds(panel)
                        local mine,yours=0,0
                        -- Of a script user's own avatar nothing is known here: any listed item that is not of the
                        -- synced skin counts as theirs.
                        for id in pairs(listed) do if wanted[id] then mine=mine+1 elseif who or own[id] then yours=yours+1 end end
                        if mine+yours==0 then
                            -- Pictures that name no item of either avatar: the panel can't be checked.
                            unreadable=unreadable+1
                            if unreadable>=4 then settled=true end
                        elseif yours>mine then
                            strikes=strikes+1
                            if strikes>=2 then
                                settled=true
                                local nextAttempt=attempt+1
                                if UI.InspectLevels[nextAttempt] then
                                    task.defer(function() if App.alive() and serial==UI.InspectSerial then UI.inspectWorn(true,nextAttempt,who) end end)
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            settled=true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        pcall(UI.ownedRestore,owned.List); pcall(UI.ownedRestore,owned.Detail)
        if serial==UI.InspectSerial then
            if UI.InspectView then pcall(function() UI.InspectView:Destroy() end); UI.InspectView=nil end
            if UI.InspectOverlay then pcall(function() UI.InspectOverlay:Destroy() end); UI.InspectOverlay=nil end
        end
    end)
end
-- Roblox's own request to open the panel on a player (the Players page, the leaderboard's Examine Avatar, a game's
-- button): when it is you and you wear a copied avatar, the panel is pointed at what you wear. Some executors can't
-- listen to it; the Players page and leaderboard buttons are then followed instead (UI.hookInspectCard).
function UI.watchInspect()
    pcall(function()
        RegisterConnection(game:GetService("GuiService").InspectPlayerFromUserIdWithCtxRequest:Connect(function(userId)
            if not App.alive() then return end
            local uid=tonumber(userId)
            if uid==lp.UserId then UI.InspectHeardAt=os.clock(); UI.inspectSelf()
            elseif uid and Sync.pictureUsers()[uid] then UI.InspectHeardAt=os.clock(); UI.inspectPeer(uid) end
        end))
    end)
end
function UI.inspectHeard()
    return UI.InspectHeardAt~=nil and os.clock()-UI.InspectHeardAt<2
end
-- The profile loads from the web, so the request is repeated once in case it finished after the first one.
function UI.inspectSelf()
    if not Store.Settings.MenuAvatar or not App.Current or App.Current.Original then return end
    task.delay(0.2,function() if App.alive() then UI.inspectWorn(true) end end)
    task.delay(1.3,function() if App.alive() then UI.inspectWorn(true) end end)
end
-- THEIR PANEL: Skin sync shows you the skin another script user wears, but Roblox's avatar panel (Examine Avatar in
-- the leaderboard, a player's card in the Roblox menu, a game's own inspect button) still listed the items of their
-- real avatar. While their skin is synced, the panel opened on them is pointed at that skin instead: its items with
-- Roblox's own names, prices and Buy button, the total, and the skin drawn in 3D where Roblox draws a profile's avatar.
-- On your screen only, with Skin sync on and "Show my avatar on the game's copies of me" too (as their pictures).
function UI.inspectPeer(uid)
    if not Sync.pictureUsers()[uid] then return end
    for _,delay in ipairs({0.2,1.3}) do
        task.delay(delay,function() if App.alive() and Sync.pictureUsers()[uid] then UI.inspectWorn(true,nil,uid) end end)
    end
end
-- Whose card of the Roblox menu's Players page this is right now: you, a script user sharing a skin, or nil.
function UI.cardUser(root)
    local names={[lp.DisplayName]=lp.UserId,[lp.Name]=lp.UserId,["@"..lp.Name]=lp.UserId}
    local unique={}
    for uid in pairs(Sync.pictureUsers()) do
        local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
        if player then unique[player.Name]=uid; unique["@"..player.Name]=uid; if player.DisplayName~="" and not names[player.DisplayName] then names[player.DisplayName]=uid end end
    end
    -- A username names one player; a display name can be shared, so it only counts when no username is on the card.
    local byDisplay
    for _,item in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") then
            local text=Ident.raw(item)
            if text==lp.Name or text=="@"..lp.Name then return lp.UserId end
            if unique[text] then return unique[text] end
            byDisplay=byDisplay or names[text]
        end
    end
    return byDisplay
end
--[[YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE]]
-- Tapping your own card opens Roblox's panel for your profile; it is then pointed at what you wear. The profile
-- loads from the web, so the request is repeated once in case it finished after the first one.
UI.InspectHooks=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
function UI.hookInspectCard(root)
    if UI.InspectHooks[root] then return end
    -- The card's main button is the largest one (small ones are actions like add friend).
    local button,area=nil,0
    local candidates=root:GetDescendants(); table.insert(candidates,root)
    for _,item in ipairs(candidates) do
        if item:IsA("GuiButton") then
            local size=item.AbsoluteSize.X*item.AbsoluteSize.Y
            if size>area then button,area=item,size end
        end
    end
    if not button then return end
    UI.InspectHooks[root]=true
    UI.connect(button.Activated,function()
        -- Cards are recycled while scrolling: only who the card shows right now counts (you, or a script user
        -- sharing a skin, see THEIR PANEL).
        local who=UI.cardUser(root)
        if not who then return end
        -- Roblox's own request, when heard, already did this (see UI.watchInspect).
        task.delay(0.1,function()
            if not App.alive() or UI.inspectHeard() then return end
            if who==lp.UserId then UI.inspectSelf() else UI.inspectPeer(who) end
        end)
    end)
end
-- Finds your card in the Players page (the list recycles its cards, so every card is checked each time).
function UI.patchMenuAvatar()
    local rgui=game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
    local page=rgui and rgui:FindFirstChild("peoplepage",true)
    if not page then return end
    -- The menu's other pages (the profile page) are followed by their own watcher, started once.
    if not (Thumbs.MenuRoot and Thumbs.MenuRoot.Parent) then pcall(Thumbs.watchMenu,page) end
    local pictures=Store.Settings.MenuAvatar
    -- A profile worn as it is shows that profile's own Roblox picture (its pose or emote included); any other look is
    -- drawn in 3D.
    local profileId=pictures and Thumbs.userFor(App.Current) or nil
    local model,serial
    if pictures and not profileId then model,serial=UI.menuAvatarModel() end
    local names={[lp.DisplayName]=lp.UserId,[lp.Name]=lp.UserId,["@"..lp.Name]=lp.UserId}
    -- Other script users sharing a skin through Skin sync show it in their cards too (see SKIN SYNC PICTURES).
    for uid in pairs(Sync.pictureUsers()) do
        local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
        if player then names[player.Name]=uid; names["@"..player.Name]=uid; if player.DisplayName~="" and not names[player.DisplayName] then names[player.DisplayName]=uid end end
    end
    for _,label in ipairs(page:GetDescendants()) do
        if label:IsA("TextLabel") or label:IsA("TextButton") then
            -- Your name and @username on your card (see YOUR NAME).
            if Ident.Active then pcall(Ident.consider,label) end
        elseif label.Name=="LyraMenuAvatar" then
            -- Ours (a profile picture covering Roblox's): never covered itself.
        elseif not pictures then
            local view=label:FindFirstChild("LyraMenuAvatar")
            if view then view:Destroy(); if label:IsA("ImageLabel") then label.ImageTransparency=0 end end
        elseif label.Name=="AvatarThumbnail" and label:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            local root=label.Parent
            while root and root~=page and not root.Name:find("^VirtualizedItem") do root=root.Parent end
            local who
            if root and root~=page then
                for _,item in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton")) and names[Ident.raw(item)] then who=names[Ident.raw(item)]; break end
                end
                pcall(UI.hookInspectCard,root)
            end
            UI.coverMenuPicture(label,who,Thumbs.read(label.Image),true,model,serial,profileId)
        elseif label:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            -- Other pictures of you in the page (the list view's small pictures): found by the picture they load.
            local info=Thumbs.read(label.Image)
            local who=info and (info.User==lp.UserId or Sync.pictureUsers()[info.User]) and info.User or nil
            UI.coverMenuPicture(label,who,info,false,model,serial,profileId)
        end
    end
end
-- One picture of the Roblox menu: covered by the copied profile's own picture, by a 3D view of the avatar, or by
-- nothing (Roblox's picture shows again). card: the large picture of a player card.
function UI.coverMenuPicture(label,who,info,card,model,serial,profileId)
    local view=label:FindFirstChild("LyraMenuAvatar")
    local shown,shownSerial
    if who==lp.UserId then
        if profileId then shown,shownSerial="profile","user:"..tostring(profileId) else shown,shownSerial=model,serial end
    elseif who then shown,shownSerial=Sync.pictureModel(who) end
    if who and shown then
        if not view or view:GetAttribute("Serial")~=shownSerial then
            if view then view:Destroy() end
            if shown=="profile" then pcall(UI.menuProfilePicture,label,profileId,info,shownSerial)
            elseif card then UI.menuAvatarView(label,shown,shownSerial)
            else pcall(UI.menuPicture,label,shown,shownSerial,info and info.Kind or "Avatar") end
        end
    elseif view then view:Destroy(); label.ImageTransparency=0 end
end
-- The copied profile's own Roblox picture, the same kind and size as the one it covers.
function UI.menuProfilePicture(label,userId,info,serial)
    local image=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    image.Name="LyraMenuAvatar"; image.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); image.BackgroundTransparency=1; image.BorderSizePixel=0
    image.ZIndex=label.ZIndex+1; image.ScaleType=label.ScaleType
    image.Image=Thumbs.swapUser(label.Image,userId) or string.format("rbxthumb://type=%s&id=%d&w=%d&h=%d",info and info.Kind or "Avatar",userId,info and info.W or 420,info and info.H or 420)
    image:SetAttribute("Serial",serial)
    local corner=label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
    if corner then corner:Clone().Parent=image
    elseif label.Name~="AvatarThumbnail" and Thumbs.looksRound(label,label.Image,info and info.Kind) then Thumbs.round(image) end
    label.ImageTransparency=1
    image.Parent=label
end
-- PROFILE PAGE, CURRENTLY WEARING: the Roblox menu's profile page lists the items you really wear. While you wear a
-- copied avatar, Roblox's row is hidden on your screen and a row of ours takes its place: a copy of Roblox's scrolling
-- row (same place, size and style) holding copies of one of Roblox's cards, one per item of the avatar (picture, name
-- and price from the catalog). Roblox places its cards one by one as you scroll (only those on screen exist), so our
-- cards are laid out by a list of our own. Tapping one of ours does nothing. Roblox's row comes back when the avatar is
-- your own, the option is off or the page shows someone else.
UI.Worn=nil
-- The items a profile page lists, in Roblox's order: accessories, makeup, face, clothing, then body parts.
function UI.wornIds(data)
    local list,seen={},{}
    local function add(id) id=Codec.id(tonumber(id)); if id and not seen[id] then seen[id]=true; table.insert(list,id) end end
    if type(data)~="table" then return list end
    local props=data.Version==2 and data.Properties or data
    for _,row in ipairs(type(data.Accessories)=="table" and data.Accessories or {}) do if type(row)=="table" then add(row.AssetId) end end
    if type(props)=="table" then
        for _,field in ipairs(Codec.accessoryFields) do if type(props[field])=="string" then for id in props[field]:gmatch("%d+") do add(id) end end end
    end
    for _,row in ipairs(type(data.Makeup)=="table" and data.Makeup or {}) do if type(row)=="table" then add(row.AssetId) end end
    if type(props)=="table" then
        for _,field in ipairs({"Face","Shirt","Pants","GraphicTShirt","Head","Torso","LeftArm","RightArm","LeftLeg","RightLeg"}) do add(props[field]) end
    end
    return list
end
-- A card of the row: a picture and a text.
function UI.isWornCard(item)
    if not item:IsA("GuiObject") or item:GetAttribute("LyraWorn") then return false end
    local picture,text=false,false
    for _,part in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("ImageLabel") or part:IsA("ImageButton") then picture=true end
        if part:IsA("TextLabel") and part.Text~="" then text=true end
        if picture and text then return true end
    end
    return false
end
-- The row near your @username: a scrolling list whose cards sit side by side. Returns the scrolling frame and the
-- cards on screen. The Players page is never searched.
function UI.wornRow(label)
    local cursor=label.Parent
    for _=1,8 do
        if not cursor or cursor:IsA("LayerCollector") then return nil end
        if Thumbs.PeoplePage and Thumbs.PeoplePage.Parent and Thumbs.PeoplePage:IsDescendantOf(cursor) then return nil end
        local ok,items=pcall(function() return cursor:GetDescendants() end)
        if ok and #items<=4000 then
            for _,scroller in ipairs(items) do
                if scroller:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and not scroller:GetAttribute("LyraWorn") and not label:IsDescendantOf(scroller) and UI.onScreen(scroller) then
                    for _,holder in ipairs({scroller,scroller:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiObject")}) do
                        local cards={}
                        for _,child in ipairs(holder and holder:GetChildren() or {}) do if UI.isWornCard(child) and child.Visible then table.insert(cards,child) end end
                        local first,second=cards[1],cards[2]
                        local sideBySide=second and math.abs(first.AbsolutePosition.Y-second.AbsolutePosition.Y)<=4 and math.abs(first.AbsolutePosition.X-second.AbsolutePosition.X)>4
                        if sideBySide or (first and scroller.ScrollingDirection==Enum.ScrollingDirection.X) then
                            table.sort(cards,function(a,b) return a.AbsolutePosition.X<b.AbsolutePosition.X end)
                            return scroller,cards
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        cursor=cursor.Parent
    end
    return nil
end
-- Where a part sits in a card: at each level its name and which child of that name it is, so the same part is found in
-- a copy of the card (Roblox gives many parts the same name).
function UI.partPath(card,part)
    local steps,cursor={},part
    while cursor and cursor~=card do
        local parent=cursor.Parent
        if not parent then return nil end
        local nth=0
        for _,child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name==cursor.Name then nth=nth+1 end
            if child==cursor then break end
        end
        table.insert(steps,1,{cursor.Name,nth})
        cursor=parent
    end
    return cursor==card and steps or nil
end
function UI.followPath(card,path)
    if not path then return nil end
    local cursor=card
    for _,step in ipairs(path) do
        local found,nth=nil,0
        for _,child in ipairs(cursor:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name==step[1] then nth=nth+1; if nth==step[2] then found=child; break end end
        end
        cursor=found
        if not cursor then return nil end
    end
    return cursor
end
-- A card's parts, read while Roblox's cards are on screen: its pictures (the item's picture can be drawn in more than
-- one layer), its name (the top text), its price (the text with digits in the bottom row) and the Robux sign beside the
-- price (a small picture, or a text drawn in Roblox's icon font).
UI.RobuxSign="\238\128\130"
function UI.wornParts(card)
    local texts,images,largest={},{},0
    for _,part in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("TextLabel") and part.Text~="" and part.Visible then table.insert(texts,part) end
        -- Only parts that draw a picture: the card's own button and frames are images with none.
        if (part:IsA("ImageLabel") or part:IsA("ImageButton")) and part.Visible and part.Image~="" and not part.Image:find("^rbxasset://") then
            table.insert(images,part)
            largest=math.max(largest,part.AbsoluteSize.X*part.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        end
    end
    table.sort(texts,function(a,b)
        if math.abs(a.AbsolutePosition.Y-b.AbsolutePosition.Y)>4 then return a.AbsolutePosition.Y<b.AbsolutePosition.Y end
        return a.AbsolutePosition.X<b.AbsolutePosition.X
    end)
    local parts={Pictures={},Name=texts[1]}
    for _,image in ipairs(images) do
        if largest>0 and image.AbsoluteSize.X*image.AbsoluteSize.Y>=largest*0.4 then table.insert(parts.Pictures,image) end
    end
    local last=texts[#texts]
    if last and last~=parts.Name then
        local row={}
        for _,text in ipairs(texts) do
            if text~=parts.Name and math.abs(text.AbsolutePosition.Y-last.AbsolutePosition.Y)<=4 then table.insert(row,text) end
        end
        -- The price: the text with digits, else (an unavailable item) the widest text of the row.
        for _,text in ipairs(row) do if UI.isPrice(text.Text) then parts.Price=text end end
        if not parts.Price then
            for _,text in ipairs(row) do if not parts.Price or text.AbsoluteSize.X>parts.Price.AbsoluteSize.X then parts.Price=text end end
        end
        -- Any other text of the row left of the price is the Robux sign.
        for _,text in ipairs(row) do
            if text~=parts.Price and text.AbsolutePosition.X<parts.Price.AbsolutePosition.X then parts.SignText=text end
        end
    end
    if parts.Price and not parts.SignText then
        local probe=UI.ownedState()
        UI.ownedSign(probe,parts.Price)
        parts.SignImage=next(probe.Hidden)
        for item,visible in pairs(probe.Hidden) do item.Visible=visible end
    end
    return parts
end
-- The template: a card with a price (so its Robux sign is there to show), else the first one. Read from Roblox's cards
-- on screen, then copied, so the copy is taken before anything is hidden.
function UI.wornTemplate(cards)
    local chosen,unavailable
    for _,card in ipairs(cards) do
        local parts=UI.wornParts(card)
        if parts.Price and UI.isPrice(parts.Price.Text) then chosen=chosen or {Card=card,Parts=parts}
        elseif parts.Price then unavailable=unavailable or parts.Price.Text end
    end
    chosen=chosen or {Card=cards[1],Parts=UI.wornParts(cards[1])}
    local card,parts=chosen.Card,chosen.Parts
    local pictures={}
    for _,image in ipairs(parts.Pictures) do table.insert(pictures,UI.partPath(card,image)) end
    local sample=parts.Price and parts.Price.Text or ""
    -- A price written with the sign in the same text keeps it in front.
    local prefix=sample:match("^(.-"..UI.RobuxSign.."%s*)") or ""
    local copy=card:Clone()
    -- The gap between cards, from Roblox's own row.
    local gap=12
    if cards[2] then gap=math.clamp(cards[2].AbsolutePosition.X-(cards[1].AbsolutePosition.X+cards[1].AbsoluteSize.X),0,64) end
    return {Card=copy,Size=card.AbsoluteSize,Gap=gap,Pictures=pictures,Name=parts.Name and UI.partPath(card,parts.Name),
        Price=parts.Price and UI.partPath(card,parts.Price),Sign=(parts.SignText or parts.SignImage) and UI.partPath(card,parts.SignText or parts.SignImage),
        Prefix=prefix,Unavailable=unavailable or Lang.text("Unavailable"),Sample=sample}
end
-- A price written like Roblox's own in this menu (its thousands separator).
function UI.formatPrice(value,sample)
    local separator=tostring(sample):match("%d([%.,])%d%d%d") or ","
    local text=tostring(math.floor(value))
    while true do
        local changed
        text,changed=text:gsub("^(%d+)(%d%d%d)",function(a,b) return a..separator..b end)
        if changed==0 then break end
    end
    return text
end
function UI.wornPrice(info)
    if type(info)~="table" then return nil end
    if info.IsForSale and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) then return tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) end
    local details=type(info.CollectiblesItemDetails)=="table" and info.CollectiblesItemDetails or nil
    local lowest=details and tonumber(details.CollectibleLowestResalePrice)
    if lowest and lowest>0 then return lowest end
    return nil
end
function UI.fillWornCard(worn,card,id)
    local info=Catalog.Info[id]
    local template=worn.Template
    for _,path in ipairs(template.Pictures) do
        local picture=UI.followPath(card,path)
        if picture then picture.Image=string.format("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=%d&w=150&h=150",id) end
    end
    local name=UI.followPath(card,template.Name)
    if name then name.Text=type(info)=="table" and tostring(info.Name or "") or "…" end
    local price=UI.followPath(card,template.Price)
    local sign=UI.followPath(card,template.Sign)
    local value=UI.wornPrice(info)
    if price then
        if value then price.Text=template.Prefix..UI.formatPrice(value,template.Sample)
        else price.Text=info==nil and "" or template.Unavailable end
    end
    if sign then sign.Visible=value~=nil end
end
function UI.clearWorn()
    local worn=UI.Worn
    UI.Worn=nil
    if not worn then return end
    pcall(function() worn.Row:Destroy() end)
    pcall(function() worn.Template.Card:Destroy() end)
    pcall(function() if worn.Scroller.Parent then worn.Scroller.Visible=worn.WasVisible end end)
end
-- Our row: a copy of Roblox's scrolling frame without its cards, with a list of our own.
function UI.wornBuildRow(scroller)
    local row=scroller:Clone()
    for _,child in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do
        if not (child:IsA("UIPadding") or child:IsA("UICorner")) then child:Destroy() end
    end
    row.Name="LyraWornRow"; row:SetAttribute("LyraWorn",true); row.Visible=true
    row.ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.X; row.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
    row.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(); row.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    return row
end
-- Runs with the Roblox menu's loop while the menu is open.
function UI.patchProfileWorn()
    local label=UI.ProfileName
    local showing=label and label.Parent and UI.onScreen(label) and Ident.raw(label)=="@"..lp.Name
    local snapshot=App.Current
    local wanted=showing and Store.Settings.MenuAvatar and snapshot and not snapshot.Original and type(snapshot.Data)=="table"
    local worn=UI.Worn
    if worn and (not wanted or worn.Label~=label or not worn.Scroller.Parent or not worn.Row.Parent) then UI.clearWorn(); worn=nil end
    if not wanted then return end
    if not worn then
        local scroller,cards=UI.wornRow(label)
        if not scroller or #cards==0 then return end
        local template=UI.wornTemplate(cards)
        -- The gap in the row's own units: the menu may be scaled (UIScale), screen pixels are not.
        local scale=1
        local cursor=scroller
        while cursor and not cursor:IsA("LayerCollector") do
            local factor=cursor:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            if factor and factor.Scale>0 then scale=scale*factor.Scale end
            cursor=cursor.Parent
        end
        local row=UI.wornBuildRow(scroller)
        local list=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        list.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal; list.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        list.Padding=UDim.new(0,math.floor(template.Gap/scale+0.5)); list.Parent=row
        worn={Label=label,Scroller=scroller,Row=row,Template=template,WasVisible=scroller.Visible,Scale=scale}
        UI.Worn=worn
        row.Parent=scroller.Parent
    end
    -- Roblox's row stays hidden (it may show it again when it redraws).
    if worn.Scroller.Visible then worn.Scroller.Visible=false end
    local ids=UI.wornIds(snapshot.Data)
    if worn.Snapshot==snapshot and not worn.Dirty then return end
    for _,child in ipairs(worn.Row:GetChildren()) do if child:GetAttribute("LyraWornCard") then child:Destroy() end end
    worn.Snapshot=snapshot; worn.Dirty=false
    for index,id in ipairs(ids) do
        local ok,card=pcall(function() return worn.Template.Card:Clone() end)
        if ok and card then
            card:SetAttribute("LyraWorn",true); card:SetAttribute("LyraWornCard",true); card.Name="LyraWorn"..index
            card.Visible=true; card.LayoutOrder=index; card.AnchorPoint=Vector2.zero; card.Position=UDim2.new()
            -- Roblox sizes its cards as a share of its fixed scroll width; ours scroll as far as they need.
            card.Size=UDim2.new(0,math.floor(worn.Template.Size.X/worn.Scale+0.5),1,0)
            pcall(UI.fillWornCard,worn,card,id)
            card.Parent=worn.Row
        end
    end
    -- Names and prices come from the catalog in the background; the cards are filled again when they arrive.
    if not worn.Fetching then
        local missing={}
        for _,id in ipairs(ids) do if Catalog.Info[id]==nil then table.insert(missing,id) end end
        if #missing>0 then
            worn.Fetching=true
            task.spawn(function()
                for _,id in ipairs(missing) do
                    if not App.alive() or UI.Worn~=worn then return end
                    pcall(Catalog.info,id)
                end
                worn.Fetching=false
                if UI.Worn==worn then worn.Dirty=true end
            end)
        end
    end
end
-- A picture in the Roblox menu framed like the one it covers (head, bust or whole body).
function UI.menuPicture(label,model,serial,kind)
    local view=Thumbs.view(label,model,kind,Thumbs.looksRound(label,label.Image,kind))
    view.Name="LyraMenuAvatar"; view.ZIndex=label.ZIndex+1; view:SetAttribute("Serial",serial)
    label.ImageTransparency=1
end
-- While the menu is open: fast at first (it builds its cards lazily), then slower to follow scrolling.
function UI.runMenuAvatar()
    if UI.MenuAvatarRunning or not (Store.Settings.MenuAvatar or Ident.Active) then return end
    UI.MenuAvatarRunning=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local started=os.clock()
        while App.alive() and UI.MenuIsOpen and (Store.Settings.MenuAvatar or Ident.Active) do
            pcall(UI.patchMenuAvatar)
            pcall(UI.patchProfileWorn)
            task.wait(os.clock()-started<4 and 0.2 or 0.6)
        end
        UI.MenuAvatarRunning=false
    end)
end
function UI.clearMenuAvatar()
    local rgui=game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
    if rgui then
        for _,item in ipairs(rgui:GetDescendants()) do
            if item.Name=="LyraMenuAvatar" then
                local parent=item.Parent; item:Destroy()
                if parent and parent:IsA("ImageLabel") then parent.ImageTransparency=0 end
            end
        end
    end
    if UI.MenuAvatar then pcall(function() UI.MenuAvatar.Model:Destroy() end); UI.MenuAvatar=nil end
    pcall(UI.clearWorn)
end
function UI.menuReopen()
    UI.Minimized=false; UI.setVisible(true); UI.layout(false)
    App.toast({Title="Avatar Studio reopened",Text="You opened the Roblox menu 3 times in a row. If that was by accident, you can turn this shortcut off.",
        Kind="info",Icon="menu",Duration=9,
        Action={Text="Turn off shortcut",Callback=function()
            if not App.alive() then return end
            Store.Settings.MenuReopen=false; App.persist()
            local refresh=UI.Toggles and UI.Toggles.MenuReopen; if refresh then refresh() end
            UI.refreshReopenCard()
            App.report("Roblox menu shortcut turned off. You can turn it back on in Settings.","info")
        end}})
end
function UI.watchMenu()
    local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
    UI.connect(GuiService.MenuOpened,function() UI.MenuIsOpen=true; UI.runMenuAvatar() end)
    UI.connect(GuiService.MenuClosed,function() UI.MenuIsOpen=false end)
    local stamps={}
    local openedAt=nil
    UI.connect(GuiService.MenuOpened,function()
        openedAt=(not UI.Visible and Store.Settings.MenuReopen) and os.clock() or nil
    end)
    -- A close only counts when its open was seen while the window was hidden and the shortcut was on.
    UI.connect(GuiService.MenuClosed,function()
        local opened=openedAt; openedAt=nil
        if not opened or UI.Visible or not Store.Settings.MenuReopen then table.clear(stamps); return end
        local now=os.clock()
        table.insert(stamps,now)
        while #stamps>0 and now-stamps[1]>5 do table.remove(stamps,1) end
        if #stamps>=3 then table.clear(stamps); UI.menuReopen() end
    end)
end
-- DEV: MENU DUMP. Dev builds only: "/lyradump" in chat writes, for the next 2 minutes, text files of Roblox's own
-- screens as they appear on screen (the avatar panel, the Roblox menu's Players and profile pages, the leaderboard),
-- so their real layout can be read: LyraDump_<screen>.txt in the executor's workspace folder.
function UI.dumpValue(value)
    local kind=typeof(value)
    if kind=="Vector2" then return string.format("%d,%d",math.floor(value.X+0.5),math.floor(value.Y+0.5)) end
    if kind=="UDim2" then return string.format("{%.2f,%d,%.2f,%d}",value.X.Scale,value.X.Offset,value.Y.Scale,value.Y.Offset) end
    if kind=="Color3" then return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X",math.floor(value.R*255+0.5),math.floor(value.G*255+0.5),math.floor(value.B*255+0.5)) end
    if kind=="number" then return (string.format("%.3f",value):gsub("%.?0+$","")) end
    if kind=="EnumItem" then return value.Name end
    if kind=="string" then return string.format("%q",#value>90 and value:sub(1,90).."…" or value) end
    return tostring(value)
end
function UI.dumpTree(root)
    local lines={}
    local function prop(item,name,styled)
        local ok,value=pcall(function() return styled and UI.styled(item,name) or item[name] end)
        return ok and value~=nil and (name.."="..UI.dumpValue(value)) or nil
    end
    local function walk(item,depth)
        if #lines>=8000 then return end
        local parts={string.rep("  ",depth)..item.ClassName.." \""..item.Name.."\""}
        if item:IsA("GuiObject") then
            for _,name in ipairs({"Visible","AbsolutePosition","AbsoluteSize","Size","Position","AnchorPoint","LayoutOrder","ZIndex","AutomaticSize"}) do
                table.insert(parts,prop(item,name))
            end
            table.insert(parts,prop(item,"BackgroundTransparency",true)); table.insert(parts,prop(item,"BackgroundColor3",true))
            if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") or item:IsA("TextBox") then
                for _,name in ipairs({"Text","TextTransparency","TextColor3","TextSize","RichText"}) do table.insert(parts,prop(item,name,name~="Text")) end
                pcall(function() table.insert(parts,"Font="..item.FontFace.Family) end)
            end
            if item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton") then
                for _,name in ipairs({"Image","ImageTransparency","ScaleType"}) do table.insert(parts,prop(item,name,name~="Image")) end
            end
            if item:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                for _,name in ipairs({"ScrollingDirection","CanvasSize","AbsoluteCanvasSize","AutomaticCanvasSize","CanvasPosition"}) do table.insert(parts,prop(item,name)) end
            end
            if item:IsA("GuiButton") then table.insert(parts,"Button") end
        elseif item:IsA("UIListLayout") then
            table.insert(parts,prop(item,"FillDirection")); table.insert(parts,prop(item,"Padding"))
        elseif item:IsA("UICorner") then table.insert(parts,prop(item,"CornerRadius"))
        elseif item:IsA("UIPadding") then table.insert(parts,prop(item,"PaddingLeft")); table.insert(parts,prop(item,"PaddingTop"))
        elseif item:IsA("UIScale") then table.insert(parts,prop(item,"Scale")) end
        pcall(function() local tags=item:GetTags(); if #tags>0 then table.insert(parts,"tags="..table.concat(tags," ")) end end)
        local attributes={}
        pcall(function() for key in pairs(item:GetAttributes()) do table.insert(attributes,key) end end)
        if #attributes>0 then table.insert(parts,"attrs="..table.concat(attributes,",")) end
        table.insert(lines,table.concat(parts," "))
        local ok,children=pcall(function() return item:GetChildren() end)
        for _,child in ipairs(ok and children or {}) do walk(child,depth+1) end
    end
    walk(root,0)
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
-- The screens to write, when they are on screen.
function UI.dumpTargets()
    local targets={}
    local core=game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local inspect=UI.inspectRoot()
    if inspect then table.insert(targets,{"InspectPanel",inspect}) end
    local rgui=core:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
    local page=rgui and rgui:FindFirstChild("peoplepage",true)
    if page and UI.onScreen(page) then table.insert(targets,{"PlayersPage",page}) end
    local label=UI.ProfileName
    if label and label.Parent and UI.onScreen(label) then
        -- The profile page: the frame around your @username that also holds the row of worn items.
        local cursor=label
        for _=1,8 do
            if not cursor.Parent or cursor.Parent:IsA("LayerCollector") or (page and page:IsDescendantOf(cursor.Parent)) then break end
            cursor=cursor.Parent
        end
        table.insert(targets,{"ProfilePage",cursor})
    end
    local list=core:FindFirstChild("PlayerList")
    if list then table.insert(targets,{"Leaderboard",list}) end
    return targets
end
function UI.startDump()
    if type(writefile)~="function" then App.report("This executor can't write files.","warning"); return end
    UI.DumpUntil=os.clock()+120
    App.report("Menu dump on for 2 minutes: open the Roblox menu, your profile page and the avatar panel, and wait 3 seconds on each.","info")
    if UI.Dumping then return end
    UI.Dumping=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local written={}
        while App.alive() and os.clock()<UI.DumpUntil do
            for _,target in ipairs(UI.dumpTargets()) do
                local name,root=target[1],target[2]
                local row=written[name]
                -- Written once it has been on screen for 2 seconds (loaded), and again if it changed screens.
                if not row or row.Root~=root then written[name]={Root=root,Since=os.clock(),Done=false}
                elseif not row.Done and os.clock()-row.Since>=2 then
                    row.Done=true
                    local ok,text=pcall(UI.dumpTree,root)
                    if ok then
                        local header=string.format("Avatar Studio menu dump · %s · %s · %dx%d\n",name,os.date("!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y)
                        pcall(writefile,"LyraDump_"..name..".txt",header..text)
                        App.report("Menu dump written: LyraDump_"..name..".txt","success")
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
        UI.Dumping=false
    end)
end
function UI.inputs()
    UI.watchMenu()
    UI.connect(UIS.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
        if UI.CapturingKey and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            UI.CapturingKey=false
            if input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Escape and input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                local reserved={L=true,R=true,K=true,W=true,A=true,S=true,D=true,Space=true,Return=true,Tab=true,Backspace=true}
                if reserved[input.KeyCode.Name] then App.report("That key is already used by the game or hub. Choose another one.","warning")
                else Store.Settings.Keybind=input.KeyCode.Name; App.persist(); UI.refreshReopenCard() end
            end
            UI.KeyButton.Label.Text=Store.Settings.Keybind; return
        end
        if processed or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.KeyCode.Name==Store.Settings.Keybind then UI.setVisible(not UI.Visible) end
    end)
    local function chat(message)
        local normalized=message:lower():gsub("%s+","")
        local devBuild=rawget(_G,"LyraDevBuild")
        if normalized=="/lyradump" and type(devBuild)=="string" and devBuild:match("^%x+$") then UI.startDump(); return end
        if normalized=="/lyralog" and type(devBuild)=="string" and devBuild:match("^%x+$") then App.startLog(); return end
        if normalized=="/ecopier" or normalized=="/ehub" or normalized=="/copier" or normalized=="/hub" or normalized=="/edance1" or normalized=="/dance1" then
            UI.Minimized=false; UI.setVisible(true); UI.layout(false); App.report("Hub opened.","info")
            return
        end
        -- The same message can arrive through more than one chat event; act on it once.
        local command=normalized:gsub("^/e","/")
        if command~="/next" and command~="/prev" and command~="/cycle" then return end
        if UI.LastChatCommand==command and os.clock()-(UI.LastChatAt or 0)<1 then return end
        UI.LastChatCommand=command; UI.LastChatAt=os.clock()
        if command=="/next" then Auto.switchNow(1)
        elseif command=="/prev" then Auto.switchNow(-1)
        else
            Store.Auto.CycleEnabled=not Store.Auto.CycleEnabled
            Auto.DeathsSince=0; Auto.TimerStart=os.clock(); Auto.Pending=nil
            App.persist(); UI.renderAuto()
            App.report(Store.Auto.CycleEnabled and "Avatar cycle on." or "Avatar cycle off.","info")
        end
    end
    UI.connect(lp.Chatted,chat)
    pcall(function()
        local tcs=game:GetService("TextChatService")
        -- "/e copier" is handled by Roblox's emote command, so it never reaches the chat window.
        pcall(function()
            local commands=tcs:FindFirstChild("TextChatCommands")
            local emote=commands and commands:FindFirstChild("RBXEmoteCommand")
            if emote then UI.connect(emote.Triggered,function(source,text) if (not source or source.UserId==lp.UserId) and type(text)=="string" then chat(text) end end) end
        end)
        UI.connect(tcs.MessageReceived,function(message) if message.TextSource and message.TextSource.UserId==lp.UserId then chat(message.Text) end end)
        local command=UI.new("TextChatCommand",{Name="LyraCopierCommand",PrimaryAlias="/copier",SecondaryAlias="/hub"},tcs)
        UI.ChatCommand=command
        UI.connect(command.Triggered,function(source) if not source or source.UserId==lp.UserId then chat("/copier") end end)
    end)
end

-- Discord invite: at most two ever. The first plays 5 minutes into a session of this version; the second
-- 1 minute into the 10th run counted from that first one. Without saved data the counts would reset every
-- run, so it never plays then. It respects the Show notifications and Copy the Discord invite settings.
function UI.schedulePromo()
    if type(writefile)~="function" or Store.ReadOnly or not Store.Settings.CopyDiscord then return end
    local promo=Store.Promo
    if promo.Shown>=2 then return end
    promo.Runs=math.min(promo.Runs+1,1000)
    if not App.persist() then return end
    local second=promo.Shown==1
    if second and (promo.Runs<10 or promo.Runs<=promo.FirstAt) then return end
    task.delay(second and 60 or 300,function()
        if not App.alive() or not Store.Settings.Notifications or not Store.Settings.CopyDiscord or not UI.Toasts then return end
        promo.Shown=promo.Shown+1
        if promo.Shown==1 then promo.FirstAt=promo.Runs end
        App.persist()
        local function join()
            local copy=type(setclipboard)=="function" and setclipboard or type(toclipboard)=="function" and toclipboard or nil
            if copy and pcall(copy,App.Creator.Discord) then App.report("Discord invite copied. Paste it in your browser to join.","success"); return end
            UI.Minimized=false; UI.setVisible(true); UI.layout(false); UI.selectTab("Creator")
        end
        -- It closes only when its timer runs out or the invite is copied, never on a stray tap.
        UI.Toasts:Notify({Featured=true,Dismissible=false,Kind="info",Image=UI.LogoImage,Icon="discord",Duration=15,
            Title=second and "You're one of the regulars!" or "Enjoying Avatar Studio?",
            Text=second and "Join the Lyra Discord: new features land there first, plus requests, sneak peeks and help."
                or "Join the Lyra Discord to get updates first, request features and get help fast.",
            Action={Text="Join the Discord",Callback=join}})
    end)
end

-- SKIN OVERLAY: draws an avatar over a character without changing the character. The avatar is a separate local
-- model that follows the character every frame, so the game's rig, joints, animations and movement stay exactly as
-- they were. Used for other script users' skins (skin sync) and for the visual-only mode.
-- Two ways to follow, chosen per character:
--   joints: the character has the standard joints. The overlay keeps its own proportions; its root follows the
--           character's root (lifted by the difference in standing height) and every joint copies the matching
--           joint's animation Transform.
--   parts:  anything else (custom rigs). Each overlay body part is placed on the visible part with the same name.
Overlay.EvadeGame = 3647333358
-- Overlay.Auto: on for this game in this session when an avatar that only shows right on R15 went on an R6 character
-- (see R15 AVATARS IN R6 GAMES).
function Overlay.visualOnly()
    return Store.Settings.VisualOnly == true or game.GameId == Overlay.EvadeGame or Overlay.Auto == true
end
-- The folder lives in the camera (local only, and out of reach of game scripts that look for characters in
-- workspace). It follows the current camera, and a removed overlay is rebuilt from its spare copy (Overlay.revive).
-- A game that keeps clearing the camera (three losses in ten seconds) gets the folder in workspace instead.
Overlay.FolderLosses = {}
function Overlay.folder()
    local parent = Overlay.InWorkspace and workspace or workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace
    local folder = Overlay.Folder
    if folder then
        local moved = pcall(function() if folder.Parent ~= parent then folder.Parent = parent end end)
        if moved and folder.Parent == parent then return folder end
        local now = os.clock()
        table.insert(Overlay.FolderLosses, now)
        while #Overlay.FolderLosses > 0 and now - Overlay.FolderLosses[1] > 10 do table.remove(Overlay.FolderLosses, 1) end
        if #Overlay.FolderLosses >= 3 and not Overlay.InWorkspace then Overlay.InWorkspace = true; parent = workspace end
    end
    folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name = "LyraSkinOverlays"; folder.Parent = parent
    Overlay.Folder = folder
    return folder
end
-- The part a character moves by: its HumanoidRootPart, else its PrimaryPart, else a torso or head. Games with their
-- own movement (Evade) do not always give the character a Humanoid or a standard root.
function Overlay.rootOf(character)
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then return root end
    local primary = character and character.PrimaryPart
    if primary then return primary end
    for _, name in ipairs({"Root", "RootPart", "Torso", "UpperTorso", "Head"}) do
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then return part end
    end
    return character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or nil
end
-- WORLD SCAN: models anywhere in the world are found by one shared scan that visits a few hundred instances every
-- frame (workspace and the camera, four folders or models deep), never all at once: searching the whole map every
-- few seconds froze big games (city and driving maps) for a moment each time. It notes models named after a player
-- (a game's separate render model) and models whose body stands where your character is.
Overlay.Scanner = {Found = {}, Named = {}, Done = -math.huge, Passes = 0}
-- A root, torso or head part of the model within a few studs of origin: that distance, else nil.
function Overlay.nearBody(model, origin)
    local near
--[==[YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE]==]
    for _, name in ipairs({"HumanoidRootPart", "Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "Head"}) do
        local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            local distance = (part.Position - origin).Magnitude
            if distance < 3.5 and (not near or distance < near) then near = distance end
        end
    end
    return near
end
function Overlay.scanStep(budget)
    local scan = Overlay.Scanner
    if not scan.Stack then
        if os.clock() - scan.Done < 2 then return end
        scan.Stack, scan.PassFound, scan.PassNamed, scan.Names, scan.Skip = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            scan.Names[player.Name] = true
            if player.Character then scan.Skip[player.Character] = true end
        end
        local root = lp.Character and Overlay.rootOf(lp.Character)
        scan.Origin = root and root.Position or nil
        for _, container in ipairs({workspace, workspace.CurrentCamera}) do
            local ok, list = pcall(function() return container:GetChildren() end)
            if ok then table.insert(scan.Stack, {list, 1, 1}) end
        end
    end
    local stack = scan.Stack
    while budget > 0 and #stack > 0 do
        local top = stack[#stack]
        local child = top[1][top[2]]
        if child == nil then
            table.remove(stack)
        else
            -- The index moves on first, so an instance that errors is skipped next time instead of blocking the scan.
            top[2] = top[2] + 1; budget = budget - 1
            local depth = top[3]
            local isModel = child:IsA("Model")
            if (isModel or child:IsA("Folder")) and child ~= Overlay.Folder and not scan.Skip[child] then
                if isModel then
                    if depth <= 3 and scan.Names[child.Name] then
                        local list = scan.PassNamed[child.Name]
                        if not list then list = {}; scan.PassNamed[child.Name] = list end
                        table.insert(list, child)
                    end
                    if scan.Origin then
                        local ok, near = pcall(Overlay.nearBody, child, scan.Origin)
                        if ok and near then table.insert(scan.PassFound, child) end
                    end
                end
                if depth < 4 then
                    local ok, list = pcall(function() return child:GetChildren() end)
                    if ok and #list > 0 then table.insert(stack, {list, 1, depth + 1}) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #stack == 0 then
        scan.Found, scan.Named = scan.PassFound, scan.PassNamed
        scan.Stack, scan.PassFound, scan.PassNamed, scan.Skip = nil, nil, nil, nil
        scan.Done = os.clock(); scan.Passes = scan.Passes + 1
    end
end
-- The first look happens at once (the avatar is being applied, a short wait is expected then); later ones spread out.
function Overlay.scanReady()
    for _ = 1, 3 do
        if Overlay.Scanner.Passes > 0 then return end
        pcall(Overlay.scanStep, math.huge)
    end
end
-- Some games draw the visible body as a separate model named after the player (Evade keeps one per player). It is
-- looked for where games keep it (up to three folders deep in workspace). Returns the model and whether a joint links
-- it to the character's root (otherwise it was found only because its visible body stands where the character is).
function Overlay.renderRig(character)
    local root = Overlay.rootOf(character)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    if not root or not player then return nil end
    local function check(model)
        if not model or model == character or not model:IsA("Model") or model:IsDescendantOf(character)
            or (Overlay.Folder and model:IsDescendantOf(Overlay.Folder)) then return nil end
        for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("JointInstance") or item:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                local ok, linked = pcall(function() return item.Part0 == root or item.Part1 == root end)
                if ok and linked then return model, true end
            end
        end
        for _, item in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("JointInstance") or item:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                local ok, linked = pcall(function() return (item.Part0 ~= nil and item.Part0:IsDescendantOf(model)) or (item.Part1 ~= nil and item.Part1:IsDescendantOf(model)) end)
                if ok and linked then return model, true end
            end
        end
        local near = 0
        for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("BasePart") and S.BD[item.Name] and item.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and item.Transparency < 1
                and not item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") and (item.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < 8 then
                near = near + 1
                if near >= 3 then return model, false end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local found, linked = check(workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name))
    if found then return found, linked end
    for _, model in ipairs(Overlay.Scanner.Named[player.Name] or {}) do
        if model.Parent then
            found, linked = check(model)
            if found then return found, linked end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
-- Other models drawing your body where you stand. A game can keep the visible body on a separate model with any name,
-- in workspace or only on your screen in the camera (Evade switches to one once a cosmetic or skin was equipped). A
-- model counts when a root, torso or head part of it is within a few studs of your character's root and it shows at
-- least three body parts; other players' characters never count. A spatial query finds most of them; deep adds what
-- the world scan found (parts that spatial queries skip) and the camera. Nearest first.
-- entry: the overlay hiding them, so a body it already hid still counts.
function Overlay.bodies(character, deep, entry)
    local root = Overlay.rootOf(character)
    if not root then return {} end
    local origin = root.Position
    local others = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local other = player.Character
        if other and other ~= character then others[other] = true end
    end
    local function inOther(model)
        local cursor = model
        while cursor and cursor ~= workspace do
            if others[cursor] then return true end
            cursor = cursor.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local seen, rows = {}, {}
    local check
    -- One odd model never stops the search for the others.
    local function consider(model, inside)
        if seen[model] then return end
        seen[model] = true
        pcall(check, model, inside)
    end
    check = function(model, inside)
        if model == character or (not inside and model:IsDescendantOf(character)) or (Overlay.Folder and model:IsDescendantOf(Overlay.Folder)) or inOther(model) then return end
        local near = Overlay.nearBody(model, origin)
        if not near then return end
        local visible = 0
        for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            -- Only parts where you stand count (see FAR BODIES).
            if item:IsA("BasePart") and S.BD[item.Name] and item.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and not item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
                and (item.Position - origin).Magnitude <= 12 and (entry and Overlay.original(entry, item) or item.Transparency) < 1 then
                visible = visible + 1
                if visible >= 3 then table.insert(rows, {Model = model, Distance = near}); return end
            end
        end
    end
    -- A body drawn by a model nested inside the character itself (first, so it is judged as such).
    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("Model") and not item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then consider(item, true) end
    end
    pcall(function()
        local params = OverlapParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Overlay.Folder and {character, Overlay.Folder} or {character}
        for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(origin, 4, params)) do
            if S.BD[part.Name] then
                local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                if model then consider(model) end
            end
        end
    end)
    if deep then
        Overlay.scanReady()
        for _, model in ipairs(Overlay.Scanner.Found) do if model.Parent then consider(model) end end
        -- The camera holds few things and a body there can appear at any moment: it is looked at directly.
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        for _, child in ipairs(camera and camera:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if child ~= Overlay.Folder and (child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder")) then
                if child:IsA("Model") then consider(child) end
                for _, inner in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do if inner:IsA("Model") then consider(inner) end end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(rows, function(x, y) return x.Distance < y.Distance end)
--- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    local models = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do table.insert(models, row.Model) end
    return models
end
-- Whether a model's body is being animated: an Animator writes the joints' Transform every frame (an idle included),
-- so any joint away from its rest pose means it moves. A body moved by CFrame instead (no animated joints) counts when
-- its limbs changed pose since the last look (kept per overlay entry).
-- direct: only the model's own body (joints moving its direct children), not a body nested inside it.
function Overlay.animated(model, entry, direct)
    for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        local joint = (item:IsA("Motor6D") or item:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) and not item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
        if joint and direct then
            local ok, _, part1 = pcall(Overlay.jointInfo, item)
            joint = ok and part1 ~= nil and part1.Parent == model
        end
        if joint then
            local ok, moving = pcall(function()
                local t = item.Transform
                return t.Position.Magnitude > 1e-3 or t.LookVector.Z > -0.99999 or t.UpVector.Y < 0.99999
            end)
            if ok and moving then return true end
        end
    end
    if not entry then return false end
    local torso = model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    if not (torso and torso:IsA("BasePart")) then return false end
    local key = 0
    for index, name in ipairs({"Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg", "LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg"}) do
        local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            local ok, value = pcall(function()
                local relative = torso.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
                return relative.LookVector.Y * index + relative.UpVector.Z * index * 3
            end)
            if ok then key = key + value end
        end
    end
    entry.Poses = entry.Poses or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local last = entry.Poses[model]
    entry.Poses[model] = key
    return last ~= nil and math.abs(last - key) > 1e-3
end
-- The body to follow: the render model when a joint links it to the character. Otherwise the body the game animates:
-- when one copy of your body moves while the other stands still, the moving one (Evade animates its separate body,
-- not the character, once a cosmetic or skin was equipped). Otherwise by what you see: the character while its own body
-- shows, else the copy followed so far, the render model, or the nearest body drawn where the character stands.
function Overlay.target(character, extras)
    local rig, linked = Overlay.renderRig(character)
    if rig and linked then return rig end
    local entry = Overlay.Active[character]
    local candidates = {}
    if rig then table.insert(candidates, rig) end
    for _, model in ipairs(extras or {}) do if model ~= rig then table.insert(candidates, model) end end
    if #candidates == 0 then return character end
    local own = Overlay.animated(character, entry, true)
    local moving
    for _, model in ipairs(candidates) do
        if Overlay.animated(model, entry) then moving = moving or model end
    end
    if own and not moving then return character end
    if moving and not own then return moving end
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and S.BD[part.Name] and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            local transparency = entry and Overlay.original(entry, part) or part.Transparency
            if transparency < 1 then return character end
        end
    end
    if entry and entry.Target and entry.Target ~= character and table.find(candidates, entry.Target) then return entry.Target end
    return candidates[1]
end
-- The rig the overlay is built as: the one the visible (animated) body uses.
function Overlay.rigType(character)
    local root = Overlay.rootOf(character)
    local extras = root and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) == lp and Overlay.bodies(character, true) or nil
    return F.getTrueRigType(Overlay.target(character, extras)) or F.getTrueRigType(character)
end
-- Height of the root's centre above the feet when standing (Roblox's HipHeight rule for R15 and R6).
function Overlay.standHeight(model)
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
    local height = hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
    if F.getTrueRigType(model) == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
        local leg = model:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
        height = height + (leg and leg:IsA("BasePart") and leg.Size.Y or 2)
    end
    return height
end
-- Turns a built avatar model into a puppet: no physics, no animator of its own, root anchored.
-- Height of the root's centre above the lowest point of the body in the rest pose, measured on the real geometry.
-- Roblox's HipHeight for an avatar does not always match its legs (Korblox, for example), which made skins hover.
function Overlay.restHeight(model)
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
    local lowest
    for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= root and Appearance.isBody(part, model) then
            local cf, half = part.CFrame, part.Size / 2
            for _, x in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                for _, y in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                    for _, z in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                        local point = cf * Vector3.new(half.X * x, half.Y * y, half.Z * z)
                        if not lowest or point.Y < lowest then lowest = point.Y end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return lowest and root.Position.Y - lowest or nil
end
function Overlay.prepare(model)
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    -- Off before the model enters the world: a live Humanoid turns its head/torso collisions back on.
    if hum then pcall(function() hum.EvaluateStateMachine = false end) end
    UI.preparePreview(model, Overlay.folder())
    model.Name = "LyraSkinOverlay"
    -- Measured now, while the model is still in its rest pose (preparePreview just posed it from its joints).
    local stand = Overlay.restHeight(model)
    if stand then model:SetAttribute("LyraStandHeight", stand) end
    -- Rest pose of every part relative to the root, for drawing this avatar on a body of the other rig type.
    local restRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if restRoot then
        for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part:SetAttribute("LyraRest", restRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)) end
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        hum.EvaluateStateMachine = false
        hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
        hum.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
        hum.RequiresNeck = false; hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
    end)
    -- Only the copied joint transforms may move the overlay's joints.
    for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("Animator") then item:Destroy()
        elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then item.Massless = true end
    end
end
function Overlay.setMode(entry, mode)
    if entry.Mode == mode and (mode ~= "puppet" or (entry.Puppet and entry.Puppet.Model == entry.Model)) then return end
    if entry.Puppet then Overlay.puppetStop(entry) end
    entry.Mode = mode; entry.Limbs = nil; entry.ArmBlend = 0; entry.BodyBlend = 0
    local model = entry.Model
    for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("Motor6D") or item:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
            item.Enabled = mode ~= "parts"
            pcall(function() item.Transform = CFrame.new() end)
        end
    end
    for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or Appearance.isBody(part, model)) then
            part.Anchored = mode == "parts" or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
        end
    end
    if mode == "puppet" then Overlay.puppetStart(entry) end
end
function Overlay.build(data, rig)
    local desc = Codec.decode(data)
    local built, model = pcall(Visual.model, data, desc, rig); desc:Destroy()
    assert(built and model, tostring(model))
    Overlay.prepare(model)
    return model
end
function Overlay.showLocal(character, source)
    local model = source:Clone(); assert(model, "Could not prepare the avatar.")
    -- Read now, while the avatar is being applied and waiting is fine: the animations a puppet would play, and the
    -- mood of a dynamic head.
    local set, pack = Overlay.animationSet(model)
    local mood = Overlay.moodSet(model, character)
    Overlay.prepare(model)
    Overlay.attach(character, model, true, "local", {AnimSet = set, Pack = pack, Mood = mood})
end
-- MOOD: a dynamic head's face moves with a mood animation (a smile, a frown) that Animate plays on your character.
-- The avatar drawn over your character plays its own: the avatar's mood, else the one your character's Animate has
-- (Roblox's default), so its face is never left blank. Yields; nil for a head without face controls.
function Overlay.moodSet(model, character)
    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not (head and head:FindFirstChildOfClass("FaceControls")) then return nil end
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local desc = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("HumanoidDescription")
    local ok, assetId = pcall(function() return desc and desc.MoodAnimation end)
    if ok and tonumber(assetId) and tonumber(assetId) ~= 0 then
        local sets = F.animationSets(assetId)
        if sets and sets.mood and #sets.mood > 0 then return sets.mood end
        local one = F.resolveAnimationTrackId(assetId)
        if one then return {{Id = one}} end
    end
    local animate = character and character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    local folder = animate and F.animateFolder(animate, "mood")
    local list = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(folder and folder:GetDescendants() or {}) do
        if child:IsA("Animation") and child.AnimationId ~= "" then table.insert(list, {Id = child.AnimationId}) end
    end
    return #list > 0 and list or nil
end
-- Keeps the mood playing on the drawn avatar (started again if the model was rebuilt or its animator went).
function Overlay.playMood(entry)
    local model = entry.Model
    local track = entry.MoodTrack
    if track and entry.MoodModel == model and track.IsPlaying and entry.MoodAnimator and entry.MoodAnimator.Parent then return end
    local controller = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
    if not controller then controller = Instance.new("AnimationController"); controller.Parent = model end
    local animator = controller:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then animator = Instance.new("Animator"); animator.Parent = controller end
    local row = entry.Mood[Overlay.pickVariant(entry.Mood)] or entry.Mood[1]
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation"); animation.AnimationId = F.normalizeAnimId(row.Id)
    local loaded = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    loaded.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core; loaded.Looped = true
    loaded:Play(0.3)
    entry.MoodTrack, entry.MoodModel, entry.MoodAnimator = loaded, model, animator
end
-- PUPPET: an overlay of the other rig type (an R6 avatar drawn on an R15 character, or the other way round) cannot copy
-- the character's joints: following the limbs one by one warped it. Then the overlay animates itself the way
-- Roblox's Animate script does: idle, walk and run (blended by speed), jump, fall, climb, swim and sit follow the
-- character's Humanoid (or the root's motion when there is none), and a held tool raises the arm. What the character
-- carries is drawn on it (see CARRIED ITEMS). On the same rig the overlay always copies the joints: an avatar's own
-- animations are played by the character itself then (see App.visualAnimations), so the hidden body and the overlay
-- move together, and what the body carries is drawn on the overlay's hands and back.
Overlay.PuppetDefaults = {
    R15 = {idle = {{Id = 507766388, Weight = 9}, {Id = 507766666, Weight = 1}}, walk = {{Id = 507777826}}, run = {{Id = 507767714}},
        jump = {{Id = 507765000}}, fall = {{Id = 507767968}}, climb = {{Id = 507765644}}, swim = {{Id = 507784897}},
        swimidle = {{Id = 507785072}}, sit = {{Id = 2506281703}}, toolnone = {{Id = 507768375}}},
    R6 = {idle = {{Id = 180435571, Weight = 9}, {Id = 180435792, Weight = 1}}, walk = {{Id = 180426354}}, run = {{Id = 180426354}},
        jump = {{Id = 125750702}}, fall = {{Id = 180436148}}, climb = {{Id = 180436334}}, sit = {{Id = 178130996}}, toolnone = {{Id = 182393478}}},
}
Overlay.PuppetLooped = {idle = true, walk = true, run = true, fall = true, climb = true, swim = true, swimidle = true, sit = true, toolnone = true}
-- Yields. The animations a puppet of this model plays: Roblox's defaults for its rig and, with Copy animations on,
-- the avatar's own animation pack (packs are R15 animations). Returns the set and whether a pack is in it.
function Overlay.animationSet(model)
    local rig = F.getTrueRigType(model) == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and "R6" or "R15"
    local set, pack = {}, false
    for name, list in pairs(Overlay.PuppetDefaults[rig]) do set[name] = list end
    if rig ~= "R15" or not Store.Settings.CopyAnims then return set, pack end
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local desc = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("HumanoidDescription")
    if not desc then return set, pack end
    local map = {IdleAnimation = {"idle"}, WalkAnimation = {"walk"}, RunAnimation = {"run"}, JumpAnimation = {"jump"},
        FallAnimation = {"fall"}, ClimbAnimation = {"climb"}, SwimAnimation = {"swim", "swimidle"}}
    for field, names in pairs(map) do
        local ok, assetId = pcall(function() return desc[field] end)
        if ok and tonumber(assetId) and tonumber(assetId) ~= 0 then
            local sets = F.animationSets(assetId)
            if sets then
                for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                    local list = sets[name]
                    if list and #list > 0 then set[name] = list; pack = true end
                end
            else
                local one = F.resolveAnimationTrackId(assetId)
                if one then set[names[1]] = {{Id = one}}; pack = true end
            end
        end
    end
    return set, pack
end
-- Whether this overlay should animate itself on this body: only when it is of the other rig type.
function Overlay.wantsPuppet(entry, target)
    if not entry.Local or not entry.AnimSet then return false end
    if entry.Stiff and target == entry.Character then return true end
    local own, real = F.getTrueRigType(entry.Model), F.getTrueRigType(target)
    return own ~= nil and real ~= nil and own ~= real
end
-- STIFF BODY: the avatar drawn over your character copies its joints, so a character the game leaves without
-- animations (a game whose Animate stopped, or that drives the body its own way) drew a stiff avatar. Once your
-- character's limbs have not moved for a moment, your avatar animates itself as a puppet does (idle, walk, jump…,
-- with its own animation pack when Copy animations is on), and it copies the joints again once your character moves
-- its limbs again. Checked a few times a second.
-- FROZEN AVATAR: an avatar drawn by copying the joints could stand frozen on some skins while your character moved (a
-- cause not found yet). Six times a second the drawn avatar's limbs are compared with your character's: when your
-- character's limbs move and the drawn ones have not moved for a moment, the avatar is linked again; when that happens a
-- second time, this avatar follows your character's parts directly instead (as in Evade), which always moves with it.
-- A key of how the limbs sit relative to the torso: it changes whenever they move.
function Overlay.poseKey(model)
    local torso = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not (torso and torso:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil end
    local key, found = 0, false
    for index, name in ipairs({"LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg", "LeftLowerArm", "RightLowerArm",
        "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg"}) do
        local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            local relative = torso.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
            key = key + (relative.LookVector.Y + relative.UpVector.Z * 3 + relative.RightVector.Y * 5) * index
            found = true
        end
    end
    return found and key or nil
end
function Overlay.checkFollow(entry)
    if not entry.Local or entry.Mode ~= "joints" or entry.Target ~= entry.Character then entry.FrozenChecks = 0; entry.LastRealKey = nil; return end
    local real, mine = Overlay.poseKey(entry.Character), Overlay.poseKey(entry.Model)
    if not real or not mine then return end
    local realMoved = entry.LastRealKey ~= nil and math.abs(real - entry.LastRealKey) > 1e-3
    local mineMoved = entry.LastMineKey ~= nil and math.abs(mine - entry.LastMineKey) > 1e-4
    entry.LastRealKey, entry.LastMineKey = real, mine
    if mineMoved then entry.FrozenChecks = 0
    elseif realMoved then entry.FrozenChecks = (entry.FrozenChecks or 0) + 1 end
    if (entry.FrozenChecks or 0) < 9 then return end
    entry.FrozenChecks, entry.LastRealKey, entry.LastMineKey = 0, nil, nil
    entry.Refollows = (entry.Refollows or 0) + 1
    if entry.Refollows >= 2 then entry.ForceParts = true end
    App.devNote(entry.ForceParts and "Visual-only: the avatar stood frozen again, so it now follows your character's parts."
        or "Visual-only: the avatar stood frozen while your character moved; linking it again.")
    Overlay.link(entry)
end
function Overlay.watchStiff(entry)
-- v=YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    local character = entry.Character
    if not entry.AnimSet or entry.Target ~= character or (entry.Mode ~= "joints" and not entry.Stiff) then entry.StiffSince = nil; return end
    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    local ok, moving = pcall(Overlay.animated, character, entry, true)
    if not ok then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if entry.Stiff then
        entry.MovingSince = moving and (entry.MovingSince or now) or nil
        if entry.MovingSince and now - entry.MovingSince >= 0.5 then
            entry.Stiff, entry.MovingSince = nil, nil
            Overlay.link(entry)
        end
    else
        entry.StiffSince = not moving and (entry.StiffSince or now) or nil
        if entry.StiffSince and now - entry.StiffSince >= 1.2 then
            entry.Stiff, entry.StiffSince = true, nil
            Overlay.link(entry)
        end
    end
end
function Overlay.puppetStart(entry)
    local model = entry.Model
    local puppet = {Model = model, Tracks = {}, Variant = {}, Connections = {},
        Rig = F.getTrueRigType(model) == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and "R6" or "R15"}
    pcall(function()
        local controller = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
        if not controller then controller = Instance.new("AnimationController"); controller.Parent = model end
        -- One animator per controller (the mood may have made it already).
        local animator = controller:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then animator = Instance.new("Animator"); animator.Parent = controller end
        puppet.Animator = animator
    end)
    -- Roblox's Animate reads the speed from Humanoid.Running (relative to the floor, so a moving platform is not a walk).
    local hum = entry.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        pcall(function() table.insert(puppet.Connections, hum.Running:Connect(function(speed) puppet.Speed = speed end)) end)
    end
    entry.Puppet = puppet
end
function Overlay.puppetStop(entry)
    local puppet = entry.Puppet; entry.Puppet = nil
    if not puppet then return end
    for _, connection in ipairs(puppet.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    for _, track in pairs(puppet.Tracks) do if track then pcall(function() track:Stop(0); track:Destroy() end) end end
    if puppet.Animator then pcall(function() puppet.Animator:Destroy() end) end
end
-- What the character is doing: a state name and a speed.
function Overlay.puppetState(entry)
    local puppet = entry.Puppet
    local character = entry.Character
    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = entry.RealRoot
    local velocity = Vector3.zero
    if root and root.Parent then pcall(function() velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity end) end
    local flat = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
    if hum then
        local T = Enum.HumanoidStateType
        local ok, state = pcall(function() return hum:GetState() end)
        if not ok or hum.Health <= 0 then return "idle", 0 end
        if hum.Sit or state == T.Seated then return "sit", 0 end
        if state == T.Jumping then return "jump", 0 end
        if state == T.Freefall or state == T.FallingDown or state == T.Ragdoll or state == T.Physics then return "fall", 0 end
        if state == T.Climbing then return "climb", velocity.Y end
        if state == T.Swimming then return flat > 1 and "swim" or "swimidle", flat end
        local speed = puppet.Speed
        if type(speed) ~= "number" then speed = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat or 0 end
        return speed > (puppet.Rig == "R6" and 0.01 or 0.75) and "walk" or "idle", speed
    end
    if velocity.Y > 6 then return "jump", 0 elseif velocity.Y < -10 then return "fall", 0 end
    return flat > 0.75 and "walk" or "idle", flat
end
function Overlay.pickVariant(list)
    local total = 0
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do total = total + (tonumber(row.Weight) or 1) end
    local roll = math.random() * total
    for index, row in ipairs(list) do
        roll = roll - (tonumber(row.Weight) or 1)
        if roll <= 0 then return index end
    end
    return 1
end
function Overlay.puppetTrack(entry, name, index)
    local puppet = entry.Puppet
    local row = entry.AnimSet[name] and entry.AnimSet[name][index]
    if not row or not puppet.Animator then return nil end
    local key = name .. "#" .. index
    local track = puppet.Tracks[key]
    if track == nil then
        local ok, loaded = pcall(function()
            local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
            animation.AnimationId = F.normalizeAnimId(row.Id)
            local made = puppet.Animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
            made.Priority = name == "toolnone" and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
            made.Looped = Overlay.PuppetLooped[name] == true
            return made
        end)
        track = ok and loaded or false
        puppet.Tracks[key] = track
    end
    return track or nil
end
-- One frame of the puppet: the locomotion it should play.
function Overlay.puppetStep(entry)
    local puppet = entry.Puppet
    if not puppet or not puppet.Animator or not puppet.Animator.Parent then return end
    local state, speed = Overlay.puppetState(entry)
    -- The jump plays for a moment before the fall takes over, as in Roblox's Animate.
    if state == "jump" then puppet.JumpAt = os.clock()
    elseif state == "fall" and puppet.JumpAt and os.clock() - puppet.JumpAt < 0.31 then state = "jump" end
    local wanted = {}
    local function want(name, weight, rate)
        local list = entry.AnimSet[name]
        if not list or #list == 0 then return false end
        local index = puppet.Variant[name]
        if not index or not list[index] then index = Overlay.pickVariant(list); puppet.Variant[name] = index end
        wanted[name .. "#" .. index] = {name, index, weight, rate}
        return true
    end
    if state == "walk" then
        if puppet.Rig == "R15" then
            -- Roblox's R15 walk/run blend: walk up to half the reference speed, both in between, run above.
            local run = speed / 16
            local walkWeight, runWeight, walkRate, runRate = 0.001, 0.001, run / 0.5, run
            if run <= 0.5 then walkWeight = 1
            elseif run < 1 then local blend = (run - 0.5) / 0.5; walkWeight = 1 - blend; runWeight = blend; walkRate = 1; runRate = 1
            else runWeight = 1 end
            want("walk", walkWeight, math.clamp(walkRate, 0.05, 4))
            want("run", runWeight, math.clamp(runRate, 0.05, 4))
        else
            want("walk", 1, math.clamp(speed / 14.5, 0.05, 4))
        end
    elseif state == "climb" then
        want("climb", 1, math.clamp(math.abs(speed) / (puppet.Rig == "R15" and 5 or 12), 0, 4))
    elseif state == "swim" then
