            fade.Game[part] = value
        end
    end
    return fade
end
function Mirror.fadeUpdate(model, fade)
    if not model.Parent or not App.alive() then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (fade.WindowAt or 0) > 3 then fade.WindowAt = now; fade.Writes = 0 end
    -- A part the avatar hides itself (a headless head) always reads 1, so what the game does to it cannot be seen: it
    -- follows the whole body (the least hidden part that can be read).
    local body, count, factors = 1, 0, {}
    for part, own in pairs(fade.Own) do
        if part.Parent == model and own < 0.99 then
            body = math.min(body, math.clamp(fade.Game[part] or 0, 0, 1)); count = count + 1
        end
    end
    if count == 0 or body < 0.005 then body = 0 end
    for part, own in pairs(fade.Own) do
        if part.Parent == model then
            local f = own < 0.99 and math.clamp(fade.Game[part] or 0, 0, 1) or body
            if f < 0.005 then f = 0 end
            factors[part.Name] = f
            -- A part the game keeps writing (a fade on a limb the avatar hides) is not fought over: at most 60 writes
            -- in 3 seconds for the whole stand-in, then it is looked at again.
            local wanted = 1 - (1 - own) * (1 - f)
            if math.abs(part.Transparency - wanted) > 0.005 then
                if (fade.Writes or 0) < 60 then
                    fade.Writes = (fade.Writes or 0) + 1; fade.Pending[part] = wanted
                    pcall(function() part.Transparency = wanted end)
                elseif not fade.Retry then
                    fade.Retry = true
                    task.delay(3.1 - (now - (fade.WindowAt or now)), function() fade.Retry = false; if Mirror.fadeOf(model) == fade then pcall(Mirror.fadeUpdate, model, fade) end end)
                end
            end
            for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Decal") and child:GetAttribute("Lyra_CopiedSurface") then pcall(Cloak.fadeOne, child, f) end
            end
        end
    end
    if App.tracing() and fade.Traced ~= body then
        fade.Traced = body
        App.trace(string.format("Stand-in %s: the game shows its body at transparency %.2f", App.traceName(model), body))
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") and item:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") then
            Cloak.fadeAll(item, factors[Cloak.mountOf(item, model) or ""] or body)
        elseif item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor") then
            Cloak.fadeAll(item, factors[tostring(item:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor"))] or body)
        end
    end
end
function Mirror.fadeOf(model)
    local record = Mirror.Dressed[model]
    return record and record.Fade or nil
end
-- After the stand-in is dressed: the avatar's own transparency of each part is read, and the game's later changes are
-- followed. known: the avatar's own values when the parts were not dressed again (they then carry faded values).
function Mirror.fadeWatch(model, fade, known)
    local function schedule()
        if fade.Scheduled then return end
        fade.Scheduled = true
        task.defer(function() fade.Scheduled = false; if Mirror.fadeOf(model) == fade then pcall(Mirror.fadeUpdate, model, fade) end end)
    end
    for part in pairs(fade.Game) do
        if part.Parent == model then
            local own = known and known[part]
            if own == nil then own = part.Transparency end
            fade.Own[part] = isMask(own) and Cloak.Mask or own
            table.insert(fade.Connections, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
                local value = part.Transparency
                local pending = fade.Pending[part]
                fade.Pending[part] = nil
                if pending and math.abs(value - pending) < 1e-4 then return end
                fade.Game[part] = value
                schedule()
            end))
        end
    end
    -- Items put on it later follow at once.
    table.insert(fade.Connections, model.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:GetAttribute("Copier_CopiedItem") or child:GetAttribute("Lyra_VisualFor") then schedule() end
    end))
    pcall(Mirror.fadeUpdate, model, fade)
end
-- The stand-in has its own look back: each body part gets what the game has on it now.
function Mirror.fadeRestore(model, fade)
    Mirror.fadeStop(fade)
    -- A part the avatar hid itself may have missed the game hiding it: it is at least as hidden as the whole body.
    local body, count = 1, 0
    for part, own in pairs(fade.Own) do
        if part.Parent == model and own < 0.99 then body = math.min(body, math.clamp(fade.Game[part] or 0, 0, 1)); count = count + 1 end
    end
    if count == 0 then body = 0 end
    for part, value in pairs(fade.Game) do
        if (fade.Own[part] or 0) >= 0.99 then value = math.max(value, body) end
        if part.Parent == model and math.abs(part.Transparency - value) > 1e-4 then pcall(function() part.Transparency = value end) end
    end
end
function Mirror.dress(model)
    local record = Mirror.Dressed[model]
    -- Yours follows the avatar you wear; a script user's follows their synced skin.
    local owner = Mirror.Known[model]
    local peer = owner ~= nil and owner ~= true and owner ~= lp.UserId
    local function current() if peer then return Sync.snapshot(owner) end; return App.Current end
    local wanted = peer and current() ~= nil or (not peer and Mirror.wanted())
    -- The stand-in gets its own look back: the drawn avatar comes off, or its body is rebuilt as the game made it.
    local function undress()
        if not record then return end
        -- Forgotten first: the game's own pieces coming back must not look like a change by the game.
        Mirror.Dressed[model] = nil
        if record.Drawn then Overlay.clear(model)
        elseif model.Parent and record.Original then
            Mirror.fadeStop(record.Fade)
            local report = Appearance.apply(model, record.Original, {Original = true, Mirror = true})
            for _, row in ipairs(report.Items) do pcall(function() row.Template:Destroy() end) end
            Appearance.releaseGeometry(model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            if record.Fade then Mirror.fadeRestore(model, record.Fade) end
            Mirror.settle(model)
        end
        if record.Original then pcall(function() record.Original:Destroy() end) end
        record = nil
    end
    if not wanted then undress(); return end
    local snapshot = current()
    local rig = F.getTrueRigType(model)
    -- R15 AVATARS IN R6 GAMES: while your avatar is drawn as R15 over your R6 character, your R6 stand-ins (a copy of
    -- you a menu leaves standing, A Bizarre Run's stand menu) get it drawn over them the same way.
    local draw = not peer and Overlay.Auto == true and rig == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
    if record and record.Snapshot == snapshot and (record.Drawn == true) == draw then return end
    if not rig or #Appearance.rigMissing(model) > 0 then Mirror.retry(model); return end
    if draw then
        if record and not record.Drawn then undress() end
        local source = Mirror.source(snapshot, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
        if not source or not App.alive() or not model.Parent or snapshot ~= current() then return end
        local copied, copy = pcall(function() return source:Clone() end)
        if not copied or not copy then return end
        Overlay.prepare(copy)
        Overlay.attach(model, copy, false, "standin")
        Mirror.Dressed[model] = {Snapshot = snapshot, Drawn = true, Changes = record and record.Changes}
        return
    end
    if record and record.Drawn then undress() end
    -- A copy of the stand-in as the game made it, to give it its own look back later.
    local original = record and record.Original
    if not original then
        local archivable = model.Archivable
        pcall(function() model.Archivable = true; original = model:Clone() end)
        pcall(function() model.Archivable = archivable end)
        if not original then return end
        for _, item in ipairs(original:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("BaseScript") or item:IsA("ModuleScript") then pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end
    local source = Mirror.source(snapshot, rig)
    if not source or not App.alive() or not model.Parent or snapshot ~= current() then
        if not record then pcall(function() original:Destroy() end) end
        return
    end
    -- What the game has on each body part goes on being followed (see STAND-INS THE GAME HIDES OR FADES).
    local before = record and record.Fade
    local fade = Mirror.fadeBegin(model, record)
    local applied, report = pcall(Appearance.apply, model, source, {Mirror = true})
    if not applied then
        -- Not dressed again: a stand-in dressed before keeps being followed as it is.
        if before then record.Fade = fade; Mirror.fadeWatch(model, fade, before.Own)
        elseif not record then pcall(function() original:Destroy() end) end
        error(report, 0)
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(report.Items) do pcall(function() row.Template:Destroy() end) end
    Mirror.Dressed[model] = {Snapshot = snapshot, Original = original, Changes = record and record.Changes, Fade = fade}
    Mirror.fadeWatch(model, fade)
    Mirror.settle(model)
end
-- After every change of your look: every stand-in follows it, and so do your pictures.
function Mirror.refresh()
    if not App.alive() then return end
    for index = #Mirror.Sources, 1, -1 do
        local row = Mirror.Sources[index]
        if row.Snapshot ~= App.Current and not row.Snapshot.SyncUser then pcall(function() row.Model:Destroy() end); table.remove(Mirror.Sources, index) end
    end
    for model, who in pairs(Mirror.Known) do if model.Parent and (who == true or who == lp.UserId) then Mirror.queue(model, 0) end end
    Thumbs.refresh()
    -- The name Roblox's menus show follows the profile you wear (see YOUR NAME).
    pcall(Ident.refresh)
end
function Mirror.watch()
    if Mirror.Watching then return end
    Mirror.Watching = true
    local function added(item)
        local class = item.ClassName
        if class == "Humanoid" then
            local model = item.Parent
            if model then Mirror.queue(model, 0.4) end
        elseif class == "ImageLabel" or class == "ImageButton" then
            Thumbs.consider(item)
        end
    end
    RegisterConnection(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(added))
    local gui = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if gui then RegisterConnection(gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(added)) end
    pcall(Mirror.learn, lp.Character)
    task.spawn(function()
        -- Your profile avatar, for stand-ins a game builds from it.
        pcall(function()
            local desc = API.description(lp.UserId)
            local key = Mirror.descKey(desc)
            if key ~= "" then Mirror.OwnKeys[key] = true end
            desc:Destroy()
        end)
        -- What is already there: walked a few hundred instances per frame, a moment after the script starts. Listing a big
        -- map's whole workspace at once (hundreds of thousands of instances) froze phones as the script started.
        task.wait(2)
        local stack, count, slice = {}, 0, os.clock()
        for _, root in ipairs({gui, workspace}) do
            local ok, list = pcall(function() return root:GetChildren() end)
            if ok then table.insert(stack, {list, 1}) end
        end
        while #stack > 0 do
            if not App.alive() then return end
            local top = stack[#stack]
            local item = top[1][top[2]]
            if item == nil then table.remove(stack)
            else
                top[2] = top[2] + 1
                local class = item.ClassName
                if class == "Humanoid" or class == "ImageLabel" or class == "ImageButton" then pcall(added, item) end
                local ok, list = pcall(function() return item:GetChildren() end)
                if ok and #list > 0 then table.insert(stack, {list, 1}) end
                -- At most about two milliseconds of every frame.
                count = count + 1
                if count % 50 == 0 and os.clock() - slice > 0.002 then task.wait(); slice = os.clock() end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- YOUR PICTURE: games show your avatar's picture (leaderboards, player cards, name tags, the list of a round's
-- players). While a copied avatar is on, those pictures show it: the copied profile's own Roblox picture when the
-- avatar is that profile as it is, else a 3D view of the avatar posed like Roblox's pictures. On your screen only.
Thumbs.Labels = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Thumbs.MenuLabels = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Thumbs.Watched = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Thumbs.WatchCount = 0
-- {Kind, W, H, User} when an image is a picture of your own avatar or of a script user sharing a skin through Skin
-- sync (a headshot, bust or full avatar), else nil.
function Thumbs.parse(image)
    local info = Thumbs.read(image)
    if not info or (info.User ~= lp.UserId and not Sync.pictureUsers()[info.User]) then return nil end
    return info
end
-- Pictures of a user remember which user they show, so they can change when that user's skin arrives.
Thumbs.Seen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function Thumbs.refreshUser(uid)
    for label, user in pairs(Thumbs.Seen) do
        if user == uid and label.Parent then pcall(Thumbs.changed, label) end
    end
end
-- {Kind, W, H, User} for any avatar picture, else nil.
function Thumbs.read(image)
    if type(image) ~= "string" or image == "" then return nil end
    local lower = image:lower()
    local id, kind, w, h
    if lower:find("rbxthumb://", 1, true) then
        kind = image:match("[?&/]type=(%w+)"); id = image:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
        w = image:match("[?&]w=(%d+)"); h = image:match("[?&]h=(%d+)")
    elseif lower:find("roblox.com", 1, true) and lower:find("userid=", 1, true) then
        id = lower:match("userid=(%d+)")
        kind = lower:find("headshot", 1, true) and "AvatarHeadShot" or lower:find("bust", 1, true) and "AvatarBust" or "Avatar"
        w = lower:match("width=(%d+)") or lower:match("[?&]x=(%d+)"); h = lower:match("height=(%d+)") or lower:match("[?&]y=(%d+)")
    end
    if not tonumber(id) then return nil end
    if kind ~= "AvatarHeadShot" and kind ~= "AvatarBust" and kind ~= "Avatar" then return nil end
    local fallback = kind == "Avatar" and 420 or 150
    return {Kind = kind, W = tonumber(w) or fallback, H = tonumber(h) or fallback, User = tonumber(id)}
end
-- The same picture of another user: only the user id changes, so its kind, size and options (a round crop such as
-- filters=circular) stay as Roblox asked for them.
function Thumbs.swapUser(url, userId)
    if type(url) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local out, count = url:gsub("([?&]id=)%d+", "%1" .. tostring(userId), 1)
    if count == 0 then out, count = url:gsub("([Uu][Ss][Ee][Rr][Ii][Dd]=)%d+", "%1" .. tostring(userId), 1) end
    return count > 0 and out or nil
end
-- The profile whose own picture shows the avatar being worn: a profile copied as it is (not edited, not a saved skin).
function Thumbs.userFor(snapshot)
    if not snapshot or snapshot.Original or snapshot.Catalog or snapshot.LookKey or snapshot.Pose or type(snapshot.Data) ~= "table" then return nil end
    if snapshot.Data.Visual or (type(snapshot.Data.Tweaks) == "table" and next(snapshot.Data.Tweaks) ~= nil) then return nil end
    return Codec.id(snapshot.Id)
end
function Thumbs.ours(label)
    for _, holder in ipairs({UI.Gui, UI.InspectOverlay}) do
        if holder and label:IsDescendantOf(holder) then return true end
    end
    return false
end
function Thumbs.consider(label)
    if Thumbs.ours(label) then return end
    if not Thumbs.Watched[label] and Thumbs.WatchCount < 4000 then
        Thumbs.Watched[label] = true; Thumbs.WatchCount = Thumbs.WatchCount + 1
        pcall(function()
            RegisterConnection(label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function() if App.alive() then Thumbs.changed(label) end end))
        end)
    end
    Thumbs.changed(label)
--YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
end
function Thumbs.changed(label)
    local record = Thumbs.Labels[label]
    local image = label.Image
    if record and record.Written and image == record.Written then return end
    if record and record.Forced then
        -- A picture found by the @username next to it: kept while that is still you.
        record.Written = nil
        if Thumbs.nearUsername(label) then record.Original = image; task.spawn(Thumbs.apply, label, record)
        else Thumbs.Labels[label] = nil; Thumbs.restore(label, record, true) end
        return
    end
    local seen = Thumbs.read(image)
    Thumbs.Seen[label] = seen and seen.User or nil
    local info = Thumbs.parse(image)
    if not info then
        -- The game put someone else's picture (or anything else) there: it stays, and the label is let go.
        if record then Thumbs.Labels[label] = nil; Thumbs.restore(label, record, true) end
        return
    end
    if record then record.Original = image; record.Info = info; record.Written = nil
    else record = {Original = image, Info = info, Core = label:IsDescendantOf(game:GetService("CoreGui")), Menu = Thumbs.MenuLabels[label]}; Thumbs.Labels[label] = record end
    task.spawn(Thumbs.apply, label, record)
end
-- THE ROBLOX MENU'S PROFILE PAGE (tap a player in the Players page's list view): your picture there may be loaded from
-- Roblox's servers by an address that does not name you, so it is found as the largest square web picture next to your
-- @username, and followed like the others (as a head picture). Your names there follow YOUR NAME.
function Thumbs.nearUsername(label)
    local cursor = label.Parent
    for _ = 1, 4 do
        if not cursor or cursor:IsA("LayerCollector") then return false end
        local ok, items = pcall(function() return cursor:GetDescendants() end)
        if not ok or #items > 160 then return false end
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do
            if (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton")) and Ident.raw(item) == "@" .. lp.Name then return true end
        end
        cursor = cursor.Parent
    end
    return false
end
function Thumbs.profilePicture(label)
    if not label.Parent or Ident.raw(label) ~= "@" .. lp.Name then return end
    local cursor = label.Parent
    for _ = 1, 4 do
        if not cursor or cursor:IsA("LayerCollector") then return end
        local ok, items = pcall(function() return cursor:GetDescendants() end)
        if not ok or #items > 160 then return end
        local best, area = nil, 0
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do
            if (item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton")) and item.Name ~= "LyraMenuAvatar" and not Thumbs.ours(item) then
                local record = Thumbs.Labels[item]
                local image = record and record.Original or item.Image
                local info = Thumbs.read(image)
                -- Already followed by its address.
                if info and info.User == lp.UserId then return end
                local size = item.AbsoluteSize
                local web = image:find("^https?://") ~= nil or image:find("rbxcdn", 1, true) ~= nil
                if not info and web and size.X >= 40 and math.abs(size.X - size.Y) <= size.X * 0.2 and size.X * size.Y > area then best, area = item, size.X * size.Y end
            end
        end
        if best then Thumbs.force(best); return end
        cursor = cursor.Parent
    end
end
function Thumbs.force(label)
    if Thumbs.Labels[label] then return end
    local record = {Original = label.Image, Info = {Kind = "AvatarHeadShot", W = 420, H = 420, User = lp.UserId}, Core = true, Forced = true, Menu = true}
    Thumbs.Labels[label] = record
    if not Thumbs.Watched[label] then
        Thumbs.Watched[label] = true; Thumbs.WatchCount = Thumbs.WatchCount + 1
        pcall(function()
            RegisterConnection(label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function() if App.alive() then Thumbs.changed(label) end end))
        end)
    end
    task.spawn(Thumbs.apply, label, record)
end
-- The rest of the Roblox menu (its profile page and other pages): avatar pictures and your names added there are
-- followed like the leaderboard's. The Players page itself is handled by UI.patchMenuAvatar.
function Thumbs.watchMenu(page)
    local rgui = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
    if not rgui or not page then return end
    Thumbs.PeoplePage = page
    local root = page
    while root.Parent and root.Parent ~= rgui do root = root.Parent end
    if root.Parent ~= rgui or Thumbs.MenuRoot == root then return end
    Thumbs.MenuRoot = root
    local function added(item)
        if Thumbs.PeoplePage and Thumbs.PeoplePage.Parent and item:IsDescendantOf(Thumbs.PeoplePage) then return end
        if item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton") then
            -- Only avatar pictures: the menu has many icons.
            if Thumbs.read(item.Image) then Thumbs.MenuLabels[item] = true; Thumbs.consider(item) end
        elseif item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") then
            Ident.consider(item)
            if Ident.raw(item) == "@" .. lp.Name then
                UI.ProfileName = item
                task.delay(0.3, function() if App.alive() and Store.Settings.MenuAvatar then pcall(Thumbs.profilePicture, item) end end)
            end
        end
    end
    RegisterConnection(root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item) if App.alive() then pcall(added, item) end end))
    local ok, items = pcall(function() return root:GetDescendants() end)
    for _, item in ipairs(ok and items or {}) do pcall(added, item) end
end
-- Pictures in Roblox's own menus (the leaderboard) follow "Show my avatar in the Roblox menu"; the game's pictures
-- follow "Show my avatar on the game's copies of me".
function Thumbs.wanted(record)
    if record and record.Core then return Store.Settings.MenuAvatar ~= false and App.Current ~= nil and not App.Current.Original end
    return Mirror.wanted()
end
-- THE ROBLOX LEADERBOARD: Roblox's own player list. Tapping your name opens a card with your picture and name; on
-- your screen it shows the avatar you wear (the copied profile's own picture when the avatar is that profile as it
-- is), and the name and badge of YOUR NAME. "Examine Avatar" on that card opens Roblox's panel on what you wear, and
-- on a script user's card, on the skin they share.
Thumbs.CoreButtons = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function Thumbs.watchCore()
    if Thumbs.CoreWatching then return end
    Thumbs.CoreWatching = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local core = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        local list
        for _ = 1, 60 do
            list = core:FindFirstChild("PlayerList")
            if list or not App.alive() then break end
            task.wait(1)
        end
        if not list or not App.alive() then return end
        Thumbs.CoreList = list
        local function added(item)
            if item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton") then Thumbs.consider(item) end
            if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") then Ident.consider(item) end
            if item:IsA("GuiButton") then Thumbs.hookCoreButton(item) end
        end
        RegisterConnection(list.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item) if App.alive() then pcall(added, item) end end))
        local ok, items = pcall(function() return list:GetDescendants() end)
        for _, item in ipairs(ok and items or {}) do pcall(added, item) end
    end)
end
-- Whose card of the leaderboard a button belongs to: a picture of you, or of a script user sharing a skin, in the
-- same small group of elements as the button tapped. Returns that user id, or nil for anyone else.
function Thumbs.coreCardUser(button)
    local peers = Sync.pictureUsers()
    local cursor = button.Parent
    for _ = 1, 6 do
        if not cursor or cursor:IsA("LayerCollector") then return nil end
        local ok, items = pcall(function() return cursor:GetDescendants() end)
        if not ok or #items > 200 then return nil end
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do
            if item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton") then
                local user = Ident.imageUser(item)
                if user and (user == lp.UserId or peers[user]) then return user end
            end
        end
        cursor = cursor.Parent
    end
    return nil
end
-- A button of the leaderboard tapped on your card may be Examine Avatar: once Roblox's panel shows your profile, it
-- is pointed at what you wear, as from the Players page of the Roblox menu.
function Thumbs.hookCoreButton(button)
    if Thumbs.CoreButtons[button] then return end
    Thumbs.CoreButtons[button] = true
    RegisterConnection(button.Activated:Connect(function()
        if not App.alive() then return end
        local ok, who = pcall(Thumbs.coreCardUser, button)
        if not ok or not who then return end
        local mine = who == lp.UserId
        if mine and (not Store.Settings.MenuAvatar or not App.Current or App.Current.Original) then return end
        -- Only when the panel really opened (other buttons of the card do something else), and only when Roblox's own
        -- request was not heard (UI.watchInspect already answered it). A script user's card opens the panel on the
        -- skin they share (see THEIR PANEL).
        for _, delay in ipairs({0.4, 1.4}) do
            task.delay(delay, function()
                if not App.alive() or UI.inspectHeard() or not UI.inspectRoot() then return end
                if mine then UI.inspectWorn(true) elseif Sync.pictureUsers()[who] then UI.inspectWorn(true, nil, who) end
            end)
        end
    end))
end
-- Yields. The posed avatar model shared with the Roblox menu (built once per look).
function Thumbs.model()
    while Thumbs.Building do task.wait(0.05) end
    Thumbs.Building = true
    local ok, model, serial = pcall(UI.menuAvatarModel)
    Thumbs.Building = false
    if ok then return model, serial end
    return nil, nil
end
function Thumbs.apply(label, record)
    if not App.alive() or Thumbs.Labels[label] ~= record or not label.Parent then return end
    if record.Info.User ~= lp.UserId then
        -- Another script user's picture: their synced skin, posed (see SKIN SYNC PICTURES).
        local model, serial = Sync.pictureModel(record.Info.User)
        if not model or Thumbs.Labels[label] ~= record or not label.Parent then Thumbs.restore(label, record); return end
        if record.View and record.View.Parent == label and record.Serial == serial then return end
        if record.View then pcall(function() record.View:Destroy() end) end
        local ok, view = pcall(Thumbs.view, label, model, record.Info.Kind)
        if not ok then return end
        record.View = view; record.Serial = serial
        if record.Transparency == nil then record.Transparency = label.ImageTransparency end
        label.ImageTransparency = 1
        return
    end
    if not Thumbs.wanted(record) then Thumbs.restore(label, record); return end
    if record.Menu and not record.Corner and Thumbs.looksRound(label, record.Original, record.Info.Kind) then record.Corner = Thumbs.round(label) end
    local userId = Thumbs.userFor(App.Current)
    if userId then
        if record.View then pcall(function() record.View:Destroy() end); record.View = nil end
        if record.Transparency ~= nil then pcall(function() label.ImageTransparency = record.Transparency end); record.Transparency = nil end
        local info = record.Info
        local url = Thumbs.swapUser(record.Original, userId) or string.format("rbxthumb://type=%s&id=%d&w=%d&h=%d", info.Kind, userId, info.W, info.H)
        record.Written = url
        pcall(function() label.Image = url end)
        return
    end
    -- Any other look: the game's picture stays underneath, covered by a posed 3D view.
    if record.Written then record.Written = nil; pcall(function() label.Image = record.Original end) end
    local model, serial = Thumbs.model()
    if not model or Thumbs.Labels[label] ~= record or not label.Parent or not Thumbs.wanted(record) then return end
    if record.View and record.View.Parent == label and record.Serial == serial then return end
    if record.View then pcall(function() record.View:Destroy() end) end
    local ok, view = pcall(Thumbs.view, label, model, record.Info.Kind)
    if not ok then return end
    record.View = view; record.Serial = serial
    if record.Transparency == nil then record.Transparency = label.ImageTransparency end
    label.ImageTransparency = 1
end
function Thumbs.restore(label, record, keepImage)
    if record.View then pcall(function() record.View:Destroy() end); record.View = nil end
    if record.Corner then pcall(function() record.Corner:Destroy() end); record.Corner = nil end
    if record.Transparency ~= nil then pcall(function() label.ImageTransparency = record.Transparency end); record.Transparency = nil end
    local written = record.Written
    record.Written = nil
    if written and not keepImage and label.Image == written then pcall(function() label.Image = record.Original end) end
end
function Thumbs.refresh()
    for label, record in pairs(Thumbs.Labels) do
        if label.Parent then task.spawn(Thumbs.apply, label, record) end
    end
end
function Thumbs.clearAll()
    for label, record in pairs(Thumbs.Labels) do pcall(Thumbs.restore, label, record) end
    table.clear(Thumbs.Labels)
end
-- The part of the avatar a picture shows: the whole body, or the head with what is worn on it (and the upper body
-- for a bust). Returns the centre and the height, width and depth to fit.
function Thumbs.frame(model, kind)
    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if kind == "Avatar" or not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then
        local center, size = Pose.bounds(model)
        return center, size.Y, size.X, size.Z
    end
    local parts = {head}
    for _, accessory in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        local handle = accessory:IsA("Accessory") and accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and (handle.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < head.Size.Magnitude * 1.5 then table.insert(parts, handle) end
    end
    if kind == "AvatarBust" then
        for _, name in ipairs({"UpperTorso", "Torso"}) do
            local torso = model:FindFirstChild(name)
            if torso and torso:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, torso) end
        end
    end
    local low, high = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        local cf, half = part.CFrame, part.Size / 2
        for _, x in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
            for _, y in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                for _, z in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                    local point = cf * Vector3.new(half.X * x, half.Y * y, half.Z * z)
                    low = low:Min(point); high = high:Max(point)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local size = high - low
    return (low + high) / 2, size.Y, size.X, size.Z
end
-- ROUND PICTURES: the Roblox menu's round pictures (its list view, the profile page) are cut round by Roblox's picture
-- itself or by a style, and a picture of ours carries neither: it gets a round corner of its own. A picture is round
-- when it is square and its address asks for a round crop, a style tag says circle, or it is a head picture there.
function Thumbs.looksRound(label, image, kind)
    local size = label.AbsoluteSize
    if size.X <= 0 or math.abs(size.X - size.Y) > size.X * 0.15 then return false end
    if tostring(image or ""):lower():find("circular", 1, true) then return true end
    local ok, tags = pcall(function() return label:GetTags() end)
    for _, tag in ipairs(ok and tags or {}) do if tostring(tag):lower():find("circle", 1, true) then return true end end
    return kind == "AvatarHeadShot"
end
function Thumbs.round(target)
    if target:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then return nil end
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.Name = "LyraRound"; corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0); corner.Parent = target
    return corner
end
function Thumbs.view(label, model, kind, round)
    local view = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    view.Name = "LyraPicture"; view.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); view.BackgroundTransparency = 1; view.BorderSizePixel = 0
    view.ZIndex = label.ZIndex; view.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(195, 186, 213); view.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 233); view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)
    local clone = model:Clone(); clone.Parent = view
    local focus, height, width, depth = Thumbs.frame(clone, kind)
    local size = label.AbsoluteSize
    local aspect = size.X > 0 and size.Y > 0 and math.clamp(size.X / size.Y, 0.4, 2.5) or 1
    local fit = math.max(height, width / aspect)
    local distance = (fit * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(15)) + depth * 0.5) * (kind == "Avatar" and 1.12 or 1.06)
    -- Roblox's full-body pictures turn the avatar slightly; head pictures look straight at it.
    local direction = CFrame.Angles(0, kind == "Avatar" and math.rad(-15) or 0, 0) * Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    local camera = Instance.new("Camera"); camera.FieldOfView = 30
    camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(focus + direction * distance, focus)
    camera.Parent = view; view.CurrentCamera = camera
    local corner = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"); if corner then corner:Clone().Parent = view
    elseif round or tostring(label.Image):lower():find("circular", 1, true) then Thumbs.round(view) end
    view.Parent = label
    return view
end

-- YOUR NAME: on your screen only, Roblox's leaderboard, the Players page of the Roblox menu, Roblox's avatar panel and
-- your chat messages can show another name and a verified badge: the copied player's (Settings > Name and badge >
-- Copied) or one you type (Custom). Nothing is sent to anyone: other players keep seeing your real name. Roblox's
-- own text is put back when it is off, and a text Roblox writes again (a list that redraws) is changed again.
-- The badge is the sign Roblox's fonts draw for verified accounts (U+E000), so it looks like Roblox's own.
Ident.Original = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Ident.Written = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Ident.Watched = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Ident.Titles = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Ident.WatchCount = 0
Ident.Info, Ident.Pending = {}, {}
Ident.Badge = utf8.char(0xE000)
Ident.Active = false
-- The text Roblox wrote in a label, also while ours is showing.
function Ident.raw(label)
    local written = Ident.Written[label]
    if written and label.Text == written then return Ident.Original[label] or label.Text end
    return label.Text
end
-- The user a picture shows, from the picture Roblox put there (a picture changed by YOUR PICTURE included).
function Ident.imageUser(image)
    local record = Thumbs.Labels[image]
    local info = Thumbs.read(record and record.Original or image.Image)
    return info and info.User
end
-- Yields nothing. Username, display name and badge of a profile, fetched once in the background; nil until known.
function Ident.lookup(id)
    local info = Ident.Info[id]
    if info or Ident.Pending[id] then return info end
    Ident.Pending[id] = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, rows = pcall(function() return US:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync({id}) end)
        local row = ok and type(rows) == "table" and rows[1]
        if type(row) == "table" then
            Ident.Info[id] = {Name = tostring(row.Username or ""), Display = tostring(row.DisplayName or ""), Verified = row.HasVerifiedBadge == true}
        end
        Ident.Pending[id] = nil
        if App.alive() and Ident.Info[id] then Ident.refresh() end
    end)
    return nil
end
-- The Roblox profile you are wearing: a profile copied from Roblox (edited or not), not a saved skin or your own.
function Ident.copied()
    local snapshot = App.Current
    if not snapshot or snapshot.Original or snapshot.LookKey or snapshot.Catalog or snapshot.SyncUser then return nil end
    local id = Codec.id(snapshot.Id)
    if not id or id == lp.UserId then return nil end
    local info = Ident.lookup(id)
    local name = info and info.Name ~= "" and info.Name or (type(snapshot.Name) == "string" and snapshot.Name ~= "" and snapshot.Name) or nil
    if not name then return nil end
    local display = info and info.Display ~= "" and info.Display or (type(snapshot.DisplayName) == "string" and snapshot.DisplayName ~= "" and snapshot.DisplayName) or name
    return {Id = id, Name = name, Display = display, Verified = info ~= nil and info.Verified}
end
-- What Roblox's menus show for you: {Name, Display, Badge}, or nil when it is your own name and nothing changes.
function Ident.target()
    local mode, badgeMode = Store.Settings.NameMode, Store.Settings.Badge
    if (mode ~= "Copied" and mode ~= "Custom") and (badgeMode ~= "Copied" and badgeMode ~= "On") then return nil end
    local copied = (mode == "Copied" or badgeMode == "Copied") and Ident.copied() or nil
    local name, display = lp.Name, lp.DisplayName
    if mode == "Copied" and copied then
        name, display = copied.Name, copied.Display
    elseif mode == "Custom" then
        if Store.Settings.CustomName ~= "" then name = Store.Settings.CustomName end
        if Store.Settings.CustomDisplay ~= "" then display = Store.Settings.CustomDisplay end
    end
    local badge = badgeMode == "On" or (badgeMode == "Copied" and copied ~= nil and copied.Verified)
    -- A verified account already shows Roblox's own badge.
    local real = false
    pcall(function() real = lp.HasVerifiedBadge == true end)
    if real then badge = false end
    if name == lp.Name and display == lp.DisplayName and not badge then return nil end
    return {Name = name, Display = display, Badge = badge}
end
-- The new text for one of Roblox's labels, or nil to leave it.
function Ident.rewrite(text, target, title)
    if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" or not target then return nil end
    if title then
        -- The panel's title ("<username>'s Avatar" in any language).
        local at = text:find(lp.Name, 1, true)
        if not at then return nil end
        return text:sub(1, at - 1) .. target.Name .. text:sub(at + #lp.Name)
    end
    if text == lp.DisplayName then return target.Badge and (target.Display .. " " .. Ident.Badge) or target.Display end
    if text == "@" .. lp.Name then return "@" .. target.Name end
    if text == lp.Name then return target.Name end
    return nil
end
-- Whether a label with your name is about you: in your row of the leaderboard (PlayerEntry_<your id>), or next to a
-- picture of you or your @username (your card in the leaderboard or the Roblox menu). Display names are not unique,
-- so a name alone is never enough.
function Ident.mine(label)
    local cursor = label.Parent
    for _ = 1, 8 do
        if not cursor or cursor:IsA("LayerCollector") then return false end
        local entry = cursor.Name:match("^PlayerEntry_(%d+)$")
        if entry then return tonumber(entry) == lp.UserId end
        local ok, items = pcall(function() return cursor:GetDescendants() end)
        if not ok or #items > 160 then return false end
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do
            if item ~= label then
                if (item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton")) and Ident.imageUser(item) == lp.UserId then return true end
                if (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton")) and Ident.raw(item) == "@" .. lp.Name then return true end
            end
        end
        -- One card of the Roblox menu's list: the cards around it are other players.
        if cursor.Name:find("^VirtualizedItem") then return false end
        cursor = cursor.Parent
    end
    return false
end
-- target: the name to show (false: none, nil: worked out here).
function Ident.apply(label, target)
    if not label.Parent then return end
    local text = label.Text
    local written = Ident.Written[label]
    local original = (written and text == written) and (Ident.Original[label] or text) or text
    Ident.Original[label] = original
    if target == nil then target = Ident.target() end
    local new = target and Ident.rewrite(original, target, Ident.Titles[label]) or nil
    if new and new ~= original and (Ident.Titles[label] or Ident.mine(label)) then
        if text ~= new then Ident.Written[label] = new; label.Text = new end
    elseif written then
        Ident.Written[label] = nil
        if text == written then label.Text = original end
    end
end
function Ident.consider(label)
    if not Ident.Active or not (label:IsA("TextLabel") or label:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
    if not Ident.Watched[label] then
        if Ident.WatchCount >= 3000 then return end
        Ident.Watched[label] = true; Ident.WatchCount = Ident.WatchCount + 1
        pcall(function()
            RegisterConnection(label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                if App.alive() and (Ident.Active or Ident.Written[label]) then pcall(Ident.apply, label) end
            end))
        end)
    end
    pcall(Ident.apply, label)
end
-- The title of Roblox's avatar panel while it shows what you wear.
function Ident.title(label)
    if not Ident.Active then return end
    Ident.Titles[label] = true
    Ident.consider(label)
end
-- Every label already followed, after a change of look or of the settings; the leaderboard is read again when it
-- turns on.
function Ident.refresh()
    if not App.alive() then return end
    local target = Ident.target()
    local was = Ident.Active
    Ident.Active = target ~= nil
    if Ident.Active then
        pcall(Ident.hookChat)
        local list = Thumbs.CoreList
        if not was then
            for _, holder in ipairs({list, Thumbs.MenuRoot}) do
                if holder and holder.Parent then
                    local ok, items = pcall(function() return holder:GetDescendants() end)
                    for _, item in ipairs(ok and items or {}) do if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") then pcall(Ident.consider, item) end end
                end
            end
        end
        if UI.MenuIsOpen then pcall(UI.runMenuAvatar) end
    end
    for label in pairs(Ident.Watched) do
        if label.Parent then pcall(Ident.apply, label, target or false) end
    end
end
-- CHAT: the name in front of your own messages (Roblox's chat window and the bubbles over your head take it from
-- there). Roblox lets one function change incoming messages; a game's own one (chat tags) keeps running first and
-- only the name in what it returns is changed. Where the executor can't read the game's function, each chat channel's
-- function is used instead, which games rarely set. Older games still on the legacy chat are left alone.
function Ident.chatProperties(message, props)
    if not Ident.Active then return props end
    local source = message.TextSource
--: YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    if not source or source.UserId ~= lp.UserId then return props end
    local target = Ident.target()
    if not target then return props end
    local prefix = props and props.PrefixText ~= "" and props.PrefixText or message.PrefixText
    if type(prefix) ~= "string" or prefix == "" then return props end
    local display = target.Badge and (target.Display .. " " .. Ident.Badge) or target.Display
    local new
    local at = prefix:find(lp.DisplayName, 1, true)
    if at then new = prefix:sub(1, at - 1) .. display .. prefix:sub(at + #lp.DisplayName)
    else
        at = prefix:find(lp.Name, 1, true)
        if at then new = prefix:sub(1, at - 1) .. target.Name .. prefix:sub(at + #lp.Name) end
    end
    if not new or new == prefix then return props end
    local out = props or Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
    out.PrefixText = new
    return out
end
function Ident.chatHandler(previous)
    return function(message)
        local props
        if previous then
            local ok, value = pcall(previous, message)
            if ok then props = value end
        end
        local ok, value = pcall(Ident.chatProperties, message, props)
        if ok then return value end
        return props
    end
end
function Ident.hookChat()
    if Ident.ChatHooked then return end
    Ident.ChatHooked = true
    local tcs = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    if tcs.ChatVersion ~= Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then return end
    if type(getcallbackvalue) == "function" then
        local ok, previous = pcall(getcallbackvalue, tcs, "OnIncomingMessage")
        if ok and (previous == nil or type(previous) == "function") then
            local set = pcall(function() tcs.OnIncomingMessage = Ident.chatHandler(previous) end)
            if set then Ident.ChatRestore = {Target = tcs, Previous = previous}; return end
        end
    end
    Ident.ChatChannels = {}
    local function hook(channel)
        if not channel:IsA("TextChannel") or Ident.ChatChannels[channel] then return end
        if pcall(function() channel.OnIncomingMessage = Ident.chatHandler(nil) end) then Ident.ChatChannels[channel] = true end
    end
    local folder = tcs:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
    if folder then
        for _, channel in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do pcall(hook, channel) end
        RegisterConnection(folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(channel) if App.alive() then pcall(hook, channel) end end))
    end
end
-- When the script closes: Roblox's text and the chat functions go back as they were.
function Ident.cleanup()
    Ident.Active = false
    for label, written in pairs(Ident.Written) do
        pcall(function() if label.Text == written then label.Text = Ident.Original[label] end end)
    end
    table.clear(Ident.Written)
    if Ident.ChatRestore then
        local row = Ident.ChatRestore
        pcall(function() row.Target.OnIncomingMessage = row.Previous end)
        Ident.ChatRestore = nil
    end
    for channel in pairs(Ident.ChatChannels or {}) do pcall(function() channel.OnIncomingMessage = nil end) end
    Ident.ChatChannels = nil
end

-- POSE: Roblox's avatar pictures, and the avatar in the Roblox menu, show the avatar in the first frame of its idle
-- animation instead of standing stiff: its own animation pack's idle, else Roblox's default idle for its rig. A
-- model is posed from that keyframe without playing anything: every joint takes the keyframe's offset and the parts
-- are placed from the joints. Some packs open on a frame that leans or lies the body down (the picture then looked
-- at its feet), so a pose that does not leave the avatar standing is skipped for a later keyframe, else none is used.
-- A skin saved while posed in a posing game keeps that pose for these pictures instead (see SAVED POSE).
Pose.Cache = {}
Pose.MaxFrames = 6
-- Yields. A list of {[part name] = joint offset}, one per keyframe (the first ones, in time order), or nil.
function Pose.frames(id)
    id = F.normalizeAnimId(id)
    local cached = Pose.Cache[id]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached or nil end
    local result = false
    pcall(function()
        local sequence
        local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects(id) end)
        for _, root in ipairs(ok and objects or {}) do
            if root:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then sequence = root; break end
            local inner = root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("KeyframeSequence", true)
            if inner then sequence = inner; break end
        end
        if not sequence then
            local got, value = pcall(function() return game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider"):GetKeyframeSequenceAsync(id) end)
            if got and typeof(value) == "Instance" then sequence = value end
        end
        if not sequence then return end
        local frames = sequence:GetKeyframes()
        table.sort(frames, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
        local list = {}
        for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do
            if #list >= Pose.MaxFrames then break end
            local map = {}
            local function walk(pose)
                -- A pose with no weight only holds the hierarchy: it does not move its joint.
                if (tonumber(pose.Weight) or 1) > 0 then map[pose.Name] = pose.CFrame end
                for _, child in ipairs(pose:GetSubPoses()) do if child:IsA("Pose") then walk(child) end end
            end
            for _, pose in ipairs(frame:GetPoses()) do if pose:IsA("Pose") then walk(pose) end end
            if next(map) then table.insert(list, map) end
        end
        if #list > 0 then result = list end
    end)
    Pose.Cache[id] = result
    return result or nil
end
-- Yields. The idle a picture of this model is posed with.
function Pose.idleId(model)
    local r6 = F.getTrueRigType(model) == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
    if not r6 then
        local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local desc = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("HumanoidDescription")
        local ok, asset = pcall(function() return desc.IdleAnimation end)
        if ok and tonumber(asset) and tonumber(asset) ~= 0 then
            local sets = F.animationSets(asset)
            local list = sets and sets.idle
            if list and #list > 0 then
                -- The main idle (the one played most), not the rare look-around.
                local best
                for _, row in ipairs(list) do if not best or (tonumber(row.Weight) or 1) > (tonumber(best.Weight) or 1) then best = row end end
                return best.Id
            end
            local one = F.resolveAnimationTrackId(asset)
            if one then return one end
        end
    end
    return r6 and "rbxassetid://180435571" or "rbxassetid://507766388"
end
-- Every joint of the model takes the offset its part has in map (none: its rest pose); the parts follow.
function Pose.set(model, map)
    for _, joint in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
            local ok, _, part1 = pcall(Overlay.jointInfo, joint)
            local offset = map and ok and part1 and map[part1.Name] or nil
            pcall(function() joint.Transform = offset or CFrame.new() end)
        end
    end
    pcall(Rig.reachable, model, true)
end
-- Distance of every body part from the root (the rest pose's reach), measured before posing.
function Pose.reach(model)
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local reach = {}
    if not root then return reach end
    for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= root and Appearance.isBody(part, model) then reach[part] = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude end
    end
    return reach
end
-- Whether a posed model still stands: torso upright, head above the root, no part pulled away from the body.
function Pose.standing(model, reach)
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local torso = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not (root and torso and torso:IsA("BasePart")) then return false end
    if torso.CFrame.UpVector.Y < 0.6 then return false end
    if head and head:IsA("BasePart") and head.Position.Y <= root.Position.Y then return false end
    for part, rest in pairs(reach) do
        if part.Parent == model and (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > rest * 1.35 + 1.5 then return false end
    end
    return true
end
-- Yields. Poses a prepared model (root at its place); returns whether a pose was used.
function Pose.apply(model)
    local list = Pose.frames(Pose.idleId(model))
    if not list then return false end
    local reach = Pose.reach(model)
    for _, map in ipairs(list) do
        Pose.set(model, map)
        if Pose.standing(model, reach) then return true end
    end
    Pose.set(model, nil)
    return false
end
-- The box a picture of the whole avatar fits: the body and what is worn close to it, in world axes (a part the game
-- or an item left far away, or a hidden root, does not stretch it). Returns the centre and the size.
function Pose.bounds(model)
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local body = {}
    for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= root and Appearance.isBody(part, model) then table.insert(body, part) end
    end
    local function corners(part, low, high)
        local cf, half = part.CFrame, part.Size / 2
        for _, x in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
            for _, y in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                for _, z in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                    local point = cf * Vector3.new(half.X * x, half.Y * y, half.Z * z)
                    low = low:Min(point); high = high:Max(point)
                end
            end
        end
        return low, high
    end
    local low, high = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
    for _, part in ipairs(body) do low, high = corners(part, low, high) end
    if #body == 0 then
        local box, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
        return box.Position, size
    end
    -- Worn items count while they hang near the body (wings and big hats included, a stray part not).
    local center, extent = (low + high) / 2, (high - low).Magnitude
    for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Transparency < 1 and item:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
            if (item.Position - center).Magnitude <= extent * 1.25 + 2 then low, high = corners(item, low, high) end
        end
    end
    return (low + high) / 2, high - low
end

-- SKIN SYNC: script users in the same server see each other's skin. While the setting is on, the skin you wear is
-- shared with the Lyra server for this Roblox server only, and the other users' skins are drawn over their characters
-- on your screen. Nothing changes for players without the script.
Sync.Url = "https://api.lyraez.lol/v1/sync"
Sync.Interval = 8
function Sync.requestFn()
    return type(request) == "function" and request or type(http_request) == "function" and http_request
        or (type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" and syn.request) or nil
end
function Sync.enabled()
    return Store.Settings.SkinSync == true and App.alive() and not Sync.Closed and game.JobId ~= "" and Sync.requestFn() ~= nil
end
function Sync.call(body)
    local requestFn = Sync.requestFn(); if not requestFn then return nil end
    local ok, response = pcall(requestFn, {Url = Sync.Url, Method = "POST", Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)})
    if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" or type(response.Body) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local decoded, reply = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body) end)
    return decoded and type(reply) == "table" and reply or nil
end
-- FNV-1a (32-bit) plus the length: only used to notice that a skin changed.
function Sync.hash(text)
    local h = 2166136261
    for i = 1, #text do h = bit32.bxor(h, string.byte(text, i)); h = (bit32.lshift(h, 24) + h * 403) % 4294967296 end
    return string.format("%08x%08x", h, #text)
end
-- The skin you share. A skin's full copy (every part and mesh) can be a few hundred KB; sending that from a phone on
-- mobile data filled the upload and the game's ping went to seconds. Past MaxShared characters only the avatar
-- description is shared (the other users build it from the catalog items, as a rig change does), and a skin that is
-- still too big is not shared. Skins the Lyra server refused (Rejected) are not sent again this session.
Sync.MaxShared = 60000
Sync.Rejected = {}
function Sync.mine()
    local snapshot = App.Current
    if not snapshot or snapshot.Original or type(snapshot.Data) ~= "table" then return nil end
    if Sync.MineFor ~= snapshot then
        local function encode(data)
            local ok, text = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode({Version = 2, Data = data}) end)
            return ok and type(text) == "string" and text or nil
        end
        local text = encode(snapshot.Data)
        if text and #text > Sync.MaxShared and snapshot.Data.Visual ~= nil then
            local lite = {}
            for key, value in pairs(snapshot.Data) do if key ~= "Visual" then lite[key] = value end end
            text = encode(lite)
        end
        Sync.MineFor = snapshot
        Sync.MineText = text and #text <= Sync.MaxShared and text or nil
        Sync.MineHash = Sync.MineText and Sync.hash(Sync.MineText) or nil
    end
    if Sync.MineHash and Sync.Rejected[Sync.MineHash] then return nil end
    return Sync.MineText, Sync.MineHash
end
-- Another user's skin is untrusted: it goes through the same checks as an imported skin code.
function Sync.decode(text)
    assert(type(text) == "string" and #text <= 262144, "Invalid skin.")
    local ok, packet = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(text) end)
    assert(ok and type(packet) == "table" and packet.Version == 2 and type(packet.Data) == "table", "Invalid skin.")
    if packet.Data.Visual then Visual.validate(packet.Data.Visual) end
    local valid, desc = pcall(Codec.decode, packet.Data)
    assert(valid and desc, "Invalid skin.")
    local data = Codec.encode(desc); desc:Destroy(); data.Visual = packet.Data.Visual; data.Tweaks = Tweaks.clean(packet.Data.Tweaks)
    return data
end
-- Yields. Returns whether the Lyra server answered, and the error it gave. A skin upload that fails three times (or
-- that the server finds too big) stops being shared until you change skin, so a failing upload is never repeated
-- every few seconds.
Sync.Uploads = {}
function Sync.beat()
    local text, hash = Sync.mine()
    local body = {a = "beat", job = game.JobId, user = lp.UserId, hash = hash or ""}
    local function upload()
        Sync.Uploads[hash] = (Sync.Uploads[hash] or 0) + 1
        if Sync.Uploads[hash] >= 3 then Sync.Rejected[hash] = true end
        body.data = text
    end
    if hash and Sync.Sent ~= hash then upload() end
    local reply = Sync.call(body)
    if reply and reply.error == "too_large" and hash then Sync.Rejected[hash] = true end
    if not reply or reply.ok ~= true then return false, reply and reply.error end
    if hash and reply.need and not body.data and not Sync.Rejected[hash] then
        upload()
        reply = Sync.call(body)
        if reply and reply.error == "too_large" then Sync.Rejected[hash] = true end
        if not reply or reply.ok ~= true then return false, reply and reply.error end
    end
    if hash then Sync.Uploads[hash] = nil; Sync.Rejected[hash] = nil end
    Sync.Sent = hash
    local listed = {}
    if type(reply.peers) == "table" then
        for _, peer in ipairs(reply.peers) do
            if type(peer) == "table" and type(peer.user) == "number" and type(peer.hash) == "string" then listed[peer.user] = peer.hash end
        end
    end
    Sync.Peers = listed
    -- The Server tab shows Ask skin on users sharing a skin: it is drawn again when they change.
    local signature = {}
    for uid in pairs(listed) do table.insert(signature, uid) end
    table.sort(signature); signature = table.concat(signature, ",")
    if signature ~= Sync.PeerSignature then
        Sync.PeerSignature = signature
        if UI.Tab == "Players" then UI.scheduleList("players") end
    end
    Sync.requests(reply.asks, reply.answers)
    return true
end
-- SKIN SYNC PICTURES: a script user's synced skin also shows where the game shows their avatar: its pictures
-- (leaderboards, player cards), their card in the Roblox menu and the game's copies of them (lobby displays,
-- cutscenes), on your screen only, while Skin sync is on and "Show my avatar on the game's copies of me" is too.
Sync.Snapshots, Sync.Pictures = {}, {}
function Sync.pictureUsers()
    local users = {}
    if not Sync.enabled() or Store.Settings.StandIns == false then return users end
    for uid, shown in pairs(Sync.Shown) do if shown.Data and Sync.Peers[uid] == shown.Hash then users[uid] = true end end
    return users
end
-- A stable snapshot per synced skin (stand-ins and pictures are built once per skin).
function Sync.snapshot(uid)
    if not Sync.pictureUsers()[uid] then return nil end
    local shown = Sync.Shown[uid]
    local snapshot = Sync.Snapshots[uid]
    if not snapshot or snapshot.Hash ~= shown.Hash then
        snapshot = {Data = shown.Data, Hash = shown.Hash, SyncUser = uid, Name = Sync.who(uid)}
        Sync.Snapshots[uid] = snapshot
    end
    return snapshot
end
-- Yields. The synced skin posed for a picture, with a serial that changes with the skin.
Sync.PictureBuilding = {}
function Sync.pictureModel(uid)
    -- One build per user at a time (many pictures can ask at once).
    while Sync.PictureBuilding[uid] and App.alive() do task.wait(0.05) end
    local snapshot = Sync.snapshot(uid)
    if not snapshot then return nil end
    local cached = Sync.Pictures[uid]
    if cached and cached.Snapshot == snapshot then return cached.Model, cached.Serial end
    if cached then pcall(function() cached.Model:Destroy() end); Sync.Pictures[uid] = nil end
    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
    Sync.PictureBuilding[uid] = true
    local ok, model = pcall(UI.posedModel, snapshot, player and player.Character and F.getTrueRigType(player.Character) or nil)
    Sync.PictureBuilding[uid] = nil
    if not ok or not model then return nil end
    UI.MenuAvatarSerial = UI.MenuAvatarSerial + 1
    Sync.Pictures[uid] = {Snapshot = snapshot, Model = model, Serial = UI.MenuAvatarSerial}
    return model, UI.MenuAvatarSerial
end
-- A user's synced skin arrived, changed or went: their pictures and stand-ins follow.
function Sync.changed(uid)
    task.spawn(function()
        local cached = Sync.Pictures[uid]
        if cached and cached.Snapshot ~= Sync.snapshot(uid) then pcall(function() cached.Model:Destroy() end); Sync.Pictures[uid] = nil end
        if not Sync.pictureUsers()[uid] then Sync.Snapshots[uid] = nil end
        pcall(Thumbs.refreshUser, uid)
        pcall(Mirror.refreshUser, uid)
    end)
end
function Sync.draw()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= lp then
            local uid, character = player.UserId, player.Character
            local hash, shown = Sync.Peers[uid], Sync.Shown[uid]
            if not hash then
--|YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
                if shown then Sync.Shown[uid] = nil; if character then Overlay.clear(character) end; Sync.changed(uid) end
            else
                -- One download every few seconds at most, and a skin that fails to arrive is tried again later each
                -- time (8 s, 16 s… up to 2 min, then not until it changes): many users sharing skins at once
                -- used to download all of them over and over.
                local due = not shown or shown.Hash ~= hash or (not shown.Data and os.clock() >= shown.Retry)
                if due and os.clock() >= (Sync.NextGet or 0) then
                    Sync.NextGet = os.clock() + 3
                    local reply = Sync.call({a = "get", job = game.JobId, user = lp.UserId, peer = uid})
                    local ok, data = pcall(function()
                        assert(reply and reply.ok == true and reply.hash == hash, "Skin unavailable.")
                        return Sync.decode(reply.data)
                    end)
                    local fails = (shown and shown.Hash == hash and not ok) and (shown.Fails or 0) + 1 or (ok and 0 or 1)
                    shown = {Hash = hash, Data = ok and data or nil, Fails = fails, BuildFails = 0,
                        Retry = fails >= 6 and math.huge or os.clock() + math.min(120, 8 * 2 ^ (fails - 1))}
                    Sync.Shown[uid] = shown
                    if shown.Data then Sync.changed(uid) end
                end
                local entry = character and Overlay.Active[character]
                if shown and shown.Hash == hash and shown.Data and character and character.Parent and (not entry or entry.Key ~= hash) and os.clock() >= (shown.BuildRetry or 0) then
                    local rig = Overlay.rigType(character)
                    if rig and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                        local ok, model = pcall(Overlay.build, shown.Data, rig)
                        if ok and model then
                            if Sync.enabled() and character.Parent and Sync.Peers[uid] == hash then Overlay.attach(character, model, false, hash)
                            else pcall(function() model:Destroy() end) end
                        else
                            -- A skin that cannot be built here waits longer after each failure (10 s, 20 s… up to 60 s).
                            shown.BuildFails = (shown.BuildFails or 0) + 1
                            shown.BuildRetry = os.clock() + math.min(60, 10 * shown.BuildFails)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for uid in pairs(Sync.Shown) do if not Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid) then Sync.Shown[uid] = nil; Sync.changed(uid) end end
end
function Sync.start()
    if Sync.Running then return end
    Sync.Running = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local lastBeat, fails, waitUntil = -math.huge, 0, 0
        while App.alive() and not Sync.Closed do
            if Sync.enabled() then
                local _, hash = Sync.mine()
                -- Beats every Interval seconds (every 4 s while a skin request is open), and sooner (at most every
                -- 5 s) right after you change avatar. After a failed beat the next one waits longer each time
                -- (16 s, 32 s… up to 2 min; at least 25 s when the server asks to slow down).
                local interval = (next(Sync.Asked) or next(Sync.Incoming)) and 4 or Sync.Interval
                local due = os.clock() - lastBeat >= interval or ((Sync.Woken or hash ~= Sync.Sent) and os.clock() - lastBeat >= 5)
                if due and os.clock() >= waitUntil then
                    Sync.Woken = false; lastBeat = os.clock()
                    local ok, answered, err = pcall(Sync.beat)
                    if ok and answered then fails = 0; waitUntil = 0
                    else
                        fails = fails + 1
                        waitUntil = os.clock() + math.max(err == "rate_limited" and 25 or 0, math.min(120, Sync.Interval * 2 ^ fails))
                    end
                end
                pcall(Sync.draw)
            end
            task.wait(2)
        end
        Sync.Running = false
    end)
end
function Sync.wake() Sync.Woken = true; Sync.Sent = nil end
function Sync.stop()
    local gone = {}
    for uid in pairs(Sync.Shown) do table.insert(gone, uid) end
    Sync.Peers = {}; table.clear(Sync.Shown); Sync.Sent = nil; Sync.PeerSignature = nil
    for _, uid in ipairs(gone) do Sync.changed(uid) end
    for _, entry in pairs(Sync.Incoming or {}) do if entry.Card then pcall(entry.Card.Close) end end
    if Sync.Incoming then table.clear(Sync.Incoming); table.clear(Sync.Asked) end
    if UI.refreshAskButtons then pcall(UI.refreshAskButtons) end
    for character, entry in pairs(Overlay.Active) do if not entry.Local then Overlay.clear(character) end end
    if Sync.requestFn() and game.JobId ~= "" then task.spawn(Sync.call, {a = "leave", job = game.JobId, user = lp.UserId}) end
end
function Sync.close() Sync.Closed = true; Sync.stop() end
-- SKIN REQUESTS: tap Ask skin on a script user in the Server tab and they get a request card; when they accept, the
-- skin they wear comes to you, to wear or save (see the worker's skin requests). Only users sharing a skin can be
-- asked, a request waits 45 s, and with "Skin requests" off in Settings the ones you get are declined.
Sync.Asked, Sync.Incoming = {}, {}
function Sync.who(uid)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
    return player and (player.DisplayName ~= "" and player.DisplayName or player.Name) or "A player"
end
function Sync.headshot(uid) return "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(uid) .. "&w=150&h=150" end
-- Yields. Asks a user for the skin they wear.
function Sync.ask(uid)
    local who = Sync.who(uid)
    if not Sync.enabled() then App.report("Turn on See other script users' skins in Settings to ask for skins.", "warning"); return end
    if Sync.Asked[uid] then return end
    Sync.Asked[uid] = {Until = os.clock() + 45, Sending = true}
    UI.refreshAskButtons()
    local reply = Sync.call({a = "ask", job = game.JobId, user = lp.UserId, peer = uid})
    if reply and reply.ok == true then
        Sync.Asked[uid] = {Until = os.clock() + math.clamp(tonumber(reply.wait) or 45, 1, 45)}
        App.report("Request sent to " .. who .. ". Waiting for an answer…", "info")
        UI.askTicker()
    else
        Sync.Asked[uid] = nil
        local err = reply and reply.error
        if err == "cooldown" then App.report(who .. " declined a moment ago. Ask again in " .. tostring(math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(reply.wait) or 60))) .. " s.", "warning")
        elseif err == "too_many" then App.report("You already have 3 requests waiting. Wait for an answer first.", "warning")
        elseif err == "not_sharing" then App.report(who .. " is not sharing a skin right now.", "warning")
        else App.report("Could not reach the Lyra server. Try again in a moment.", "error") end
    end
    UI.refreshAskButtons()
end
function Sync.cancelAsk(uid)
    if not Sync.Asked[uid] or Sync.Asked[uid].Sending then return end
    Sync.Asked[uid] = nil
    UI.refreshAskButtons()
    task.spawn(Sync.call, {a = "cancel", job = game.JobId, user = lp.UserId, peer = uid})
    App.report("Request cancelled.", "info")
end
-- Yields. Answers a request to you; accepting sends the skin you wear now.
function Sync.answer(uid, accept)
    local entry = Sync.Incoming[uid]
    if entry then entry.Answered = true end
    local name
    if accept then
        local text, hash = Sync.mine()
        if not text then
            accept = false
            App.report("You are not wearing a skin to send, so the request was declined.", "warning")
        else
            -- The other player fetches the skin you share: the Lyra server gets the one you wear now first.
            if Sync.Sent ~= hash then pcall(Sync.beat) end
            name = App.Current and Looks.name(App.Current.Name) or nil
        end
    end
    local reply = Sync.call({a = "answer", job = game.JobId, user = lp.UserId, peer = uid, accept = accept, name = name})
    if not (reply and reply.ok == true) then
        if accept then App.report("The request from " .. Sync.who(uid) .. " ended before your answer arrived.", "warning") end
        return
    end
    if accept then App.toast({Title = "Skin sent", Text = Sync.who(uid) .. " received the skin you are wearing.", Kind = "success", Image = Sync.headshot(uid), Duration = 5}) end
end
-- Yields. Loads the skin an accepted request sent you.
function Sync.receive(uid, name)
    local who = Sync.who(uid)
    local reply = Sync.call({a = "get", job = game.JobId, user = lp.UserId, peer = uid})
    local ok, data = pcall(function()
        assert(reply and reply.ok == true, "Skin unavailable.")
        return Sync.decode(reply.data)
    end)
    if not App.alive() then return end
    if not ok then
        App.toast({Title = "Skin request", Text = who .. " accepted, but the skin could not be loaded. Ask again.", Kind = "warning", Image = Sync.headshot(uid), Duration = 6})
        return
    end
    -- Without a name it is called after them, in your language ("Ronathan's skin").
    UI.receivedSkin(uid, Looks.name(name) or Looks.name(Lang.text(who .. "'s skin")) or "Received skin", data)
end
-- Requests to you and answers to yours, from a beat.
function Sync.requests(asks, answers)
    local listed = {}
    for _, ask in ipairs(type(asks) == "table" and asks or {}) do
        local uid = type(ask) == "table" and tonumber(ask.user)
        -- Only a player in this server can ask you (the Lyra server can't check who is here).
        if uid and uid ~= lp.UserId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid) then
            listed[uid] = true
            if not Sync.Incoming[uid] then
                local wait = math.clamp(tonumber(ask.wait) or 45, 1, 45)
                local entry = {Until = os.clock() + wait}
                Sync.Incoming[uid] = entry
                if Store.Settings.SkinRequests == false then task.spawn(Sync.answer, uid, false)
                else entry.Card = UI.skinRequest(uid, wait) end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Gone from the list: answered, cancelled or expired.
-- @YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    for uid, entry in pairs(Sync.Incoming) do
        if not listed[uid] then
            Sync.Incoming[uid] = nil
            if entry.Card then entry.Card.Close() end
        end
    end
    for _, answer in ipairs(type(answers) == "table" and answers or {}) do
        local uid = type(answer) == "table" and tonumber(answer.user)
        if uid and Sync.Asked[uid] then
            Sync.Asked[uid] = nil
            if answer.state == "accepted" then task.spawn(Sync.receive, uid, answer.name)
            else App.toast({Title = "Skin request", Text = Sync.who(uid) .. " declined your request.", Kind = "info", Image = Sync.headshot(uid), Duration = 5}) end
        end
    end
    UI.refreshAskButtons()
end

-- Server tab: the Ask skin buttons, which show a waiting request's countdown (tap again to cancel it).
UI.AskButtons = {}
function UI.refreshAskButtons()
    for uid, item in pairs(UI.AskButtons) do
        if not item.Button.Root.Parent then UI.AskButtons[uid] = nil
        else
            local asked = Sync.Asked[uid]
            local left = asked and math.max(0, math.ceil(asked.Until - os.clock())) or 0
            local text = not asked and (item.Wide and "Ask skin" or "Ask") or asked.Sending and "…"
                or (item.Wide and ("Waiting " .. left .. "s") or (left .. "s"))
            if item.Text ~= text then item.Text = text; UI.setText(item.Button.Label, text) end
        end
    end
end
function UI.askTicker()
    if UI.AskTicking then return end
    UI.AskTicking = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while App.alive() and next(Sync.Asked) do
            for uid, asked in pairs(Sync.Asked) do
                -- A few seconds of grace: the answer comes with the next beat.
                if not asked.Sending and os.clock() > asked.Until + 6 then
                    Sync.Asked[uid] = nil
                    App.toast({Title = "Skin request", Text = Sync.who(uid) .. " didn't answer your request.", Kind = "info", Image = Sync.headshot(uid), Duration = 5})
                end
            end
            UI.refreshAskButtons()
            task.wait(1)
        end
        UI.AskTicking = false
        UI.refreshAskButtons()
    end)
end
-- REQUEST CARDS: a skin request to you (accept or decline) and a skin sent to you (wear or save) slide in at the top
-- of the screen, with the window open or not.
function UI.requestStack()
    if UI.RequestStack and UI.RequestStack.Parent then return UI.RequestStack end
    local stack = UI.new("Frame", {Name = "LyraRequests", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 56),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 1, -66), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 210}, UI.Surface)
    UI.new("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center}, stack)
    UI.RequestStack, UI.RequestOrder = stack, 0
    return stack
end
-- spec: UserId, Tag, Tone, Title (a name, shown as it is), Text, Chip, Seconds (a countdown; else a close button),
-- Left and Right ({Text, Icon, Callback(card)}), OnTimeout, BodyHeight (room for a longer Text; 34 by default).
-- Returns {Close = function, Right = button, Left = button}.
function UI.requestCard(spec)
    local stack = UI.requestStack()
    local screen = UI.Surface.AbsoluteSize.X
    local width = math.floor(math.min(360, (screen > 0 and screen or 400) - 24))
    stack.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, -66)
    local bodyHeight = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(spec.BodyHeight) or 34), 34, 160)
    local extra = bodyHeight - 34
    local tone, height = spec.Tone or UI.C.Accent, 188 + extra
    UI.RequestOrder = UI.RequestOrder + 1
    local holder = UI.new("Frame", {Name = "Request", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = UI.RequestOrder}, stack)
    local card = UI.new("CanvasGroup", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -14), GroupTransparency = 1,
        BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Card, BackgroundTransparency = 0.03, BorderSizePixel = 0}, holder)
    UI.round(card, 18)
    local edge = UI.stroke(card, 0.3, tone); edge.Thickness = 1.2
    -- The card's colour washes down from the top; a soft glow sits behind the picture.
    local wash = UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = tone, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1}, card)
    UI.new("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.78), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.95), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})}, wash)
    local glow = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 28), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 72), BackgroundColor3 = tone, BackgroundTransparency = 0.84, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, card)
    UI.round(glow, 36)
    local picture = UI.new("ImageLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 36), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Image = Sync.headshot(spec.UserId), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 3}, card)
    UI.round(picture, 28)
    local ring = UI.stroke(picture, 0.05, tone); ring.Thickness = 2
    local badge = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 72), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundColor3 = tone, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4}, card)
    UI.round(badge, 12)
    local cut = UI.stroke(badge, 0, UI.C.Card); cut.Thickness = 2
    local mark = UI.icon(badge, spec.Icon or "shirt", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UI.C.Base)
    mark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); mark.ZIndex = 5; UI.new("UIScale", {Scale = 0.62}, mark)
    local tag = UI.text(card, spec.Tag, 10, tone, true); tag.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12); tag.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 16); tag.ZIndex = 3
    local title = UI.text(card, "", 15, UI.C.Text, true); title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 38); title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 20); title.ZIndex = 3
    title.Text = tostring(spec.Title or "")
    local body = UI.text(card, "", 12, UI.C.Muted); body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 59); body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, bodyHeight); body.ZIndex = 3
    body.TextWrapped = true; body.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None; body.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    UI.setText(body, spec.Text)
    local chip = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 104 + extra), Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 28), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised, BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, card)
    UI.round(chip, 14)
    local chipIcon = UI.icon(chip, "shirt", UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0), tone); chipIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5); chipIcon.ZIndex = 4
    UI.new("UIScale", {Scale = 0.68}, chipIcon)
    local chipText = UI.text(chip, "", 11, UI.C.Text, true); chipText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 0); chipText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0); chipText.ZIndex = 4
