    UI.setText(chipText, spec.Chip)
    local handle, closed = {}, false
    function handle.Close()
        if closed then return end
        closed = true
        UI.tween(card, {GroupTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -14)}, 0.18)
        task.delay(0.2, function() pcall(function() holder:Destroy() end) end)
    end
    local half = math.floor((width - 40) / 2)
    local function action(side, primary, x)
        local button = UI.button(card, side.Text, primary, function() if not closed then side.Callback(handle) end end, side.Icon)
        button.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(half, 38); button.Root.Position = x; button.Root.ZIndex = 4
        return button
    end
    handle.Left = action(spec.Left, false, UDim2.fromOffset(16, 140 + extra))
    handle.Right = action(spec.Right, true, UDim2.new(1, -16 - half, 0, 140 + extra))
    -- A countdown (pill and a line along the bottom), or a close button when the card waits for you.
    local line = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = tone, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4}, card)
    UI.round(line, 1)
    local pill = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(spec.Seconds and 46 or 26, 22),
        BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, card)
    UI.round(pill, 11)
    local started, total = os.clock(), tonumber(spec.Seconds) or 90
    local count
    if spec.Seconds then
        count = UI.text(pill, "", 11, UI.C.Muted, true); count.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); count.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; count.ZIndex = 4
    else
        local close = UI.new("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 4}, pill)
        local cross = UI.icon(close, "x", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UI.C.Muted); cross.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); cross.ZIndex = 5
        UI.new("UIScale", {Scale = 0.6}, cross)
        UI.connect(close.Activated, handle.Close)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while not closed and App.alive() and holder.Parent do
            local left = math.max(0, total - (os.clock() - started))
            local share = left / total
            line.Size = UDim2.new(share, -32 * share, 0, 2)
            if count then count.Text = tostring(math.ceil(left)) .. "s" end
            if left <= 0 then
                if spec.OnTimeout then pcall(spec.OnTimeout) end
                handle.Close(); break
            end
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
    end)
    UI.tween(card, {GroupTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)}, 0.3)
    return handle
end
-- A request to you: their picture and name, the skin you'd send, Decline and Accept.
function UI.skinRequest(uid, seconds)
    local current = App.Current
    local skin = current and not current.Original and Looks.name(current.Name) or nil
    return UI.requestCard({UserId = uid, Tag = "SKIN REQUEST", Title = Sync.who(uid), Seconds = seconds, Icon = "shirt",
        Text = "wants to copy the skin you are wearing.",
        Chip = skin and ("You would send: " .. skin) or "You are not wearing a skin right now",
        Left = {Text = "Decline", Icon = "x", Callback = function(card) card.Close(); task.spawn(Sync.answer, uid, false) end},
        Right = {Text = "Accept", Icon = "check", Callback = function(card)
            card.Close(); App.report("Sending your skin to " .. Sync.who(uid) .. "…", "loading"); task.spawn(Sync.answer, uid, true)
        end}})
end
-- A skin sent to you: wear it now, save it in Saved Skins, or both.
function UI.receivedSkin(uid, name, data)
    local who = Sync.who(uid)
    local saved = false
    local card
    card = UI.requestCard({UserId = uid, Tag = "SKIN RECEIVED", Tone = UI.C.Green, Title = who, Icon = "check",
        Text = "accepted your request and sent the skin they are wearing.", Chip = name,
        Left = {Text = "Save", Icon = "save", Callback = function()
            if saved then return end
            local ok, row = pcall(Looks.addReceived, data, name, "Sent by " .. who)
            if not ok then App.report(tostring(row), "error"); return end
            saved = true
            UI.setText(card.Left.Label, "Saved!"); UI.enabled(card.Left, false)
            if UI.Tab == "Looks" then UI.renderLooks() end
            App.report("Saved in Saved Skins as " .. row.Name .. ".", "success")
        end},
        Right = {Text = "Wear", Icon = "shirt", Callback = function()
            if App.Busy then App.report("Wait for the current change to finish.", "warning"); return end
            task.spawn(App.applySnapshot, {Data = Codec.copy(data), Name = name, ThumbId = uid, Shared = true}, "apply")
        end}})
    App.toast({Title = "Skin received", Text = who .. " sent you their skin.", Kind = "success", Image = Sync.headshot(uid), Duration = 4})
end

-- RESTYLE: a new theme, font or text size is put on the open window in place. Every colour of the old palette
-- becomes the same role's colour in the new one, every label takes the font for its weight, and text sizes are scaled
-- from each label's base size (so going back and forth never drifts).
function UI.colorKey(color)
    return string.format("%d,%d,%d", math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5))
end
function UI.restyle(oldColors, oldScale)
    if not UI.Gui then return end
    local map = {}
    for role, color in pairs(oldColors or {}) do if UI.C[role] then map[UI.colorKey(color)] = UI.C[role] end end
    local scale = UI.TextScale or 1
    oldScale = oldScale or scale
    local regular, bold = UI.FaceRegular, UI.FaceBold
    if not regular then
        pcall(function() regular = Font.fromEnum(UI.Font.Regular); bold = Font.fromEnum(UI.Font.Bold) end)
    end
    local function swap(item, property)
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return item[property] end)
        if ok and typeof(value) == "Color3" then
            local new = map[UI.colorKey(value)]
            if new and new ~= value then pcall(function() item[property] = new end) end
        end
    end
    local roots = {UI.Gui}
    if UI.InspectOverlay then table.insert(roots, UI.InspectOverlay) end
    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
        for _, item in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("GuiObject") then
                swap(item, "BackgroundColor3")
                if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") or item:IsA("TextBox") then
                    swap(item, "TextColor3")
                    if item:IsA("TextBox") then swap(item, "PlaceholderColor3") end
                    if regular and not item:GetAttribute("LyraOwnFont") then
                        pcall(function()
                            local heavy = item.FontFace.Weight.Value >= Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold.Value
                            item.FontFace = heavy and bold or regular
                        end)
                    end
                    if scale ~= oldScale then
                        local constraint = item:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")
                        local current = item.TextScaled and constraint and constraint.MaxTextSize or item.TextSize
                        local base = item:GetAttribute("LyraTextBase")
                        if type(base) ~= "number" then base = current / oldScale end
                        item:SetAttribute("LyraTextBase", base)
                        local size = math.max(8, math.floor(base * scale + 0.5))
                        if item.TextScaled then
                            if constraint then constraint.MaxTextSize = size end
                        else item.TextSize = size end
                    end
                elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton") then swap(item, "ImageColor3")
                elseif item:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then swap(item, "ScrollBarImageColor3") end
            elseif item:IsA("UIStroke") then swap(item, "Color")
            elseif item:IsA("UIGradient") and item ~= UI.Sheen then
                pcall(function()
                    local keys = {}
                    for i, key in ipairs(item.Color.Keypoints) do keys[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(key.Time, map[UI.colorKey(key.Value)] or key.Value) end
                    item.Color = ColorSequence.new(keys)
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    if UI.Sheen then pcall(function() UI.Sheen.Color = UI.sheenColors() end) end
    -- Pop-ups read their colours from this table when they open.
    pcall(function()
        local theme = UI.Toasts and UI.Toasts.Theme
        if type(theme) == "table" then
            theme.Background = UI.C.Base; theme.Text = UI.C.Text; theme.Muted = UI.C.Muted; theme.Line = UI.C.Line
            if type(theme.Kinds) == "table" then theme.Kinds.info = UI.C.Accent; theme.Kinds.success = UI.C.Green; theme.Kinds.warning = UI.C.Gold; theme.Kinds.error = UI.C.Red end
        end
    end)
end
function UI.setTheme(name)
    if not UI.Themes[name] then return end
    local old = {}
    for role, color in pairs(UI.C) do old[role] = color end
    Store.Settings.Theme = name
    local colors = UI.palette(name)
    for role, color in pairs(colors) do UI.C[role] = color end
    UI.restyle(old)
    pcall(UI.Decor.apply)
    App.persist()
end
function UI.setFont(name)
    local regular, bold = nil, nil
    if name ~= "Builder Sans" then
        regular, bold = UI.fontFaces(name)
        if not regular then App.report("This font is not available in your Roblox version.", "warning"); return false end
    end
    Store.Settings.Font = name
    UI.FaceRegular, UI.FaceBold = regular, bold
    UI.restyle({})
    App.persist()
    return true
end
function UI.setTextSize(percent)
    local old = UI.TextScale or 1
    Store.Settings.TextSize = percent
    UI.TextScale = percent / 100
    UI.restyle({}, old)
    UI.layout(false)
    App.persist()
end
-- The theme and font pickers of Settings > Look.
function UI.themeOptions()
    local options = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(Store.SettingOptions.Theme) do
        local colors = UI.palette(name)
        local special = UI.ThemeSpecial[name]
        local option = {Value = name, Label = name, Swatch = {colors.Base, colors.Accent, colors.AccentDark}}
        if special then option.Special = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(special.Color[1], special.Color[2], special.Color[3]), Tag = special.Tag}; option.Icon = special.Icon end
        table.insert(options, option)
    end
    return options
end
function UI.fontOptions()
    local options = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(UI.FontList) do
        local regular = UI.fontFaces(row.Name)
        if regular then table.insert(options, {Value = row.Name, Label = row.Name, Face = regular}) end
    end
    return options
end

-- THEME DECORATIONS: Halloween and Christmas dress the window up. Some pieces sit on the window's corners and edges,
-- half outside it, with a soft shadow on the window below them and a little parallax (they drift against the pointer
-- and float on their own), so they seem to hang in front of it; others live inside: falling snow, a cobweb, a
-- string of lights along the top. Low effects keeps them still and drops the moving ones; reduced motion stops them.
UI.Decor = {Items = {}}
-- Pieces: Icon (a cell of the seasonal sheet), Size, X/Y as {scale, offset} relative to the window, Rotation, motion
-- (Bob, Sway, Flap, Fade, Speed, Phase) and Depth (how far it drifts with the pointer).
UI.Decor.Sets = {
    Halloween = {
        Badge = {Icon = "pumpkin", Text = "Happy Halloween"},
        Pieces = {
            {Icon = "pumpkin", Size = 56, X = {0, -36}, Y = {0, -34}, Rotation = -12, Bob = 3, Speed = 1.1, Depth = 7},
            {Icon = "bat", Size = 46, X = {1, -214}, Y = {0, -36}, Rotation = 6, Bob = 5, Flap = 10, Speed = 2.2, Depth = 9},
            {Icon = "bat", Size = 30, X = {1, -266}, Y = {0, -20}, Rotation = -8, Bob = 4, Flap = 12, Speed = 2.6, Phase = 1.7, Depth = 5},
            {Icon = "moon", Size = 46, X = {1, -26}, Y = {0, -42}, Rotation = 0, Bob = 1.5, Speed = 0.5, Depth = 3},
            {Icon = "ghost", Size = 52, X = {0, -32}, Y = {1, -46}, Rotation = 6, Bob = 6, Fade = 0.35, Speed = 0.8, Depth = 8},
            {Icon = "spider", Size = 32, X = {1, -82}, Y = {1, 6}, Thread = true, Bob = 10, Speed = 0.7, Depth = 4},
        },
        Inside = {{Icon = "cobweb", Size = 124, X = {1, -62}, Y = {1, -62}, Transparency = 0.72}},
    },
    Christmas = {
        Badge = {Icon = "tree", Text = "Merry Christmas"},
        Lights = true, Snow = true,
        Pieces = {
            {Icon = "gift", Size = 48, X = {0, -26}, Y = {0, -30}, Rotation = 10, Bob = 2, Speed = 1.3, Depth = 6},
            {Icon = "holly", Size = 46, X = {1, -38}, Y = {0, -38}, Rotation = -8, Sway = 4, Speed = 0.8, Depth = 5},
            {Icon = "tree", Size = 66, X = {0, -38}, Y = {1, -68}, Rotation = -3, Sway = 2, Speed = 0.9, Depth = 8},
            {Icon = "snowman", Size = 56, X = {1, -34}, Y = {1, -54}, Rotation = 5, Bob = 3, Speed = 1, Phase = 0.8, Depth = 7},
            {Icon = "star", Size = 24, X = {0, -8}, Y = {1, -80}, Fade = 0.5, Speed = 2.4, Depth = 9},
        },
    },
}
function UI.Decor.clear()
    for _, item in ipairs({UI.Decor.Layer, UI.Decor.Inner, UI.Decor.Badge}) do if item then pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end end
    UI.Decor.Layer, UI.Decor.Inner, UI.Decor.Badge = nil, nil, nil
    UI.Decor.Items, UI.Decor.Snow, UI.Decor.Bulbs = {}, nil, nil
end
-- A soft round shadow: two stacked ovals, the outer one fainter.
function UI.Decor.shadow(parent, size)
    local holder = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size * 0.9, size * 0.38), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 1}, parent)
    for index, spec in ipairs({{1, 0.86}, {0.62, 0.72}}) do
        local oval = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(spec[1], spec[1]),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = spec[2], BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = index}, holder)
        UI.new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, oval)
    end
    return holder
end
function UI.Decor.apply()
    UI.Decor.clear()
    local set = UI.Decor.Sets[Store.Settings.Theme]
    if not set or not UI.Main then return end
    -- In front of the window, following it (position, size, scale), not clipped by it.
    local layer = UI.new("Frame", {Name = "LyraThemeDecor", BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4, Active = false}, UI.Surface)
    UI.new("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, layer)
    UI.Decor.Layer = layer
    -- Inside the window, behind its content.
    local inner = UI.new("Frame", {Name = "LyraThemeInside", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, ClipsDescendants = true}, UI.Main)
    UI.Decor.Inner = inner
    for _, spec in ipairs(set.Inside or {}) do
        UI.seasonImage(inner, spec.Icon, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(spec.X[1], spec.X[2], spec.Y[1], spec.Y[2]),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(spec.Size, spec.Size), ImageTransparency = spec.Transparency or 0.8, Rotation = spec.Rotation or 0, ZIndex = 0})
    end
    for index, spec in ipairs(UI.seasonSheet() and set.Pieces or {}) do
        local anchor = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(spec.X[1], spec.X[2] + spec.Size / 2, spec.Y[1], spec.Y[2] + spec.Size / 2),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(spec.Size, spec.Size), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, layer)
        local shadow = UI.Decor.shadow(anchor, spec.Size)
        shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 1, -spec.Size * 0.08)
        local thread
        if spec.Thread then
            thread = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Muted,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, anchor)
            shadow.Visible = false
        end
        local label = UI.seasonImage(anchor, spec.Icon, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            Rotation = spec.Rotation or 0, ZIndex = 3})
        table.insert(UI.Decor.Items, {Spec = spec, Anchor = anchor, Label = label, Shadow = shadow, Thread = thread, Phase = spec.Phase or index * 0.9})
    end
    if set.Lights then
        -- A string of lights along the window's top edge, twinkling one after another.
        local wire = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, -1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 70, 52), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, layer)
        UI.Decor.Bulbs = {}
        local colors = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 86, 86), Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 84), Color3.fromRGB(90, 214, 120), Color3.fromRGB(110, 170, 255)}
        for index = 0, 17 do
            local bulb = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(index / 17, 0, 0, index % 2 == 0 and 1 or 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 10),
                BackgroundColor3 = colors[index % #colors + 1], BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, wire)
            UI.new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, bulb)
            table.insert(UI.Decor.Bulbs, bulb)
        end
    end
    if set.Snow and not Store.Settings.LowEffects then
        UI.Decor.Snow = {}
        for index = 1, 22 do
            -- Every third flake is a drawn snowflake, the rest soft dots.
            local size = index % 3 == 0 and 14 or (5 + index % 3 * 2)
            local flake = index % 3 == 0 and UI.seasonImage(inner, "snowflake", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
                ImageTransparency = 0.3 + (index % 4) * 0.1, Rotation = index * 23, ZIndex = 0}) or nil
            if not flake then
                flake = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 + (index % 4) * 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0}, inner)
                UI.new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, flake)
            end
            table.insert(UI.Decor.Snow, {Label = flake, X = math.random(), Y = math.random(), Speed = 0.04 + math.random() * 0.06, Drift = math.random() * 6.28})
        end
    end
    if set.Badge then
        -- A small badge next to the window's title: the theme's piece and a greeting.
        -- The piece and the text sit side by side in a row (a padding on the label itself would push the piece over
        -- the text).
        local badge = UI.new("Frame", {Name = "LyraThemeBadge", AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.AccentDark,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0}, UI.Header)
        UI.round(badge, 10)
        UI.new("UIListLayout", {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)}, badge)
        local icon = UI.seasonImage(badge, set.Badge.Icon, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), LayoutOrder = 1})
        UI.new("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, icon and 4 or 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)}, badge)
        UI.new("TextLabel", {AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = set.Badge.Text, TextColor3 = UI.C.Text,
            Font = UI.Font.Bold, TextSize = 10, LayoutOrder = 2}, badge)
        UI.Decor.Badge = badge
    end
    UI.Decor.start()
end
function UI.Decor.start()
    if UI.Decor.Running then return end
    UI.Decor.Running = true
    local clock, elapsed = 0, 0
    UI.connect(RS.RenderStepped, function(dt)
        local layer = UI.Decor.Layer
        if not layer or not layer.Parent then return end
        -- Follow the window.
        local main = UI.Main
        layer.Visible = main.Visible and UI.Visible
        if not layer.Visible then return end
        layer.AnchorPoint = main.AnchorPoint; layer.Position = main.Position; layer.Size = main.Size
        local scaler = layer:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        if scaler and UI.WindowScale then scaler.Scale = UI.WindowScale.Scale end
        if UI.Decor.Badge and UI.HeaderTitle then
            UI.Decor.Badge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(UI.HeaderTitle.Position.X.Offset + UI.HeaderTitle.TextBounds.X / math.max(UI.WindowScale and UI.WindowScale.Scale or 1, 0.1) + 10, 10)
            UI.Decor.Badge.Visible = not UI.Narrow
        end
        if Store.Settings.ReducedMotion then return end
        elapsed = elapsed + (dt or 0)
        if elapsed < 1 / 30 then return end
        clock = clock + elapsed
        local step = elapsed; elapsed = 0
        -- Parallax: the pointer's place over the window, from -1 to 1 on each side.
        local px, py = 0, 0
        pcall(function()
            local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation() - game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
            local center = main.AbsolutePosition + main.AbsoluteSize / 2
            px = math.clamp((mouse.X - center.X) / math.max(main.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, 1), -1, 1)
            py = math.clamp((mouse.Y - center.Y) / math.max(main.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2, 1), -1, 1)
        end)
        local still = Store.Settings.LowEffects
        for _, item in ipairs(UI.Decor.Items) do
            local spec = item.Spec
            local t = clock * (spec.Speed or 1) + item.Phase
            local depth = spec.Depth or 5
            local bob = still and 0 or math.sin(t) * (spec.Bob or 0)
            local offset = Vector2.new(-px * depth, -py * depth * 0.6 + bob)
            item.Label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, offset.X, 0.5, offset.Y)
            -- The shadow stays on the window and shrinks as the piece rises.
            local lift = 1 - (bob / math.max(spec.Size, 1)) * 2
            item.Shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4 - px * depth * 0.3, 1, -spec.Size * 0.08 - py * depth * 0.2)
            item.Shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(spec.Size * 0.9 * lift, spec.Size * 0.38 * lift)
            local rotation = spec.Rotation or 0
            if not still and spec.Flap then rotation = rotation + math.sin(t * 4) * spec.Flap end
            if not still and spec.Sway then rotation = rotation + math.sin(t) * spec.Sway end
            item.Label.Rotation = rotation
            if spec.Fade then item.Label.ImageTransparency = still and 0 or (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t)) * spec.Fade end
            if item.Thread then
                local length = 22 + (still and 0 or (math.sin(t) + 1) * (spec.Bob or 0))
                item.Thread.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, length)
                item.Label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, offset.X, 0.5, length - 22)
                item.Thread.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, offset.X, 0.5, length - 22 - spec.Size * 0.3)
            end
        end
        for index, bulb in ipairs(UI.Decor.Bulbs or {}) do
            bulb.BackgroundTransparency = still and 0 or (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(clock * 3 + index * 0.8)) * 0.65
        end
        for _, flake in ipairs(UI.Decor.Snow or {}) do
            flake.Y = flake.Y + flake.Speed * step
            if flake.Y > 1.05 then flake.Y = -0.05; flake.X = math.random() end
            flake.Label.Position = UDim2.new(flake.X + math.sin(clock + flake.Drift) * 0.012, 0, flake.Y, 0)
        end
    end)
end

-- PLUGINS: extra tools made by Lyra or by other players. A plugin is one Lua file, installed from its raw GitHub link
-- (raw.githubusercontent.com, or a gist's raw link) and kept in the executor's workspace, in "Avatar-copier plugins".
-- Plugins that are on load by themselves every time the script runs. A plugin returns a table:
--   return {Name = "My plugin", Version = "1.0", Author = "me", Description = "What it does.",
--           Load = function(api) ... end, Unload = function() ... end}
-- and builds its controls in the Plugins tab with the api it is given (see Plugins.api). What it connects, starts or
-- creates through the api is stopped when it is turned off. A plugin runs with the executor's full access, so the
-- tab says so before one is installed. A plugin that fails shows its error on its card; the rest carries on.
local Plugins = {Folder = "Avatar-copier plugins", Running = {}, List = {}, Settings = {}, Open = {}, MaxSize = 512000, MaxPlugins = 30,
    Official = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyraEz/Avatar-Studio-Plugins/main/plugins/lyra-tools.lua",
    Docs = "https://github.com/lyraEz/Avatar-Studio-Plugins"}
Plugins.Index = Plugins.Folder .. "/plugins.json"
Plugins.Version = "26.3.0"
-- Text from a plugin or its saved list: no control characters, trimmed, cut to a length; nil when empty.
function Plugins.text(value, limit)
    if type(value) ~= "string" and type(value) ~= "number" then return nil end
    local text = tostring(value):gsub("[%c]", " "):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):sub(1, limit or 60)
    return text ~= "" and text or nil
end
-- A setting a plugin may keep: a short name and a true/false, a number or a short text.
function Plugins.validValue(name, value)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or #name > 60 then return false end
    local kind = type(value)
    return kind == "boolean" or (kind == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < 1e12) or (kind == "string" and #value <= 2000)
end
function Plugins.files() return type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" end
function Plugins.ensureFolder()
    if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then return end
    local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, Plugins.Folder)
    if not (ok and exists) then pcall(makefolder, Plugins.Folder) end
end
function Plugins.path(row)
    if type(row) == "table" then return Plugins.Folder .. "/" .. (row.File or (row.Id .. ".lua")) end
    return Plugins.Folder .. "/" .. row .. ".lua"
end
-- A file name a plugin may have in the folder: a .lua or .luau file, no folders.
function Plugins.validFile(name)
    return type(name) == "string" and #name <= 80 and not name:find("[/\\]") and not name:find("%.%.") and (name:match("%.luau?$") ~= nil)
end
-- A link as pasted: a github.com file page becomes its raw link.
function Plugins.normalizeUrl(url)
    url = tostring(url or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    local owner, repo, path = url:match("^https://github%.com/([%w%-_%.]+)/([%w%-_%.]+)/blob/(.+)$")
    if owner then url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. owner .. "/" .. repo .. "/" .. path end
    return url
end
function Plugins.validUrl(url)
    if type(url) ~= "string" or #url > 400 or url:find("%s") then return false end
    return url:match("^https://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/.+") ~= nil or url:match("^https://gist%.githubusercontent%.com/[^/]+/.+") ~= nil
end
function Plugins.find(id) for index, row in ipairs(Plugins.List) do if row.Id == id then return row, index end end; return nil end
function Plugins.byUrl(url) for index, row in ipairs(Plugins.List) do if row.Url == url then return row, index end end; return nil end
-- The file name a plugin is saved under, from its link (lyra-tools.lua: "lyra-tools").
function Plugins.idFor(url)
    local file = url:gsub("[?#].*$", ""):match("([^/]+)$") or "plugin"
    local id = file:gsub("%.luau?$", ""):lower():gsub("[^%w%-_]", "-"):gsub("%-+", "-"):gsub("^%-", ""):gsub("%-$", ""):sub(1, 36)
    if id == "" then id = "plugin" end
    local base, number = id, 1
    while Plugins.find(id) do number = number + 1; id = base .. "-" .. number end
    return id
end
function Plugins.read()
    if Plugins.Loaded then return end
    Plugins.Loaded = true
    local data = Store.read(Plugins.Index)
    if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, row in ipairs(type(data.Plugins) == "table" and data.Plugins or {}) do
        if #Plugins.List >= Plugins.MaxPlugins then break end
        local fromLink = type(row) == "table" and Plugins.validUrl(row.Url)
        local fromFolder = type(row) == "table" and row.Url == nil and Plugins.validFile(row.File)
        if (fromLink or fromFolder) and type(row.Id) == "string" and #row.Id <= 40 and row.Id:match("^[%w%-_]+$") and not Plugins.find(row.Id) then
            table.insert(Plugins.List, {Id = row.Id, Url = fromLink and row.Url or nil, File = fromFolder and row.File or nil, Enabled = row.Enabled == true,
                Name = Plugins.text(row.Name, 40) or row.Id, Version = Plugins.text(row.Version, 20), Author = Plugins.text(row.Author, 40),
                Description = Plugins.text(row.Description, 240)})
        end
    end
    for id, values in pairs(type(data.Settings) == "table" and data.Settings or {}) do
        if type(id) == "string" and type(values) == "table" then
            local clean = {}
            for name, value in pairs(values) do if Plugins.validValue(name, value) then clean[name] = value end end
            Plugins.Settings[id] = clean
        end
    end
end
function Plugins.save()
    if not Plugins.files() then return false end
    Plugins.ensureFolder()
    local rows, settings = {}, {}
    for _, row in ipairs(Plugins.List) do
        table.insert(rows, {Id = row.Id, Url = row.Url, File = row.File, Enabled = row.Enabled, Name = row.Name, Version = row.Version, Author = row.Author, Description = row.Description})
        local values = Plugins.Settings[row.Id]
        if values and next(values) then settings[row.Id] = values end
    end
    return Store.write(Plugins.Index, {Version = 1, Plugins = rows, Settings = settings})
end
-- Settings change often (a slider): they are written a moment after the last change.
function Plugins.saveSoon()
    Plugins.SaveToken = (Plugins.SaveToken or 0) + 1
    local token = Plugins.SaveToken
    task.delay(1, function() if token == Plugins.SaveToken then pcall(Plugins.save) end end)
end
-- Stops with a message for the person, without this script's file and line in front of it.
function Plugins.need(ok, message) if not ok then error(message, 0) end end
-- A compile error as "line 3: what is wrong", whatever name the executor gives the plugin's code.
function Plugins.lineError(err)
    local text = tostring(err)
    local line, rest = text:match("^[^:\n]*:(%d+): (.+)$")
    return line and ("line " .. line .. ": " .. rest) or text
--YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
end
-- Yields. The plugin file at a link, checked: a Lua file of at most 500 KB that compiles.
function Plugins.download(url)
    local fresh = url .. (url:find("?", 1, true) and "&" or "?") .. "t=" .. tostring(os.time())
    local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(fresh) end)
    if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" then
        local requestFn = Sync.requestFn()
        if requestFn then
            local got, response = pcall(requestFn, {Url = fresh, Method = "GET"})
            if got and type(response) == "table" and type(response.Body) == "string" and (tonumber(response.StatusCode) or 200) < 400 then ok, body = true, response.Body end
        end
    end
    Plugins.need(ok and type(body) == "string", "Could not download the plugin. Check the link and your connection.")
    Plugins.need(not body:find("^%s*404: Not Found"), "Nothing was found at that link. Check it on GitHub (use the Raw button's link).")
    Plugins.need(not body:find("^%s*<"), "That link is a web page, not a Lua file. Open the file on GitHub, tap Raw and copy that link.")
    Plugins.need(#body > 0 and #body <= Plugins.MaxSize, "The plugin file is empty or too big (500 KB at most).")
    Plugins.need(type(loadstring) == "function", "Your executor can't run plugins (it has no loadstring).")
    local chunk, err = loadstring(body, "=plugin")
    Plugins.need(chunk, "The plugin has an error and was not installed: " .. Plugins.lineError(err))
    return body
end
-- Stops a running plugin: its Unload, what it registered, its connections, loops, instances and controls.
function Plugins.unload(id)
    local runtime = Plugins.Running[id]
    if not runtime then return end
    Plugins.Running[id] = nil
    runtime.Alive = false
    if runtime.Spec and type(runtime.Spec.Unload) == "function" then pcall(runtime.Spec.Unload) end
-- YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
    for index = #runtime.Unloads, 1, -1 do pcall(runtime.Unloads[index]) end
    for _, connection in ipairs(runtime.Connections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    for _, thread in ipairs(runtime.Threads) do if thread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, thread) end end
    for _, item in ipairs(runtime.Instances) do pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
    for _, connection in ipairs(UI.Rows[runtime.Key] or {}) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    UI.Rows[runtime.Key] = nil
    pcall(function() runtime.Body:Destroy() end)
end
function Plugins.unloadAll() for id in pairs(Plugins.Running) do pcall(Plugins.unload, id) end end
function Plugins.fail(runtime, err)
    local row = runtime.Row
    row.Error = "Error: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 240)
    warn("[Avatar Studio plugin " .. row.Id .. "] " .. tostring(err))
    Plugins.unload(row.Id)
end
-- Yields. Runs a plugin from its saved file (or the source just downloaded). Returns whether it loaded.
function Plugins.start(row, source)
    Plugins.unload(row.Id)
    row.Error = nil
    if not source then
        local ok, text = pcall(readfile, Plugins.path(row))
        if not ok or type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then
            row.Error = row.Url and "The plugin file is missing. Tap Update to download it again." or "The plugin file is missing or empty in the Avatar-copier plugins folder."
            return false
        end
        if #text > Plugins.MaxSize then row.Error = "The plugin file is too big (500 KB at most)."; return false end
        source = text
    end
    if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then row.Error = "Your executor can't run plugins (it has no loadstring)."; return false end
    local chunk, err = loadstring(source, "=" .. row.Id)
    if not chunk then row.Error = "Error: " .. Plugins.lineError(err):sub(1, 240); return false end
    local runtime = {Row = row, Key = "plugin:" .. row.Id, Connections = {}, Threads = {}, Instances = {}, Unloads = {}, Alive = true}
    UI.Rows[runtime.Key] = {}
    runtime.Body = UI.new("Frame", {Name = "PluginControls", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    UI.stack(runtime.Body, 6)
    Plugins.Running[row.Id] = runtime
    local ran, result = pcall(chunk)
    if not ran then Plugins.fail(runtime, result); return false end
    local spec = type(result) == "table" and result or (type(result) == "function" and {Load = result}) or {}
    runtime.Spec = spec
    row.Name = Plugins.text(spec.Name, 40) or row.Name or row.Id
    row.Version = Plugins.text(spec.Version, 20) or row.Version
    row.Author = Plugins.text(spec.Author, 40) or row.Author
    row.Description = Plugins.text(spec.Description, 240) or row.Description
    if type(spec.Load) == "function" then
        local loaded, loadError = pcall(spec.Load, Plugins.api(runtime))
        if not loaded then Plugins.fail(runtime, loadError); return false end
    end
    return Plugins.Running[row.Id] == runtime
end
-- Yields. Installs the plugin at a link (or updates it when it is already installed) and turns it on.
function Plugins.install(url)
    url = Plugins.normalizeUrl(url)
    Plugins.need(Plugins.validUrl(url), "Paste a raw GitHub link: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/... (or a gist's raw link).")
    Plugins.need(Plugins.files(), "Your executor can't save files, so plugins can't be installed.")
    local row = Plugins.byUrl(url)
    Plugins.need(row or #Plugins.List < Plugins.MaxPlugins, "You can have up to " .. Plugins.MaxPlugins .. " plugins. Remove one first.")
    local source = Plugins.download(url)
    Plugins.ensureFolder()
    local fresh = not row
    if fresh then row = {Id = Plugins.idFor(url), Url = url} end
    Plugins.need(pcall(writefile, Plugins.path(row.Id), source), "The plugin could not be saved in your executor's workspace.")
    if fresh then row.Name = row.Id; table.insert(Plugins.List, row) end
    row.Enabled = true
    local loaded = Plugins.start(row, source)
    Plugins.save()
    return row, loaded
end
function Plugins.remove(id)
    local row, index = Plugins.find(id)
    if not row then return end
    Plugins.unload(id)
    table.remove(Plugins.List, index)
    Plugins.Settings[id] = nil; Plugins.Open[id] = nil
    if type(delfile) == "function" then pcall(delfile, Plugins.path(row)) else pcall(writefile, Plugins.path(row), "") end
    Plugins.save()
end
-- Lua files put in the folder by hand show up as plugins (on, since you put them there); a hand-added file that
-- was deleted from the folder leaves the list. Returns the new ones.
function Plugins.scan()
    if type(listfiles) ~= "function" then return {} end
    Plugins.ensureFolder()
    local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, Plugins.Folder)
    if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then return {} end
    local present, known, added = {}, {}, {}
    for _, row in ipairs(Plugins.List) do known[(row.File or (row.Id .. ".lua")):lower()] = true end
    for _, path in ipairs(files) do
        local name = type(path) == "string" and path:match("([^/\\]+)$")
        if Plugins.validFile(name) then
            present[name:lower()] = true
            if not known[name:lower()] and #Plugins.List < Plugins.MaxPlugins then
                local id = Plugins.idFor(name)
                local row = {Id = id, File = name, Enabled = true, Name = name:gsub("%.luau?$", "")}
                table.insert(Plugins.List, row); table.insert(added, row)
                known[name:lower()] = true
            end
        end
    end
    for index = #Plugins.List, 1, -1 do
        local row = Plugins.List[index]
        if row.File and not present[row.File:lower()] then Plugins.unload(row.Id); table.remove(Plugins.List, index) end
    end
    if #added > 0 then Plugins.save() end
    return added
end
-- Yields. Reads the list and runs the plugins that are on, one after another.
function Plugins.boot()
    pcall(Plugins.read)
    pcall(Plugins.scan)
    for _, row in ipairs(Plugins.List) do
        if not App.alive() then return end
        if row.Enabled then pcall(Plugins.start, row) end
    end
    UI.schedulePlugins()
end
-- The api a plugin's Load gets. Controls go in the plugin's own card in the Plugins tab, in the order they are made.
function Plugins.api(runtime)
    local row, body, key = runtime.Row, runtime.Body, runtime.Key
    local settings = Plugins.Settings[row.Id] or {}
    Plugins.Settings[row.Id] = settings
    local api = {Player = lp, Version = Plugins.Version, Name = row.Name}
    local order = 0
    local function place(item) order = order + 1; item.LayoutOrder = order; return item end
    -- Runs plugin code; an error ends up on the plugin's card instead of stopping anything else.
    local function guard(fn, ...)
        if not runtime.Alive or type(fn) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
        if not ok then
            row.Error = "Error: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 240)
            warn("[Avatar Studio plugin " .. row.Id .. "] " .. tostring(err))
            UI.schedulePlugins()
        end
        return ok
    end
    local function bind(event, fn)
        table.insert(UI.Rows[key], event:Connect(function(...) if App.alive() and runtime.Alive then fn(...) end end))
    end
    local function spec(value, field) if type(value) == "table" then return value end; return {[field or "Title"] = value} end
    function api.alive() return runtime.Alive and App.alive() end
    function api.notify(text, kind)
        kind = ({info = true, success = true, warning = true, error = true})[kind] and kind or "info"
        App.toast({Title = row.Name, Text = Plugins.text(text, 200) or "", Kind = kind, Icon = kind == "error" and "circle-x" or kind == "warning" and "triangle-alert" or "info", Duration = 4})
    end
    function api.get(name, default)
        local value = settings[name]
        if value == nil then return default end
        return value
    end
    function api.set(name, value)
        if value == nil and type(name) == "string" then settings[name] = nil; Plugins.saveSoon()
        elseif Plugins.validValue(name, value) then settings[name] = value; Plugins.saveSoon() end
    end
    function api.connect(signal, fn)
        local connection = signal:Connect(function(...) guard(fn, ...) end)
        table.insert(runtime.Connections, connection)
        return connection
    end
    function api.spawn(fn, ...)
        local thread = task.spawn(guard, fn, ...)
        table.insert(runtime.Threads, thread)
        return thread
    end
    -- Runs fn every few seconds (0: every frame) until the plugin is turned off; an error stops the loop.
    function api.every(seconds, fn)
        seconds = math.max(tonumber(seconds) or 1, 0)
        local thread = task.spawn(function()
            while runtime.Alive and App.alive() do
                if not guard(fn) then break end
                if seconds <= 0 then RS.Heartbeat:Wait() else task.wait(seconds) end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(runtime.Threads, thread)
        return thread
    end
    -- fn(character) for your character now and after every respawn.
    function api.onCharacter(fn)
        if lp.Character then api.spawn(fn, lp.Character) end
        return api.connect(lp.CharacterAdded, fn)
    end
    function api.onUnload(fn) if type(fn) == "function" then table.insert(runtime.Unloads, fn) end end
    -- An instance the plugin made, destroyed when it is turned off.
    function api.track(item) table.insert(runtime.Instances, item); return item end
    function api.section(value)
        local info = spec(value)
        place(UI.section(body, Plugins.text(info.Title, 60) or "", Plugins.text(info.Text or info.Description, 300)))
    end
    function api.label(value)
        local info = spec(value, "Text")
        local label = place(UI.paragraph(body, Plugins.text(info.Text, 500) or "", 12, UI.C.Muted, false))
        return {Get = function() return label.Text end, Set = function(text) label.Text = Plugins.text(text, 500) or "" end}
    end
    function api.button(value)
        local info = spec(value)
        local card = place(UI.controlCard(body, Plugins.text(info.Title, 60) or "Action", Plugins.text(info.Description, 300) or "", 110))
        local button = UI.button(card, Plugins.text(info.Button, 14) or "Run", true, function() api.spawn(info.Pressed or info.Callback) end, nil, key)
        button.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 38); button.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -122, 0.5, -19)
        return {Get = function() return button.Label.Text end, Set = function(text) button.Label.Text = Plugins.text(text, 14) or "Run" end}
    end
    -- On/off switch. Changed(on) runs when it is switched, and once when the plugin loads if it was left on.
    function api.toggle(value)
        local info = spec(value)
        local saveName = Plugins.text(info.Save, 60)
        local on = info.Default == true
        if saveName and type(settings[saveName]) == "boolean" then on = settings[saveName] end
        local card = place(UI.controlCard(body, Plugins.text(info.Title, 60) or "Option", Plugins.text(info.Description, 300) or "", 58))
        local switch = UI.new("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, -15), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 30), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0}, card); UI.round(switch, 30)
        local knob = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), BackgroundColor3 = UI.C.Text, BorderSizePixel = 0}, switch); UI.round(knob, 22)
        local function draw()
            UI.tween(switch, {BackgroundColor3 = on and UI.C.AccentDark or UI.C.Raised})
            UI.tween(knob, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(on and 24 or 4, 4), BackgroundColor3 = on and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted})
        end
        local handle = {}
        function handle.Get() return on end
        function handle.Set(state, quiet)
            state = state == true
            if state == on then return end
            on = state; draw()
            if saveName then settings[saveName] = on; Plugins.saveSoon() end
            if not quiet then api.spawn(info.Changed or info.Callback, on) end
        end
        bind(switch.Activated, function() handle.Set(not on) end)
        draw()
        -- Deferred, so the plugin already holds the switch (handle) when its Changed runs.
        if on then table.insert(runtime.Threads, task.defer(guard, info.Changed or info.Callback, true)) end
        return handle
    end
    -- A number between Min and Max, changed in Steps with - and + (or typed). Changed(value) runs when it changes.
    function api.number(value)
        local info = spec(value)
        local low, high = tonumber(info.Min) or 0, tonumber(info.Max) or 100
        if high < low then low, high = high, low end
        local step = math.max(tonumber(info.Step) or 1, 0.001)
        local saveName = Plugins.text(info.Save, 60)
        local function fit(number)
            number = math.clamp(tonumber(number) or low, low, high)
            return math.clamp(low + math.floor((number - low) / step + 0.5) * step, low, high)
        end
        local current = fit(info.Default)
        if saveName and type(settings[saveName]) == "number" then current = fit(settings[saveName]) end
        local card = place(UI.controlCard(body, Plugins.text(info.Title, 60) or "Value", Plugins.text(info.Description, 300) or "", 140))
        local box = UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 38), Position = UDim2.new(1, -152, 0.5, -19), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, card)
        local field = UI.new("TextBox", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextColor3 = UI.C.Text, Font = UI.Font.Bold, TextSize = UI.size(13), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center}, box)
        local function show() field.Text = step >= 1 and string.format("%d", current) or string.format("%.2f", current) end
        local handle = {}
        function handle.Get() return current end
        function handle.Set(number, quiet)
            number = fit(number)
            if number == current then show(); return end
            current = number; show()
            if saveName then settings[saveName] = current; Plugins.saveSoon() end
            if not quiet then api.spawn(info.Changed or info.Callback, current) end
        end
        local minus = UI.button(box, "", false, function() handle.Set(current - step) end, "minus", key); minus.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 38)
        local plus = UI.button(box, "", false, function() handle.Set(current + step) end, "plus", key); plus.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 38); plus.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 0)
        bind(field.FocusLost, function() handle.Set(tonumber(field.Text) or current) end)
        show()
        return handle
    end
    api.slider = api.number
    -- A text box with a button. Submitted(text) runs on the button or Enter.
    function api.input(value)
        local info = spec(value)
        local card = place(UI.autoCard(body, 0, 6, 12))
        if Plugins.text(info.Title, 60) then UI.paragraph(card, Plugins.text(info.Title, 60), 13, UI.C.Text, true, 1) end
        if Plugins.text(info.Description, 300) then UI.paragraph(card, Plugins.text(info.Description, 300), 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 2) end
        local line = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = 3, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, card)
        local frame, box = UI.input(line, Plugins.text(info.Placeholder, 80) or "Type here", "pencil")
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 42)
        box.Text = Plugins.text(info.Default, 200) or ""
        local function submit() api.spawn(info.Submitted or info.Callback, box.Text) end
        local go = UI.button(line, Plugins.text(info.Button, 12) or "OK", true, submit, nil, key)
        go.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 42); go.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 0)
        bind(box.FocusLost, function(enter) if enter then submit() end end)
        return {Get = function() return box.Text end, Set = function(text) box.Text = tostring(text or "") end}
    end
    -- A list of choices. Changed(choice) runs when another one is picked.
    function api.dropdown(value)
        local info = spec(value)
        local options = {}
        for _, option in ipairs(type(info.Options) == "table" and info.Options or {}) do
            local text = Plugins.text(option, 40)
            if text and #options < 30 then table.insert(options, {Value = text, Label = text}) end
        end
        assert(#options > 0, "A dropdown needs Options")
        local saveName = Plugins.text(info.Save, 60)
        local current = Plugins.text(info.Default, 40) or options[1].Value
        if saveName and type(settings[saveName]) == "string" then current = settings[saveName] end
        local known = false
        for _, option in ipairs(options) do if option.Value == current then known = true end end
        if not known then current = options[1].Value end
        local card = place(UI.controlCard(body, Plugins.text(info.Title, 60) or "Choice", Plugins.text(info.Description, 300) or "", 150))
        local drop
        drop = UI.dropdown(card, options, function() return current end, function(choice)
            current = choice
            if saveName then settings[saveName] = current; Plugins.saveSoon() end
            api.spawn(info.Changed or info.Callback, current)
        end)
        drop.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40); drop.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -162, 0.5, -20)
        drop.refresh()
        return {Get = function() return current end, Set = function(choice) current = choice; drop.refresh() end}
    end
    return api
end

-- PLUGINS tab.
function UI.schedulePlugins()
    UI.PluginToken = (UI.PluginToken or 0) + 1
    local token = UI.PluginToken
    task.delay(0.1, function() if App.alive() and token == UI.PluginToken then UI.renderPlugins() end end)
end
function UI.buildPlugins()
    local page = UI.page("Plugins"); UI.stack(page, 8)
    local order = 0
    local function add(item) order = order + 1; item.LayoutOrder = order; return item end
    add(UI.section(page, "Plugins", "Extra tools for your games, made by Lyra or by other players. Turn each one on or off below."))
    local install = add(UI.card(page, 56))
    local linkFrame, link = UI.input(install, "Paste a plugin link (raw.githubusercontent.com/…)", "link")
    linkFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7); linkFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -118, 0, 42); UI.PluginLink = link
    local go = UI.button(install, "Install", true, function() UI.installPlugin(link.Text) end, "download")
    go.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -105, 0, 7); go.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(98, 42)
    add(UI.paragraph(page, "Or put the plugin's .lua file in your executor's workspace, in the \"Avatar-copier plugins\" folder: it shows up here.", 11, UI.C.Muted, false))
    local check = add(UI.button(page, "Check the folder", false, function()
        task.spawn(function()
            local added = Plugins.scan()
            for _, row in ipairs(added) do if row.Enabled then Plugins.start(row) end end
            if not App.alive() then return end
            UI.renderPlugins()
            App.report(#added > 0 and (tostring(#added) .. (#added == 1 and " plugin" or " plugins") .. " found in the folder.") or "No new plugin files in the folder.", #added > 0 and "success" or "info")
        end)
    end, "refresh-cw").Root); check.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    add(UI.paragraph(page, "Plugins run code with your executor's full access. Only install plugins from people you trust.", 11, UI.C.Gold, false))
    UI.PluginOfficial = add(UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, page)); UI.stack(UI.PluginOfficial, 6)
    add(UI.section(page, "Installed"))
    UI.PluginList = add(UI.new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, page)); UI.stack(UI.PluginList, 8)
    local docs = add(UI.autoCard(page, 0, 6, 14))
    UI.paragraph(docs, "Make your own plugin", 13, UI.C.Text, true, 1)
    UI.paragraph(docs, "A plugin is one Lua file on GitHub. The step-by-step guide, and Lyra Tools' code as a commented example, are on Lyra's GitHub.", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 2)
    local copy = UI.button(docs, "Copy the guide's link", false, function()
        local clipboard = type(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard or type(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard or nil
        if clipboard and pcall(clipboard, Plugins.Docs) then App.report("Guide link copied.", "success")
        else App.report("Guide: " .. Plugins.Docs, "info") end
    end, "github")
    copy.Root.LayoutOrder = 3; copy.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    UI.renderPlugins()
end
-- Opening the tab looks for plugin files added to the folder meanwhile.
function UI.openPlugins()
    UI.renderPlugins()
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, added = pcall(Plugins.scan)
        if not ok or not App.alive() then return end
        for _, row in ipairs(added) do if row.Enabled then Plugins.start(row) end end
        UI.renderPlugins()
    end)
end
-- official: Lyra's own plugin, installed without the trust question.
function UI.installPlugin(url, official)
    url = Plugins.normalizeUrl(url)
    if url == "" then App.report("Paste a plugin link first.", "warning"); return end
    if not Plugins.validUrl(url) then App.report("Paste a raw GitHub link: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/... (or a gist's raw link).", "warning"); return end
    local function run()
        if UI.PluginBusy then return end
        UI.PluginBusy = true; App.report("Installing the plugin…", "loading")
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, row, loaded = pcall(Plugins.install, url)
            UI.PluginBusy = false
            if not App.alive() then return end
            if not ok then App.report(tostring(row), "error")
            else
                if UI.PluginLink and not official then UI.PluginLink.Text = "" end
                Plugins.Open[row.Id] = loaded or nil
-- @YMLXO3K7GVTGMODEMRTGEMRUMNQTCNRZMQZWKMZSCE
                App.report(loaded and (row.Name .. " is installed and on.") or (row.Name .. " was installed but could not start. See its card."), loaded and "success" or "warning")
            end
            UI.renderPlugins()
        end)
    end
    if official or Plugins.byUrl(url) then run(); return end
    UI.confirm("Install this plugin?", "It will run code with your executor's full access. Only install plugins from people you trust.\n" .. url, run, {Confirm = "Install"})
end
function UI.setPluginOn(row, on)
    row.Enabled = on
    if on then
        task.spawn(function()
            local loaded = Plugins.start(row)
            if not App.alive() then return end
            if not loaded then App.report(row.Name .. " could not start. See its card.", "warning") end
            Plugins.save(); UI.renderPlugins()
        end)
    else
        Plugins.unload(row.Id); row.Error = nil
        Plugins.save()
    end
    UI.renderPlugins()
end
function UI.pluginCard(row, index)
    local runtime = Plugins.Running[row.Id]
    local card = UI.autoCard(UI.PluginList, index, 8, 12)
    local head = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, card)
    local title = UI.text(head, row.Name or row.Id, 14, nil, true); title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 20)
    local about = {}
    if row.Version then table.insert(about, "v" .. row.Version) end
    if row.Author then table.insert(about, "by " .. row.Author) end
    if row.File then table.insert(about, "from your folder") end
    table.insert(about, row.Error and "Error" or runtime and "On" or row.Enabled and "Starting…" or "Off")
    local sub = UI.text(head, table.concat(about, "  ·  "), 11, row.Error and UI.C.Red or runtime and UI.C.Green or UI.C.Muted)
    sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 21); sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18)
    local on = row.Enabled
    local switch = UI.new("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0.5, -15), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 30), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
        BackgroundColor3 = on and UI.C.AccentDark or UI.C.Raised, BorderSizePixel = 0}, head); UI.round(switch, 30)
    local knob = UI.new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(on and 24 or 4, 4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), BackgroundColor3 = on and UI.C.Text or UI.C.Muted, BorderSizePixel = 0}, switch); UI.round(knob, 22)
    UI.rowConnect("plugins", switch.Activated, function() UI.setPluginOn(row, not row.Enabled) end)
    if row.Description then UI.paragraph(card, row.Description, 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 2) end
    if row.Error then UI.paragraph(card, row.Error, 11, UI.C.Red, false, 3) end
    local hasControls = runtime and runtime.Body and #runtime.Body:GetChildren() > 1
    local grid = UI.new("Frame", {LayoutOrder = 4, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, card)
    UI.new("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / (hasControls and 3 or 2), -6, 0, 38), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, grid)
    local open = hasControls and Plugins.Open[row.Id]
    if hasControls then
        local toggle = UI.button(grid, open and "Hide" or "Options", false, function() Plugins.Open[row.Id] = not Plugins.Open[row.Id] or nil; UI.renderPlugins() end, open and "chevron-up" or "chevron-down", "plugins")
        toggle.Root.LayoutOrder = 1
    end
    local update = UI.button(grid, row.Url and "Update" or "Reload", false, function()
        -- A plugin from the folder is read again from its file (after you edited it).
        if not row.Url then
            row.Enabled = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local loaded = Plugins.start(row)
                if not App.alive() then return end
                Plugins.save(); UI.renderPlugins()
                App.report(loaded and ((row.Name or row.Id) .. " was reloaded from its file.") or ((row.Name or row.Id) .. " could not start. See its card."), loaded and "success" or "warning")
            end)
            return
        end
        App.report("Updating " .. (row.Name or row.Id) .. "…", "loading")
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, result, loaded = pcall(Plugins.install, row.Url)
            if not App.alive() then return end
            if not ok then App.report(tostring(result), "error")
            else App.report(loaded and ((row.Name or row.Id) .. " is up to date.") or ((row.Name or row.Id) .. " was updated but could not start. See its card."), loaded and "success" or "warning") end
            UI.renderPlugins()
        end)
    end, "refresh-cw", "plugins"); update.Root.LayoutOrder = 2
    local remove = UI.button(grid, "Remove", false, function()
        UI.confirm("Remove plugin?", "'" .. (row.Name or row.Id) .. "' will be turned off and its file deleted from the Avatar-copier plugins folder.", function()
            Plugins.remove(row.Id); UI.renderPlugins(); App.report("Plugin removed.", "success")
        end)
    end, "trash-2", "plugins"); remove.Root.LayoutOrder = 3
    if open then runtime.Body.LayoutOrder = 5; runtime.Body.Parent = card end
end
function UI.renderPlugins()
    if not UI.PluginList then return end
    -- A plugin's controls live on while the list is drawn again.
    for _, runtime in pairs(Plugins.Running) do pcall(function() runtime.Body.Parent = nil end) end
    UI.clearRows("plugins", UI.PluginList)
    UI.clearRows("pluginsOfficial", UI.PluginOfficial)
    if not Plugins.byUrl(Plugins.Official) then
        local card = UI.autoCard(UI.PluginOfficial, 1, 6, 14)
        UI.paragraph(card, "Lyra Tools  ·  official", 13, UI.C.Text, true, 1)
        UI.paragraph(card, "Anti-fling, anti-kick, anti-AFK, FPS boost and more, made by Lyra. Its code is also a commented example for making your own.", 11, UI.C.Muted, false, 2)
        local get = UI.button(card, "Install Lyra Tools", true, function() UI.installPlugin(Plugins.Official, true) end, "download", "pluginsOfficial")
        get.Root.LayoutOrder = 3; get.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    end
    if #Plugins.List == 0 then
        UI.emptyList(UI.PluginList, "No plugins yet", "Install Lyra Tools above, or paste the raw link of a plugin someone shared.")
        return
    end
    for index, row in ipairs(Plugins.List) do UI.pluginCard(row, index) end
end

-- PRESENCE AND NOTICES: while the script runs it tells the Lyra server about once a minute that you are playing: your
-- Roblox id and name, the game and server, the script version and the Roblox account whose avatar you copied last
-- (Chat and Community show that avatar as your picture). The owner's panel counts who is playing right now from it,
-- and can send a notice to everyone, to one game or to one player: a card on screen, a short notification, confetti or
-- a Community skin to try. A notice is text only and is only shown on your screen; the newest one you saw is kept in
-- your workspace, so a notice is not shown twice.
Presence.Url = "https://api.lyraez.lol/v1/presence"
Presence.Interval = 60
Presence.SeenFile = "Copier_LyraNotices.txt"
Presence.Shown = {}
Presence.Kinds = {popup = true, toast = true, confetti = true, skin = true}
function Presence.call(body)
    local requestFn = Sync.requestFn(); if not requestFn then return nil end
    local ok, response = pcall(requestFn, {Url = Presence.Url, Method = "POST", Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)})
    if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" or type(response.Body) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local decoded, reply = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body) end)
    return decoded and type(reply) == "table" and reply or nil
end
-- The Roblox account whose avatar you wear: a copied profile, or a skin made from one. Nil for your own look and for a
-- skin taken from someone's post or sent by a player (their picture is not that skin).
function Presence.look()
    local snapshot = App.Current
    if not snapshot or snapshot.Original or snapshot.Shared then return nil end
    local id = Codec.id(snapshot.Id) or Codec.id(snapshot.ThumbId)
    return id ~= lp.UserId and id or nil
end
function Presence.seen()
    if Presence.Seen ~= nil then return Presence.Seen end
    local value
    pcall(function() if type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(Presence.SeenFile) then value = tonumber((readfile(Presence.SeenFile))) end end)
    Presence.Seen = Codec.id(value) or 0
    return Presence.Seen
end
function Presence.markSeen(id)
    if id <= Presence.seen() then return end
    Presence.Seen = id
    if type(writefile) == "function" then pcall(writefile, Presence.SeenFile, tostring(id)) end
end
-- Yields. One beat; returns whether the Lyra server answered.
function Presence.beat()
    -- The device key (the one Community and Chat use) lets only this device change your picture.
    local body = {a = "beat", user = lp.UserId, uname = lp.Name, key = Community.key(), place = game.PlaceId, v = Plugins.Version, seen = Presence.seen(), look = Presence.look()}
    if game.JobId ~= "" then body.job = game.JobId end
    local reply = Presence.call(body)
    if not reply or reply.ok ~= true then return false end
    if body.look then Presence.Sent = body.look end
    local nextBeat = tonumber(reply.next)
    if nextBeat then Presence.Interval = math.clamp(math.floor(nextBeat), 30, 600) end
    for _, raw in ipairs(type(reply.notices) == "table" and reply.notices or {}) do pcall(Presence.show, raw) end
    return true
end
-- Height a notice's text needs in a request card.
function Presence.textHeight(text)
    local screen = UI.Surface and UI.Surface.AbsoluteSize.X or 0
    local width = math.floor(math.min(360, (screen > 0 and screen or 400) - 24)) - 104
    local ok, bounds = pcall(function() return game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(text, UI.size(12), UI.Font.Regular, Vector2.new(width, 1000)) end)
    return ok and math.ceil(bounds.Y) + 4 or 64
end
-- A notice from the owner's panel (see the worker's presence.js): checked, and shown once.
function Presence.show(raw)
    if type(raw) ~= "table" or not UI.Surface then return end
    local id = Codec.id(raw.id)
    if not id or Presence.Shown[id] then return end
    Presence.Shown[id] = true
    Presence.markSeen(id)
    local kind = Presence.Kinds[raw.kind] and raw.kind or "popup"
    local title = Codec.cut(type(raw.title) == "string" and raw.title or "", 60)
    local text = Codec.cut(type(raw.text) == "string" and raw.text or "", 240)
    if title == "" then title = "Lyra" end
    local from = Codec.id(raw.from) or lp.UserId
    local seconds = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(raw.seconds) or 20), 5, 120)
    if kind == "toast" or kind == "confetti" then
        if kind == "confetti" then UI.confetti() end
        if App.ToastSink then pcall(App.ToastSink, {Title = title, Text = text ~= "" and text or nil, Kind = "info", Icon = kind == "confetti" and "star" or "bell",
            Image = Sync.headshot(from), Duration = math.min(seconds, 12), Featured = kind == "confetti"}) end
        return
    end
    if kind == "skin" then
        local post = type(raw.post) == "string" and #raw.post == 10 and raw.post:match("^[a-z2-9]+$") or nil
        if not post then return end
        local name = Codec.cut(type(raw.name) == "string" and raw.name or "", 48)
        if name == "" then name = "Community skin" end
        local author = Codec.id(raw.author)
        local about = text ~= "" and text or "The Lyra team picked this skin for you to try."
        UI.requestCard({UserId = author or from, Tag = "SKIN OF THE MOMENT", Tone = UI.C.Gold, Title = title, Text = about, Chip = name, Seconds = seconds, Icon = "star",
            BodyHeight = Presence.textHeight(about),
            Left = {Text = "Later", Icon = "x", Callback = function(card) card.Close() end},
            Right = {Text = "Wear", Icon = "shirt", Callback = function(card)
                if App.Busy then App.report("Wait for the current change to finish.", "warning"); return end
                card.Close()
                UI.useCommunity({id = post, name = name, user = author, uname = type(raw.uname) == "string" and raw.uname or nil}, "wear")
            end}})
        return
    end
    UI.requestCard({UserId = from, Tag = "MESSAGE FROM LYRA", Title = title, Text = text, Chip = "Avatar Studio team", Seconds = seconds, Icon = "bell",
        BodyHeight = Presence.textHeight(text),
        Left = {Text = "Close", Icon = "x", Callback = function(card) card.Close() end},
        Right = {Text = "OK", Icon = "check", Callback = function(card) card.Close() end}})
end
-- A short burst of confetti over the whole screen (nothing with Reduced motion or Low effects on).
function UI.confetti()
    if not UI.Surface or Store.Settings.ReducedMotion or Store.Settings.LowEffects then return end
    local layer = UI.new("Frame", {Name = "LyraConfetti", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 205}, UI.Surface)
    local colors = {UI.C.Accent, UI.C.Green, UI.C.Gold, UI.C.Red, Color3.fromRGB(120, 190, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}
    for _ = 1, 70 do
        local size = math.random(6, 11)
        local x = math.random()
        local piece = UI.new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0, -20 - math.random(0, 160)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, math.floor(size * 0.6)),
            Rotation = math.random(0, 360), BackgroundColor3 = colors[math.random(1, #colors)], BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 206}, layer)
        local goal = {Position = UDim2.new(x + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25, 0, 1, 30), Rotation = piece.Rotation + math.random(-540, 540)}
        pcall(function()
            UI.TweenService:Create(piece, TweenInfo.new(2.4 + math.random() * 1.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, 0, false, math.random() * 0.6), goal):Play()
        end)
    end
    task.delay(5.5, function() pcall(function() layer:Destroy() end) end)
end
function Presence.start()
    if Presence.Running or not Sync.requestFn() then return end
    Presence.Running = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local fails = 0
        -- The first beat waits a moment, so the window is up before a notice shows.
        task.wait(6)
        while App.alive() and not Presence.Closed do
            local ok, answered = pcall(Presence.beat)
            fails = (ok and answered) and 0 or fails + 1
            -- A failed beat waits longer each time (up to 10 min), so a server problem costs nothing.
            local delay = fails == 0 and Presence.Interval or math.min(600, Presence.Interval * 2 ^ fails)
            local beatAt = os.clock()
            local resume = beatAt + delay
            while os.clock() < resume and App.alive() and not Presence.Closed do
                task.wait(1)
                -- A newly copied avatar becomes your picture soon (at most one extra beat every 15 s).
                local look = fails == 0 and Presence.look()
                if look and look ~= Presence.Sent and os.clock() - beatAt >= 15 then break end
            end
        end
        Presence.Running = false
    end)
end

local function cleanup()
    if App.Closed then return end
    pcall(App.leaveCarry)
    pcall(Plugins.unloadAll)
    Repair.stop(); F.AnimSerial = F.AnimSerial + 1
    pcall(Fit.stop); pcall(CameraLift.reset)
    pcall(Cover.finish); pcall(Cloak.stop); pcall(Scale.stop)
    App.Closed=true; App.QueryToken=App.QueryToken+1; S.operationSerial=(S.operationSerial or 0)+1
    _G.Copier_TargetID=nil; _G.ToolsGiverActive=false
    pcall(F.unlockCamera); pcall(F.resumeCamScripts)
    if _G.Copier_UIHidden then pcall(F.ToggleUI) end
    for _,connection in ipairs(OwnedConnections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end; table.clear(OwnedConnections)
    for _,group in pairs(UI.Rows) do for _,connection in ipairs(group) do connection:Disconnect() end end
    for _,tween in pairs(UI.Tweens) do pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end) end
    if UI.Toasts then pcall(function() UI.Toasts:Destroy() end) end
    pcall(Thumbs.clearAll); pcall(UI.clearMenuAvatar); pcall(Ident.cleanup)
    for _,row in ipairs(Mirror.Sources or {}) do pcall(function() row.Model:Destroy() end) end
    pcall(Sync.close); pcall(Overlay.clearAll); Presence.Closed = true
    for _,item in ipairs({UI.Gui,UI.Blur,UI.ChatCommand}) do if item then pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end end
    if S.cD then pcall(function() S.cD:Destroy() end) end
    if S.customDesc then pcall(function() S.customDesc:Destroy() end) end
    if S.gameDescription then pcall(function() S.gameDescription:Destroy() end) end
    if App.ModelCache then pcall(function() App.ModelCache.Model:Destroy() end); App.ModelCache=nil end
    if App.SavedPreviewDesc then pcall(function() App.SavedPreviewDesc:Destroy() end) end
    if App.LiveLook then pcall(function() App.LiveLook.Description:Destroy() end) end
    if UI.InspectDesc then pcall(function() UI.InspectDesc:Destroy() end) end
    if UI.InspectView then pcall(function() UI.InspectView:Destroy() end) end
    if UI.InspectOverlay then pcall(function() UI.InspectOverlay:Destroy() end) end
    Visual.clearCache()
    for _,row in pairs(App.Cache) do pcall(function() row.Profile.Description:Destroy() end) end
    _G.Copier_HookContext=nil; _G.Copier_ToolsGiverToggle=nil
end
_G.Copier_Cleanup=cleanup

local built,buildError=xpcall(function()
    pcall(Lang.load, Store.Settings.Language)
    -- Chat availability is asked first. Start hidden with the floating button off waits (at most 2 s) for the
    -- answer, because it decides whether anything could bring the window back.
    UI.detectChat()
    if Store.Settings.StartHidden and not Store.Settings.MobileOrb then
        local deadline=os.clock()+2
        while not UI.ChatChecked and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
    end
    -- Auto-load starts first: its avatar is fetched and built while the window is being made (see Auto.prefetch).
    pcall(Auto.prefetch)
    UI.buildShell()
    -- The rest of the window is built in short steps, so a slower phone keeps drawing the game meanwhile instead of
    -- freezing until the whole window is made. The window (and its floating button) stays hidden until it is complete.
    local shownMain, shownOrb = UI.Main.Visible, UI.Orb.Visible
    UI.Main.Visible = false; UI.Orb.Visible = false
    local slice = os.clock()
    for _, step in ipairs({UI.buildAvatar, UI.buildPlayers, UI.buildCollection, UI.buildLooks, UI.buildCatalog, UI.buildCustomize, UI.buildAuto,
        function() pcall(Plugins.read) end, UI.buildPlugins, UI.buildSettings, UI.buildCreator, UI.buildModal, UI.inputs}) do
        step()
        if os.clock() - slice > 1 / 30 then
            task.wait(); slice = os.clock()
            -- The script was run again meanwhile: the new run takes over.
            if not App.alive() then return end
        end
    end
    UI.Main.Visible = shownMain; UI.Orb.Visible = shownOrb
    App.Notify=function(message,kind)
        local colors={error=UI.C.Red,warning=UI.C.Gold,success=UI.C.Green,loading=UI.C.Accent,info=UI.C.Muted}
        UI.StatusText.Text=Lang.text(message); UI.StatusText.TextColor3=colors[kind] or UI.C.Muted; UI.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3=colors[kind] or UI.C.Accent
        if kind=="error" then warn("[Lyra Avatar Studio] "..message) end
    end
    App.Refresh=UI.refresh
    -- Toasts use the icon sheet for named icons; without it every toast falls back to its built-in glyph.
    -- They sit in the bottom-right corner on every device, inset just enough never to be cut off.
    UI.Toasts=Toast.new({Parent=UI.Surface,Font=UI.Font,Max=4,Margin=10,
        Icon=function(parent,name,position,color)
            assert(UI.IconSheet and UI.IconIndex[UI.IconAlias[name] or name],"Icon sheet unavailable")
            return UI.icon(parent,name,position,color)
        end,
        Theme={Background=UI.C.Base,Text=UI.C.Text,Muted=UI.C.Muted,Line=UI.C.Line,
            Kinds={info=UI.C.Accent,success=UI.C.Green,warning=UI.C.Gold,error=UI.C.Red}},
        ReducedMotion=function() return Store.Settings.ReducedMotion end})
    App.ToastSink=function(spec) UI.Toasts:Notify(spec) end
    pcall(App.writeLoaderFlag)
    pcall(App.queueTeleport)
    pcall(App.adoptCarry)
    App.captureInitial(lp.Character)
    -- Your own avatar's saved item adjustments (see SAVED ADJUSTMENTS).
    pcall(Tweaks.watchSelf, lp.Character)
    -- The tab that was open last time (and where it was scrolled to), unless the script was started to copy someone.
    local lastTab=UI.loadHubState()
    UI.selectTab((lastTab and Config.TargetUsername=="" and UI.Pages[lastTab]) and lastTab or "Avatar"); UI.refresh(); UI.layout(true)
    pcall(UI.Decor.apply)
    task.defer(function() if App.alive() then UI.layout(true); if Store.LoadIssue then App.report(Store.LoadIssue,"warning") end end end)
    if Config.TargetUsername~="" and (Config.CopyAvatar or Config.CopyAvatarHD) then
        UI.SearchBox.Text=Config.TargetUsername; UI.query(Config.TargetUsername,true)
    end
    Auto.startTimer()
    -- Start hidden: the window was built closed (no flash); say how to reopen it when there is no floating button.
    if not UI.Visible then UI.effects(); UI.hiddenHint() end
    if UI.StartSkipped then App.report("Start hidden was skipped: nothing could reopen the window. Turn on a way to reopen it in Settings.","warning") end
    Auto.boot()
    UI.schedulePromo()
    Sync.start()
    Presence.start()
    Mirror.watch()
    Thumbs.watchCore()
    pcall(UI.watchInspect)
    task.defer(function() if App.alive() then pcall(Ident.refresh) end end)
    task.spawn(Plugins.boot)
end,function(err) return tostring(err) end)
-- If the window itself failed to build there is no GUI to show a toast in, so this one message uses Roblox's notification.
if not built then cleanup(); warn("[Lyra Avatar Studio] The hub could not be opened: "..tostring(buildError)); pcall(function() SG:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="Avatar Studio",Text="The interface could not be opened. Check the console.",Duration=8}) end) end
